tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Lusuku Lwenkhululeko Lwebetindzaba.
tgt: Siku ra Ntshunxeko wa Swihangalasamahungu.

src: IKhabhinethi nayo njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ibungata Lusuku Lwenkhululeko Lwebetindzaba ngaLesine, mhla ti-19 ku-Okthoba 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tsundzuka Siku ra Ntshunxeko wa Swihangalasamahungu hi Ravumune, 19 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Betindzaba badlala indzima lebaluleke kakhulu ekulweni nelubandlululo, kuveta lababulawa ngesihluku neludlame lebekwentiwa ngumbuso welubandlululo.
tgt: Swihangalasamahungu swi tirhile ntirho wa nkoka swonghasi eka ku lwisana na xihlawuhlawu, ku humesela erivaleni maxangu na tihanyi leti endliweke hi mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu.

src: Lomnyaka ngewe-40 kusukela hulumende welubandlululo wavala kusebenta kwemaphephandzaba lebekanenchubekela phambili lafana ne-World, Weekend World kanye ne-Voice.
tgt: Nan'waka ri fungha 40 wa malembe kusukela loko mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu wu yirisile maphephahungu yo seketela ncinco wa vaaki yo tanihi World, Weekend World na Voice.

src: Namuhla, kukhululeka kwebetindzaba kukhutsatwa ngalokugcwele kuMtsetfosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika futsi kuyohlala kuyincenye lebalulekile kulelive letfu lelisatfutfuka.
tgt: Namuntlha, ntshunxeko wa swihangalasamahungu wu simekiwile hi ndlela yo tiya eka Vumbiwa ra Afrika-Dzonga naswona wu tama wa ha ri xihlawulekisi xa nkoka xa rixaka ra ka hina leri hluvukaka.

src: IKhabhinethi ibuye ikhutsate bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke batfutfukise kufinyelela kulwatiso nekusebentisa lelilungelo lekukhululeka kwebetindzaba ngendlela lefanele kute basite ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika lebumbene, lengacwasi ngekwebuhlanga, lengacwasi ngekwebulili, lebuswa ngentsandvo yelinyenti futsi lenemphumelelo kubo bonkhe bantfu.
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi khutaza yi MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va kondletela mfikelelo eka mahungu na ku tirhisa mfanelo ya ntshuxeko wa swihangalasamahungu hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri ku pfuna ku aka Afrika-Dzonga ra hinkwavo leri nga na vun'we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu, ra xidemokirasi na ku va leri humelelaka.

src: Umnotfo Waselwandle.
tgt: Ikhonomi ya Malwandle.

src: IKhabhinethi ishayela tandla Mengameli Jacob Zuma ngekwetfula umbiko walokuchubekako kulabo labantsintsekako ngekucala kwekusebenta kwe-Operation Phakisa:Umnotfo Waselwandle nekumema bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi bachubeke basebentisane nahulumende ekuveteni ematfuba emnotfo lakhona kumalwandle etfu.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Jacob Zuma eku nyikeni xiviko eka vakhumbheki eka nsimeko wa Operation Phakisa eka Ikhonomi ya Malwandle naswona yi rhamba vakhumbheki hikwavo ku ya emahlweni va tirhisana na mfumo ku humesa vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya malwandle ya hina.

src: Umnotfo Waselwandle sewuvele wente ligalelo lelilinganiselwa ku- 4.4% kuMikhicito Wonkhe weNingizimu Afrika (i-GDP) kantsi umbiko waMengameli kulaba labatsintsekako ukhombisa ngalokugcwele kwekutsi umtamo lomkhulu nekusekelwa kwabo bonkhe labasebentisana nahulumende labangenelele kulamatfuba lamakhulu lavelako.
tgt: Ikhonomi ya Malwandle se yi hoxile xandla hi kwalomu ka 4.4% eka Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa Tiko swa Afrika-Dzonga naswona xiviko xa Phuresidente eka vanghenisaxandla xi kombisa hi ndlela ya matimba matshalatshala ya nhlanganelo na nseketelo wa vatirhisani hinkwavo va mfumo lava tirhisaka vuswikoti lebyikulu.

src: Imiiklamo yeMnotfo Waselwandle kwanyalo seyivule imali lengemabhiliyoni lange-R.6 lesisiwe levela ngalokuhlanganisiwe kuhulumende kanye nemkhakha walabatimele, kantsi seyakhe ematfuba emsebenti langetulu kwa-6 500.
tgt: Tiphurojeke ta Ikhonomi ya Malwandle kufika sweswi ti humesile R.6 wa tibiliyoni leti katsanisiweke eka vuvekisi kusuka eka mfumo na sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo, naswona ti tumbuluxile ku tlula 6 500 wa mitirho.

src: Kusisa lokukhulu kunakokonkhe lokuvela kuMnotfo Waselwandle, lolawulwa ngekukhutsatwa tinsita tahulumende, locondziswe ekutfutfukiseni tinsitanchanti, ikakhulukati emachweba, kukhicita, kwakha imikhumbi, tekulima taselwandle nekwenta lucwaningo lwesayensi kumkhakha wawoyela negesi.
tgt: Vuvekisi lebyikulu eka Ikhonomi ya Malwandle, lebyi fambisiweke hi ku tirhisa swinavetisi swa mfumo, byi kongomisiwile eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa, ngopfungopfu mihlaluko, vumaki, vumakaswikwekwetsu, nkuriso wa swiharhi na swimilani swa le matini na mivalango ya xisayense eka sekitara ya oyili na gasi.

src: Tinhlelo tahulumende kusungula sikhungo sinye lesikhulukati sekwakha imikhumbi eNingizimu ne-Afrika.
tgt: Mfumo wu kunguhata ku tumbuluxa xitirhisiwa xa vumakelaswikwekwetsu xin'we lexikulu eka hinkwaswo edzongeni wa Afrika.

src: IKwaZulu-Natal Boatbuilding Park letfolakala kulichweba laseDurban itawungenisa ematfuba kubasisi labasha, kutfunyelwa kwemikhicito ngaphandle nekwakha ematfuba emsebenti.
tgt: Phaka ya Vumakaswikwekwetsu ya KwaZulu-Natal eka Hlaluko ra Durban yi ta hlengeleta vuswikoti kusuka eka vuvekisi lebyintshwa, tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.

src: Kuvakasha kweMbuso eZambia.
tgt: Vuendzi bya mfumo ku ya eZambia.

src: IKhabhinethi yamukela lemiphumela yeKuvakasha kweMbuso lokwentiwe nguMengameli Zuma eRiphabhulikhi yaseZambia kusukela ngamhlaka-12 kuya ku-13 Imphala 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo kusuku eka Vuendzi bya Mfumo bya Phuresidente Zuma ku ya eRhiphabuliki ra Zambia kusuka hi ti 12 kufika ti 13 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Lokuchumana emkhatsini waMengameli Zuma kanye nemlingani wakhe waseZambia Mengameli Edgar Lungu kucinise budlelwane lobuhle lebebukhona kutepolitiki, umnotfo nemasiko emkhatsini walamave lamabili, lobusekelwe tibopho leticinile tangalesikhatsi lesesadlula kusukela ngaleminyaka yekulwela inkhululeko.
tgt: Min'wangulano exikarhi ka Phuresidente Zuma na ntangha yakwe hi ntirho ya Zambia Edgar Lungu yi tiyisile vuxaka lebyi nga kona bya xipolitiki, xiikhonomi na vuxaka bya mfuwo exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi, lebyi seketeriwaka hi vuxaka bya swa matimu byo tiya lebyi tumbulukeke kusuka emalembeni ya nyimpi ya ntshuxeko.

src: LeTinhloko teMbuso letimbili tivule ngalokusemtsetfweni indzawo yemagugu i-OR Tambo National Heritage leseChelstone, eLusaka, ngekuhlonipha ligalelo lelafakwa ngu-OR Tambo lekulwela inkhululeko yemave aseNingizimu ne-Afrika.
tgt: Tiphuresidente letimbirhi ti pfurile ximfumo ndhawu ya OR Tambo National Heritage eChelstone, Lusaka, hi ku xixima vuhoxaxandla bya OR Tambo eka nyimpi ya ntshuxeko edzongeni wa Afrika.

src: I-Zambia iyohlala ingulelinye lemave lahambembili kulesigodzi ekuhwebelaneni neNingizimu Afrika nakumhlaba wonkhe jikelele.
tgt: Zambia yi tama ya ha ri rin'wana ra vatirhisani va bindzu va le henhla va Afrika-Dzonga exifundzeni na le tikwenikulu.

src: Kubambisana kutemnotfo emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neZambia kuyachubeka nekukhula, imikhicito yaseNingizimu Afrika letfunyelwa eZambia ilinganiselwa kumabhiliyoni lange-R30 wemarandi nga-2016.
tgt: Ntirhisano wa swa ikhonomi exikarhi xa Afrika-Dzonga na Zambia wu ya emahlweni wu kula, laha tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe ta Afrika-Dzonga ku ya eZambia ti endleke kwalomu ka R30 wa tibiliyoni hi lembe ra 2016.

src: Lamave lamabili asebentisana kumikhakha leminyenti, kufaka ekhatsi kuhwebelana nekusisa, isayensi netheknoloji, tekuvikela, tekulima, temvelo, emandla netemphilo.
tgt: Matiko lamambirhi ya tirhisana eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana, ku katsa mabindzu na vuvekisi, sayense na thekinoloji, vusirheleri, vurimi, mbangu, eneji na rihanyo.

src: Kuvakashela iNigeria ngekwemsebenti.
tgt: Vuendzi byo tirha ku ya eNigeria.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Mengameli Zuma ngekuhlonishwa ngesitfombe lesibatiwe kanye nesitaladi lesibitwe ngeligama lakhe eNigeria, ngalesikhatsi avakashe ngekwemsebenti kuyicinisa budlelwano bekusebentisana kutemnotfo kanye nalamanye emabhizinisi.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Zuma eka ku va a xiximiwile hi xifaniso na xitarata leswi thyiweke mavito ya yena eNigeria, hi nkarhi wa vuendzi byo tirha ku tiyisa vuxaka bya vaaki na ikhonomi na mitirhisano yin'wana.

src: Umphatsi weSifundza sase-Imo, Rochas Okorocha, uhloniphe Mengameli Zuma nge-Imo Merit Award, lekungumklomela lomkhulukati kulesifundza kantsi kuhlonishwa ngawo labo labente umehluko ekutfutfukiseni imimmango yabo.
tgt: Gavhenara wa Xifundzakulu xa Imo, Rochas Okorocha, u nyikile Phuresidente Zuma Sagwati ra Meriti ya Imo, sagwati ra le henhlahenhla ra Xifundzakulu leri nyikiwaka lava endleke ku hambana eka nhluvukiso wa le migangeni ya ka vona.

src: Umhlangano we-17 waboNdvuna weMkandlu we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA).
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Huvo ya Vaholobye ya Indian Ocean Rim (IORA) ya vu Afrika-Dzonga ri sungule Vutshamaxitulu bya IORA eka nhlengeletano ya vu 17 leyi khomeriweke eDurban kusuka hi ti 14 kufika 18 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Ingcikitsi yeNingizimu Afrika ngalesikhatsi sayo itsi “Kuhlanganisa bantfu base-Afrika, Asia, Australasia naseMiddle East Ngekusebentisa Kubambisana Lokunotsile Kwentela Kuthula, Kusimama Nentfutfuko Lelawulekako”.
tgt: Nkongomelo wa Afrika-Dzonga wa nkarhi wa rona wa ku va ehofisini i “Ku Hlanganisa Vanhu va Afrika, Asia, Australasia na Middle East hi Ntirhisano lowu Antswisiweke wa ku Rhula, Ntshamiseko na Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni”.

src: IKhabhinethi ibuye yacinisekisa kutinikela kwayo ngalokuba ngusihlalo kuchubekisa kubambisana etigodzini nakumikhakha lefana nemnotfo waselwandle kusekela bomake ngemandla kutemnotfo kutfutfukisa emabhizinisi lasemancane, lasemkhatsini nalamakhulu kuniketa lusha emandla, nekusebentisana kwalabafundzile, kusayensi netheknoloji.
tgt: Khabinete yi vule nakambe ku tiboha ka yona hi vutshamaxitulu lebyi eka ntirhisano wa xifundza wo yisa emahlweni eka swiyenge swo tanihi ikhonomi ya malwandle ku nyika matimba eka ikhonomi wa vavasati ku tlakusa mabindzu lamatsongo, ya le xikarhi na lamatsongo swinene ku nyika matimba eka vantshwa, na ntirhisano eka swa tidyondzo, sayense na thekinoloji.

src: Imihlangano yemnyaka yeSikhwama Setetimali Temhlaba (i-IMF) neLibhange Lemhlaba.
tgt: Tinhlengeletano ta lembe na lembe ta Nkwama wa Timali wa Matiko ya Misava (IMF) na Bangi ya Misava.

src: IKhabhinethi yabikelwa nguNdvuna weTetimali, MnuMalusi Gigaba, ngemuva kwekungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika emihlanganweni yemnyaka yanga-2017 ye-IMF neLibhange Lemhlaba, lebeyibanjwe kusukela ngamhla ti-13 kuya ku-15 Imphala 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat.

src: Lemihlangano yaniketa litfuba lekuhlatiya inchubo yamhlaba wonkhe etindzabeni letiphatselene nekutfutfuka bese ichaza kancono umtamo weNingizimu Afrika wekutfutfukiswa kwemnotfo, kukhula lokufaka ekhatsi yonkhe intfo, kwakhiwa kwematfuba emsebenti nekunciphisa kuhlupheka.
tgt: Malusi Gigaba, hikwalaho ka vungheneri bya Afrika-Dzonga eka tinhlengeletano ta lembe na lembe ta Bangi ya Misava na IMF ya 2017, leti veke kona kusuka hi ti 13 kufika ti 15 Nhlangula 2017.

src: IKhabhinethi yabuye yatiswa ngemhlangano waNdvuna Gigaba lekawubambe naletikhungo letitimele letihlola lizinga letimali nebasisi kute kucinisekiswe tinchubumgomo letikhona nyalo eNingizimu Afrika kanye nendlela lekulawulwa ngayo timali takuleli.
tgt: Tinhlengeletano ti nyike xivandlanene xa ku hlela nhluvuko wa matiko eka timhaka ta nhluvukiso na ku tivisa mapfhumba ya rona Afrika-Dzonga eka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki, ku kula loku katsaka hinkwaswo, ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku hungutiwa ka vusweti.

src: IKhabhinethi yenelisekile ngalokucinisekiswa lokuniketwe basisi ngetinhlelo tahulumende tekukhulisa umnotfo nekutinikela kwahulumende ekulungiseni tinkhinga tekulawula kutikhungo tetfu letiphetfwe ngumbuso.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi hlamuseriwa ku ya emahlweni hi nhlengeletano leyi Holobye Gigaba a yi khomeke na tiejensi to pima swikweleti swa matiko lama tifumaka na vavekisi ku tiyisisa nakambe tipholisi na maendlelo ya nkarhi wa sweswi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka matikhomelo lamanene ya swa timali.

src: Sitatimende Senchubomgomo Yekwabiwa Kwemali Emkhatsini Nemnyaka sitawetfulwa ePhalamende, eKapa, ngamhla tinge-25 Imphala kantsi sitawucacisa ngetinhlelo tekucitfwa kwemali yahulumende kuleminyaka lemitsatfu letako.
tgt: Khabinete ya eneriseka hi ku tiyisisa nakambe loku nyikiweke vavekisi eka makungu ya mfumo ya ku kurisa ikhonomi na ku tiboha ka mfumo ku tirhana na swiphiqo swa mfumo eka mavandla ya ka hina lama nga ehansi ka vun'wini bya mfumo.

src: IKhabhinethi ishayele tandla lokusekelwa ngemandla ekutfutfukiseni tinsitanchanti tahulumende ngekutsi kuniketwe ngalokusemtsetfweni emabhuloho lamatsatfu laseBotlokwa eLimpopo aniketwa nguMengameli Zuma ngamhla ti-17 Imphala 2017.
tgt: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi xi ta andlariwa ePalamende, eKapa, hi ti 25 Nhlangula naswona xi ta katsakanya makungu ya matirhiselo ya timali ya mfumo eka malembe manharhu lama taka.

src: Inhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika Yemigwaco Yavelonkhe (i-Sanral) yakhe lamabhuloho aseBotlokwa, lafaka ekhatsi libhuloho linye lelisetjentiswa timoto nemabhuloho lamabili lasetjentiswa bantfu labahamba ngetinyawo laku-N1 emkhatsini wePolokwane neMakhado.
tgt: Khabinete hi hoyozerile mpfuneto lowukulu eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa mfumo hi ku hundzisiwa ka ximfumo ka mabiloho manharhu eBotlokwa eLimpopo hi Phuresidente Zuma hi ti 17 Nhlangula 2017.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi lomklamo utawutfutfukisa kakhulu simo setekutfutsa kanye nekuphepha kubo bonkhe labasebentisa umgwaco kuleyo ndzawo.
tgt: Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga yi akile mabuloho ya Botlokwa, lama nga na buloho rin'we ra gondzo na mabuloho mambirhi ya van'wamilenge eN1 exikarhi Polokwane na Makhado.

src: Emabhizinisi lasemancane nalasafufusa.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku phurojeke leyi yi ta antswisa swinene swiyimo swa ku teka tendzo na vuhlayiseki bya vatirhisi va magondzo hinkwavo endhawini leyi.

src: IKhabhinethi ishayela tandla Litiko letekutfutfukiswa Kwemabhizinisi Lamancane ngekutsi lomnyaka isebentisane neChina International Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) Fair, njengoba loku kuba neligalelo ekuvuleleni emabhizinisi aseNingizimu Afrika lasemancane kanye netinkampani letisafufusa ematfuba ekutsengisa mikhicitho yato eChina.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo eka ku rhurhela Nkombiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo na ya le Xikarhi (SME) ya Matiko ya China, tanihileswi wu hoxaka xandla eka ku humesa makete wa China wa mabindzu lamatsongo na mabindzu ya nhlanganelo ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Le-SME Fair itawubanjelwa eGuangzhou, eChina kusukela ngamhla ti-10 kuya ku-27 Imphala 2017.
tgt: Nkombiso wa SME wu le ku yeni emahlweni eGuangzhou, China kusuka hi ti 10 kufika ti 27 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Emabhizinisi lasemancane asisekelo semnotfo wetfu nenjini yekukhula kwemnotfo nekusungula ematfuba emsebenti eNingizimu Afrika, kantsi kungenelela kulemibukiso wekuhwebelana kusinikete litfuba lekutsengisa imikhicito yetfu kanye nekukhulisa emabhizinisi.
tgt: Mabindzu lamatsongo hi wona xivindzi xa ikhonomi ya hina na njhini ya ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho eAfrika-Dzonga, naswona ku nghenela ka hina eka nkombiso wa mabindzu ku tlakusile mfikelelo eka timakete na swivandlanene eka ku kurisa mabindzu.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi loku kukhombisa kutinikela kwahulumende kulenjongo yekutfutfukisa nekusimamisa temabhizinisi.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku leswi swi kombisa ku tiboha ka mfumo eka xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa na ku yisa emahlweni vubindzu.

src: Kusisa kumabhizinisi lasemancane kutawusita lelive kutsi likhone kubukana naletinselele temnotfo netenhlalo letikhona nyalo.
tgt: Ku vekisa eka mabindzu lamatsongo swi ta pfuna tiko ku angula eka mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi ya vaaki ya sweswi.

src: Tekuvakasha.
tgt: Vupfhumba.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela lokusungulwa kweLuhlelo lwaVelonkhe Lwebacapheli Betekuvakasha eSoweto, ngaLesibili, ngamhla ti-17 Imphala 2017, loluhlose kutfutfukisa kutitfokotisa kwetivakashi nekwenta kancono luhlelo lwekuphepha kwetivakashi.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phurogireme ya Valanguteri va Vupfhumba ya Rixaka eSoweto, hi Ravumbirhi, 17 Nhlangula 2017, leri nga na xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa ntokoto wa vaendzi xikan'we na ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba.

src: Litiko Letekuvakasha, libambisene neNhlangano yeTekuvakasha eGauteng, basungule loluhlelo kwekucala eVilakazi Street, lekungiso kuphela sitaladi mhlaba wonkhe lebesihlala bantfu lababili labakhulu labahlonishwa nge-Nobel Peace Prize – Mengameli wangaphambilini Nelson Mandela na-Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba, hi ku tirhisana na Vulawuri bya Vupfhumba bya Gauteng, yi simekile pfhumba eXitarateni xa Vilakazi, lexi xi nga xitarata xi ri xoxe emisaveni lexi tinyungubyisaka hi vutshamo bya Vaxiximiwa va Sagwati ra Nobel vambirhi – Khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela na Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.

src: Loluhlelo luhambisana netinjongo teLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekutfutfukisa (i-NDP) tekwakha ematfuba emsebenti kubantfu labasha laba-200, labatawuceceshelwa kutsi babe ngebacapheli etindzaweni letivakashelwako sikhatsi lesilinganiselwa etinyangeni leti-36.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ri fambisana na swikongomelo swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka (NDP) naswona ri na xikongomelo xa ku tumbuluxa mitirho ya 200 ya vantshwa, lava va nga ta leteriwa ku va valanguteri eka tindhawu ta vupfhumba ku ringana nkarhi wa 36 wa tin'hweti.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata banikati bemabhizinisi nebantfu baseGauteng kutsi basebentisane nalabacapheli betekuvakasha kute kutfutfukiswe kuphepha kwetivakashi kute kuvikelwe ematfuba etemnotfo lavela kulemboni.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vini va mabindzu na miganga eGauteng ku tirha na valanguteri va vupfhumba ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba na ku lawula vuswikoti bya ikhonomi kusuka eka xiyenge leyi.

src: Isayensi neTheknoloji.
tgt: Sayense na Thekinoloji.

src: IKhabhinethi yamukela ibuye ihalalisele bososayensi labangenelele lucwaningo lobelusentiwa ngematheleskophu e-South African Astronomical Observatory (i-SAAO) kanye ne-Southern African Large Telescope (i-SALT).
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela na ku hoyozela vativi va sayenselava va ngheneleke mbalango wa tithelesikopu wa Muako wa Thelesikopu ya Ntivotinyeleti wa Afrika-Dzonga (SAAO) na Thelesikopu Leyikulu ya Dzongeni wa Afrika (SALT).

src: Loku kugcine kuphumelelisa ekucebentisaneni kwekucala lokuhambembili kwamhlaba wonkhe kute kuphandvwe ngemsuka wekubonwa kwekucala kwema-gravitational waves lakheka uma ngabe kushayisana tinkhanyeti letincane kakhulu letimbili.
tgt: Leswi swi vangile ntirhisano wa matiko lowu nga si tshamaka wu va kona ku lavisisa masungulo ya vuthumbhi byo sungula bya gandlati ra giravhithi leri humesiweke hi tinyeleti timbirhi ta tinyutironi leti tlumbaneke.

src: Lokushayisana kubuye kubangele kudubuka kwekukhanya lokubitwa nge-kilonova.
tgt: Nakambe ntlumbano lowu wu tlhele wu vanga mbhuluko wa khilonovha wa ku vonakala.

src: I-kilonova sehlakalo lesenteka emkhatsini lapho khona tinkhanyenti letincanekakhulu letimbili letijikeletako tishayisana noma inkhanyeti lencane kakhulu tihlangana ndzawonye ne-black hole.
tgt: Khilonovha i xiendleko xa ntivotinyeleti lexi endlekaka eka sisiteme ya swilo swimbirhi loko tinyeleti ta tinyutironi timbirhi kumbe nyeleti ya nyutironi na nkele wa ntima swi pfangana.

src: Lama-gravitational waves abaluleke kakhulu kutifundvo te-astrophysics, sehlakalo sekucala sasemkhatsini lesitfolakele kuko kokubili lekungemagagasi e-gravity nekukhanya.
tgt: Vuthumbhi lebyi byi fungha ku fika ka nkarhi lowuntshwa wa asitirofizikisi, xiendleko xa ntumbuluko wa misava na tinyeleti lexi voniweke eka ngulumelo wa nkokelamisaveni na ku vonakala.

src: I-SALT nalamanye amatheleskophu e-SAAO anikete idatha yekucala ngca ngalesigameko kutfolakala kutsi sijike saba ngulesinye lesesifundvwe kakhulu kutigameko te-astrophysics emlandvweni.
tgt: SALT na tithelesikopu tin'wana ta SAAO ti nyikile switiviwa swo sungulasungula eka leswi swi vonakaka swi ri swiendleko swa asitirofizikisi leswi nga tshama swi dyondziwa.

src: I-SALT ne-SAAO asekhatsi kwetikhungo letinge-70 letinematheleskophu atfolakala phansi nasemkhatsini labone lokudubuka lokubangelwa kushayisana kwetinkhanyeti letimbili letincane kakhulu, ngekushesha ngemuva kwekubonakala kwemagagasi e-gravity lekabonwa yi-Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory lese-United States kanye ne-Virgo lese-Europe.
tgt: SALT na SAAO ti le xikarhi ka yin'wana ya 70 ya miako ya thelesikopu leyi kumekaka ehansi na le mpfhukeni leyi hlanganeke na ku buluka wa lokukulu ka tinyeleti timbirhi ta nyutironi leti tlumbaneke, xikan'wekan'we endzhaku ka loko magandlati ya xoko ya giravhithi ya thumbhiwile hi Muako wa Thelesikopu wa Magandlati ya Giravhithi ya Nkatsano wa ku Vonakala ka Leyizara lowu kumekaka eUnited States na muthumbhi wa Virgo loyi a kumekaka eYuropa.

src: Umgidvo Wamhlabawonkhe weLusha neTitjudeni.
tgt: Nkhuvu wa Misava wa Vantshwa na Swichudeni.

src: I-Russia itawubungata Umgidvo Wamhlabawonkhe weLusha neTitjudeni wanga-2017 kusukela ngamhla ti-14 kuya mhla tinge-22 Imphala 2017, lewutawuhanjelwa bantfu labasha labangetulu kwabanga-20 000 labavela emaveni la-150.
tgt: Russia yi le ku rhurheleni Nkhuvu wa Misava wa Vantshwa na Swichudeni wa 2017 kusuka hi ti 14 kufika 22 Nhlangula 2017, lowu ku nga ku ngheneleleni ka ku tlula 20 000 wa vantshwa vo huma eka 150 wa matiko.

src: Injongo yalomgidvo kuhlanganisa ndzawonye lusha lwasemaveni onkhe emhlabeni atodzingidza ludzaba lwebulungiswa, kuciniswa kwebudlelwano bemave amhlabawonkhe, nekutfutfukiswa kwebudlelwano betinhlanga letihlukene nemasiko lahlukene.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa nkhuvu i ku tisa endhawini yin'we vantshwa va misava eka mhaka ya vululami, ku tiyisa vuxaka bya matiko, na nhluvukiso wa vuxaka bya le xikarhi ka tinxaka na bya le xikarhi ka mifuwo.

src: Kuvikelwa kwebantfwana.
tgt: Nsirhelelo wa vana.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka ngekutfolakala kwemibiko lekhatsatako yebugebengu lobufaka ekhatsi bantfwana, lesandza kwenteka ngulena yekuhlukumeta ngetemacansi bafundzi labandlula kuma-80 eSikolweni Semabanga Laphansi i-AB Xuma lesise-Orlando, eSoweto, bahlukunyetwa ngunogadza.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombisile ku khumbeka hikwalaho ka swiviko swo vavisa swa vugevenga ehenhla ka vana, xin'wana lexa ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale ngopfu ku nga nxaniso wa swa masangu lowu ehleketeleriwaka wa ku tlula 80 wa vana va xikolo eka Xikolo xa le Hansi xa AB Xuma eOrlando, Soweto hi murindzi wo tsemakanyisa vana va xikolo gondzo.

src: Litiko lakulesifundza lishayelwa tandla ngalokuphendvula ngekushesha ngekutsi likhiphe, ngekushesha, baphatsi kulesikolo, baletse bosonhlalakahle babuye basungule luphenyo lolwentiwa ngumtimba lotimele.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya xifundzakulu ya hoyozeriwa eka n'wangulo wa xihatla hi ku susa, xikan'wekan'we, vufambisinkulu bya xikolo, ku tisiwa vakondleteri na ku simeka vulavisisi hi huvo leyi tiyimeleke.

src: IKhabhinethi icela yonkhe imimango eNingizimu Afrika kutsi isebentisane kute ivikele bonkhe bantfwana kunoma nguyiphi inhlobo yengoti noma kuhlukunyetwa, nekutsi basebentisane nemaphoyisa asendzaweni kute imimango yetfu igcinwe iphephile.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga ku tirhisana ku sirhelela vana hinkwavo eka muxaka wihi kumbe wihi wa khombo na nxaniso, na ku tirhisana na maphorisa ya muganga ku endla miganga yi tshama yi hlayisekile.

src: Luhlolo.
tgt: Swikambelo.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi luhlolo lwekuphela kwemnyaka etikolweni lutawuchubeka ngaphandle kwekuphatamiseka kulandzela lokushuca lokukhulu kwaleliviki lebekuholwa yi-South African Democratic Teachers’ Union (i-SADTU).
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku swikambelo swa xikolo swa ku hela ka lembe swi ta ya emahlweni ku ri hava nkavanyeto endzhaku ka ku kombisa ku vilela ka ntshungu ka vhiki leri leyi loku a ku rhangeriwile hi Nhlangano wa Vadyondzisi wa Xidemokirasi wa Afrika-Dzonga (SADTU).

src: I-SADTU inikete Ndvuna weteMfundvo Lesisekelo, Make Angie Motshekga, luhlu lwetikhalo yena lotinikele ekusombululeni tinkinga lebakhala ngato ngekushesha.
tgt: SADTU yi nyikile memorandamu eka Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Hansi, Man.

src: Kubalulekile kwekutsi bonkhe labatsintsekako basebentisane ekwakheni simondzawo lesifanele kute kutsi bafundzi bakhone kubukana nekufundza kanye nekubhala luhlolo.
tgt: Angie Motshekga, loyi a tiboheke ku ololoxa swiphiqo swa swivilelo hi ku hatlisa hilaha swi kotekaka hakona.

src: IKhabhinethi itsandza nekuvakalisa kubonga kwayo kubo bonkhe labatinikele, tinhlangano tonkhe tasemphakatsini, imimango, tisebenti letisitako nakunenkinga kanye nemacembu Ekulawula Tinhlekelele ngekutsi basite labo lebebatsintsekile.
tgt: I swa nkoka leswaku vakhumbheki hinkwavo va tirhisana ku tumbuluxa mbangu wo tirheka ku kotisa vadyondzi hi ndlela yo antswa ku kongomisa eka ku dyondza na swikambelo swa vona.

src: I-Life Esidimeni.
tgt: Swidzedze.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga lokucalwa kwalenchubo lekungulenye indlela yekusombulula kungaboni ngeliso linye ngalokwenteka e-Life Esidimeni lokungaba yindlela yekucala kulapheka kwalemindeni yetigulane letashona.
tgt: Khabinete yi komba nchavelelo wa le mbilwini eka varhandziwa va lavaya va lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona eka swidzedze leswa ha ku vaka kona eka swiphemu swin'wana swa tiko.

src: IKhabhinethi yendlulise kuletsemba lelijaji leselitsetse umhlalaphansi lekuLisekela Lelijaji Lelikhulu Lenkhantolo Yemtsetfosisekelo Dikgang Moseneke, lekunguye sihlalo waloludzaba kantsi ifisela emalunga emindeni emandla njengoba bahleli babukela intfo lelukhuni ngekubaliswa kwalesehlakalo.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi khensa vatinyiketi hinkwavo, mihlangano ya leyi nga na ku navela kun’we ya vaaki, miganga, vatirhi va mphalalo-mpfuno na swipanu swa Mafambiselo ya Mhangu eka ku pfuna volava va khumbekeke.

src: IKhabhinethi icinisekisiwe kwekutsi Litiko Letekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti (i-DAFF) liyawanakisisa emapulazi eveni lonkhe kute likhone kuvikela kubhebhetseka kwemkhuhlane i-Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5I-avian influenza itfolakale etinyonini nasetinkhukhwini.
tgt: Des van Rooyen, eka xiyimo xa yena tanihi murhangeri wa Senthara ya Mafambiselo ya Mhangu ya Rixaka eAfrika-Dzonga, u endzerile tindhawu leti khumbekeke hi swidzedze na timpfula ta matimba eka Masipalankulu wa Doroba ra eThekwini eKwaZulu-Natal hi ti 13 Nhlangula 2017 na le ka Masipala wa Muganga wa Doroba ra Mogale eGauteng hi ti 16 Nhlangula 2017.Hikwalaho ka timpfula ta matimba na swidzedze leswi hlaseleke swiphemu swo tala swa tiko, 19 wa vutomi byi lahlekile na swona ku tlula 20 wa vanhu va vavisekile.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bantfu kutsi bakugweme kubamba tinyoni netinkhukhu letigulako noma letifile nekutsi bangazami kuniketa tinyoni tasendle kudla babike tinyoni labatibona ngatsi tiyagula kulabo labaphetse kuleyo ndzawo.
tgt: Nakambe Holobye van Rooyen u endzerile tindhawu ta leti ta ha ku humeleriwaka hi timhangu ePhilippi eKapa-Vupeladyambu laha tsevu wa swirho swa ndyangu, ku katsa na vana vanharhu, swi lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya swona hikwalaho ka ndzilo lowu mbumburheleke tiyindlu tinharhu ta mixaxa na vhengelexiphaza.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakugceka lokuhlaselwa lwemalunga lasitfupha eMaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika lahlaselwe e-Vanderbijlpark eGauteng ngamhla ti-10 Imphala 2017 ahlaselwa ngemalunga emphakatsi.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku sungula ka endlelo ra xitshunxo xa nkwetlembetano rin'wana ra Life Esidimeni tanihileswi swi nga ta va masungulo ya makumu eka mindyangu ya vavabyi lava loveke.

src: Letikhungo temtsetfo tiniketwe umyalelo wekuvikela imiphakatsi kunoma ngutiphi tento tebugebengu.
tgt: Khabinete yi humesa ntshembo hi vutalo eka Xandla xa Muavanyisinkulu xa Khoto ya Vumbiwa Dikgang Moseneke, loyi a fambisaka nandzu lowu naswona yi navelela hi ku tshembeka swirho swa mindyangu matimba tanihiloko swi vona leswi swi nga vaka swi ri xivangelo xo tika xa khomborifu leri.

src: Ngako-ke, akukho kukwata lokungasetjentiswa noma ngubani njengesizatfu sekuhlasela letikhungo temtsetfo.
tgt: Vulavisisi lebyi a byi fanelangi ku pfuna ntsena eka ku tisa makumu eka mindyangu leyi khumbekaka kambe na ku tirha ku nyika tidyondzo eka mfumo hi ku angarhela.

src: IKhabhinethi icela emalunga alowo mango kutsi asebentisane nemaphoyisa kutsi bagweme tento tebugebengu nekusita ekwenteni iNingizimu Afrika iphephe kuwonkhe-wonkhe.
tgt: Mfumo wa tiboha ku nyika vukorhokeri bya risima eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo.

src: IKhabhinethi ichazelwe ngalokutfolakele kanye nalokunconyiwe ngalomtselela Nekucala Kusebenta Kwekubuyeketa ngaLoluhlelo Lwetindlu Temphakatsi naloluhlelo lwekutfutfukisa, ngekuzama kucedza kwabiwa kwendzawo lebekubandlulula emalokishi nemklamo wekuhlanganisa tindlu letitfolakala emadolobheni.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshembisiwile leswaku Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Swihlahla na swa Tinhlampfi (DAFF) yi le ku endleni vulanguteri bya nkarhi hinkwawo eka mapurasi ya tiko hinkwaro hi ku ringeta ku sivela ku hangalaka ka ntungu wa Mukhuhlwana wa Tinyenyana (HPAI) H5Ntshikelelo wa mukhuhlwana wa tinyenyana wu thumbiwile eka tinyenyana.

src: Loluhlelo luniketa indzawo yekucasha lefinyelelekako yalabo labahola kancane nalabahola ngalokulinganene etindzaweni lapho khona bebangeke bakwati kukhona kuhlala khona noma baniketwe tindlu letingabaneli.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vaaki ku sukela ku khomakhoma tinyenyana to vabya na leti nga fa naswona va nga ringeti ku phamela tinyenyana ta nhova kambe va nga ha mangala tinyenyana leti ehleketeleriwaka ku va ti vabya eka vulawuri bya le ndhawini.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlaka lweLuhlelo lwe-NYS lolubuyeketiwe njengencenye yekutfutfukisa lusha njengebahlali baseNingizimu Afrika labangenelela ngalokugcwele.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlohlotela vaakandhawu lava ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku khoma swigevenga leswi na ku pfuna ku endla Afrika-Dzonga ri hlayiseka swinene eka hinkwavo.

src: I-NYS yenta kutsi lusha lwaseNingizimu Afrika luhlale lumatasatasa kantsi lufake sandla ngendlela lenhle ekutfutfukeni kwalelive ngalesikhatsi litfola kutitfutfukisa lona nangekwemfundvo.
tgt: Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi mikumo na swibumabumelo swa Nkhumbho na Nkambelo wa Nsimeko wa Phurogireme ya Tiyindlu ta Vaaki na kungu ro antswisa, hi xikongomelo xa ku ololoxa tipheteni ta matshamelo ya xihlawuhlawu hi ku antswisa ndhawu ya matshamelo na mpfanganiso wa tiphurojeke ta tiyindlu.

src: Loku kutawufaka ekhatsi lusha lolungenelela kumisebenti letawuhlomulisa imimango yakuleli ngalesikhatsi lutfutfukisa emakhono alo ngekusebenta nangekufundza kute kutsi ematfuba abente bakhone kungena ngemphumelelo emsebentini baphindze babe bosomabhizinisi.
tgt: Phurogireme leyi yi nyika vutshamo bya rhente yo fikeleleka eka mindyangu ya malinghena ya le hansi na ya le xikarhi eka tindhawu laha swiyimo swa timakete nkarhi wun'wana a swi ta va siya ehandle kumbe ku avela tiyindlu leti nga ringanelangiki.

src: Lomcimbi uhambisana ne-NDP kantsi ukhetse kukhicitwa kwekudla lokwanele njengendlela yekubukana naletinkinga letintsatfu kuswelakala kwemsebenti, buphuya nekungalingani.
tgt: Leyi i phurogiremeba yi ri roxe leyi yi susumetaka ku hakeriwa ka swikweleti yi tekelaka enhlokweni ku yiseka emhalweni ka swa timali ta nkarhi wo leha ka tiphurojeke na ku tumbuluxa ndzhendzeleko wa swa timali lowunene na vahiri lava hakelaka tirhente na mihlangano ya tiyindlu ta vaaki leyi hakelaka tirhente, swibalo, na tihakelo ta vukorhokeri eka timasipala.

src: Ingcikitsi itsi: “Kwenyusa tindlela tekulima letihlakaniphile letingakhona kumelana netimo telitulu: kuhlanganisa lusha, bomake, netingucuko kutethekinoloji”, lomcimbi utawubanjwa ngaphansi kwebuholi be-DAFF, ngekubambisana ne-South African Society for Agricultural Extension kanye ne-African Forum for Agricultural Advisory Services.
tgt: Xiviko lexi xi pfuna tindzawulo leti faneleke eka ku antswisa ku ya emahlweni makungu ya tona ya matirhelo ya tindzawulo to hambanahambana.

src: Lokuchumana lokukhulu kwe-Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services (AEAS) e-Afrika kuniketa indzawo yekufundza nekutfola tingucuko kulabo labaniketa i-AEAS e-Afrika yonkhe namhlabawonkhe.
tgt: Xiviko hi vutalo xi ta vekiwa eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo wa Matirhelo kun’we na Vulawuri (WEBTOKEN).

src: I-NDP ibuye isekele kutfutfukiswa kwemakhono nekuceceshwa kumkhakha wetekulima, kufaka ekhatsi kuceceshwa kwemacembu lamasha labatawusabela ngekushesha kutidzingo tebalimi labanemasimu lamancane.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Phurogireme ra NYS leri pfuxetiweke na ku antswisiwa tanihi xiphemu xa vantshwa tanihi vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Ekufakeni sandla ekukhishweni kwaletihibe tekuhwebelana, iKhabhinethi ibikelwe ngalokuba ngusihlalo kweNingizimu Afrika weLicembu Lemave Lahwebelana Ngewayini Mhlabawonkhe kusukela ngaMabasa 2017 kuya kuNkhwekhweti 2018.
tgt: NYS i mukotisi wa vantshwa eAfrika-Dzonga ku va vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va tiko na ku hoxa xandla hi ndlela leyinene eka nhluvukiso wa tiko loko ku ri karhi ku fikeleriwa nhluvukiso wa munhu yena n'wini na wa xiphurofexinali.

src: Lelicembu lihlose kubuketa kuhwebelana ngewayini nemave aphesheya ngekutsi aniketane lwatiso, kucocisana ngetintfo lemitsetfo lelawula emave lakhicita iwayini kanye nekusebentisane kute kukhishwe tihibe tekuhwebelana.
tgt: Leswi swi ta khumba vantshwa lava nghenelelaka eka migingiriko leyi vuyerisaka vaakandhawu va miganga loko ku ri karhi ku hluvukisiwa vuswikoti hi vukorhokeri na ku dyondza ku endlela leswaku swivandlanene swa vona swa ku nghena hi ndlela leyi humelelaka eka timakete ta vatirhi na ku va van'wamabindzu swi tiyisiwa.

src: Bakhiciti labasafufusa kanye nalabatfumela iwayini ngaphandle bakuleli laseNingizimu Afrika batawuhlomula ngekungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.

src: Loku kwenetetela kuLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfinca ne-NDP, lokuhlose kuvuselela tekulima nekuhlelenjiswa kwemikhicito yalokulinyiwe.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhurheriwa ka Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi, leyi nga ta khomeriwa eKwaZulu-Natal kusuka hi ti 30 Nhlangula kufika ti3 Hukuri 2017.

src: Kulomkhakha wewayini, inhloso kukhulisa lendzawo lengaphansi kwekukhicitwa ngewayini, bakhiciti labasebancane bese kubukwa tindzawo nemave latsite langakhetfwa kute kukhuliswe samba semkhicito wewayini lotawutfunyelwa ngaphandle.
tgt: Xiendleko lexi xi fambisana na NDP naswona xi kuma nsirhelelo wa swakudya tanihi ndlela ya ku tirhana na ntlhontlho xinharhu wa mpfumaleko wa mitirho, vusweti na nkandzingano.

src: I-ID4Africa yinhlangano lenalabatsintsekako labanyenti letfutfukisa kutsatfwa nekusetjentiswa kwethekinoloji ngalokubonakalako nangendlela lefanele kute kuhanjiswe kahle kutfutfuka kutemnotfo e-Afrika.
tgt: Nkongomelo i: “Ku tlakusa vurimi lebyi fambelanaka na maxelo: ku pfanganisa vantshwa, vavasati, na ncinco wa xidijitali”, naswona xiendleko lexi xi ta khomeriwa ehansi ka vurhangeri bya DAFF, hi ku tirhisana na Nhlangano wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Foramu ya Afrika ya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.

src: Tingcogco titawuhlosa kutfutfukisa indlela kubhaliswa kwebantfu nedatha yelubalo lebalulekile lecokelelwa ngayo, kuyihlanganisa nekuyihlatiya, kwenta lwatiso lolutsembekile lutfolakale kulabo labenta tinchubomgomo.
tgt: Netiweke leyi ya tikokulu ya Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo (AEAS) eAfrika yi nyika pulatifomo ya ku dyondzisana na maendlelo lamantshwa exikarhi vaphakeri va AEAS eAfrika na le misaveni hinkwayo.

src: Kubamba lenkhomfa kutawusita iNingizimu Afrika kutsi ibone letinye tetinjongo te-NDP kubuye kwakhe kunakwa kwemasu lasezingeni aloluhlelo lwekwatiwa eNingizimu Afrika njengaloluhlelo lwekutsatsa iphasiphoti kanye nabomatisi besimanje bemakhadi (emakhadi-matisi) kusetjentiswa i-inthanethi.
tgt: Nakambe NDP yi seketela vuantswisi eka nhluvukiso wa swikili na vuleteri eka sekitara ya vurimi, ku katsa na vuleteri bya swipanu leswintshwa swa vatirhi va mphakelo wa vuxokoxoko lava nga ta angula hi ndlela leyi vuyerisaka eka swidingo swa varimi va swipurasani.

src: IKhabhinethi ibikelwe ngetibalo tebugebengu tavelonkhe kusukela ngamhla lu-1 Mabasa 2016 kuya ku-31 Indlolenkhulu 2017.
tgt: Eka ku hoxa xandla ka ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa , khabinete hi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi Vutshamaxitulu wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava kusuka hi Dzivamisoko 2017 kufika hi Mudyaxihi 2018.

src: Letibalo temnyaka tebugebengu Ttelonkhe tenta kwekutsi hulumende akhone kulawula emanani ekulwa nebugebengu ngalokubalulekile, njengoba kubekiwe kuLuhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTSF) 2014-2019.
tgt: Tanihi mutshamaxitulu, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta rhurhela nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava eKapa kusuka hi ti1 kufika hi ti3 Hukuri 2017.

src: Letibalo tebugebengu tisetjentiswa njengesecwayiso kusenesikhatsi sekusimamisa tindlela kanye nemasu ekuvikela bugebengu alamanye ematiko.
tgt: Ntlawa lowu wu na xikongomelo xa ku fambisa bindzu ra matiko eka vhinyo hi ku tirhisa ku avelana vuxokoxoko, nkanelo wa swiphiqo swa malawulelo na swiendlo swa nhlanganelo swa ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa mabindzu.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumile kwekutsi kukhishwe lombiko lowetfulwa nguNdvuna Yetemaphoyisa, MnuFikile Mbalula.
tgt: Vahumesi lava tumbulukaka na tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe ta vumaki bya vhinyo ya Afrika-Dzonga va vuyeriwa kusuka eka vungheneri bya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: IKhabhinethi iyatfokota kwekutsi emalungiselelo ekubungata iminyaka lelikhulu yekutalwa kwa-OR Tambo sekasezingeni leliphakeme kantsi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke batifundzise ngemlandvo loshiwe lesishoshovu setfu lesalwela inkhululeko, indzima lowayidlala ekukhululekeni kwetfu, kanye nemigomo yakhe lekungiyo lesasihola nanamuhla.
tgt: Leswi swi hoxa xandla eka Kungu ra Timhaka ta Kaye na NDP, leswi swi lavaka ku pfuxeta vurimi na nkhuluko wa nkoka wa ku phurosesiwa ka swirin'wa.

src: Mengameli Zuma wetfula umnyaka wanga-2017 njengemnyaka wa-OR Tambo ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi letsi: “Imphilo neMlandvo wa-OR Tambo” kantsi ngaLesine, mhla ti-19 Imphala 2017, utawuvula sitfombe lesibatiwe sa-OR Tambo esikhumulweni setindiza i-OR Tambo International Airport, Ekurhuleni, eGauteng.
tgt: Eka sekitara ya vhinyo, xikongomelo i ku engetela ndhawu leyi nga ehansi ka vuhumesi bya vhinyo, ku seketela vahumesi va mpimo lowutsongo na ku pakanisa timakete to karhi eka ku kula ka tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe.

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi bahlanganyele kulokubungatwa kweminyaka lelikhulu, lolutawupheleliswa ngamhla tinge-27 Imphala eMbizana, eMpumalanga Kapa, lapho kwatalelwa khona lesishoshovu iminyaka le-100 lendlulile.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICKhabinete yi pasisile ku rhurhela ka Afrika-Dzonga ka Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICA hi lembe ra 2019.

src: Hulumende uyachubeka nekwakha umlandvo wa-OR Tambo kusukela nga-1994, kantsi lokuhlomula kwetfu lokunyenti njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kubungatwe futsi kuvikelwe.
tgt: ID4Africa i vandla ra vakhumbhekinyingi leri tlakusaka ku amukeriwa ka nkavuciva na loku nga na vutihlamuleri ka vutitivisi bya xidijiti eka ku fambisiwa ka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu.

src: Lelikomidi laboNdvuna leliniketwe umsebenti wekulungiselela lokubungatwa kweminyaka lelikhulu, leliholwa ngusihlalo longuNdvuna Jeff Hadebe, ngaLesihlanu, ngamhla ti-20 Imphala 2017, litawubikela betindzaba ngemalungiselelo alomkhosi.
tgt: Mikanelo yi ta lava ku antswisa ndlela ya ntsariso wa vaaki na ku va switiviwa swa tinhlayohlayo ta nkoka swi hlengeletiwa, swi fambelanisiwa na ku xopaxopiwa, ku endliwa vuxokoxoko byo tshembeka byi kumeka eka vaendli va tipholisi.

src: Ikhabinethi beyihlangene eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Tindzaba Letimcoka.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Sitatimende Senchubomgomo Yelwabiwomali Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS) Semnyaka we-2017.
tgt: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa le Xikarhi ka Theme (MTBPS) xa 2017.

src: Ikhabinethi iyayamukela i-MTBPS letfulwe Yindvuna Yetetimali, MnuMalusi Gigaba, Ephalamende, Ekapa, kuleliviki leliphelile.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela MTBPS leyi andlariweke hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat.

src: Lelwabiwomali lwemcombelelo wekulungisa luyachubeka nekugcugcutela kukhula kwemnotfo lofaka konkhe kanye nekuhlanganisa imalingena kube kulolunye luhlangotsi luvikela futsi lugcugcutela kusebenta kwetimali kutemfundvo, temphilo, kusakhiwonchanti kanye nasekuphakeleni tibonelelo tahulumende, lapho bantfu labaningi baseNingizimu Afrika bancike khona kute baphile imphilo lencono.
tgt: Malusi Gigaba, ePalamende, eKapa, vhiki leri nga hundza.

src: Kulesikhatsi lapho simo setimali sibutsakatsaka, kutibophelela kwahulumende ekulweni netinseyeya letibhekene neNingizimu Afrika kubonakala ngetinhlelo tekungenelela letikhulisa iminotfo yasemalokishini neyasemakhaya, kukhulisa kulawulwa kahle kwetinkhapani tahulumende, kanye nekwengeta kakhulu imali leyabelwe temfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Mpimanyeto wo cincanyana wu ya emahlweni wu hlohlotela ku kula loku katsaka vanhu hinkwavo na nhlengeleto wa xibalo loko ku ri karhi ku sirheleriwa na ku kondletela matirhiselo ya timali ya vaaki eka dyondzo, rihanyu, switirhisiwakulu swa masungulo na nhlayiseko wa vaaki, leswi Maafrika-Dzonga varikwerhu vo tala va tshembelaka eka swona ku tiphina hi vutomi byo antswa.

src: Ikhabinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlangane bente imitamo yekukhulisa umnotfo.
tgt: Eka xivandla xa xibalo lexi tshikelelekeke, vutiboheleri bya mfumo ku ololoxa mitlhontlho eAfrika-Dzonga byi kombisiwa hi mphalalo wa ku kurisa tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le tindhawini ta le makaya, byi tiyisa mafumelo lamanene eka tikhamphani leti nga ehansi ka vun'wini bya mfumo, xikan'we na avelo wo tivikana wo engetela wa ku nyika timali eka dyondzo ya le henhla.

src: Lucubungulo Lwetisebenti.
tgt: Mbalango wa Vatirhi.

src: Ikhabinethi ibonga kukhishwa kwelucubungulo lwetisebenti lwekota lelusandza kwentiwa, lwekota yesitfatfu yemnyaka we-2017, lolukhombise kutsi lizinga lekuswelakala kwemisebenti lisengakantjintji kulelo lekota leyengcile leliku-27.7%.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Mbalango wa Vatirhi wa Kotara na Kotara lowu wa ha ku humesiwaka wa kotara ya vunharhu ya 2017, lowu wu kombeke leswaku vupfumalantirho byi tshame byi nga cincangi kusuka eka kotara leyi nga hundza eka 27.7%.

src: Linani lebantfu labatfole imisebenti kulomkhakha lobhaliswe ngalokusemtsetfweni kulekota lingu-187 000.
tgt: Mivuyelo ya vupfumalantirho leyi rhekodiweke eka sekitara ya ximfumo ya 187 000 ekotareni, sekitara leyi nga riki ya ximfumo na sekitara ya vurimi ti rhekodile milahlekelo ya mitirho ya 71 000 na 25 000 hi ku landzelelana.

src: Bantfu labalahlekelwe misebenti emkhakheni longakabhaliswa ngalokusemtsetfweni bangema-71 000 kantsi bangema-25 000 ebantfu labalahlekelwe misebenti emkhakheni wetekulima.
tgt: Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile ku endla hinkwaswo leswi kotekaka ku tirhana na mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho naswona wu rhamba sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku tirha xiphemu xa yona.

src: Iminyaka lelikhulu Ya-Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: Malembexidzana ya Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Ikhabinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekugubha umkhosi weminyaka lelikhulu yalomakadzebona Wemzabalazo OR Tambo.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo eka ku tlangela malembexidzana ya Nhenha ya Nyimpi OR Tambo, loku heteleleke eka ku tlangeriwa hi Ravuntlhanu, 27 Nhlangula eka Muganga wa ka Nkatolo eKapa-Vuhumadyambu.

src: Umkhosi lomkhulu wekugcina utawubanjwa Ngalesihlanu, ti-27 Imphala 2017 eSigodzini saseNkantolo eMmphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Tanihi xiphemu xa mitlangelo ya malembexidzana, Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u vile rhangerile tiphurojeke ta vuantswisi, ku katsa na:Ku hundziseriwa ka Damu ra Ludeke eMbizana, leri ri akiweke tanihi xiphemu xa Xikimi xa Mphakelo wa Mati yo Tala xa Xifundza xa Greater Mbizana hi Ndzawulo ya Mati na MbhasisoVuendzi kuya eka ndyangu wa ka Nyameni eka Muganga wa ka Ludeke laha Phuresidente a lumekeke gezi, tanihi xiphemu xa pfhumba ra ku nghenisiwa ka gezi etindhawini ta le makaya ra mfumo ro angarhela eMbizana na le tindhawini ta le kusuhiSwikanyakanya swi phakeriwile eka vadyondzi va Xikolo xa le Henhla xa Vuthekiniki xa OR Tambo, tanihi xiphemu xa pfhumba ra Shova Kalula ra Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli, leri ri seketelaka vadyondzi lava va fambaka ku tlula tikhilomitara tinharhu ku ya exikolweniKu nyikeriwa ka tikhomphyuta eka vadyondzi va Xikolo xo Hlawuleka xa Vukuzenzele eka vana lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa, loku rhangeriweke hi Holobye wa Vuhlanganisi, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.

src: Tibalobalo Tebugebengu.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga.

src: Ikhabinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemimango kutsi ihlanganyele nema-ejensi emtsetfo kute kuliwe nebugebengu.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo na miganga hinkwayo ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku lwisana na vugevenga.

src: Letibalobalo tebugebengu letisandza kukhishwa Yindvuna Yetemaphoyisa, Umnu Fikile Mbalula, tikhombise letinye tetindzawo lapho siphumelele khona kulwa nebugebengu kanye netindzawo lapho bugebengu busasetulu khona.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga leta ha ku humesiwaka hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Tat.

src: Ikhabinethi iyakholwa kutsi uma singasebenta ngekubambisana singakhona kuzuza sonkhe ngekwenta imimango yetfu ibe ngulephephile nalekhona kutfutfuka.
tgt: Fikile Mbalula, ti kombile tindhawu tin'wana laha hi khatseke ndzima eka ku lwisana na vugevenga na tindhawu tin'wana laha tilevhele ta vugevenga ti tamaka ta ha ri ehenhla.

src: Letibalobalo tebugebengu tisita hulumende kanye Neluphiko Lwemisebenti Yetemaphoyisa AseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kubona kutsi kuyafinyelelwa kumiphumela lebalulekile lekucondziswe kuyo futsi tisetjentiswa njengesicwayiso sekucala sendlela yekucinisa tinhlelo netindlelalisu tekulwa nebugebengu.
tgt: Khabinete yi kholwa leswaku ko va ntsena hi ku tirhisana hi kona hi nga ta kota ku vuyeriwa hinkwerhu eka ku vumba miganga yo hlayiseka swinene leyi kotaka ku hluvuka.

src: Kuyincenye yendlelalisu yekulwa nebugebengu kucinisekisa kutsi bonkhe bantfu esiveni baphephile futsi bativa baphephile.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ti pfuna mfumo na Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga ku endla vulanguteri eka swikongomisiwakulu na ku tirha tanihi endlelo ro tsundzuxa nkarhi wa ha ri kona ku tiyisa mitirho na maqhinga yo sivela vugevenga.

src: Ludlame Lwetebulili (i-GBV).
tgt: Madzolonga yo ya hi rimbewu (GBV).

src: Hulumende uyaphindza futsi uyakugceka kuhlukunyetwa ngekwetebulili lokubhekiswe kubomake nasebantfwaneni, ngaphandle kwekubuka simo nesikhundla salabo bahlukumeti emangweni.
tgt: Khabinete yi vula nakambe ku sola ka yona ka nxaniso hi swa masangu wa vavasati na vana, handle ko languta swiyimo swa le rixakeni swa vaendlaswivi lava ehlekeleteriwaka.

src: Ikhabinethi igcugcutela bahlukunyetwa kutsi babike lamacala lamabi kulabo betemtsetfo, lekufanele baphenye letinsolo te-GBV bese bacinisa sandla ngendlela lesemtsetfweni kute bacinisekise kutsi bulungiswa buyasebenta.3 Lomkhankhaso Wetinsuku leti-16 Tekulwa Neludlame Lolubhekiswe Kubomake Nasebantfwaneni sewuyasondzela kantsi Ikhabinethi ivumelene ngengcikitsi letsi: “Nami Ngikhona: Sisonkhe sichubekisela iNingizimu Afrika Lete Ludlame Embili”5.4 Ikhabinethi futsi icela takhamuti kutsi tifundzisane ngemalungelo abomake newebantfwana, kanye nangaletindlela letiningi tebulungiswa letikhona kute bahlukunyetwa bancedzakale.5 Lomkhankhaso Wetinsuku leti-16 Wekwecwayisa ungumkhankhaso Wamhlabuhlangene (UN), lobanjwa njalo ngemnyaka kusuka mhla ti-25 Lweti (Lusuku Lwemave Emhlaba Lwekucedza Ludlame Lolubhekiswe Kubomake) kuya kumhla ti-10 Ingongoni (Lusuku Lwemave Emhlaba Lwemalungelo Eluntfu).6 Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayagcugcutelwa kutsi bahlanganyele ngemandla kutinhlelo tekusekela naletikhuluma ngalomkhankhaso kumimango nasemikhakheni yabo lehlukahlukene.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vaxanisiwa ku mangala vugevenga lebya tihanyi eka vulawuri bya nsindziso wa nawu, lebyi byi faneleke ku lavisisa swihehlo swa GBV na ku teka goza hi ndlela yo tiya leri nga endzeni ka nawu ku tiyisisa leswaku vaendlaswivi va tengisiwa na ku xupuriwa.

src: Umhlangano Wetingucuko Kutekuvakasha.1 Ikhabinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi basekele tinhlelo tekugucula umkhakha wetekuvakasha njengoba tinemandla ekukhulisa umnotfo ngekutfutfukisa imimango lephuyile kanye nekugcugcutela kukhula kwematfuba emisebenti.
tgt: Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na Madzolonga Ehenhla ka Vavasati na Vana ri le ku tshineleni naswona Khabinete yi pasisile nkongomelo wa nan'waka: "Ndzi katse na mina: Hi ri Kun'we hi Fambisa Afrika-Dzonga leyi nga riki na Madzolonga kuya Emahlweni”.

src: Litiko Letekuvakasha belibambe Umhlangano Wavelonkhe Wekugucula Tekuvakasha mhla ti-30 kuya kumhla ti-31 Imphala 2017 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kuvakasha kwawonkhewonkhe: Gucula, Khulisa futsi Simamisa”, lapho kukhishwe khona Umbiko Wekugucula Simo Salomkhakha futsi kwasungulwa Luhlu Lolusetsetfweni Lweluhlelo Lolubanti Lwekuniketa Labamnyama Emandla Kutemnotfo (iB-BBEE) kanye Nesikhwama Sekugucula Tekuvakasha.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi tlhela yi rhamba vaakatiko ku dyondzisana hi timfanelo ta vavasati na vana, na hi tindlela to pfuna to hambanahambana leti nga kona ku pfuna vaxanisiwa va swa madzolonga.

src: Lelitsimba laseTidore belifaka Muhammad Amin Farouk, situkulwane saTuan Guru, lobekalwela inkhululeko lowabanjwa nguhulumende waseHolland watfunyelwa eRobben Island ngemnyaka we-1870.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba mukhumbheki hinkwavo ku seketela mapfhumba ya cinco wa sekitara ya vupfhumba tanihi leswi ya vuyerisaka hi ndlela leyi koteka eka ikhonomi hi ku nyika matimba eka vaakindhawu lava a va tsandzisiwa na ku hlohlotela ku kula ka mitirho.

src: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah bin Qadi Abdussalam) kanye nalabanye labatsatfu bekahamba nabo baboshwa iminyaka le-12 emva kwaloko badzingiselwa eKapa, lapho Tuan wadlala indzima lenkhulu ekutfutfukiseni ummango wendzawo kanye nekwakha lisontfo lekucala lenkholo yemaMuslem, i-mosque.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba yi rhurherile Samiti ya Cinco wa Vupfhumba ya Rixaka hi ti 30 na ti 31 Nhlangula 2017 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Vupfhumba bya hinkwavo: Cinca, Kula na ku Yisa Emahlweni”, leyi endleke leswaku ku humesiwa Xiviko xa Xiyimo xa Cinco wa Sekitara na nsimeko wa Photali yo Nyika Matimba eka Ikhonomi ya Vantima ya Endleloangarhelo ya Vupfhumba (B-BBEE) na Nkwama wa Cinco wa Vupfhumba.

src: Liningi lebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika lisitukulwane sakhe.2 Lelitsimba lavakashela Libandla Lavelonkhe kanye Nemkhandlu Wetifundza Wavelonkhe lapho lamukelwa khona bosihlalo, Sekela Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa kanye Nendvuna Yetekutfutfukisa Umnotfo Ebrahim Patel.
tgt: Vuendzi bya Tiko hi Phuresidente Macky Sall wa le Senegal.

src: Lokuvakasha kwaveta lokufanana kwemlandvo wekubuswa bacindzeteli kanye nemphi lendzala yeminyaka lelikhulu yekulwela inkhululeko yebantfu base-Indonesia nebaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Vuendzi bya Tiko hi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Senegal, Muchaviseki Macky Sall hi ti 20 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Namuhla sibungata kuhwebelana, kutekuvakasha kanye naletinye tintfo letimayelana netemnotfo kulamave omabili.9 Kubhalwa Kweluhlolo Lwemnyaka.1 Ikhabinethi yanelisekile kutsi luhlolo lwekuphela kwemnyaka loluchubekako nyalo etikolweni kanye nakuletinye tikhungo luchubeka ngaphandle kwetihibe.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga na Senegal ya cincanile mavonelo ehenhla ka timhaka ta xifundza na timhaka ta misava ta nkoka swonghasi naswona ya sayinile mitwanano eka swiyenge swo talanyana.

src: Luhlelo Lwelitiko Lemfundvo Lesisekelo lekuvala lapho umfundzi asalele khona emuva kanye naletinye tinhlelo tisite bafundzi labaphazamiseka ngenca yetiteleka emkhatsini kwemnyaka kantsi kulindzelwe imiphumela lemihle.10 Kubumbana Kwesive.1 Ikhabinethi ibonga ema-ejensi emtsetfo kanye nemmango ngekulekelela kutsi kuboshwe Willem Oosthuizen kanye naTheo Jackson.
tgt: Ku sayiniwa ka Memorandamu ya Ntwanano eka ku hlanganisiwa ka Xihlala xa Robben (lexi tirhisiweke hi mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu xo ya hi nghohe ku pfalela valwelantshunxeko) na Swihlala swa Gorée (ndlela leyi vanhu va Afrika va tlutiweke hi yona ku ya eka vutomi bya vuhlonga) swi tiyisa ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka bya swa mfuwo na bya swa matimu bya matiko ya hina tanihileswi Mivulavulo ya Dakar ya 1987 yi tsundzukisiwaka xiswona.

src: Laba lababili baphocelela Victor Mlotshwa kutsi angene ebhokisini lemngcwabo bamesabisa ngekutsi nasangenile batalitsela ngaphetilomu balishise.2 Lesigwebo sikhombisa kutsi imitsetfo yaseNingizimu Afrika icinile ekuvikeleni emalungelo awo wonkhe umuntfu.3 Ikhabinethi iyaphindza futsi icinisekisa lilungelo lawo wonkhe umuntfu waseNingizimu Afrika lekubamba umshuco longenaludlame lekuyincenye yelilungelo lelikumtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela vuendzi kuta eAfrika-Dzonga hi Hosinkulu ya Mamuzilimi Husain Abubakar Syah ya Tidore eIndonesia.

src: Kodvwa ke, emalungelo lakuMtsetfosisekelo WeRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wemnyaka we-1996 awahambi odvwa, akufanelanga kutsi atsikamete emalungelo lakumtsetfosisekelo alabanye bantfu.4 Ikhabinethi iyakugceka kuvalwa kwemigwaco yahulumende, kukhombisa timphawu tenchubo yakudzala yekucindzetelwa kanye nekucekela phansi kwetimphawu tesive letisibuko sentsandvo yelinyeti lesiyitfole matima.
tgt: Vurhumiwa bya Tidore byi katse na Muhammad Amin Farouk, wa yindlu ya Tuan Guru, mulwelantshunxeko loyi a khomiweke hi Madachi kutani a rhumeriwa eka Xihlala xa Robben hi lembe ra 1780.

src: Ikhabinethi itibophelele kumsebenti wayo wekwakha sive lesibumbene futsi icela tonkhe takhamuti kutsi tidlale indzima yato ngendlela lefanele nangemoya wekusebentisana kute sakhe iNingizimu Afrika lebumbene, lengabandlululi ngebuhlanga, ngebulili, lelandzela umtsetfosisekelo wentsandvo yelinyenti nalesatfutfuka.
tgt: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah ibn Qadi Abdussalam) na vanharhu va vanghana va yena va khotsiwile ku ringana kwalomu ka 12 wa malembe kutani endzhaku ka swoleswo va pfaleriwa evuchavelohwahwa eKapa, laha a hoxeke xandla swinene eka nhluvukiso wa vaakindhawu va muganga na ku akiwa ka kereke ya ximuzilimi yo sungula.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene Ngembiko Weti-2015/16 Wesimo Sahulumende Wasekhaya eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga vo tala va landzelerisa matimu ya mindyangu ya vona eka yena.

src: Lombiko uchaza imphumelelo leyentiwe ngekusebentisa Luhlelo Lwekubuyela Kusicalonchanti (i-B2B), lekuluhlelomsebenti lekucinisekisa kutfulwa kwetinsita letisisekelo, kulawula kahle kanye nekusebentisa timali ngendlela lefanele.
tgt: Vurhumiwa byi endzerile Huvo ya Rixaka na Huvo ya Rixaka ya Swifundzakulu laha byi amukeriweke hi vaofisiri vo fambisa, Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa na Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi Ebrahim Patel.

src: Lombiko ukhombisa tindzawo letinetinseyeya bese uniketa sisekelo sekusebentisa lihlandla lesibili leLuhlelo lwe-B2Lombiko utawetfulwa Ephalamende.
tgt: Vuendzi lebyi byi kombisile matimu yo fana ya mfumo wa xikoloni na nyimpi ya malembexidzana hi vukhale ya ntshunxeko wa rixaka hi vanhu va Indonesia na Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Ikhabinethi iyatisekela letichibiyelo letiphakanyisiwe letintsatfu Kulamakhodi Emkhakha We-B-BBELetichibiyelo tilungisa tinseyeya talomkhakha kanye naloko lokuphatselene netingucuko lobekungeke kulungiswe ngalokuphelele ngemakhodi latsintsa imikhakha yonkhe.
tgt: Namuntlha hi tlangela mabindzu, vupfhumba na mihlanganiso yin'wana ya swa ikhonomoi exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi.

src: Letiphakamiso tetichibiyelo kuboniswene ngato nalabo labatsintsekako kulemikhakha.
tgt: Vatswari na vahlayisi va khutaziwa ku nyika nseketelo lowu faneleke eka vadyondzi hi nkarhi lowu.

src: Onkhe emakhodi emikhakha lachitjiyelwe atawushicilelwa kumculu wahulumende.
tgt: Mapfhumba yo hlongorisa ya Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Hansi na mapfhumba man’wana ya pfunile vadyondzi lava khumbekeke hi mikombiso ya ku vilela elembeni naswona mbuyelo lowunene wu languteriwile.

src: Ikhabinethi iphasise Indlelalisu Yavelonkhe Ye-elekhthronikhi nekutsi ishicilelwe kuMculu waHulumende.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu na ntirhisano kusuka eka vaakindhawu lava va pfuneke eka ku voniwa nandzu ka Willem Oosthuizen na Theo Jackson.

src: Yashicilelwa ngaMabasa 2017 kute ummango nawo ufake imibono yawo.
tgt: Lavambirhi va sindzisile Victor Mlotshwa ku nghena ebokisini na ku n'wi chavisa hi ku vula leswaku va ta n'wi chela hi petirolo.

src: Lendlelalisu ye-elekhtronikhi ichaza umbono lekuvunyelwene ngawo kanye nekusuka kusigaba sekuba mmango lonelwatiso kuye esigabeni sekuba mmango lonelwati kutemnotfo nakutenhlalo.
tgt: Vuavanyisi lebyi byi kombisa leswaku milawu ya Afrika-Dzonga yi tiyile eka ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vaakatiko hinkwavo.

src: Isombulula tinseyeya, letifaka ekhatsi kuhlukana kakhulu kutethekhnoloji emkhatsini kwalabo labaphuyile nalabacebile, emkhatsini kwemacembu ebuhlanga, kuhlukahlukana kwetindzawo tekuhlala kanye netintfo letimayela netebulili.
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisisa mfanelo ya Maafrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku endla nkombiso wa ku vilela wo rhula tanihi xiphemu xa xidemokirasi xa hina xa vumbiwa.

src: Inika bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika inkhundla yekuhlanganisa ithekhnoloji, lekuyintfo lehambisana nalemayelana nekukhulisa intfutfuko kanye nemphumelelo kutemnotfo lapho wonkhe umuntfu atawuhlomula khona.
tgt: Hambiswiritano, timfanelo leti tsariweke eka Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 a hi le ti hetisekeke naswona a ti fanelangi ku onha timfanelo ta xidemokirasi ta van'wana.

src: Litiko Letakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi litawuniketa lwatiso lolubanti lolumayelana nalendlelalisu.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola ku pfariwa ka magondzo ya vaaki, hi ku kombisa mifungho ya ntshikelelo wa nkarhi lowu nga hundza na ku onhiwa ka mifungho ya rixaka leyi nga xikombiso xa xidemokirasi xa hina lexi kumekeke ku tika.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene Ngeluhlelo kanye Nendlelalisu Yavelonkhe Yahulumende Ye-elekhtronikhi, kutsi ishicilelwe kuMculu Wahulumende.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiboha eka xiave xa yona xa ku aka rixaka leri khomaneke ra hinkwavo naswona yi rhamba vaakatiko hinkwavo ku tirha xiphemu xa vona hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri na hi moya wa ku tirhisana ku aka Afrika-Dzonga leri nga na vun'we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu, ra xidemokirasi na ku va leri humelelaka.

src: Itawuletsa tingucuko kutethekhinoloji kumisebenti yahulumende futsi yenta kutsi kube nentfutfuko ekutfulweni kwetinsita letisezingeni ngekusebentisa ithekhinoloji.
tgt: Xiviko xi katsakanya ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka ku simekiwa ka Pfhumba ra ku Vuyela eka Maendlelo ya Masungulo (B2B), kungu ra matirhelo ku tiyisisa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya masungulo, mafumelo lamanene na malawulelo ya swa timali lamanene.

src: Tinhloso talendlelalisu kuletinye, kuhlukanisa tinhlelo tahulumende te-elekhthronikhi kanye nekuphindvwa kaningi kwetinhlelo, kwemadathabhesi, kuba netinhlelo letiningi letingahambisani kanye nekungasebenti ngendlela lekahle.
tgt: Xiviko xi kombisa swiyenge swa mitlhontlho na ku nyika masungulo ya nsimeko wa xiyenge xa vumbirhi xa Pfhumba ra B2B.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene Ngendlelalisu Yekutfutfukisa i-ICT Yemabhizinisi Lamancane, Lasemkhatsini Kanye Nalamancane Kakhulu (ema-SMME).
tgt: Khabinete yi seketerile mihundzuluxo leyi ringanyetiweke ya Tikhodi ta Sekitara ta B-BBEE tinharhu.

src: Lolu luhlelo lokungenelela kumkhakha lotsite kute kusonjululwe tinseyeya letibukene nema-SMME lakulomkhakha we-ICT.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo lexi yi tirhana na mitlhontlho na mihambuko ya sekitara eka cinco lowu nkarhi wun'wana a wu nga ta lulamisiwa hi ku hetiseka hi tikhodi to angarhela.

src: Lendlelalisu iphakamisa kutsi kube nekungenelela kute kukhuliswe kutfutfuka kanye nekukhula kwemabhizinisi lamancane kulomkhakha we-ICT, ngalesikhatsi kusalungiswa kutsi kube nekukhula kumazinga ekutfolakala nekusetjentiswa kwe-ICT kumkhakha wemabhizinisi lamancane jikelele.
tgt: Tisekitara letinharhu ti le ka Vurimi, Timali na Vuaki.

src: Lendlelalisu ihlose kwesekela emabhizinisi e-ICT lamancane, kunika emandla kumabhizinisi lasakhona kanye nekungeta kwesekelwa kulabo labangahle babe ma-SMMIkhabinethi ivumile kutsi kushicilelwe Umbiko Lomayelana Nekuhlolwa Kweluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekuphakela Kudla Etikolweni.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka na nkandziyiso wa rona eka Gazete ya Mfumo.

src: Lolu luhlelo lwahulumende lolunebhajethi yemnyaka le-R.5 emabhiliyoni leyenta kutsi bantfwana labatigidzi letiyimfica labaphuma emindenini lephuyile batfole kudla lokunemsoco onkhe malanga esikolweni.
tgt: Ri kandziyisiwile hi Dzivamisoko 2017 ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: Lombiko wahulumende uveta tindzawo lapho kusetjentwe kahle khona nalapho kusadzinga kutsi kwentiwe kancono khona.
tgt: Qhinga lera xielekitironiki ri hlamusela xivono lexi avelaniwaka na cinco wa endlelo kusuka eka rixaka ra vuxokoxoko kuya eka ikhonomi na rixaka ra vutivi.

src: Lombiko utawutfolakala kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letekuhlela, Kucaphela kanye Nekulinganisa (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Ri lulamisa mitlhontlho, ku katsa na xiavanyisi xa xidijiti exikarhi ka lava nga fuma na lava nga swela, exikarhi ka mitlawa ya ku ya hi nghohe, na tindhawu ta ntivomisava to hambanahambana na timhaka ta rimbewu.

src: Ikhabinethi iyayisekela iNingizimu Afrika Kuphindza Ingenele Lukhetfo Lwekuba Lilunga Lemkhandlu Wenhlangano Yetaselwandle (i-IMO) Iminyaka Lemibili.
tgt: Ri nyika pulatifomo eka MaAfrika-Dzonga ku hlanganisa thekinoloji, leyi faneleke na ku fambelana na ku antswisa nhluvukiso na ku humelela ka ikhonomi ku vuyerisa rixaka hinkwaro ka rona.

src: Bulunga beNingizimu Afrika kuloMkandlu we-IMO buyangeta kulokukhula kwematfuba emisebenti lasukela ku-Operation Phakisa: Umnotfo Waselwandle.
tgt: Ri ta tisa cinco wa xidijiti eka vukorhokeri bya vaaki na ku kotisa ku nyikiwa ka nkoka lowu antswisiweke wa vukorhokeri loko ku ri karhi ku tirhisiwa tithekinoloji ta xidijiti.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumile kutsi kwetfulwe Ephalamende Kusayinwa Kwesichibiyelo Sesivumelwano SaseMontreal Setintfo Leticedza Lomkhakha Wemoya Lohlantekile (i-ozone layer) kutsi tifake ekhatsi ema-hydroflurocarbons (ema-HFC).
tgt: Qhinga ri kongomisa, exikarhi ka swin'wana, ku avanyisiwa ka mapfhumba ya mfumo ya xielekitironiki na tiphurosese leti endliwa hi kambirhi, nhlayisa-switiviwa, leswi nga katsanisekiki na leswi tirhaka hindlela leyi tlangisaka swipfuno swa tisisiteme ta xikalo lexikulu.

src: Lesichibiyelo sifuna kucedza ema-HFC (Sivumelwano SaseKigali), letingeminye yemimoya lebanga kutsi kuphele umkhakha wemoya lohlantekile.
tgt: Nakambe swi ta engetela matirhiselo ya thekinoloji ya vuhlanganisi na mahungu (tiICT), ku kondletela maendlelo lamantshwa eka tithekinoloji na switirhisiwa swa Mfumo wa Xielekitironiki.

src: INingizimu Afrika sevele ingulelinye lemave lasayina Sivumelwano SaseMontreal.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo, ya le Xikarhi na Lamatsongo swinene (SMME) ra ICLowu i mphalalo lowu kongomaneke na sekitara ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi nga langutana na tiSMME leti tirhaka eka sekitara ya ICT.

src: Ikhabinethi futsi ivumile kutsi kwetfulwe Ephalamende Kusayinwa Kwesivumelwano SaseMinamata seMekhuri.
tgt: Qhinga leri ri ringanyeta miphalalo yo hatlisisa nhluvukiso na ku kula ka mabindzu lamatsongo eka sekitara ya ICT, loko ku ri karhi ku humelerisiwa ntlakuko eka tilevhele ta matekelo na matirhiselo ya tiICT hi sekitara ya mabindzu lamatsongo hi ku angarhela.

src: Lesivumelwano sibonelela ematfuba ekutsi kuvikelwe ebantfu labangatsintswa, imiphumela lemibi lebangwa yimekhuri kusimondzawo nasemphilweni yemuntfu, kakhulu labo labahlala etindzaweni letinetimayini.10 Ikhabinethi ichazelwe Ngembiko Wekhomishana Yeluphenyo Kutemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha KuRiphabhlikhi YaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Qhinga leri ri na xikongomelo xa ku seketela mabindzu ya ICT lama ha sungulaka, ku tiyisa mabindzu lama nga kona na ku ndlandlamukisa nseketelo kuya eka tiSMME leti nga na vuswikoti bya ku tirha kahle.

src: Likomiti Lemali Yahulumende Lemengameli litawuhlangana masinyane libuke kutsi umbiko unayiphi imitselela kutetimali.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa Xiviko xa Nkambelo wa Pfhumba ra Mphamelo wa Swakudya Eswikolweni ra Rixaka.

src: Litiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kutawufuneka kutsi libuyekete imigomo kanye nemtsetfo, lapho kunesidzingo khona.
tgt: Leri i pfhumba ra mfumo leri nga na mpimanyeto wa lembe na lembe wa R.5 wa tibiliyoni eka kaye wa timiliyoni ta vana kusuka eka miganga leyi nga swela leyi kumaka swakudya leswi akaka miri siku na siku exikolweni.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene ngeMtsetfosivivinywa Wemholo Wavelonkhe Lolizingancane lowenta kutsi kube nemholo lolizingancane kutisebenti letihola imiholo lemincane Emisebentini eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Khabinete yi seketela ku yimela ku hlawuriwa hi vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga eka vuxirho bya malembe mambirhi bya Khansele ya Nhlangano wa swa Malwandle wa Matiko ya Misava (IMO).

src: Lomtsetfosivivinywa uchaza kutsi wonkhe umsebenti kufuneka akhokhelwe umholo longendluli ngebuncane umholo wavelonkhe lolizingancane.
tgt: Mihlawulo leyi yi ta khomiwa hi nkarhi wa Nhlengeletano yo Nyika Vuxokoxoko ya Nkarhi na Nkarhi ya Huvo ya vu 30 kusuka hi ti 27 Hukuri kufika ti 6 N'wendzamhala eLondon, eUnited Kingdom.

src: Ikhabinethi futsi ivumelene kutsi kwetfulwe Ephalamende Umtsetfosivivinywa Wekuchibiyela Simonchanti Sekucashwa wanga-2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ePalamende ka ku sayiniwa na ku pfumeleriwa ka Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Phurotokholo ya Montreal eka Mimusi leyi Onhaka Leyara ya Ozoni ku katsa na tihayidirofulorokhaboni (tiHFC).

src: Loku kuchibiyela Umtsetfo Wesimonchanti Sekucashwa, we-1997 (Umtsetfo 75 we-1997) kute kucinisekiswe kutsi ufaka ekhatsi sigatjana lesikhuluma Ngemtsetfosivivinywa Wemholo Wavelonkhe Lolizingancane.
tgt: Ndzhundzuluxo lowu wu lava ku herisa tiHFC (Ntwanano wa Khigali), leti ti nga tin'wana ta tigasi ta girinihawuzi leti ti hoxaka xandla eka ku onhiwa ka leyara ya ozoni.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene kutsi kwetfulwe Ephalamende Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Budlelwane Bebacashi Netisebenti wanga-2017.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga se i musayini eka Phurotokholo ya Montreal.

src: Lomtsetfosivivinywa ungumphumela wekucocisana nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ePalamende ka ku pfumeleriwa ka Ntwanano wa Minamata eka Mekhuri.

src: Utawubukana kulokunye naloku, tindlela tekuphikhetha, titeleka tesikhatsi lesidze kanye nemitimba yekusombulula ngekucocisana kungevani.
tgt: Wu nyika swivandlanene eka nsirhelelo wa mitlawa leyi nga sirhelelekangiki, ngopfungopfu liyani yi tshamaka etindhawini laha ku nga na nghingiriko wa vucelamigodi, ehenhla ka switandzhaku swa khombo swa mekhuri eka mbangu na rihanyu ra vanhu.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene kutsi kwetfulwe Ephalamende Hulumende Wasekhaya: Umtsetfosivivinywa Wekuchibiyela Indlela Labakheka Ngayo Bomasipala Wanga-2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Ndzavisiso eka Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri eRhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Ufuna futsi kubukana netintfo letimayelana nekuphatsa nekulawulwa kwelukhetfo kubomasipala, kanye nekugcugcutela kusebenta kahle nangemphumelelo kwaloMtsetfo, kanye nekukhulisa kulandzelela nekuphatfwa kwabomasipala.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri yi ta fanela ku kambisisa tipholisi ta milawu leyi fambelanaka, laha swi faneleke.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene kutsi kwetfulwe Ephalamende Umtsetfosivivinywa Wekubhaliswa Kwematatiyela Ngekwe-elekhthronikhi Wanga-2017.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta humesa xiviko eka vaaki ku nga ri khale naswona muvulavuleri wa Phuresidente, Dok.

src: Sekucociswene nalabatsintsekako ngalomtsetfosivivinywa.
tgt: Bongani Ngqulunga, u ta nyika xitiviso hi mayelana na mhaka leyi.

src: Uvumela kutsi kutfutfukiswe luhlelo lwekubhalisa ematatiyela ngekwe-elekhthronikhi (i-e-DRS), kulungisa ematatiyela, kubhalisa linani lelikhulu lematatiyela njengoba kumcoka kutinhlelo tahulumende tekuletsa tingucuko temhlaba.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Muholo wa Mpimohansi wa Rixakalowu khumbaka muholo wa mpimohansi eka vatirhi lava holeriwaka muholo wa le hansihansi eka Vanhu lava ringaneleke ku Tirha eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Njengendlela yekukhutsata kusetjentiswa kwema-ICT kute kwakheke umnotfo lofaka wonkhe umuntfu, Ikhabinethi ivumelene ngeMtsetfosivivinywa Wesikhungo Savelonkhe Ikamva Semakhono e-elekhthronikhi Wanga-2017 (Umtsetfosivivinywa we-iNeSI) kutsi ushicilelwe kute kucociswane ngawo futsi kufakwe nemibono.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu koxa ku va mutirhi un'wana na un'wana a holeriwa muholo lowu nga riki ehansi ka muholo wa mpimohansi wa rixaka.

src: Umtsetfosivivinywa we-iNeSI ubonelela kusungulwa kwe-iNeSI njengesikhungo sahulumende lesitawuba nemigomo yaso, kute sibukane nekuswelakala kwemakhono e-elekhthronikhi lavimbela kusisa, intfutfuko kutenhlalo netemnotfo kanye nekutfutfuka kwemakhono esiveni.
tgt: Xikan'wekan'we loko Nawumbisi lowu wu sungula ku tirha vathori va ta languteriwa ku holela vatirhi va vona muholo lowu nga riki ehansi ka mpimohansi wa rixaka, lowu faneleke ku cinciwanyana lembe na lembe.

src: Loku kutawenta kutsi kube netikhungo tekukhicita tinhlelo te-ICT kuleso naleso sifundza, lokutawusita i-iNeSI kutsi itfutfukise iphindze idizayine tinhlelo letifanele kanye nemabukwana ekucecesha, igcugcutele yente neluphenyo, inikete emakhono ekwenta luphenyo kubafundzi beticu letisetulu.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xaNawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo waSwipimelo swa Masungulo swa le Ntirhweni wa 2017.

src: Ikhabinethi ivumelene kutsi kushicilelwe Kumculu Wahulumende Umtsetfosivivinywa Wekuchibiyela Sakhiwonchanti Setinsita Teliposi kute kutfolwe imibono yemmango.
tgt: Lowu wu hundzuluxa Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 (Act 75 of 1997) (Nawu wa Swipimelo swa Masungulo swa le Ntirhweni, 1997 (Nawu wa 75 wa 1997) ku tiyisisa leswaku wu lulamisela Nawumbisi wa Muholo wa Mpimohansi.

src: Imicimbi LetakoIkhabinethi futsi iyavumelana nalemicimbi letako lekuluhlu lwetintfo letitakwentiwa nguhulumende.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vuxaka bya Vatirhi wa 2017.

src: Mengameli Zuma uhlele kuvashela iSteve Biko Academic Hospital, eTshwane Ngelesihlanu, ti-3 Lweti 2017 kulandzelela kwetfulwa kwetinsita tetemphilo njengencenye Yeluhelo LwaMengameli Lwekulandzelela Isiyahlola.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Mfumo waMiganga: Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxowa Swivumbeko swa Timasipala wa 2017.

src: Lesibhedlela ngilesinye lesihamba embili kutibhedlela tahulumende kulelive kantsi sicanjwe ligama ngaSteve Biko, lichawe lemzabalazo wenkhululeko lebelifundzela budokotela eNyuvesi yaseNatal (nyalo leseyatiwa ngekutsi Yinyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Lowu wu hundzuluxa Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act 117 of 1998) (Mfumo wa Miganga: Nawu wa Swivumbeko swa Timasipala, 1998 (Nawu wa 117 wa 1998).Nawumbisi wu lava ku tiyisa milulamiselo ya mafumelo ya le xikarhi ka mifumo na ya xidemokirasi.

src: )Kuvakasha kwaMengameli Zuma kuyincenye yeluhlelo loluchubekako lwekulandzelela loluhlose kubukana netinseyeya letibukene netibhedlela tahulumende nekutfutfukisa luhlelo letinsita temphilo kulelive, lekungilenye yetitfo hulumende laticalisa embili.
tgt: Nakambe wu lava ku lulamisa timhaka leti fambelanaka na mafambiselo na malawulelo ya mihlawulo ya timasipala, na ku kondletela ku pfuna na vuswikoti bya nsimeko wa Nawu, xikan'we na ku tiyisisa vuangameri na mafumelo eka timasipala.

src: Inyanga Yavelonkhe Yekwatisa Ngemalungelo Alabakhubatekile.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Nawumbisi waTisisiteme ta Ntsariso wa Mapapila ya Vun'wini bya Miako ya Xielekitironiki wa 2017.

src: Inkhofa Yavelonkhe Yekutfutfukisa Umnotfo Wasekhaya.
tgt: Nawumbisi se wu yisiwile eka nkanelo wa vaaki.

src: Litiko Letekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko kanye Nelitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwemabhizinisi Lamancane litawubamba Inkhofa Yekucala Yekutfutfukisa Umnotfo Wasekhaya mhla ti- 9 namhla ti-10 Lweti 2017 eGauteng.
tgt: Wu pfumelela nhluvukiso wa sisiteme ya ntsariso wa mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako ya xielekitironiki (e-DRS), eka ku phurosesiwa ka mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako, ku humelerisa ntsariso wa tivholomu letikulu ta mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako tanihilaha swi laviwaka hakona hi mapfhumba ya mpfuxeto wa misava ya Mfumo.

src: Lenkhofa iyinkhundla lekahle lelungele kucocisana emkhatsini kwahulumende kanye nemkhakha wabosomabhizinisi mayelana netintfo letimcoka letisematseni naletibucayi letimayelana nekukhulisa umnotfo wasetindzaweni tetfu ngekwenta simo lesikahle sekutfutfukisa umnotfo lofaka wonkhe umuntfu.
tgt: Tanihi xiphemu xa ku kondletela ntirhiso wa tiICT ku aka ikhonomi leyi katsaka hinkwavo, Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vandla ra Swikili swa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka ra iKamva wa 2017 (Nawumbisi wa iNeSI) ku va wu gazetiwa ku va na nkanelo na mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: Ikhabinethi iyasemukelo simemetelo semali lengetulu kwebhiliyoni yinye yemadola ase-US letawusiswa njalo ngetinyanga letehlukene kumnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika kutethekhnoloji, temfundvo kanye netemabhizinisi etekulima.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa iNeSI wu lulamisela ku tumbuluxiwa ka iNeSI tanihi vandla ra mfumo leri nga na milawu leyi kotisaka ya rona n'wini, ku lulamisa nkayivelo wa swikili swa xielekitironiki leswi swi kavanyetaka vuvekisi, nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu na nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti etikweni.

src: Loku kumemetelwe lincusa Harold Doley, Jr, Lomphatsi Welibhange Lentfutfuko e-Afrika.
tgt: Leswi swi ta tumbuluxa tihabu ta ntshovelo wa ICT eka xifundzakulu xin'wana na xin'wana, leswi endzhaku ka swona swi nga ta pfuna iNeSI ku hluvukisa na ku dizayina tiphurogireme leti faneleke na matheriyali wo letela, ku kondletela na ku endla ndzavisiso wa vutumbuluxi, na ku nyika vuswikoti bya ndzavisiso eka swichudeni swa le ndzhaku ka mithwaso ya digiri.

src: Nono Simelela ngekukhetfwa abe Lisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele WeNhlangano Yemhlaba Yetemphilo (i-WHO).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile vuhangalasi bya Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vukorhokeri bya Poso eka Gazete ya Mfumo ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: Ikhabinethi ibonga umsebenti weNdvuna Yetemidlalo Nekukhibika, Mnu Thulas Nxesi, Lisekela Mengameli, Cyril Ramaphosa kanye Nelitsimba leSouth African Rugby Union.
tgt: 124 wa 1998).Nawumbisi wu lulamisela ku vumbiwa hi vuntshwa ka sekitara ya poso hi ku angarhela ku hoxa xandla eka milulamiselo ya mfikelelo wa vanhu hinkwavo eka vukorhokeri bya xielekitironiki bya vutumbuluxi loko ku ri karhi ku yiwa emahlweni na ku nyika vukorhokeri bya poso bya ntolovelo bya nkoka na ku va byo hlayiseka.

src: Ikhabinethi ihalalisela bonkhe labadlalako nalabo labawinile kuMcimbi Wemnyaka Welihlandla Le-15 Wekuklomelisa Kucamba Nekusungula Kumkhakha Wahulumende.
tgt: Leswi swi hoxa xandla eka ndzingano na xindzhuti xa ximunhu hikwalaho ka mfikelelo wa mahungu na vukorhokeri bya poso lebyi nga durhiki, leswi humelerisaka nhluvukiso wa vaaki na ku antswisa nkoka wa vutomi bya vanhu na miganga.

src: Lemiklomelo yentelwa letindlela letinemphumelelo naletikahle tekwetfula tinsita letitfolakale ngekusebentisa tindlela tekucabanga, emasu kanye nemathulusi lafanele.
tgt: Mitlangu leyi TakaNakambe Khabinete yi amukela yin'wana ya mitlangu leyi taka eka khalendara ya mfumo.

src: Ikhabinethi ihalalisela iSuperSport United FC ngekufika kumdlalo wemancamu we-CAF Confederation Cup emva kwekuhlula licembu laseTunisia iClub Africa nga-3-1 na-4-2 seyihlanganiswe yonkhe imiphumela.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u kunguhateriwileku endzela Xibedhlele xa Tidyondzo xa Steve Biko eTshwane hi Ravuntlhanu, 3 Hukuri 2017 ku endla nandzeleriso wa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu tanihi xiphemu xa Pfhumba ra Nandzeleriso wa Siyahlola ra Hofisi ya Phuresidente.

src: Lelicembu lelatiwa ngekutsi Matsatsantsa litawudlala ne-TP Mazembe kumancamu emcudzelwano wesibili ngebukhulu kulelivekati lenyanga letako.
tgt: Xibedhlele lexi i xin'wana xa swibedhlele leswi tirhaka kahle etikweni naswona xi thyiwile endzhaku ka Steve Bantu Biko, sirha nhenha ya nyimpi ya ntshunxeko na khale ka xichudeni xa vudokodela eka khale ka Yunivhesiti ya Natal (sweswi yi vitaniwaka Yunivhesiti ya KwaZulu-Natal).Vuendzi bya Phuresidente Zuma i xiphemu xa pfhumba ra nandzeleriso ra mfumo leri yaka emahlweni leri nga na xikongomelo xa ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi nga langutana na swibedhlele swa mfumo na ku antswisa sisiteme ya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu etikweni, lexi xi nga xin'wana xa swirhanganakulu swa mfumo.

src: Ikhabinethi indlulise imilayeto yekudvudvuta kumndeni nakubangani ba-Ian McLeod, kushona kwakhe kulahlekelwa kwemdlalo webhola yetinyawo eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela N’hweti ya Vulemukisi ya Timfanelo ta Vutsoniwa bya Rixaka exikarhi ka ti3 Hukuri na ti3 N'wendzamhala 2017, leyi tlhelaka yi kotlana na Siku ra Vanhu lava hanyaka na Vutsoniwa ra Matiko ya Misava.

src: Waba wekucala eNingizimu Afrika kuba ngunompempe wemcudzelwano we-FIFA World Cup, lesikhatsi angunompempe ngemnyaka we-1998 kumidlalo ye-FIFA World Cup eFrance.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga ya khutaziwa ku tlakusa vulemukisi na ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vanhu lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa, loko ku ri karhi ku tekeriwa enhlokweni mivuyelo leyi yi kumekeke ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi langutaneke na vanhu lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa.

src: Kubekwa EtikhundleniBonkhe labacokiwe kufanele bahlolwe ticu tabo kanye nekutsi bavumelekile kwenta lomsebenti.
tgt: Khomferense i pulatifomo ya xiqhinga ya n'wangulano exikarhi ka sekitara ya mfumo na leyi nga riki ya mfumo eka timhaka leti nga emahungwini na ta nkoka swonghasi hi mayelana na ku hlohlotela tiikhonomi ta le migangeni hi ku tumbuluxa mbangu lowu kotisaka ku fikelela nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi lowu katsaka vanhu hinkwavo.

src: Bacondzisi beBhodi Yenhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika Yemshwalensi Wemphahla Letfunyelwa Kulamanye Emave SOC Limited:a. Mk Lerato Herriette Mothae kanyeb.
tgt: Leswi swi tivisiwile hi Muyimelatiko Harold Doley, Jr, Gavhenara wa Bangi ya Nhluvukiso ya Afrika.

tgt: Nono Simelela eka ku thoriwa ka yena tanihi Mulawuri-Jenerala wo Pfuneta wa Nhlangano wa Rihanyu wa Misava (WHO).
