tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u ta nyika mbulavulo wa siku eka ku tlangela Siku ra Ntshuxeko wa Rixaka hi ti 27 Dzivamisoko eRivaleni ra mitlangu ra Dr Petrus Molemela eBloemfontein, eFree State ehansi ka nkongomelo: "Lembe ra Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: hi ya fikelela ntshuxeko wa hina hi ku tirhisa ncico wa ikhonomi ya vaaki wo helela.

src: Imiklomelo yaVelonkhe yimiklomelo lesezingeni lelisetulu kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika leklonyeliswa nguMengameli, ayiklomelise takhamuti nemalunga wemave emhlaba lafake ligalelo lelibonakalako ekwenteni lelive kutsi libe sive lesikhululekile, sentsandvo yelinyenti nalesiphumelelako lesibumbene sibe kodvwa sehlukahlukane.
tgt: "Tlangu wu ta landzeriwa hi Masagwati ya Rixaka ya 2018 hi Mugqivela , 28 Dzivamisoko ePitori, laha Phuresidente Ramaphosa a nga ta nyika lava nga fanela ku Xiximiwa hi Baobab, Ku Xiximiwa ka Ikhamanga, Ku Xiximiwa ka Luthuli na ku Xiximiwa ka Vanghana va OR Tambo.

src: Imigubho yeLusuku lweTisebenti (i-May Day)Ikhabhinethi imema tonkhe tisebenti talelive kutsi tihlanganyele ekugubheni umkhosi weLilanga leTisebenti ngaLesibili, Mhla lu-1 Inkhwekhweti 2018 kanye nekubuyeketa lokuzuzwe ngemalungelo etisebenti kusukela kwana nenkhululeko.
tgt: Masagwati ya Rixaka I masagwati ya le henhla lawa Afrika-Dzonga yi wa nyikaka, hi ku fambisiwa hi Presidente, eka vaakatiko na swirho swa muganga wa matiko ya misava leswi hoxeke xandla eku endleni tiko ri ntshuxeka, xidimokirasi na ku va rixaka ro humelela, ri va rin’we eka ku hambanahambana ka vanhu va rona.. Ku tlangela Siku ra DzivamisokoKhabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo laha tikweni ku nghenelela eka ku tlangela Siku ra Vatirhi hi Ravumbirhi, 1 Dzivamisoko 2018 na ku languta leswi nga fikeleriwa eka timfanelo ta vatirhi ku sukela loko xidemokirasi xi sungurile.

src: Lolusuku lolu losikhumbuto sekutsi tindzawo tasemsebentini tifanele kutsi tibe ngletiphephile kanye nekutsi bacashi bafanele kutsi bentisise kute bacinisekise kuphepha kwetisebenti tabo, ikakhulu emkhakheni wetekumbiwa kwetimbiwa.
tgt: Siku leri ri tirha ku hi tsundzuxa leswaku tindzhawu to tirha ti fanele ku va tihlayisekile naswona vathori va fanele ku endla swotala ku tiyisisa vuhlayiseki bya vatirhi, ngopfungopfu emigodini.

src: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yalilela imindeni, bangani kanye nebalingani bebavukuti labasitfupha labasha bangcongca ngesikhatsi ibhasi yabo leyibayisa emsebentini ilunyekwa ngemlilo webhomu yaphethiloli leyajikijelwa bahlaseli.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi kombisa ku khumbeka ka yona eka mindyangu, vanghana na vatirhikulorhi wa swirho swa ntsevu leswi nga tshwa swi lova loko bazi ri karhi ri swi yisa entirhweni ri hisiwa hi bomo ya petirolo leyi nga hoxiwa hi un'wana wa vahlaseri lava nga tiviweki.

src: Ikhabhinethi icele emalunga emmango kutsi asite emaphoyisa eluphenyweni lwawo lwalelicala.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela swirho swa vaaki ku pfuna maphorisa eka ku lavisisa ka vona hi xihatla ku kota ku tirhana na nandzu lowu.

src: ImibikoIkhabhinethi ihalalisela:1.
tgt: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka:1.

src: Sobuciko wemNdebele Esther Mahlangu, lotfole ticu tekuhlonishwa tebudokotela eNyuvesi yaseJozi ngeligalelo lakhe lelivelele kutebuciko nemasiko taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: N'wavutshila wa Mundevele Esther Mahlangu, ku va a xiximiwile hi vudokodela ku suka eYunivhesiti ya Joni hi ku tekela enhlokweni ku hoxa xandla xa yena ko hlamarisa eka vutshila na mfuwo wa laha tikweni eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Licembu laseNingizimu Afrika leliphakamisele umjeka wetfu ezingeni leliphakeme eMidlalweni yeCommonwealth eGold Coast, e-Australia, lapho baphume bababesitfupha futsi batfola tindvondvoli letinge-37 (teligolide le-13, telisiliva le-11 kwatsi telitfusi tona taba-13).
tgt: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga lexi nga tlakusa mujeko wa hina eka Mitlangu ya Vun'we bya Matiko eGold Coast eAustralia, loko va hetile va ri eka xiyimo xa vutsevu na ku va na 37 wa timendlele (13 ta nsuku, 11 ta silivhere na 13 ta koporo).

src: Kuphemelela kwabo kungenca yekusebenta ngekutikhandla, kutinikela kanye ngekungaphelimandla.
tgt: Ku humelela ka vona i hi kwalaho ka ku tirha swinene, ku tinyikela na ku tiyisela.

src: Loku kuyinshisekelo kubasubatsi labasebancane kantsi futsi kucinisekisa kutsi temidlalo tiyincenye yelibhandi lelisibophela ndzawonye lisihlanganise njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Leswi swi hlohlotela lavantshwa eka mitlangu na ku tiyisisa leswaku mitlangu i xiphemu xa vutomi na ku hi vumba hi va nchumu wun'we tanihi Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Labaphume embili kakhulu batfola tindvondvo teligolide bafaka ekhatsi:Caster Semenya – i-800m ne-1500m yabomakeLuvo Manyonga – kuzuba umgamu lomudze kwabobabeNdodomzi Ntutu – i-T12 100m yabobabeHenri Schoeman – i-triathlon yabobabeTatjana Schoenmaker – i-100m ne-200m yabomake ye-breaststrokeChad le Clos – i-50m, 100m ne-200m yabobabe ye-butterflyCameron van der Burgh – i-50m yabobabe ye-breaststrokeAkani Simbine – i-100m yabobabe kanyenaMartin Erasmus – i-freestyle wrestling yabobabe labanesisindvo lesiyi-97kg.
tgt: Lava nga fikelela leswikulu hi ku kuma timendlele ta nsuku va katsa:Caster Semenya - eka vaxisati 800m na 1500mLuvo Manyonga - vaxinuna eka ku tlula ko lehaNdodomzi Ntutu, eka vaxinuna T12 100mHenri Schoeman - eka vaxinuna eka mitlangu yinharhuTatjana Schoenmaker - eka vaxisati 100m na 200m eku hlambeleniChad le clos - vaxinuna 50m, 100m na 200m eka ku hlambelaCameron van der Burgh - vaxinuna eka 50m hi ku hlambelaAkani Simbine - vaxinuna eka 100 na Martin Erasmus - vaxinuna eka 97 eka ku tlimbana.

src: Solwati Sibongile Muthwa ngekubekwa esikhundleni saSekelashansela naDkt Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi ngekubekwa esinkhundleni saShansela lokusandza kwentiwa eNyuvesi iNelson Mandela.
tgt: Phurofesa Sibongile Muthwa na Dok Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi eka ku thoriwa ka vona ku va xandla xa muchanselara na ku va muchanselara eYunivhesiti ya Nelson Mandela.

src: Licembu laseNingizimu Afrika ngekutfola imiklomelo lemitsatfu kuNkhomfa yeTemabhizinisi yeMave Emhlaba ye-10 lebeyibanjelwe e-Istanbul, eTurkey ngaMabasa 2018, yahlonishelwa kutinikela kwayo ekutfutfukiseni ema-SMMLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwemabhizinisi Lamancane kanye nemlingani walo, i-22 on Sloane, litiko lelikhulukati e-Afrika lekutfutfukisa mabhizinisi lamancane,, litfole umklomelo i-Global Entrepreneurship Country of the Year Award.
tgt: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga eka ku hlula eka masagwati ya Nhlangano wa Mabindzu ya Misava ya vu 10 eInstanbul, Turkey hi Dzivamisoko 2018, hi ku tekela enhlokweni ku tinyikela ka vona na ku yisa emahlweni ti-SMMNdzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo na xirho xa yona, 22 eSloane, khemphasi leyikulu eAfrika, va hlurile eka Tiko ra Mabindzu eka Masagwati ya Lembe ya Matiko ya misava.

src: Licembu laseNingizimu Afrika liphindze futsi latfola umklomelo i-Brand Champions Award kanye ne-Research Champions Award, , lokuhlonipha emave eGlobal Entrepreneurship Network emhlabeni wonkhe jikelele.
tgt: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi tlhele xi hlula eka Tinghwazi ta Mavito na Tinghwazi ta Vulavisisi, laha ku tekeriwaka enhlokweni Nhlanganelo wa Mabindzu ya Misava eka matiko hinkwawo ya misava.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleniKutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa ku va kona endzhaku ka nkambelo wa tidyondzo na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, wamhla tiyi- 9 Mabasa 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapaTindzaba Letimcoka Telive.
tgt: Xitatimende xa Nhlengeletano ya Khabinete ya ti 9 Mudyaxihi 2018Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 9 Mudyaxihi 2018, eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Ludlame Lolubuketane Nebulili Lobutsite (i-GBV).
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze ivakalisa kukhuta kwayo ngeludlame lwekuhlukunyetwa kwebantfu labasikati nebantfwana, kantsi imema tsine sonkhe etindzaweni tetfu letihlukene kutsi simelane nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake, bantfwana kanye nebantfu labaTinkonkoni, labaTitabani, beBulili-bubili kanye nebebulili lobungahambisani nemuntfu wakhona.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi sola madzolonga ehenhla ka vaxisati na vana, na ku kombela eka hinkwerhu eka mihlangano hinkwayo ku lwa na ku herisa madzolonga ehenhla ka vaxisati, vana, Vavasati vo rhandza rimbewu-fanana, Vavanuna vo rhandza rimbewu-fanana, rimbewumbirhi na lava nga cincaka rimbewu.

src: Kungumsebenti wabo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bafundzisane ngemalungelo abomake nebantfwana, netindlela letikhona labangakhetsa kuto kusita labatsintsekako kuloludlame.
tgt: I ntirho wa MuAfrika-Dzonga wihi kumbe wihi ku dyondzisana hi timfanelo ta vaxisati na vana, na hi tindlela to hambanahambana leti nga kona ku pfuna vaxanisiwa hi madzolonga.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasamukela lesincumo lesentiwe yinkhantolo lephakeme yaseNingizimu neGauteng ngekugweba lotfolwe anelicala lekubulala Sandile Mantsoe iminyaka lenge-32 advonsa ejele ngekubulala lebekasingani sakhe Karabo Mokoena.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela xiboho xa Khotonkulu ya Gauteng Dzonga xa ku khotsa mudlayi Sandile Mantsoe ku tshama ekhotsweni malembe ya 32 eka ku dlaya khale ka muhlekisani wa yena Karabo Mokoena.

src: Lamanye emacala aphatselene nalokutfolakala kwemtimba wemntfwana loneminyaka le-10 Katlego Joja eMamelodi West, empumalanga nePitoli kanye nekubulawa kwaZolile Khumalo, abulawa ngulebekangumfundzi, eMangosuthu University of Technology eDurban, kubufakazi baletinselele lesibukene nato njengesive.
tgt: Eka milandzu yin’wana yo fana na ku kumiwa ka ntsumbu wa n'wana wa malembe ya 10 Katlego Joja eMamelodi Vupeladyambu, evuxeni bya Pitori na ku dlayiwa ka Zolile Khumalo, ni khale ka muchudeni kulobye, eYunivhesiti ya Thekinoloji ya Mangosuthu eDurban, i vumbhoni bya ku ya emahlweni ka mitlhontlho leyi rixaka ri hlanganaka na yona.

src: IKhabhinethi indlulisa kulila kwayo emndenini wakaJoja newaka Khumalo.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka mindyangu ya ka Joja na Khumalo.

src: Ngalesikhatsi tikhungo tebulungiswa naletishaya umtsetfo tiniketwe umtfwalo wekucinisekisa kwekutsi labenti balokubi bayajeziswa, njengemphakatsi sonkhe sinemtfwalo wekuvimbela lobu bugebengu.
tgt: Loko lava va vululami na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ti ri na vun’winyi bya ku tiyisisa leswaku lava nga endla manyala va hela va xupuriwa, tanihi vaaki hinkwerhu hi na ntirho lowu hi faneleke ku wu endla ku herisa vugevenga lebyi.

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi bangenelele ngalokugcwele ekusekeleni nakutinhlelo letikhuluma ngekucwayisa emimmangweni labahlala kuyo nasemisebentini.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga va hlohloteriwa ku nghenelela va gingirika eka minongonoko yo seketela na ku tlakusa ndzemukiso eka miganga na tisekitara ta vona to hambanahambana.

src: IKhabhinethi ibuya ikhutsata labahlukunyetiwe kutsi babike lobugebengu lobusabekako kubantfu bemtsetfo, lekutawufanele baphenye letinsolo te-GBV bese baphendvule ngekusebentisa umtsetfo kute bacinisekise kwekutsi bulungiswa buyentiwa.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi khutaza vaxanisiwa ku vika vugevenga lebyi bya tihanyi eka vulawuri byo sindzisa nawu, lava va faneleke ku lavisisisa swihehlo swa GBV na ku tirha swinene hi ku landza nawu ku tiyisisa leswaku vululami bya fikeleriwa.

src: Kulolunye ludzaba loluhlukile kodvwa lunebudlelwano nalolu, iUmhlangano loMkulu waMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) umemetele umhla ti-13 Inhlaba Lusuku Lwemave Emhlaba Lwekucwayisa Nge-Albinism.
tgt: Eka mhaka yo hambana kambe leyi yelanaka, Nhlengeletano yo Angarhela ya Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN) yi vekile 13 Khotavuxika tanihi Siku ra Ndzemukiso wa Alibinizimi wa Matiko ya Misava.

src: Lomkhankaso uhlose kwecwayisa ngebantfu labaphila ne-albinism lenabo bavikelwe ngalokugcwele nguMtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhulikhi yeNingizimu Afrika wanga-1996.
tgt: Phfumba ri lava ku tlakusa ndzemukiso mayelana na vanhu lava hanyaka na alibinizimi lava nga sirheleriwa hi ku hetiseka hi Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.

src: Kungumsebenti wabo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batifundzise babuye bafundzise nalabanye emimmangweni nge-albinism kute kucedvwe letinkholelo letingasiwo emaciniso nalemicondvo lengekho.
tgt: I ntirho wa MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku ti dyondzisa na ku dyondzisa swirho swa vaaki hi alibinizimi leswaku ku bakanyeriwa etlhelo swikholwakholwani na leswi nga ri ki ntiyiso.

src: Loku kutawunciphisa lokuhlukumeteka lokubuketana nebantfu labane-albinism kanye nemindeni yabo.
tgt: Leswi swi ta hunguta ku chava loku nga kona eka vanhu lava nga na alibinizimi na mindyangu ya vona.

src: Sincumo seNhlangano Yebasubatsi Yemave Emhlaba(i-IAAF).
tgt: Xiboho xa Federexini ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ya Swipotso (IAAF).

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka kwayo ngalokusandza kwenteka lokuphatselene nalemitsetfo lemisha lemiswe nguleNhlangano Yebasubatsi Yemave Emhlaba (i-IAAF).
tgt: Khabinete yi kombise ku vilela hileswi humelelaka mayelana na swipimelo swintshwa IAAKhabinete yi amukela ntirho lowu nga ku endliweni hi Ndzawulo ya Mitlangu na Vuhungasi ya Afrika-Dzonga na leswaku, phanele ya xiyimo xa le henhla ya vativi eka swiyenge leswi fambelenaka swa mirhi na nawu swi hlanganisiwile hi SRSPhanele leyi yi ta hlaya swipimelo leswi hi vuxiyaxiya na ku kanela hi vumbhoni bya xisayense lebyi IAAF yi nga khomelela eka byona.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawamukela lomsebenti lowentiwe Litiko Letemidlalo Nekukhibika laseNingizimu Afrika (i-SRSA), ngalesento sekutsi kubese kuhlanganiswa litsimba labochwepheshe kulemikhakha lephatselene netekwelapha netemtsetfo lihlanganiswa yi-SRSLelitsimba litawufundza kabanti lemitsetfo lemisiwe bese liphenyisisa lobufakazi ngekwesayensi lobu i-IAAF lesime ngabo.
tgt: Yi ta kambela vulavisisi na vumbhoni bya xisayense hinkwabyo lebyi nga kona ku katsa na timhaka ta matikhomelo na ku tirhisa mbuyelo lowu ku tlhontlha swipimelo leswi eka tiforamu leti nga fanela.

src: Litawubuyeketa yonkhe inhlobo yelucwaningo lolukhona kanye nebufakazi ngekwesayensi kanye nalokunye lokuphatselene nendlela yekutiphatsa bese basebentise letiphumo kubeka inselele kulemitsetfo lemisiwe emihlanganweni lefanelekile.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela van’waswipotso hinkwavo lava nga va ka va khumbiwile hi swipimelo leswi kwala ekaya na lava nga le matikweni ya misava hinkwayo.

src: Simo saseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Xiyimo xa le N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: IKhabhinethi iniketwe umbiko nguleLitsimba Lenhlanganisela yaboNdvuna Lemsebenti Wesikhashane (i-IMTT) ngeNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyikiwile xiviko hi Xipano xa va Vaholobye (IMTT) mayelana na swa le N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Lombiko ukhuluma ngalomsebenti wekucala lesebavele bawentile kulamaviki lamabili landlulile.
tgt: Xiviko xi nyikile ntirho wo sungula lowu nga endliwa eka mavhiki mabirhi lawa ya nga hundza.

src: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile ngalomsebenti lesewentiwe ngule i-IMTT ngemitamo yabo yekuletsa kusimama kuleSifundza.
tgt: Khabinete yi enetekile hi ku humelela loku nga fikeleriwa hi IMTT eka matshalatshala ya yona ya ku tshamisekisa Xifundzankulu.

src: Le IMTT, leholwa nguNgcongcoshe loseHhovisi laMengameli, Dkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, litawuchubeka nalomsebenti waloludzaba lwaseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: IMTT, leyi nga rhangeriwa hi Holobye wa le Hofisini ya Phuresidente, Dok Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, yi na vun’winyi eka timhaka ta le N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Umhlangano lobalisa kabanti utawubanjwa eNyakatfo Nshonalanga kuleliviki lelitako ngulelitsimba le-IMTT lotawube watisa betindzaba ngalokuchubekako ngalomsebenti.
tgt: Xiviko xo helela eka vahangalasamahungu hi mivuyelo ya ntirho lowu wa IMTT xi ta endliwa eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu vhiki leritaka.

src: Umhlangano Wemnotfo Wahulumende Netinkampani Tangasese emkhatsini weJapan ne-Afrika.
tgt: Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Mfumo-Mabindzu exikarhi ka Japan-Afri.

src: Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wetfule inkhulumo nakuvulwa umhlangano Wemnotfo Wahulumende Netinkampani Tangasese lebewusemkhatsini weJapan ne-Afrika lebewubanjelwe eSandton Convention Centre kusukela ngamhlaka-3 kuya ku-4 Mabasa 2018.
tgt: Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u nyikile mbulavulo wa siku eka ku pfuriwa ka Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Mfumo-Mabindzu exikarhi ka Japan-Afrika leyi a yi khomeriwile eSandton Convention Centre ku sukela hi ti3 ku fika hi ti 4 Mudyaxihi 2018.

src: Lomhlangano bewubanjwe ngekubambisana yiNingizimu Afrika, kanye nahulumende waseJapan kanye ne-Japan External Trade Organization.
tgt: Foramu yi rhurheriwile xikan'we hi Afrika-Dzonga, na mfumo wa Japan na Nhlangano wa Mabindzu ya le Handle ka Japan.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela lokutinikela lokuchubekako lokwentiwa kuleNkhomfa yeMave Emhlaba yaseTokyo Ngekutfutfukiswa kwe-Afrika lebeyibanjelwe eNairobi, eKenya nga-2016, lekwente kwekutsi iJapan inikele ngetigidzi letingu US$30 e-Afrika emkhatsini wanga-2016 na-2019.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku tinyikela ku ya emahlweni loku endliweke eka Nhlengeletano ya Matiko ya Misava eTokyo hi Nhluvukiso wa Afrika eNairobi, eKenya hi 2016, loku nga vona Japan yi tshembisa US$30 wa tibiliyoni eAfrika exikarhi ka 2016 na 2019.

src: Tinkampani taseJapan letingetulu kwe-100 tiyatfolakala e-Afrika.
tgt: Ku tlula 100 wa tikhamphani ta le Japan ti kona laha Afrika.

src: Kwenyuswa Kwentsela Yekuhwebelana yeNsimbi ne-Aluminiyamu yi-United States (i-US) IKhabhinethi ivakalise kudvumala kwayo ngalesincumo lesitsetfwe yi-US sekunganiki iNingizimu Afrika sincepheteliso sekungakhokhi intsela yekuhwebelana yensimbi ne-aluminiyamu.
tgt: Ku Engeteleriwa ka Tihakelo ta Tinsimbhi na Aluminiyamu hi Amerika (US).

src: Hulumende waseNingizimu Afrika utawuchubeka nekukhulumisana nahulumende wase-US kutsi bangene esivumelwaneni lesitakwemukeleka kulamave lamabili.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombisa ku nga khomeki kahle hi xiboho xa Amerika ku ka yi nga humesi Afrika-Dzonga eka xikombelo xa ku nga hakeri swibalo swa tinsimbhi na aluminiyamu.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bakuleli labatsenga ngaphandle kutsi bachubeke bakhulumisane nalabo labatsenga e-US kutsi bafake sicelo sekuncepheteliswa kumikhicito, njengoba tinkampani taseNingizimu Afrika titfumela ngaphandle imikhicito lemincane nemikhicito lengakaphotfulwa ngalokugcwele kutsi icedzelelwe kuphotfulwa e-UKuvuselelwa kwema-Industrial Parks.
tgt: Mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga wu ta ya emahlweni na ku burisana na vulawuri bya Amerika ku kuma mbuyelo lowu amukelekaka eka hinkwavo.

src: IKhabhinethi yamukela lokucedvwa kwesigaba sekucala sekuvuselelwa kwePhuthaditjhaba Industrial Park leseFreyistata njengemsebenti lobaluleke kakhulu Kuloluhlelo Lwekuvuselela ema-Industrial Parks.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi khutaza varhumeri va tinhundzu va laha kaya ku ya emahlweni va hlohlotela vaxavi va le Amerika ku endla xikombelo xa ku sivela ku hakeriwa ka swibalo, tanihileswi tikhamphani ta Afrika-Dzonga ti rhumelaka swimakiwa swa xiyimo xa le henhla na swimakiwa leswi nga helelangiki ku va swi ya hetisisiwa eAmerika.

src: Kusisa.
tgt: Ku vuyelerisa Tiphaka ta Mabindzu.

src: IKhabhinethi iyabuhalalisela lobudlelwano lobusemkhatsini weLitiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni (i-dti) ne-Aspen Pharmacare, lokubangele kutsi kumemetelwe kwekutsi kutawusiswa ngemali lesigidzigidzi lesi-R1 embonini leyenta imitsi lesePort Elizabeth eMpumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku hetisiwa ka xiyenge xo sungula xa ku vuyelerisa ka Phaka ya Mabindzu ya Phuthaditjhaba eFree State tanihi goza ra nkoka eku simekiweni ka Phurogireme ya ku Vuyelerisa ka Tiphaka ta Mabindzu.

src: Lemboni lekhicita imitsi ihlomulile kule 12l leSisibonelelo Sentsela saka-dti lapho kutfolakala inzuzo yentsela lelinganiselwa kutigidzi letinge- R209.
tgt: Ku kurisa loku nga endliwa hi R50 wa timiliyoni ku ta koka rinoko eka van'wamabindzu va laha kaya ku sungula mitirho ya vona hi mhaka ya ku antswisiwa ka miako na vuhlayiseki.

src: IKhabhinethi yamukela lemitsetfo lemisha lephakanyiswe Ngumtimba Lotimele Wetekuchumana waseNingizimu Afrika (i-Icasa) yekutfutfukisa imitsetfo lemisiwe ngalokuphatselene nedatha, ema-SMS kanye netinsita tekuchumana ngekukhuluma elucingweni.
tgt: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka xinakulobye exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti) na Aspen Pharmacare, leswi nga endla leswaku ku tivisiwa vuvekisi bya R1 wa tibiliyoni eka feme ya ku endla swidzidziharisi ePort Elizabeth eka Kapa-Vuxa.

src: Letingucuko tisinyatselo letihlose kucinisekisa kusebenta ngalokungavuni licala emabhizinisini kute kucinisekiswe emanani lakahle edatha nekucinisekisa kwekutsi batsengi angeke basalahlekelwa yidatha labangakayisebentisi.
tgt: Khamphani ya ku endla mirhi yi vuyeriwile hi ku suka eka Xinavetisi xa Xibalo xa 12I xa dti hi ntsengo wa xibalo xa xikweleti wa kwalomu ka R209 wa timiliyoni.

src: Loluphenyo kuleTimakethe lwentiwa yiKhomishini Yetekuncintisana kantsi itawuveta ibuye igcile etintfweni letingetiwe, kucinisekisa kwekutsi emanani edatha yaseNingizimu Afrika asekela kufinyelela kumadijithali kantsi asilungiselela lamatfuba lasungulwe Yilesikhatsi Sekwentiwa Kwemsebenti Ngetheknoloji Yesimanjemanje.
tgt: Lebyi i vuvekisi byikulu lebyi yisaka Afrika-Dzonga eka xiyimo xintshwa xa ku vumaki na ku endla mitirho yintshwa ya nkoka leyi lavekaka etikweni.

src: Umkhakha weTimbiwa.
tgt: Tihakelo ta le Hansi ta Datha.

src: IKhabhinethi nayo njengaMengameli Ramaphosa iveta kukhatsateka ngekushona kwebantfu lebebasebenta emayini yaseSibanye-Stillwater leseDriefontein dvutane naseCarletonville eWest Rand, kantsi ibuye idlulise kulila kwayo emindenini nakubangani balaba labashonile.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela milawu yintshwa leyi nga ringanyetiwa hi Ndzawulo yo Tiyimela ya Vuhlanganisi bya Afrika-Dzonga ku antswisa swipimelo mayelana na datha, SMS na vukorhokeri bya ku vulavula.

src: Ndvuna Yetetimbiwa, MnuGwede Mantashe, ulindzeleke kutsi amele hulumende enkonzweni yesikhumbuto letawubanjwa leliviki.
tgt: Ku cinca i magoza ya ku tiyisisa vululami eka matirhelo ya bindzu eka timhaka ta mahakelelo ya datha na ku tiyisisa leswaku vatirhisi va nga lahlekeriwi hi datha leyi va nga yi tirhisangiki.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bemkhakha wetetimbiwa kutsi baphutfumise lucwaningo lwabo lolutawusita ekutfoleni tindlela tekuhlola kutamatama kwemhlaba etimayini bese kuhlengeka timphilo tebantfu.
tgt: Vulavisisi bya Timakete lebyi nga le ku endliweni hi Khomixini ya Mphikizano byi ta kombisa swinene na ku kongomisa eka tindlela to engetela, ku tiyisisa leswaku tihakelo ta datha laha Afrika-Dzonga tiseketela mfikelelo wa dijithali wo anama na ku hi lulamisela swivandlanene leswi nga endliwa hi Hundzuluxo wa Vumaki wa Vumune.

src: Umcondzisi Lomkhulu we-UNICEF, MkHenrietta Fore, ubambe umhlangano naMengameli Ramaphosa ngeMsombuluko ngamhlati-7 Mabasa 2018.
tgt: Holobye wa Swicelwa, Tat Gwede Mantashe, u languteriwe ku yimela mfumo eka ntirho wa ku tsundzuka lowu nga ta khomiwa eka vhiki leri.

src: Ucacise umbiko we-UNICEF ngekuhambisana nemitamo yeNingizimu Afrika kumikhakha lephatselene netemfundvo, kutfutfukisa emakhono emsebenti nematfuba emnotfo kubantfu labasebancane, ikakhulukati labo labasemkhatsini weminyaka le-10 kuya kule-18 budzala.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlohlotela sekithara ya migodi ku hatlisisa vulavisisi bya yona lebyi nga ta hi pfuna eka vuswikoti bya ku kuma ku tsekatseka ka migodi na ku ponisa vutomi.

src: I-UNICEF ibonge imitamo yeNingizimu Afrika yekwakha ematfuba ebantfu labasha kutsi bangenelele ngalokugcwele kumnotfo, babuye baveta nekufisa kusita tikole tetfu ngekutiniketa emanti netinsita tetekuya ngasese.
tgt: Khabinete yi yima na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku kombisa ku nkhensa eka nseketelo na ntirhisano wa UNICEF eka ku nyika matimba eka vantshwa va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: I-UNICEF imeme iNingizimu Afrika kutsi ibatjele ngekuphumelela kwayo ekuniketeni lusha emandla njengencenye yalomkhankaso wamhlabawonkhe wekwenta kancono ematfuba elusha – luphawu lolubonakalisa kutsi budlelwano balelive ne-UN buyasimama.
tgt: U andlarile xiviko xa UNICEF eka migingiriko ya Afrika-Dzonga eka timhaka ta dyondzo, nhluvukiso wa swikili swa mitirho na swivandlanene swa ikhonomi eka vantshwa, ngopfungopfu eka lava nga ni malembe ya le xikarhi ka 10 na 18 hi vukhale.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumele Loluhlelo Lwekenta Lwenchubomgomo Yetetimboni (i-IPAP) lwanga-2018/19 – 2020/21.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Kungu ra Migingiriko ra Pholisi ya Vumaki (IPAP) 2018/19 - 2020/21.

src: Lena yinchubo leseyiphindvwe ka-10 yekwetfulwa kweluhlelo lwekusebenta lwanyaka wonkhe lolutawuhambisana neLuhlaka Lwecitfomali Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini lolutsatsa sikhatsi lesiyiminyaka lemitsatfu.
tgt: Loku i ku vuyelela ka vu 10 ka kungu ra migingiriko ya lembe na lembe ya nhluvukiso lowu fambisanaka na ku humelela ka malembe ya nharhu hi ku landzelelana ka Rimba ra Ntirhiso wa le Xikarhi ka Theme.

src: Le IPAP lebuyeketiwe inikete ummongo yalesekwentiwe ngemphumelelo ngalenchubomgomo yetimboni kuleminyaka leyimfica lendlulile.
tgt: IPAP leyi nga pfuxetiwa i nkomiso wa leswi nga fikeleriwa eka pholisi ya vumaki eka malembe ya kaye lawa ya nga hundza.

src: Ihlatiya umnotfo wamhlabawonkhe newakuleli lohambisana nenchubomgomo yetimboni, iniketa sifinyeto saletinselela nebumatima kulokusetjentiswa ngalokuhambe embili kwalenchubomgomo yetimboni, kanye naloluchungechunge lwetinhlelo kanye netinhlelo talomkhakha letihambisana nesikhatsi lesitsite sekwentiwa kwemsebenti loniketwe ematiko tsite.
tgt: Yi nyika nxopaxopo wa ikhonomi ya misava na ya laha kaya leyi nga fanela eka pholisi ya vumaki, nkomiso wa mitlhontlho na mitlimbo eka ku simekiwa hi ku hetiseka ka pholisi ya vumaki, ku katsa na ku cincana ko hambanahambana na makungu ya migingirikonkulu ya nkarhi lowu vekiweke hi sekithara yokarhi lawa ya nyikiweke tindzawulo hi ku hambana ka tona.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuma kwekutsi Sivumelwano Setigodzi Letintsatfu Letingakhokhisani Intsela Yekuhwebelana (i-TFTA) kutsi setfulwe ePhalamende kute sivunyelwe.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Ntwanano wa Mabindzu ya Mihlangano yi Nharhu ya Mahala (TFTA) ku va yi andlariwa ePalamende.

src: Lesivumelwano sisungula Inhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave laseNingizimu neMpumalanga Afrika (i-COMESA), Inhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave langaseMpumalanga ne-Afrika (i-EAC) kanye neNhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave LangaseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC).Le TFTA ingumklamo lobalulekile loholwa yi-Afrika lobonisa sinyatselo sekulungisa umonakalo lowashiywa yinchubobukoloni leyayikhutsata emave kutsi angasebentisani, ngekutfutfukisa tindlela tekusisa letifaka emave aseAfrika nekuheha letinye tindlela tekusisa tangaphandle tingenele kulendzawo yekuhwebelana mahhala.
tgt: Ntwanano wu tumbuluxa Makete lowu Fanaka wa le Vuxeni na le Dzongeni wa Afrika, Muganga wa le Vuxeni bya Afrika na Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa le Dzongeni wa Afrika.

src: Ngenca yalemitamo yekuhlanganiswa kwaletigodzi nekusimama kweminotfo, kutfolakale kutsi kunekukhula lokusimeme ekusiseni kwalamave ase Afrika.
tgt: TFTA leyi i phurojeke leyi rhangeriwaka hi Afrika leyi kombisaka ku teka swiboho ku hlula ndzhaka ya xikoloni laha Afrika eka timakete letintsongo leti nga hambana, hi ku seketela vuvekisi bya kwala Afrika na ku koka rinoko ra vuvekisi byo tala bya matikomambe eka tindhawu ta mabindzu lawa ya nga ri ki na swipimelo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumele Umbiko Wekuchumana Wesitsatfu waseNingizimu Afrika kwekutsi wetfulwe KuSivumelwano se-UN Sekugucuka Kwesimo Selitulu (i-UNFCCC).Umsebenti lobalulekile we-UNFCCC kutfola indlela yekusinyanyiswa kwe-greenhouse gas kusimondzawo kufinyelele ezingeni lelitawuvikela tintfo letiyingoti letentiwa ngebantfu kutsi tiletse lushintjo kwisimo selitulu.
tgt: Tanihi mbuyelo wa ku hlangana ka miganga na ku tshamiseka ka tiikhonomi, ku vile na ku kula eka vuvekisi bya kwala tikweninkulu ra Afrika eka vuvekisi.

src: Umbiko weNingizimu Afrika ucuketse luhlatiyo ngemsebenti lewentiwe kusukela Kumbiko Wekuchumano Wavelonkhe wekucala kuya Kumbiwo Wekuchumana Wavelonkhe Wesibili kanye naLombiko Wekuchumana Wavelonkhe Wesitsatfu, njengoba kubuyeketwe ngemave angaphandle kanye nalabatsintsekako bakuleli.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko xa Vuhlanganisi xa Rixaka xa Vunharhu xa Afrika-Dzonga ku va xi rhumeriwa eka Rimba ra UN eka Ntwanano wa ku Cinca ka Maxelo (UNFCCC).Xikongomelo xo rhanga xa UNFCCC i ku fikelela ntshamiseko eka nhlanganelo wa mimoya ya le xibakabakeni ku fika eka xiyimo lexi nga ta sivela migingiriko leyi nga ya khombo ya matumbulukelo ya vanhu ku va yi kavanyeta sisiteme ya maxelo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo, lobekhona ngenca yekutsintsana ngalokugcwele nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako kumkhakha wetekulima taselwandle, ufuna kutfutfukisa intfutfuko kwetekulima taselwandle ikakhulukati kumnotfo waselwandle.
tgt: Xiviko xa Afrika-Dzonga xi na ku hlela ku humelela ku suka eka Vuhlanganisi bya Rixaka byo sungula ku ya eka Vuhlanganisi bya Rixaka bya Vumbirhi naswona hi ku landzelela Xiviko xa Vuhlanganisi bya Vunharhu, tanihilaha swi nga kamberiwa hakona hi vaaki va matiko ya misava na lava khumbhekaka kwala kaya.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumele kwetfulwa Kwemtsetfosivivinyo Wetemphilo Nekuphepha Emisebentini wanga-2018 ePhalamende.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi wa Nhluvukiso wa swa le Lwandle wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: Uma sekuvunyelwene ngawo, loMtsetfosivivinyo utawucinisekisa kwekutsi kunekuvikeleka lokusezingeni kwebasebenti ngalokuphatselene nekulimala nekugula emsebentini.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu ku nga burisaniwa na hinkwavo lava khumbhekaka lava nga fanela, wu lava ku tlakusa nhluvukiso wa swa le lwandle eka ikhonomi ya le lwandle.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo usungula Luhlelo Lwekulawula Temphilo Nekuphepha kantsi uhambisana netindlela letihambembili letisetjentiswa kulamanye emave.
tgt: Wu nyika, eka swin'wana swa kona, mitwanano ya mihlangano ya sekithara, ku endla mapapila ya mpfumelelo na swilaveko swa mpfumelelo eka swa le lwandle na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tizoni ta nhluvukiso ta swa le lwandle.

src: Ubuye ucindzetele kutsi kube netindlela tekuhlola bungoti lokutawentiwa ngumcashi kanye neluhlelo lolukhona lwasemsebentini lwekuhlola nekulawula tingoti lolusungulwe lwasetjentiswa kwehlisa emazinga ekulimala kwetisebenti.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi wa Vuhlayiseki na Rihanyo ra le Ntirhweni wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongela Mengameli Ramaphosa, ngekumenywa Ngumtimba Lobusako Wemhlangano Wemisebenti Wamhlabawonkhe kutsi ayoba ngomunye wabosihlalo kuKhomishani Yavelonkhe Ngemisebenti Letako.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu tumbuluxa nhlamuselo leyi nga erivaleni ya Sisiteme ya Vufambisi bya Vuhlayiseki na Rihanyo leyi fambisanaka na matirhelo ya xiyimo xa le henhla xa matiko ya misava.

src: Mengameli ubuye wamenywa kutsi ayokhuluma kulomhlangano, lotawube ubungata kuhlangana lihlandla le-100.
tgt: Wu tlhela wu nyika vuhleri bya nxungeto lowu bohaka ku va wu endliwa hi muthori na kungu ra mafambiselo ya nxungeto wo nkarhi wa laha ku tirhiwaka kona ku va wu endliwa na ku simekiwa ku hunguta ku va ekhombyeni ka vathoriwa.

src: Ngalesikhatsi alapho utawuhlonipha atfulele sigcoko lobetawuhlanganisa iminyaka lelikhulu lebekunguMengameli Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Ramaphosa, loyi a nga rhambiwa hi Khomfarense ya Nhlangano wa Vatirhi va Matiko ya Misava (ILO) ya Huvo leyi Fumaka ku va mutshamaxitulukulorhi eka Mitirho ya Mundzuku eka Khomixini ya Misava.

src: IKhabhinethi ibona Emave ase-Afrika kulomtimba lobusako weNhlangano Yetetisebenti Yemhlabawonkhe (i-ILO) ngekuhola letingcogco eGeneva kantsi ibonga letingcogco letibanjwe ngulenhlangano lebusako kulelive etigodzini tayo lapho ibusa khona.
tgt: Phuresidente u tlhele a rhambiwa ku nyika mbulavulo eka khomfarense, leyi tlangelaka 100 wa malembe yi ri kona.

src: IKhabhinethi indlulisa kulila kwayo emndenini nakubangani baNdvuna longasekho naNdvuna wekucala Wetimali kuhulumende wentsandvo yelinyenti, MnuDerek Keys, lowadlala indzima lebaluleke kakhulu ekundluliseni ngebuchwepheshe kweLitiko Letetimali kuhulumende lebekakhetfwe ngekwentsandvo yelinyenti nga-1994.
tgt: Khabinete yi nkhensa Ntlawa wa Afrika eka huvo ya mafumele ya ILO ku va yi rhangela mbhurisano eGeneva na ku khensa mivulavurisano leyi nga khomiweke hi vandla leri fumaka eka miganga ya kwala kaya.

src: IKhabhinethi yendlulisa tilokotfo letinhle kummango wemaMuslim ngalesikhatsi bacala kuzila bazilela lenyanga lengcwele yaRamadan kuleliviki lelitako.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka ndyangu na vanghana va khale na Holobye wo sungula wa Timali eka Afrika-Dzonga ra xidemokirasi, Tat Derek Keys, loyi a nga hoxa xandla swinene eka ku hundzisela Nkwama wa tiko ku ya eka mfumo wa xidemokirasi lowu nga hlawuriwa hi 1994.

src: Ngalesikhatsi saRamadan, emaMuslim azila kudla kusukela ekuseni lidzimate liyoshona, ngalesikhatsi bacitsa sikhatsi bagcila ekukholweni kwabo.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela ku navelela ka kahle eka rixaka ra Mamozileme loko va ha sungula ku titsona eka n'hweti yo tenga ya Ramadan vhiki leri landzaka.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa namuhla ngamhlati-10 Mabasa 2018, utawuvakashela Litiko Letekuvikela neLitiko Lekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko (i-CoGTA), njengencenye yemitamo yakhe yekungenelela akhulumisane nebaholi kucinisekisa kwekutsi umsebenti wahulumende uhambisana kahle.
tgt: Namuntlha Phuresidente Ramaphosa, 10 Mudyaxihi 2018, u ta endzela Ndzawulo ya Vusirheleri na Ndzawulo ya Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu (CoGTA) hi ku landzelelana, tanihi xiphemu xakwe xa ku burisana na vurhangerinkulu ku tiyisisa leswaku mitirho ya mfumo yi fambisana kahle.

src: Lokuvakasha kuyincenye yekwephumelelisa setsembisa Mengameli lawasenta naketfula Inkhulumo yakhe yekucala yEbunjalo Belive ngeNdlovana 2018 kwekutsi utawuvakashela onkhe ematiko ahulumende.
tgt: Riendzo leri i xiphemu xa ku tinyikela ka Phuresidente tanihiloko a vurile eka Mbulavulo wa yena na Rixaka wo sungula hi Nyenyanyana 2018 wa ku endzela ndzawulo yin'wana na yin'wana ya rixaka hi mayelana na mhaka leyi.

src: Sekelamengameli David Mabuza namuhla ngamhlati-10 Mabasa 2018, utawutfula inkhulumo Kungcungcutsela yesi-3 Yemkhandlu Wekutfutfukisa Basebenti waseNingizimu Afrika e-Emperors Palace eJozi ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: ‘Budlelwano lobuvuselela umsebenti nekufundza’.
tgt: Namuntlha Xandla xa Phuresidente David Mabuza, 10 Mudyaxihi 2018, u ta vulavula eka Samiti ya vunharhu ya Huvo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vuthori ya Afrika-Dzonga eEmperors Palace eJoni ehansi ka nkongomelo: 'Xinakulobye xa ku pfuxelela ntirho na ku dyondza.'

src: Lengcungcutsela yemalanga lamabili itawuhlanganisa baholi lababalulekile etimbonini, bochwepheshe kutemisebenti netifundziswa kutococisana ngetindzaba letihlukene, kufaka ekhatsi tiphakamiso tekubuketana nekungasebenti kwelusha, kuniketwa emandla lokusezingeni Nesikhatsi Sekwentiwa Kwemisebenti Ngetheknoloji Yesimanjemanje.
tgt: Samiti ya masiku mambirhi yi ta tisa varhangeri va vumaki bya nkoka, vativi va swa mitirho na swidyondzeki ku tekela enhlokweni timhaka to hambanahambana, ku katsa na swiringanyeto swa ku tirhana na ku pfumaleka ka mitirho ya vantshwa, na ku yisa emahlweni ku nyika matimba ku yisa emahlweni na Hundzuluxo wa Vumaki wa Vumune.

src: IKhabhinethi nayo indlulisa lesimemo kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bangenelele ekubungateni lokutawenteka umnyaka wonkhe kweminyaka lelikhulu yaBabe Nelson Mandela naMake Albertina Sisulu, labasita ekwakheni sisekelo sembuso wentsandvo yelinyenti eNingizimu Afrika lesiyitfokotelako namuhla.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vuyelerisa xirhambo eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku va va nghenelela eka ku tlangela Malembexidzana ya Tatana Nelson Mandela na Manana Albertina Sisulu, lava nga pfuna ku aka masungulo ya xidemokirasi xa Afrika-Dzonga lexi hi tiphinaka ha xona namuntlha.

src: Litsimba Lelikomidi laboNdvuna lelisebenta ngekubungatwa kweMinyaka Lelikhulu yaNelson Mandela na-Albertina Sisulu likhiphe loLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe kuleliviki.
tgt: Komiti ya Vaholobye ya Malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela na Malembexidzana ya Albertina Sisulu yi simekile Phurogireme ya Rixaka vhiki leri.

src: Imininingwane yalokubungata ingatfolakala kuwebhusayithi yahulumende (WEBTOKEN), lapho khona tinhlelo tekucocisana nahulumende letihleliwe noma imisebenti kungatfolakala khona.
tgt: Vuxokoxoko bya ku tlangela byi nga kumeka eka webusayiti ya mfumo eka (WEBTOKEN)), laha mitlangu yin'wana leyi ya ha taka ya mfumo na migingiriko yi nga kumekaka kona.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleniKonkhe kubekwa etikhundleni kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunywa lokufanele.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa ku va kona endzhaku ka nkambelo wa tidyondzo na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: MkLerato Mataboge njengalomele i-dti kuBhodi ye-Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.
tgt: Manana Lerato Mataboge tanihi muyimeri wa dti eka Huvo ya ku Rhumeriwa ka Ndzindzakhombo wa Xikweleti wa Afrika-Dzonga SOC limited.

src: MkRS Mogaladi njengeLisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele: Kwesekela Sikhungo neKuchumanisa ku- CoGTA.
tgt: Manana RS Mogaladi tanihi Xandla xa Mulawuri wo Angarhela: Mafambiselo na Nseketelo wa Nhlangano, CoGTA.

src: Ikhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-23 Inkhwekhweti 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: Xitatimente xa Nhlengeletano ya Khabinete xa ti 23 Mudyaxihi 2018Khabinete yi hlangenile hi Ravunharhu, 23 Mudyaxihi 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Tindzaba Letimcoka Telive.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Budlova lobuCondziswe kuBulili (i-GBV).
tgt: Madzolonga lama yaka hi Rimbewu (GBV).

src: Ikhabhinethi ibuhlaba kakhulu budlova lobucondziswe kubomake nebantfwana.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola hi matimba madzolonga ehenhla ka vavasati na vana.

src: Tehlakalo letisandza kwenteka taNonkululeko Mpanza naNompumelelo Mhlongo eThokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja eMamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu KwaZulu-Natal naJabulile Nhlapo, sitjudeni saseNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Unisa), tenta kutsi kubukwe ngeliso lelibukhali lizinga lebudlova lobubeka engotini timphilo tabomake nebantfwana betfu.
tgt: Milandzu leyi ya ha ku vaka kona sweswinyana ya Nonkululeko Mpanza na Nompumelelo Mhlongo eThokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja eMamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu eKwaZulu-Natal na Jabulile Nhlapo, xichudeni lexa le Unisa, yi tisa nkongomiso lowukulu eka mpimo wa madzolonga lowu chavisetaka vutomi bya vavasati na vana va hina.

src: Ikhabinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo lokukhulu emindenini nakubangani balabomake nalabantfwana.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa michavelelo ya yona leyikulu eka mindyangu na vanghana va vavasati na vana lava.

src: Loludzaba lwebugebengu lobentiwa kubomake nebantfwana lusidzinga sonkhe kutsi sihlanganyele ngemandla ekulweni nabo.
tgt: Xiphiqo xa vugevenga ehenhla ka vavasati na vana xi lava hinkwerhu ka hina ku khumbeka hi ndlela yo gingiriteka eka ku lwisana na xona.

src: Ikhabinethi iyachubeka nekucinisa ema-ejensi ebacinisekisi bekugcinwa kwemtsetfo ekulweni nekutsi kuvinjwe lobudlova lobucondziswe kubulili (i-GBV).
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisa tiejensi to sindzisa nawu eka nyimpi ya ku yimisa GBExikarhi ka Milawumbisi leyi pasisiweke eka Khabinete leyi nga hundza i Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Mafambiselo ya Vugevenga wa 2018, lowu hundzuluxaka Nawu wa Mafambiselo ya Vugevenga, 1977 (Nawu wa 51 wa 1977).

src: Emkhatsini weMitsetfosivivinyo levunywe yiKhabhinethi leyendlulile kuneMtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Inchubo yeKubukana neBugebengu wanga-2018, lochibela Umtsetfo weNchubo yeKubukana neBugebengu, wanga-1977 (Umtsetfo-51 wanga-1977).
tgt: Nawumbisi wu ta ndlandlamukisa nxaxamelo wa milandzu ya swa masangu hi mayelana na vuchuchisi naswona hindlela yo tivikana swinene wu pfumelela milandzu ya swa masangu ku ya emahlweni ka tikhoto hambi ku ri endzhaku ka 20 wa malembe.

src: Letinyatselo tekungenelela tengeta kutinhlelo nome-ke tinyatselo letinyenti hulumende lasevele atihlelile, atimise ngemumo.
tgt: Ku nghenelela loku ku ta engetela nhlayo ya magoza lama mfumo se wu ya tekeke.

src: Sekuvulwe tikhungo tetunakekela, emaThuthuzela Care Centres, letinge-54 kulo lonkhe lelive letisebenta njengetikhungo lotfola kuto tonkhe tinsita lotidzingako, letinciphisa kuhlukubeteka lokuchubekako tiphindze futsi tinciphisa nesikhatsi sekuphetfwa kwemacala ebugebengu betemacasi.
tgt: Ntsengo wa 54 wa Tisenthara ta Nhlayiso ta Thuthuzela etikweni hinkwaro ti pfuriwile ku tirha tanihi xitirhisiwa lexi nga na vukorhokeri hinkwabyo ku hunguta ku xanisiwa ka vumbirhi na ku hunguta nkarhi wa ku hetisisa milandzu ya swa masangu.

src: Hulumende sewusungule Tinkantolo teMacala eTemacasi letinge-75 letitawubukana tiphindze futsi tephetse emacala ebudlova betemacasi lobentiwa kubomake.
tgt: Mfumo wu simekile 75 wa Tikhoto ta Milandzu ya swa Masangu leti endleriweke hi xikongomelo xa ku tirhana hi ndlela yo tisa mbuyelo eka madzolonga ya swa masangu ehenhla ka vavasati.

src: Ngetulu kwaloko, Luphiko Lwemaphoyisa LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) selusungule tikhungo leti-1 047 etiteshini temaphoyisa kulo lonkhe lelive letitawubukana netidzingo tiphindze tisite bahlukunyetwa be-GBLiviki leKuvikela Bantfwana litawubanjwa kusukela mhla tinge-27 Inkhwekhweti kuya kumhla ti-2 Inhlaba 2018.
tgt: Ku yisa emahlweni, Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga hi tumbuluxile 1 047 wa switirhisiwa leswi nyikeriweke vaxanisiwa eswitichini swa maphorisa etikweni hinkwaro ku rhurhela na ku pfuneta vaxanisiwa va GBVhiki ra Nsirhelelo wa Vana ri ta khomiwa kusuka hi siku ra 27 Mudyaxihi kufika ra 2 Khotavuxika 2018.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema batali, banakekeli bebantfwana kanye nemimango kutsi isebentisane nema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo nome emaphoyisa kutsi bavikele bantfwana.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vatswari, vahlayisi na vaakandhawu ku tirhisana na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ku sirhelela vana va hina.

src: Ikhabhinethi igcizelela kutsi uma ngabe usola kutsi umntfwana wakho unyamalele, ufanele kutsi ubike masinyane esiteshini semaphoyisa.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshikelele leswaku loko u ehleketelela leswaku n’wana wa wena wa kayivela, u fanele ku mangala xikan’wekan’we exitichini xa maphorisa xa le kusuhi na wena.

src: Sifanele kutsi sisebentisane njengelive lelitsandza kuthula kanye futsi neligcina umtsetfo kulwa nabo bonkhe bugebengu lobentiwa kubomake nebantfwana.
tgt: Hi fanele ku tirhisana tanihi rixaka leri rhandzaka ku rhula na ku va leri hlayisaka nawu ku tirhana na vugevenga hinkwabyo ehenhla ka vavasati na vana.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe labanelwati nganoma ngubuphi bugebengu lobentiwa kubantfwana kutsi bashayele lucingo lwe-Childline lwamahhala ku: 0800 055 555 noma lucingo lwe-Crime Stop ku: 086 0010.111.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba lava va tivaka hi vugevenga byihi kumbe byihi ehenhla ka vana ku bela riqingho eka nomboro ya mahala yo Pfuna hi swa Vana eka 0800 055 555 kumbe Riqingho ro Mangala Vugevenga eka 086 0010.111.

src: Uma ngabe ungumake lohlukubetwako noma uma ngabe kukhona make lomatiko lohlukubetwako, inombolo yamahhala yeSikhungo seLusito se-GBV ngu: 0800 428 428 noma (0800 GBV GBV).
tgt: Loko u ri wansati loyi a nga eku xanisekeni kumbe loko u tiva wansati loyi a nga eku xanisekeni, nomboro ya mahala ya Senthara ya Ndzeriso ya GBV i 0800 428 428 kumbe (0800 GBV GBV).

src: Ikhabhinethi isimema sonkhe kutsi sisebentisane sente lokunyenti kuvikela budlova lobentiwa kubomake nebantfwana, sesekele labasindze ekuhlukunyetweni sibuye futsi sente kutsi bahlukubeti bajeziswe.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba hinkwerhu ka hina ku tirhisana ku endla swo tala ku sivela madzolonga ehenhla ka vavasati na vana, ku seketela lava poneke nxaniso na ku endla leswaku vaonhi va xupuriwa.

src: Kungumsebenti wawonkhewonkhe kubika labo labalimata, basebentise ngalokungafanele babuye futsi bahlukubete bomake nebantfwana kute kutsi lababhebhetseli bangabanjwa, baboshwe babuye futsi bagwetjwe.
tgt: I vutihlamuleri bya munhu un’wana na un’wana ku mangalela lava va vavisaka, va va tirhisaka hindlela yo homboloka na ku xanisa vavasati na vana ku endlela leswaku vaonhi va khomiwa na ku voniwa nandzu.

src: Temnotfo Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhula kwemnotfo lokuhle kwemisebenti lenge-260 000 lebonakele ekoteni yekucala yanga-2018, kuLuklayo lweTemisebenti lweKota yakamuva lolukhululwe Lihhovisi Lelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika (i-StatSA).
tgt: IkhonomiKhabinete yi amukela ku kula lokunene eka ku thoriwa ka madzanambirhi na magiditsevu wa mitirho leyi kombisiweke eka kotara yo sungula ya 2018, kusuka eka Mbalango wa Vatirhi wa Kotara na Kotara lowu wa ha ku humesiwaka hi Nhlangano wa Tinhlayonhlayo wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Lokukhula kwemisebenti kwabangelwa kukhula kwetimboni letisitfupha kuleti leti-10.
tgt: Ku tlakuka eka ku thoriwa a ku hlohloteriwa hi mitlakuko eka tsevu wa 10 ra tiindasitiri.

src: Lizinga lekungasebenti kwebantfu labasha, nanoma kunjalo, liyachubeka nekuba setulu ku-52.4%, bese kutsi lizinga lebatfola misebenti linge-12.2% kuphela.
tgt: Mpimo wa vupfumalantirho exikarhi ka vanhu va ka hina lavatsongo, hambiswiritano, ku tama ka ha ri ehenhla eka 52.4%, laha ku nga na mpimo wa ku nghena entirhweni wa 12.2% ntsena.

src: Ikhabinethi iyachubeka nekumema imikhakha yemmango kutsi ichubeke isebentisane ekulweni nekungasebenti kwelusha.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba tisekitara ta rixaka ku ya emahlweni ti tirhisana ku tirhana na vupfumalantirho bya vantshwa.

src: Ngekwemoya we-'Thuma Mina – Send Me’ loshisekeliswe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa eNkhulumeni yeBunjalo beLive (i-SoNA) yakhe yekucala yangeNdlovana 2018, Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu umkhakha lotimele, kutsi usite wakhe ematfuba emisebenti ubuye futsi utjale imali khona lapha ekhaya kute kutsi bantfu balapha eNingizimu Afrika bangene emnotfweni.
tgt: Hi moya wa ‘Thuma Mina – Send Me’ lowu hlohloteriweke hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa eka Mbulavulo wa yena Xiyimo xa Rixaka wo sungula hi Nyenyanyana 2018, Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo, ngopfungopfu sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo, ku pfuna ku tumbuluxa mitirho na ku vekisa laha tikweni ku endlela leswaku Maafrika-Dzonga vo tala va kota ku nghenisiwa eka ikhonomi.

src: TemandlaIkhabhinethi ikwemukela njengeligcatsi kwetfulwa kwemklamo wemandla elilanga i-Xina Solar One Concentrated Solar Power Project eNyakatfo Kapa.
tgt: EnejiKhabinete yi amukela tanihi mpimo ku simekiwa ka Phurojeke ya Matimba ya Dyambu lama Hlengeletaneke ya Xina Solar One eKapa-N’walungu.

src: Ungulomunye weMiklamo leSikhombisa yeMandla eLilanga longaphasi kweLuhlelo lweKutsenga Mandla laVusekelwako Kutikhicitimandla letitiMele lelingaphasi kweLitiko Letemandla.
tgt: I yin’wana ya nkombo wa Tiphurojeke ta Matimba ya Dyambu lama Hlengeletaneke leti nga ehansi ka Nongonoko wa Maxavelo ya Vahumesi va Matimba lava Tiyimelaka va Eneji leyi Vuyelerisekaka wa Ndzawulo ya Eneji.

src: Siphehligezi seXina Solar One sitawunika i-Eskom gezi lohlobile ngaphasi kwesivumelwane sekutsenga gezi seminyaka lenge-20.
tgt: Pulanti ya Xina Solar One yi ta nyika eneji yo basa eka Eskom ehansi ka ntwanano wo xava matimba wa 20 wa malembe.

src: Loku kutawusho kutsi ati-95 000 emakhaya aseNingizimu Afrika latawutfola gezi lohlobile, ikakhulu ngetikhatsi lapho asetjentiswa kakhulu khona.
tgt: Leswi swi ta hundzuka 95 000 ya miti ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi kumaka eneji yo basa, ngopfungopfu hi nkarhi ntlevuntlevu.

src: INyakatfo nshonalanga Ikhabhinethi itfole umbiko wesibili lovela kuLikomidi leTindvuna (i-IMIC) lomayelana neNyakatfo Nshonalanga futsi iyenetiseka ngenchubekelembili yekutintisa kulesifundza.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukele xiviko xa vumbirhi kusuka eka Komiti ya Vaholobye (IMC) eka N’walungu-Vupeladyambu naswona yi enerisekile hi ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka ku tshamisekisa xifundzakulu.

src: Emhlanganweni losandza kwendlula, Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi iNyakatfo Nshonalanga ibekwe ngaphasi kweSigaba se-100 (1) seMtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika wanga-1996.
tgt: Eka nhlengeletano ya yona leyi nga hundza, Khabinete yi pasise leswaku N’walungu-Vupeladyambu yi vekiwa ehansi ka Xiyenge xa 100 (1) xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.

src: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yakhulisa linani lemalunga e-IMC ngekufaka Indvuna yeTemfundvo Lesisekelo yeTemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa yeTekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu yeTekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalalakahle yeTekuvakasha yeTemvelo neyeTekutfutsa.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi engetele swirho swa IMC hi Vaholobye va Dyondzo ya Masungulo Vutirhelamfumo na Vulawuri Vutshamiso bya Vanhu Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu Vupfhumba Timhaka ta Mbangu na Vutleketli.

src: I-IMC icelwe kutsi ichubeke nemsebenti kulesifundza iphindze futsi yeluleke Ikhabhinethi mayelana nekutsi ngumaphi ematiko alesifundza lafanele kutsi afakwe ngaphasi kweSigaba se-100 (1)
tgt: IMC yi komberiwile ku endla ntirho wo yisa emahlweni exifundzenikulu na ku tsundzuxa Khabinete eka leswaku hi tihi ta tindzawulo ta xifundzakulu lexi ti faneleke ku vekiwa ehansi ka Xiyenge xa 100 (1)

src: noma sigaba se-100 (1)
tgt: kumbe Xiyenge xa 100 (1)

src: Ngenca yalomsebenti, Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi ematiko lasihlanu alesifundza afanele kutsi afakwe ngaphasi kweSigaba se-100 (1) : (1) Lihhovisi laNdvunankhulu (2) Litiko Letekuphepha Kwemmango Nekuphatfwa Kwetitfutsi(3) Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo Nekutfutfukiswa Kwetemidlalo (4) Litiko Letemphilo(5) neLitiko Lemisebenti Yahulumende Nemigwaco.
tgt: Hikwalaho ka ntirho lowu, Khabinete yi pasisile leswaku ntlhanu wa tindzawulo ta xifundzakulu ti fanele ku vekiwa ehansi ka Xiyenge xa 100 (1) :Hofisi ya PhirimiyaNdzawulo ya Vuhlayiseki bya Vaakandhawu na Mafambiselo ya VutleketliNdzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo na Nhluvukiso wa MitlanguNdzawulo ya Rihanyu naNdzawulo ya Mitirho ya Mfumo na Magondzo.

src: Ematiko laSihlanu atawufakwa ngaphasi kwesigaba se-100(1) :(1) Litiko Letetimali, Temnotfo Nekutfutfukiswa Kwetemabhizinisi aHulumende(2) Litiko Lahulumende Wendzawo Nekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu (3) Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetasemaphandleni, Temvelo Netekulima(4) Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle(5) neLitiko Letekuvakasha.
tgt: Ntlhanu wa tindzawulo ti ta fanela ku vekiwa ehansi ka xiyenge xa 100(1) :Ndzawulo ya Timali, Ikhonomi na Nhluvukiso wa MabindzuNdzawulo ya Mfumo wa Miganga na Vutshamiso bya VanhuNdzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya, Mbangu na VurimiNdzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu naNdzawulo ya Vupfhumba.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi timbalelwano letifanele tifanele kutsi titfunyelwe kuMkandlu weTifundza waVelonkhe (i-NCOP) nekutsi kuchumana nalabatsintsekako labafanele eNyakatfo Nshonalanga kufanele kutsi kwenteke.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise leswaku ntsalelano lowu lavekaka wu rhumeriwa Huvo ya Rixaka ya Swifundzakulu na leswaku mbulavurisano na vakhomaxiave lava faneleke eN’walungu-Vupeladyambu wu fanele ku endleka.

src: Umsebenti wekuphenya weKlasta yeTebulungiswa, Tekuvikela Bugebengu neTekuphepha ufanele kutsi uchubeke kuto tonkhe letindzaba letidzinga kutsi kungenelele ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo nome emaphoyisa.
tgt: Ntirho wo lavisisa wa Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Nsirhelelo wu ta ya emahlweni eka timhaka hinkwato leti ti lavaka tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ku nghenelela.

src: Tebudlelwane Bemave Emhlaba.
tgt: Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava.

src: Ikhabhinethi itihlabe kakhulu tento tekucalana tebudlova lentiwe ngumbutfo lohlomile wema-Israeli emnyeleni waseGaza, letiholele ekushoneni kwebantfu labanyenti labangasiwo emasotja.
tgt: Khabinete yi sole swinene swiendlo swa nswirhi wa tihanyi leswi endliweke hi mavuthu lama hlomeke ya Israele ku xaxamela na ndzilakana wa Gaza, leswi vangeke mafu ya nhlayo leyikulu ya vaaki.

src: Ngenca yaloluhlaselo lwakamuva lwema-Israeli lolungenangcondvo naloluyingoti kabi, hulumende waseNingizimu Afrika utsetse sincumo sekubuyisa emuva ekhaya Lincusa Sisa Ngombane kute kube ngulapho kukhishwa satiso lesisha khona.
tgt: Loko ku tekeriwa enhlokweni mukhuva lowu nga hlawuliki na ku va wo tivikana eka nhlaselo wa Israele lowu wa ha ku vaka kona, mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga wu teke xiboho xa ku vuyisa Muyimeri wa Tiko Sisa Ngombane kufikela nkarhi wolowo.

src: Ikhabhinethi incusa Umbutfo weTekuvikela wema-Israeli kutsi uphume uphele eGaza Strip uphindze futsi uyekele lokuhlasela ngesidvumo lokubudlova nalokubhubhisako endzaweni yebantfu basePalestine.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra Israele ku huma eGaza Strip na ku herisa mihlaselo ya tihanyi na ku va leyi onhaka etindhawini ta Palesitina.

src: Tento tabo tibeka lenye insayeya ekusonjululweni kwalomphelo kwetincabano, lokufanele kwentiwe yimibuso lemibili, iPalestine ne-Israel, baphilisane ngekuthula lomunye ngakulolu luhlangotsi nalomunye ngakulolu lolunye luhlangotsi.
tgt: Swiendlo swa vona swa ntolovelo swi tisa nakambe xirhalanganyi eka xitshunxo xa nkarhi hinkwawo xa ntlimbo, lexi xi faneleke ku ta hi xivumbeko xa mifumo mimbirhi, Palesitina na Isirayele, ku va ya hanyisana hi ku rhula.

src: Ikhabhinethi igcizelela simemo lesentiwe ngemave lamanyenti langemalunga aMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) kutsi kube neluphenyo lolutimele lwekuphenya ngalokubulawa, ngembono wekutsi labo labatsintsekako batiphendvulele ngalesento.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshikelele swirhambo leswi endliweke hi mifumo yo tala leyi nga swirho swa Nhlangano wa Matiko eka vulavisisi lebyi tiyimelaka eka ku dlayeteriwa loku, hi xikongomelo xa ku endla lava nga na vutihlamuleri va tihlamulela.

src: Kubanjwa inkunzi kwetimoto letitfutsa imali (-CIT)Ikhabhinethi ikhatsateke kakhulu ngalokukhula kwelizinga lokubanjwa inkunzi kwetimoto letitfutsa imali iphindze futsi iyabala lobugebengu lobenteka emini kalo—bha lobungenahlazo.
tgt: Vukhamba bya Mali leyi nga eku Fambisiweni (CIT)Khabinete yi vilerisiwa swinene hi ku tumbuluka hi vuntshwa ka vukhamba bya CIT naswona yi alana na vugevenga lebyi endliwaka erivaleni ku ri hava tingana.

src: Siyachubeka nekuncoma ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngekusebenta ngekushesha ekubambeni labasolwa siphindze futsi sibonga nemalunga emmango lasite maphoyisa kutsi kubanjwe labasolwa.
tgt: Hi ya emahlweni hi hoyozela tiejensi to sindzisa nawu eka angulo wa tona wa xihatla eka ku khoma vaehleketeleriwa naswona hi khensa vaaki lava va pfuneke vasindzisi va nawu eka ku khomiwa loku.

src: Emalunga emmango langenteka kutsi atfole lwatiso ngebugebengu acelwa kutsi alekelele futsi atsinte ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo.
tgt: Vaaki lava va nga va na vuxokoxoko bya le masungulweni va khutaziwa ku pfuna na ku tihlanganisa na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu.

src: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete.

src: Umkhandlu weMabhizinisi eMbuso waMengameli (i-PSEC)Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kusungulwa kwe-PSEC kutsi sihlalo wayo kube nguMengameli Ramaphosa.
tgt: Khansele ya Mabindzu lama nga ehansi ka Vun’wini bya Mfumo ya le Hofisini ya Phuresidente (PSEC)Khabinete yi pasise ku tumbuluxiwa ka PSEC leyi mutshamaxitulu wa yona ku nga ta va Phuresidente Ramaphosa.

src: Imigomo lebanti lekutawusetjentelwa etukwayo kuhlela kabusha emabhizinisi embuso (ema-SOE) abe ngemathulusi ekutfutfukisa umnotfo lasebenta ngemphumelelo.
tgt: Swipimelo swo angarhela swa nkongomiso i ku yimisa hi vuntshwa mabindzu lama nga ehansi ka vun’wini bya mfumo (ti-SOE) tanihi switirho leswi vuyerisaka swa nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi.

src: Le-PSEC itawubukana nekwengamela ngekwepolitiki kanye nekuphatsa ngekwendlelalisu lelitsite lelibalulekile.
tgt: PSEC yi ta nyika vuangameri bya xipolitiki na mafambiselo ya swa maqhinga.

src: Emkhatsini wetintfo letawugcila kuto itawucinisa luhlakamsebenti lwekwengamela lwalama-SOE kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi tinyatselo tekungenelela letitsite tiyafezekiswa kute tisimamise letinkampani.
tgt: Exikarhi ka nkongomiso wa yona ku ta va ku tiyisa rimba leri fumaka ra ti-SOE na ku tiyisisa leswaku ku nghenelela ko karhi ka simekiwa ku tshamisekisa tikhamphani leti.

src: Emalunga e-PSEC atawufaka ekhatsi Tindvuna letifanele, bocwepheshe, tisebenti kanye netinhlangano temmango.
tgt: Vuxirho bya PSEC byi ta katsa Vaholobye lava khumbekaka, vativikulu, vatirhi na vaaki lava nga na ntsakelo wo fana.

src: Emagama emalunga e-PSEC atawumenyetelwa ekuhambeni kwesikhatsi.
tgt: Mavito ya swirho swa PSEC ya ta tivisiwa endzhakunyana ka nkarhi.

src: Le-PSEC itawakhela etukwemsebenti lowentiwe yi-IMC – SOE lowasungulwa ngeNdlovana 2015, sihlalo wayo bekuLisekelamengameli.
tgt: PSEC yi ta aka ehenhla ka ntirho lowu tirhiweke hi IMC – SOE leyi yi vumbiweke hi Nyenyanyana 2015, leyi mutshamaxitulu wa yona ku nga Xandla xa Phuresidente.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo yeMisebenti yeBuciko (ye-IP) yeRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika-Sigaba se-1.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Pholisi ya Nhundzu ya Vutumbuluxi (IP) ya Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga-Xiyenge xa Pholisi yi katsile mavonelo kusuka eka swibumabumelo na miandlalo ya vakhomaxiave.

src: Lenchubomgomo ifake ekhatsi emagalelo lavela kutetfulo netinkhulumo letetfulwe ngulabatsintsekako.
tgt: Yi angula eka xirhambo xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka (NDP) eka ntshikelelo lowukulu eka maendlelo lamantshwa, matshovelelo lama antswisiweke na vuhlongorisi bya matimba swinene bya ikhonomi ya vutivi.

src: Iphendvula kusimemo seLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (ku-NDP) lugcizelela kakhulu kucanjwa kwalokusha, kukhicita lokwentiwe kwaba ncono kanye nekufuna ngemandla mnotfo losekelwe kulwati.
tgt: Xiyenge xa I xa Pholisi ya IP xi leteriwa exikarhi ka swin’wana hi Vumbiwa, NDP, Kungukulu ra Swidzidziharisi ra Rixaka, Rimba ra Pholisi ya Vumaki ra Rixaka na maendlelo yo hambanahambana ya Kungu ra Matirhelo ra Vumaki ra Rixaka.

src: Sigaba se-1 seNchubomgomo ye-IP sesekelwa emkhatsini walokunye nguMtsetfosisekelo, yi-NDP, Luhlelo loLukhulu lwaVelonkhe lweTidzakamiva, Luhlakamsebenti lwaVelonkhe lweNchubomgomo yeTimboni kanye neLuhlelo lweKusebenta lweNchubomgomo yeTimboni (i-IPAP).
tgt: Ri ta tirha tanihi xitirho xa pholisi xa nkoka eka ku kondletela maendlelo lamantshwa, vuhundziseri bya thekinoloji, ndzavisiso na nhluvukiso, mpaluxo wa vutumbuluxi, nsirhelelo wa vatirhisi, nhluvukiso wa vumaki na, hi ku angarhela swinene, ku kula ka ikhonomi.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi Iphalamende icinisekise Sivumelwane seKwaliwa kweTikhali teNozi.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku amukeriwa ka Ntwanano eka Ntshimbiso wa Matlhari ya Nyutliliya hi Palamende.

src: Lesivumelwane singumphumela wemtamo wetinhlangano letitimele wekulwakukhicitwa kwetikhali tenozi lowetfulwa nga-2010.
tgt: Ntwanano lowu i mahetelelo ya pfhumba ra ximunhu eka matlhari ya nyutliliya lowu simekiweke hi 2010.

src: Sisingenelelo lesibalulekile ekulahlweni phasi kwetikhali tenozi kanye nemnyama longasi lekukudzala ukhona etingcogcweni temave lamanyenti tekulahla phasi tikhali tenozi.
tgt: I ku nghenelela ka swa maqhinga eka xiyenge xa ku nga hlomi matlhari ya nyutliliya na ntshwukiselano wa mahlo wa nkarhi wo leha eka mikanerisano ya ku nga hlomi matlhari ya nyutliliya wa matikonyingi.

src: LeSivumelwane sihambisana ngalokuphelele netinchubomgomo taseNingizimu Afrika lekukudzala tikhona tekulahla phasi tikhali, umtsetfo wangekhatsi kuleli kanye netivumelwano temave emhlaba.
tgt: Ntwanano wu fambelanisiwile hi vutalo na tipholisi ta ku nga hlomi matlhari ta nkarhi wo leha ta Afrika-Dzonga, milawu ya le tikweni na miboheko ya matiko ya misava.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kuChitjelwa kweSivumelwane seKuvikelwa ngekuBonakalako kweMikhicito yeNozi, kutsi kwetfulwe ePhalamende.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Ntwanano eka Nsirhelelo wa Miri wa Matheriyali wa Nyutliliya, ku andlariwa ePalamende.

src: Sivumelwane seKuvikelwa ngekuBonakalako kweMikhicito yeNozi ngilo kuphela lithulusi lemave emhlaba lelibophana ngekwemtsetfo kutekuvikelwa ngekubonakalako kwemikhicito yenozi.
tgt: Ntwanano eka Nsirhelelo wa Miri wa Matheriyali wa Nyutliliya i xitirho xa matiko ya misava lexi bohaka hi xinawu eka xiyenge xa nsirhelelo wa miri wa matheriyali wa nyutliliya.

src: Lesivumelwane lesichitjelwe siligcatsi lelibalulekile lemitamo yemave emhlaba yekwenta kancono kuvikelwa ngekubonakalako kwemikhicito netikhungo tenozi ngekubeka emazinga lafananako ekuvikela.
tgt: Ntwanano lowu hundzuluxiweke hi mpimo wa koka eka matshalatshala ya matiko ya misava ku antswisa nsirhelelo wa miri wa timatheriyali na switirhisiwa swa nyutliliya hi ku veka mipimo yo fana ya nsirhelelo.

src: Kufaka ekhatsi emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, kuvikelwa ngekubonakalako kwemikhicito yenozi ekusetjentisweni ngekhatsi kulelive, kulondvolotwa nekutfutfwa, kanye nekuvikelwa kwemikhicito netikhungo tenozi ekuhlaselweni.
tgt: Wu angarhela, exikarhi ka swin’wana, nsirhelelo wa miri wa matheriyali eka ntirho wa le tikweni, vuhlayiselo na vutleketli, na nsirhelelo wa timatheriyali na switirhisiwa swa nyutliliya ehenhla ka ku onhiwa.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungenisa ngekubambisana Inkhomfa ye-10 yeMave Emhlaba yeTikhungo te-Ombud yeMibutfo Yekuvikela, Lihhovisi le-Ombud yeTemphi, lehlelelwe kubanjwa ngeMphala 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku rhurhela hi ku hlanganela ka Mihlangano ya Mavuthu lama Hlomeke ya Khomferense ya Matiko ya Misava ya Valavisisi va Swivilelo swa Vaaki ya vu 10, hi Hofisi ya Mulavisisi wa Swivilelo swa Vaaki wa Masocha, leyi yi xeduriweke ku va kona hi Nhlangula 2018.Lexi i xiendleko xa lembe na lembe xa Senthara ya Vulawuri bya Xidemokirasi xa Mavuthu lama Hlomeke, leyi kumekaka eGeneva, Switzerland, naswona ku ta va rosungula ku rhurheriwa hi nhlanganelo eAfrika.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Ikhabhinethi iwuvumile Umtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Tikimu teTekwelashwa wanga-2018 kutsi ushicilelwe kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Swikimi swa Vutshunguri wa 2018 ku kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo weTikimu teTekwelashwa wanga-1998 (Umtsetfo-131 wanga-1998) kuwenta uhambisane Nemtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weMshwalensi waVelonkhe weTemphilo (i-NHI) kanye neLuhlaka lweMtsetfosivivinyo weKusita ngeTimali we-NHLoMtsetfosivivinyo ufuna kutsi, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, wente kancono kulawulwa kwemboni yetikimu tetekwelashwa kanye nekwenta luhlakamsebenti lwekulawula luhambisane netingucuko letenteke kuleminyaka ilishumi leyendlulile kulomkhakha.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wa Swikimi swa Vutshunguri wa 1998 (Nawu wa 131 wa 1998) ku wu fambelanisa na Mpfapfarhuto wa Tirhele ra Mfumo ra Ndzindzakhombo wa Rihanyu wa Rixaka (NHI) na Nawumbisimpfapfarhutwa wa Nkwama wa NHNawumbisi wu lava, exikarhi ka swin’wana, ku antswisa vulawuri wa bya indasitiri ya swikimi swa vutshunguri na ku tlhela wu fambelanisa rimba ro lawula eka ku cinca loku veke kona eka malembexikhume lama nga hundza eka sekitara leyi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawenta siciniseko sekutsi bazuzi bavikeleke kancono uphindze futsi ukhutsata kufinyelela kancono ekusitweni ngetimali ngumkhakha lotimele.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu ta tlhela wu tiyisisa leswaku vavuyeriwa va sirheleriwa ku antswa naswona wu ta kondletela mfikelelo wo antswa wa timali ta rihanyu leti humaka eka swiyenge leswi nga riki swa mfumo.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela SiKweliti seMbuso wanga-2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Swikweleti swa Mfumo wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo weSikweliti seMbuso wanga-1957.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wa Swikweleti swa Mfumo wa 1957.

src: Wenta kutsi kube netimiso tekukhokhela ngalokuphelele ticelonkhokhelo lekudzinga kutsi tikhokhwe nguMbuso letavela ngenca yekutsi kwelashwe kabi bantfu labebalashwa tisebenti teMbuso.
tgt: Wu lulamisela xivumbeko xa hakelo hinkwayo ya swikoxo ehenhla ka Mfumo leswi vangiweke hi vutshunguri bya xidokodela lebyi hoxekeke bya vanhu hi vatirhelamfumo.

src: Loku kutawenta kutsi kwehle lifutse letikhokhelo letisigadla kubhajethi yetibhedlela tahulumende.
tgt: Leswi swi ta lulamisela ntshikelelo lowu hungutekeke wa tihakelo ta xumakulu eka mipimanyeto ya swibedhlele swa mfumo.

src: Letichibelo titawukhulisa imali lengasetjentiswa tibhedlela tetifundza kutsi tinikete tinsita temphilo.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta engetela swipfuno swa timali leswi kumekaka eka swibedhlele swa swifundzakulu ku nyika vukorhokeri bya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo waVelonkhe weTingucuko teSimo seLitulu wanga-2017 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca ka Maxelo wa Rixaka wa 2018 ku va vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uvumela kuhambisana netinchubomgomo letinemtselela emphendvulweni yaseNingizimu Afrika yekugucuka kwesimo selitulu.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu pfumelela ku fambelanisiwa ka tipholisi leti ti hlohlotelaka angulo wa ku cinca ka maxelo wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Utawucinisekisa, kusuka kwalelive liye kukhabhoni lesezingeni leliphasi kanye nakumnotfo lomelana nekugucuka kwesimo selitulu.
tgt: Wu ta tiyisisa ku cinca ka tiko kuya eka ikhonomi ya khaboni ya le hansi na ya maxelo lama kondzelelaka.

src: Lesi sinyatselo lesengetiwe emitameni yeNingizimu Afrika yekufezekisa Inchubomgomo yaVelonkhe yeKubukana neKugucuka kweSimo seLitulu kukhutsata kutfutfuka lokusimeme nekwenetisa lilungelo lekuba nendzawo lengasiyo ingoti kutemphilo nekuphila kahle, njengobe kuvikelekile kuMtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Leri i goza ro engetela eka matshalatshala ya Afrika-Dzonga ku tirhisa Pholisi ya Angulo wa ku Cinca ka Maxelo ya Rixaka ku kondletela nhluvukiso lowu yisekaka emahlweni na ku humelerisa mfanelo ya mbangu lowu nga vavisiki rihanyu kumbe ku hanya kahle, tanihilaha swi hlayisiweke hakona eka Vumbiwa.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Tinchubo teBugebengu wanga-2018, lochibela Umtsetfo weTinchubo teBugebengu wanga-1977.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Mafambiselo ya Vugevenga wa 2018, lowu wu hundzuluxaka Nawu wa Mafambiselo ya Vugevenga wa 1977 ku nghena ePalamende.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela lophakanyiswako welula luhlu lwemacala etemacasi mayelana nekushushiswa futsi lokubaluleke kakhulu kutsi utawuvumela kwetfweswa emacala noma ngabe sekwendlule iminyaka lenge-20 entiwe.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo lowu ringanyetiwaka wu ta ndlandlamukisa nxaxamelo wa milandzu ya swa masangu hi mayelana na vachuchisi naswona wu ta endla leswaku swihehlo swi rhwexiwa hambiloko ku ri endzhaku ka 20 wa malembe.

src: Letichibelo tinika Inkantolo lePhakeme yaseNtasi neGauteng emandla ekukhipheni sehlulelo selicala laLevenstein.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta humelerisa vuavanyisi bya Khoto ya le Henhla ya Gauteng-Dzonga eka nandzu wa Levenstein.

src: Lelicala laveta kutsi Sigaba se-18 seMtsetfo weTinchubo teBugebengu wanga-1977 awuhambisani neMtsetfosisekelo futsi awusebenti kangangobe uvimbela, kuto tonkhe timo, lilungelo lekushushisa mayelana nawo onkhe emacala etemacasi, ngaphandle kwalawo labhalwe kusigaba-18 ,
tgt: Nandzu wu tivise Xiyenge xa 18 xa Nawu wa Mafambiselo ya Vugevenga wa 1977 tanihilexi xi nga fambisaniki na Vumbiwa naswona lexi nga riki enawini kufika eka mpimo lowu xi sivelaka, eka swiyimo hinkwaswo, mfanelo ya ku endla vuchuchisi bya milandzu ya swa masangu hinkwayo, handle ka leyi yi xaxametiweke eka xiyenge xa 18 ,

src: na- waloMtsetfo ngemuva kwekuphela kweminyaka lenge-20 kusukela ngesikhatsi kwentiwa lelicala.
tgt: xa Nawu lowu endzhaku ka ku hundza ka 20 wa malembe kusukela nkarhi lowu nandzu lowu wu endliweke hawona.

src: Letichibelo titawunika Umkhandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe (i-NPA) indzawo lebanti yekushushisa ngekubona kwawo emacaleni etemacasi ngekuya kweSahluko se-2 seMtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo yi ta kotisa Vulawuri bya Vuchuchisi bya Rixaka ku va na mavonelo yo anama swinene eka ku endla vuchuchisi eka milandzu ya swa masangu hi ku ya hi Kavanyisa ka2 ka Vumbiwa.

src: Imikhosi Letako.
tgt: Swiendleko leswi nga eku teni.

src: Sifundvo seLilanga le-Afrika seMinyaka Lelikhulu yaNelson MandelaMengameli Ramaphosa utawetfula Sifundvo seLilanga le-Afrika seMinyaka Lelikhulu yaNelson Mandela kuNkhomfa yekuVusetelwa kwe-Afrika, mhla tinge-24 Inkhwekhweti 2018 kuSikhungo seTinkhomfa seMave Emhlaba e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban.
tgt: Ndzetelo wa Malembexidzana ya Siku ra Afrika ra Nelson MandelaPhuresidente Ramaphosa u ta andlala Ndzetelo wa Malembexidzana ya Siku ra Afrika ra Nelson Mandela eka Khomferense ya Mpfuxelelo wa Afrika, hi siku ra 24 Mudyaxihi 2018 eInkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban.

src: Lomkhosi uyincenye yemigubho yemnyaka wonkhe yekukhumbula imphilo taMengameli wetfu wekucala wentsandvo yelinyenti, Babe Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela kanye neyesikhonkhwane seMzabalazo Make Albertina Nontsikelelo Sisulu.
tgt: Xiendleko xi vumba xiphemu xa ku tsundzukiwa ka malembexidzana ka lembe hinkwaro ka vutomi bya Phuresidente wa hina wa xidemokirasi wo sungula Tatana Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela na Mfungho wa Nyimpi Manana Albertina Nontsikelelo Sisulu, loku nga eku endlekeni etikwenikulu na misava hinkwayo.

src: Lilanga Le-Afrika Lilanga le-Afrika libanjwa njalo ngemnyaka mhla tinge-25 Inkhwekhweti kulo lonkhe lelivekati kuhlonipha kuSungulwa kweNhlangano yeBunye be-Afrika (i-OAU)– manje leyatiwa kakhulu ngekutsi Bunye be-Afrika (i-AU) – nga-1963.
tgt: Siku ra AfrikaSiku ra Afrika ri tlangeriwa lembe na lembe hi siku ra 25 Mudyaxihi etikwenikulu hinkwaro ku fungha ku simekiwa ka Nhlangano wa Vun’we bya Afrika – lowu sweswi wu tivekaka tanihi Yuniyoni ya Afrika – hi lembe ra 1963.

src: Lukugujwa kwetive kanye nebantfu labahlukahlukene base-Afrika kanye nesimemo sekubumbana kwalelivekati.
tgt: I ku tlangeriwa ka ku hambanahambana ka Afrika na xirhambo xa vun’we etikwenikulu.

src: INingizimu Afrika igubha Lilanga le-Afrika ngemikhosi yekugubha nekufundzisa yenyanga yonkhe yeNyanga ye-Afrika.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi tlangela Siku ra Afrika hi nkhuvu wa n’hweti hinkwayo wa N’hweti ya Afrika wa migingiriko leyi tlangelaka na ku dyondzisa, leyi nga na mivuyelo ya xipolitiki na ya ximunhu na xiikhonomi eka vanhu va Afrika-Dzonga na Tikokulu.

src: Lemikhosi inetinzuzo tetepolitiki kanye netetenhlalo nemnotfo kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nebaleLivekati.
tgt: Nkongomelo wa N’hweti ya Afrika hi lowu: “Lembe ra Nelson Mandela – Ku Aka Afrika yo Antswa na Misava yo Antswa”.Mahungu.

src: Ingcikitsi yaleNyanga itsi: "Umnyaka waNelson Mandela – Kwakha i-Afrika Lencono neMhlaba Loncono”.Imibiko.
tgt: Michavelelo Khabinete yi hundzise michavelelo ya yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va sirha nghwazi mutekaswifaniso tlhelo muamukeri wa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Ikhamanga, Tat Sam Nzima, loyi a tirhiseke khamera ya yena ku paluxa tihanyi ta mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu.

src: Kudvudvuta Ikhabhinethi yendlulisele emavi endvudvuto emndenini nakubangani besigayigayi lebesingumtfwebulititfombe futsi lowahlonishwa ngendvondvo yeSive, i-Order of Ikhamanga, Mnu Sam Nzima.
tgt: U ta tsundzukiwa hikwalaho ka xifaniso xa mfungho xa Hector Pieterson‚ hi siku ra 16 Khotavuxika 1976, lexi sindziseke misava ku lemuka na ku teka goza ehenhla ka mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu xa tihanyi.

src: Lesigayigayi sasebentisa ikhamera yaso kuveta lunya lwembuso welubandlululo.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa ku tsana lokukulu na michavelelo ya yona eka ndyangu wa Dok Phillip Nchipi Tabane, loyi a hundzeke emisaveni endzhaku ka vuvabyi bya nkarhi wo leha hi siku ra 18 Mudyaxihi 2018.

src: Utawukhunjulelwa sitfombe sakhe lesisikhonkhwane saHector Pieterson‚ mhla ti-16 Inhlaba 1976, lesaphocelela umhlaba kutsi unake uphindze futsi utsatse tinyatselo utitsatsele lombuso welubandlululo ngalolunya lwawo.
tgt: Tanihi xirho lexi sunguleke xa Malombo Jazzmen, a ri un’wana wa swiyimbeleri leswi nga na talenta swinene swa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisela kudzabuka nemavi ayo endvudvuto emndenini waDkt.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa michavelelo ya yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va Tat Sonwabo Eddie Funde loyi a ri khale ka Muyimeri wa Afrika-Dzonga eJarimani na Mutshamaxitulu wa Huvo ya Nhlangano wa Vuhaxi wa Afrika-Dzonga (SABC).Khabinete yi vilerisiwa swinene endzhaku ka mafu ya swinhwanyetana swimbirhi leswi swi dlaweke endzhaku ka loko khumbi ri hirimukile eDurban.

src: Phillip Nchipi Tabane, lowendlule emhlabeni ngemuva kwekugula sikhatsi lesidze mhla ti-18 Inkhwekhweti 2018.
tgt: VuhoyozeriKhabinete yi hoyozela Vusumuzi Ndlovu loyi a kumeke xiyimo xa vunkombo eka masagwati ya Musweki Lontsongo wa Pellegrino wa 2018 lama ha ku vaka kona eMilan.

src: Njengemsunguli weMalombo Jazzmen, bekangulomunye webaculi baseNingizimu Afrika labebanesiphiwo lesikhulu.
tgt: Mfikelelo wa yena wu endlile Afrika-Dzonga yi tinyungubyisa.

src: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisela emavi ayo endvudvuto emndenini nakubangani baMnu Sonwabo Eddie Funde lobekaLincusa laphambilini leNingizimu Afrika eGermany lobekaphindze futsi abe nguSihlalo weBhodi yeNhlangano Yetekusakata Ngemoya yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC).Ikhabhinethi iyadzabuka kakhulu ngekushona kwemantfombatana lamabili ngemuva kwekudzilika kwelubondza eDurban.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela nghwazi ya Federexini ya Xibakele ya Matiko ya Misava (IBF), ya Tingwenya ta Nhlangano wa Xibakele wa Misava (WBA) na ya ntikonhongani wa lavatsongo wa Magazini wa Ring leya ha ku rhwexiwaka xidlodlo Hekkie "Hexecutioner" Budler, loyi a veke MuAfrika-Dzonga wo sungula ku kuma swidlodlokulu swa misava swimbirhi xikan’we endzhaku ka ku hlula eka swidlodlo wa ntikonhongani swa lavatsongo swa IBF na WBA.

src: TihalalisoIkhabhinethi incoma Vusumuzi Ndlovu lophumelele waba wesikhombisa kumiklomelo yemncintiswane wekupheka we-Pellegrino Young Chef 2018 losandza kubanjwa eMilan.

tgt: Ikhonomi Khabinete yi lemukile ku ya ehansi ka 2,2% eka Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa Tiko (GDP) eka kotara yo sungula ya 2018.
