src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela emakoporasi aseNingizimu Afrika ekucala lamancane etinhlanti emkhakheni wetekudvoba, latiwa ngekutsi yiPort Nolloth neHondeklipbaai laseNyakatfo Kapa, latfulwa yiNdvuna yeTekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti, Umnu Senzeni Zokwana.
tgt: Mabindzu lamatsongo ya vunjoveri yo sungula ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Lamalungelo ekudvoba anika badvobi bendzawo sitfunti, ngobe bebasolo badvoba ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kenje nyalo sebavikeleke kwekucala.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela mabindzu lamatsongo yo sungula ya Afrika-Dzonga eka sekitara ya vunjoveri lama ku nga mabindzu ya le Port Nolloth na Hondeklipbaai eKapa-N’walungu, lama simekiweke hi Holobye wa Vurimi, Swihlahla na Vunjoveri, Tat Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Lemimamngo lemincane lemibili ledvobako letawuzuza kulenchubomgomo seyitfole kuceceshwa lokusisekelo lokumayelana nemakoporasi futsi seyisitwe ngekutsi ibhalise emakoporasi ngenhloso yekufaka sicelo semalungelo ekudvoba iminyaka le-.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ku fungha matirhiselo ya pholisi ya vunjoveri lebyitsongo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyababonga labakhokhi bemtselo labacishe balinganiselwe etigidzini letintsatfu labangenise emafomu abo emtselo, kwatsi sigamu sabo sangenise emafomu abo ngekusebentisa i-eFiling.
tgt: Timfanelo to njovela ti nyika xindzhuti eka vanjoveri va tinhlampfi va laha ndzeni ka tiko, lava a va njovela swi nga ri enawini, laha sweswi va sirheleriweke ro sungula.

src: Ngamhla tinge-31 Imphala, sikhatsi sekutsela sa-2018 sekuvala kwalabo labangakhokhi umtselo ngendlela letikhawu kanye nalabo labakhokha umtselo ngetikhawu labakhetse kutsi batawuletsa emafomu abo emtselo egatjeni lemahhovisi eLuphiko LwaseNingizimu Afrika Lwekugcogcwa Kwemtselo (i-SARS).
tgt: Miganga leyimbirhi ya swa vunjoveri lebyitsongo yi nga ta vuyeriwa kusuka eka pholisi leyi yi kume vuleteri bya masungulo hi mayelana na mabindzu naswona yi pfuniwe ku tsarisa mabindzu ya yona hi xikongomelo xo endla xikombelo xa timfanelo to njovela xa malembe ya Nguva ya xibalo.

src: Labakhokha umtselo ngetikhawu labakhetse kuletsa emafomu abo emtselo ngendlela ye-eFiling bangakwenta loko kudzimate kube mhla tinge-31 Bhimbidvwane 2019.
tgt: Khabinete yi bumabumela kwalomu ka timiliyoni tinharhu ta vahakeri va swibalo lava tlheriseke swibalo swa vona laha ku tlula hafu ya vona va tlheriseke hi ku tirhisa Inthanete.

src: Kugcogcwa kahle kwemalingena yemtselo nangemphumelelo kucinisekisa kutibusa ngekwetimali tahulumende, kantsi nekuletsa emafomu lagcwaliswe kahle futsi nangesikhatsi kucinisekisa kutfobela indlela yekwenta tintfo yebakhokhi bemtselo.
tgt: Hi ti 31 Nhlangula, nguva ya xibalo ya 2018 ya pfala eka vahakeri va swibalo lava holaka miholo lava hakelaka xibalo kan’we hi lembe na le ka vahakeri va xibalo lava handle ka miholo, va endlaka mali hi tindlela tin’wana lava hakelaka kambirhi hi lembe lava hlawulaka ku ya tlherisa xibalo eka rhavi ra Vukorhokeri bya Swibalo swa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Imalingena yemtselo isita hulumende kutsi akhokhele imiklamo yalelive yekuletsa tinsita kanye naletinye tinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalomnotfo.
tgt: Vahakeri va swibalo lava handle ka miholo, va endlaka mali hi tindlela tin’wana lava hakelaka kambirhi hi lembe lava hlawulaka ku tlherisa swibalo swa vona hi ku tirhisa Inthanete va nyikiwa kufikela ti 31 Sunguti 2019 ku endla tano.

src: Kukhokhwa kwetibonelelo temali yahulumende.
tgt: Ku hakeriwa ka midende ya vaakatiko.

src: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna: Tibonelelo Temali Yahulumende, sihlalo walo lokuyiNdvuna Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwe hi Komiti ya Vaholobye: Midende ya Vaakatiko leyi fambisiwaka hi Holobye Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Kusukela mhla ti-01 Imphala 2018, bantfu labangetulu kwetigidzi letilishumi bakhokhelwa kusetjentiswa letinye taletindlela – Lihhovisi Leliposi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-Sapo)/i-Postbank i-Grindrod Bank kanye netitolo letifanana neBoxer, Shoprite, nePick n Pay.
tgt: Kusukela hi ti1 Nhlangula 2018, ku tlula 10 wa timiliyoni ta vahori va midende va hakeriwile hi ku tirhisa yin’wana na yin’wana ya tipulatifomo leti – Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPO)/Postbank Bangi ya Grindrod xikan’we na mavhengele yo xavisa yo fana na Boxer, Shoprite na Pick n Pay.

src: Hulumende ukutsutse ngemphumelelo kukhokhelwa kwetibonelelo yemali yahulumende kusuka ku-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) njengekuyalwa Sijubo seNkantolo yeteMtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Mfumo wu swi kotile ku rhurhisela ku hakeriwa ka midende ya vaakatiko ku suka eka Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) tanihilaha swi lerisiweke hakona hi Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.

src: Bonkhe bantfu labebaholelwa imali lengukheshi i-CPS sebatfutsiwe kantsi na-CPS sewatisiwe futsi nangekuncanyulwa kwalesivumelwane kusukela mhla tinge-30 Inyoni 2018.
tgt: Vavuyeriwa va mali ya midende hinkwavo lavaa va hakeriwaka hi CPS va rhurhisiwile naswona CPS yi tivisiwile hi ku herisiwa ka kontiraka ya yona hi ti 30 Ndzati 2018.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudvumisa kwayo ngalomsebenti wekwengamela lobewuholwa Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna lebelisekelwa Licembu Lemasu Ekusebenta leBacondzisi Jikelele.
tgt: Khabinete yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wo langutela lowu tirhiweke kahle lowu a wu rhangeriwile hi Komiti ya Vaholobye lowu seketeriweke hi Ntlawa wa Ntirho wa Xithekiniki Vafambisijenerali.

src: Iphindze futsi ivakalise kudvumisa kwayo umsebenti lowentiwe tikhulu taka-SAPO, i-Ejensi yetekuCinisekiswa kweteNhlalakahle eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sassa)kanye, neLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalalakahle Letakhiwonchanti Tekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi letekuHlela, kuCaphela nekuLungisa, Temafa Avelonkhe Luphiko Lwembutfo Wemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) neLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Netekwatisa (i-GCIS).
tgt: Yi tlhela yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wa vatirhi vo huma eka SAPO, Ejensi ya swa Midende ya Vaakatiko ya Afrika-Dzonga (Sassa) na, tindzawulo ta Nhluvukiso wa Vaaki Vukorhokeri bya Tiposo na Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho, Nkunguhato, Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo Vutameri bya Nkwama wa Tiko Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga na GCIKhabinete yi khensa vavuyeriwa va midende hinkwavo eka ntirhisano wa vona hi nkarhi wa ku cinca loku.

src: Iminyaka Lelikhulu ya-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana nemalungiselelo emcimbi wekugubha iminyaka lelikhulu yekutalwa kwaMake Albertina Sisulu lotawubanjwa ngenyanga yekutalwa kwakhe, Imphala.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi malunghiselo yo tlangela lembexidzana ra Manana Albertina Sisulu loku nga ta va kona hi n’hweti ya ku velekiwa ka yena, nhlangula.

src: Make Sisulu watalwa mhla tinge-21 Imphala 1918 kantsi Sihlalo we-IMC lebukene naleMigubho Yelikhulu Leminyaka, Indvuna Jeff Radebe, nguye lotawuchaza ngaloko lokutawukwentiwa lokuphatselene nalomgubho welikhulu leminyaka.
tgt: Manana Sisulu u velekiwe hi ti 21 Nhlangula 1918, naswona Mutshamaxitulu wa IMC wa Ku Tlangela Lembexidzana, Holobye Jeff Radebe u kona laha ku andlala migingiriko leyi taka leyi fambelanaka na ku tlangeriwa ka lembexidzana.

src: Kugwetjwa kwababe waseSprings IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kugwetjwa kwendvodza lengumhlukubeti, lebeyatiwa ngalokwetayekile ngekutsi Silwane saseSprings.
tgt: Ku gweviwa ka tatana wa le Springs.

src: Ugwetjwe iminyaka lenge-35 abhadla ejele ngekulinga kubulala indvodzana yakhe, kuhlukubeta bantfwana nekungabanakekeli, kanye nekusebentisa aphindze futsi atsengise tidzakamiva.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku gweviwa ka wanuna wa muxanisi loyi a tiviwa swinene tanihi Xihovori xa le Springs.

src: Budlova lobucondziswe kulabasikati buyinsayeya lenkhulu emmangweni wetfu, njengaloku kubonakele ngesikhatsi kugagadlelwa umntfwana lomncane lapha resitjurenti eDros eSilverton.
tgt: U gweviwe kufikela eka malembe ya 35 ekhotsweni eka ku ringeta ku dlaya n’wana wa yena wa jaha, ku xanisa n’wana na ku tsan’wa, xikan’we na ku tirhisa na ku xavisa swidzidziharisi.

src: Umshuco waseWestbury IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kungenelela kweNdvuna Yetemaphoyisa Bheki Cele eWestbury, lokuyincenye yendlelalisu lelibanti lekulwa nalesishayo setidzakamiva nebudlova lobuhambisana nemacembu emigulugudvu kulendzawo.
tgt: Madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu ma ha ri ntlhontlho lowukulu emigangeni ya hina,tanihilaha swi tikombeke hakona hi mpfinyo lowu wa ha ku vaka kona wa n’wana lontsongo evhengeleni ro xavisa swakudya leswi swekiweke na ku dyela ra Dros eSilverton.

src: Lesingenelelo sifaka ekhatsi kutfunyelwa kweLicembu Lemaphoyisa Leliceceshwe Ngalokuvelele (maBharethe) kanye nekubonakala ngalokugcamile kwemaphoyisa kulendzawo.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshikelela xirhambo xa minhlangano ya nsindziso wa nawu ku tirha hi matimba swinene eka ku gweva vaendlamilandzu va vugevenga lebyi byo chavisa.

src: IKhabhinethi icela ummango waseWestbury kutsi kanye nayo yonkhe nje imimango kutsi isebentisane nemaphoyisa ekucinisekiseni kutsi sitisephula netimphandze tato tonkhe tento tebugebengu, tetidzakamiva netemigulukudvu kuletindzawo lapho tenteka khona.
tgt: Yi tlhela yi rhamba hinkwerhu ka hina ku tirhisana eka ku herisa ku tluriwa ka timfanelo ta vana na swirho leswi nga sirhelelekangiki swinene swa vaakatiko va hina.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawabonga ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngekwenta luphenyo lolujulile nalolufaka tindlela letinengi lolumacondzana netehlakalo letenteka emamoli, etitolo kanye nasemasontfweni eMamozilemu lokuholele ekutseni kubanjwe basolwa laba-19.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Holobye wa Maphorisa Bheki Cele eWestbury, loku nga xiphemu xa qhinga ro angarhela ro lwisana na ntungu wa swidzidziharisi na madzolonga lama fambelanaka na mitlawa ya vugevenga eka ndhawu yoleyo.

src: Loku kufake ekhatsi LiKlasta Letebulungiswa, Letekuvikela Bugebengu neTekuphepha.
tgt: Ku nghenelela ku katsa ku rhumeriwa ka Ntlawa wa Qhinga ro Angula (Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta) na vukona bya maphorisa lebyi vonakaka swinene.

src: Labatsatfu kulabasolwa baboshelwe mayelana netisetjentiswa letivutsako endzaweni yaseDurban, lokufaka ekhatsi lisontfo leMamozilemu leliseVerulam.
tgt: Xa nkoka swinene, hi leswaku ku ta tlhela ku va na vulavisisi bya swihehlo swa vukungundzwana eka Xitichi xa Maphorisa xa le Westbury.

src: Bonkhe labasolwa balindzeleke kutsi babukane nemacala lafaka ekhatsi kubulala kanye nekuzama kubulala kanye nekwephula Umtsetfo weTichumachumachumane.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vaakatiko va le Westbury na vaaki hinkwavo ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku vona leswaku hi herisa migingiriko ya vugevenga, swidzidziharisi na mitlawa ya swigevenga eka tindhawu ta vona to hambanahambana.

src: IKhabhinethi itsandza kucinisekisa bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi kulwa nebugebengu yintfo lesembili eluhlwini lwetintfo lekumele kutsi kucalwe ngato tentiwe kanye nekutsi hulumende utawuchubeka atsatse tinyatselo letidzingekako kucinisekisa kutsi kuba nesimondzawo lesiphephile nalesivikelekile sabo bonkhe labahlala lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Khabinete yi bumabumela tiejensi to sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka nawu eka ku endla vulavisisi bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi fambelanaka na timhangu ta le timolo, mavhengele yo xavisa na tikereke ta MaIslam lebyi nga endla leswaku ku khomiwa vaehleketeriwa va khumekaye.

src: Kuntjintja kweligama: Makhanda IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuntjintjwa kweligama iGrahamstown, lidolobha leliseMphumalanga Kapa, kutsi ibe yiMakhanda kute kuhlonishwe umpholofidi, linjulamcondvo lesive semaXhosa, naloyindvodza yemphi leyalwa nebukholoni.
tgt: A byi katsa Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Vusirheleri.

src: Loluntjintjo luyincenye lebalulekile yeluhambo lwetfu lwentsandvo yelinyenti futsi lutawusita ekwakheni kubumbana kutenhlalo kanye nekwakha kwatisa lokujulile kwemlandvo wetfu lesabelana ngawo.
tgt: Vaehleketeleriwa vanharhu va khomiwile hi mayelana na swibuluki eka ndhawu ya le Durban, ku katsa na Kereke ya MaIslam ya le Verulam.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi iyivumile indlela lebuyeketiwe yekwetfula kucala kusebenta kweMkamo weLuhlelo Lwekutfutsa Tekusakata Tiye Ekusakateni Ngekwedijithali.
tgt: Vaehleketeleriwa hinkwavo va languteriwa ku langutana na swihehlo leswi katsaka ku dlaya na ku ringeta ku dlaya na tlula Nawu wa Swibuluki.

src: Lendlela ilandzela sichamkelo lesichutjwa yimakethe/batsengi ngekusebentisana kanye nebudlelwane nemkhakha lotimele netimboni.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshembisa MaAfrika-Dzonga leswaku ku lwisana na vugevenga i xirhangana xa le henhla na leswaku mfumo wu ta ya emahlweni wu teka magoza lama faneleke ku vona leswaku ku na mbangu lowu hlayisekeke na ku sirheleleka eka vatshami hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Loku kunika iNingizimu Afrika inchubekelembili ekuphotfuleni lomklamo ngendlela lefaka wonkhewonkhe, lengabiti futsi lenemphumelelo, kanye futsi nalenciphisa bungoti kuhulumende.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku cinciwa ka vito ra Grahamstown ri va Makhanda eKapa-Vuxa, hi ku xixima muphurofeta, mufilosofa na nhenha ya nyimpi ya Muqhoza leyi nga lwa na xikoloni.

src: Lokutfutsa kutawenta kutsi kubukela idijithali kube sezingeni le-85% nangetulu, ekuntjintjeni tonkhe tindlela tekusakata nge-analogi.
tgt: Ku cinca i xiphemu xa nkoka xa rendzo ra hina ra xidemokirasi naswona ku ta pfuneta ku tlakusa vun’we bya vaaki hi lakukulu na ku aka ku tlangela ko enta ka ku avelana ka matimu ya hinaSwiboho swa KhabineteKhabinete yi pasise modlolo wo korhokela lowu pfuxetiweke eka nsimeko wa Phurojeke ya Ndzhurho wa Vuhaxi byi ya eka Dijitali.

src: IKhabhinethi iyivumile i-Common Core Document letawutfunyelwa kuMhlabuhlangene (i-UN).
tgt: Modlolo lowu wu amukela endlelo leri fambisiwaka hi makete/vuxavisi hi ku tirhisana swin’we na vutirhisani na sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo na indhasitiri.

src: Ledokhumenti ichaza ngenchubekelembili lecuketse lwatiso jikelele, emaphuzu kanye netibalobalo letimayelana nekugcina kweNingizimu Afrika tibophelelo letisayinwe etivumelwaneni letiyimfica taMhlabuhlangene.
tgt: Hi endlelo leri, mfumo wu nge he khumbeki eka nkumo wa Xibokisana xa Vuhaxi bya Mahungu vuhlayiselanhundzu, ku tleketliwa na ku nghenisiwa ka switirhisiwa.

src: Imikhosi LetakoSitatimende Senchubomgomo yeSabelotimali Sethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS)Indvuna Yetetimali Tito Mboweni utakwetfula Sitatimende Senchubomgomo yeSabelotimali Sethemu Lesemkhatsini, mhla tinge-24 Imphala 2018, lesitawuveta kulungiswa kwesabelotimali savelonkhe kute kucinisekiswe kusimama etimalini tahulumende.
tgt: Leswi swi nyika Afrika-Dzonga nhluvukiso wo ya emakumu ka phurojeke hi ndlela leyi nghenisaka hinkwavo, yo kala yi nga durhi na ku koteka, naswona sweswo swi hungutaka nxungeto eka mfumo.

src: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa Luhlelo lwalonyaka lweNyanga yeTekutfutsa lutawugcizelela kubaluleka kwesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa, njengetaselwandle, tasemoyeni, tajantji kanye nemkhakha wetemgwaco njengetikhutsati tekukhula kwemnotfo.
tgt: Leswi swi ta susumeta ndzhurhiso wa ku vona ka dijitali ku ya eka 85% ya masungulo na ku yisa emahlweni, ku ya eka ku timiwa ka vuhaxi hinkwabyo bya analogo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu kutsi basebentise tekutfutsa tawonkhewonkhe kanye nekutsi bacale kusebentisa tindlela tekuphepha umnyaka wonkhe.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Tsalwa ra Nkoka wa Swo Fana swa Afrika-Dzonga leri nga ta yisiwa eka Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN).

src: Asisebentiseni lenyanga kugubha kanye nekubuyisa lisiko lekusebentisa emacembu ekugibelisana etimotini nasiya emisebentini kute sinciphise siminyaminya lesibakhona emigwacweni.
tgt: Tsalwa ri nyika nhluvukiso lowu nga na mahungu ya ntolovelo, ya ntiyiso na ku va ya muxaka wa tinhlayo eka ku landzelela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka mfanelo leyi fambisanaka na ku sayiniwa na mitwanano ya kaye ya UN.

src: Kuphepha emigwacweni yetfu kusaseyinsayeya, bashayeli kanye nalabahamba ngetinyawo kufanele kutsi basebentise imigwaco yawonkhewonkhe ngekucophelela.
tgt: Swiendleko leswi takaXitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS)Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni u ta andlala Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS) hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018, lexi nga ta humesela erivaleni cincacinco eka mpimanyeto wa rixaka ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ntshamiseko wa swa timali ta tiko.

src: ImilayetoKulalaliselaIthelesikobhu yemagagasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-MeerKAT, itawuhlangana ne-Breakthrough Listen, lokungumtamo wemave emhlaba wekufuna timphawu temphilo emhlabeni wonkhe nasezulwini.
tgt: N’hweti ya swa VutleketliNongonoko wa lembe leri wa N’hweti ya Vutleketli wu ta tshikelela nkoka wa switirhisiwankulu swa vutleketli swo fana na tisekitara ta swa malwandle, vuhahisi, swiporo na magondzo tanihi swipfuneti swa ku kula ka ikhonomi.

src: Loku kukhomba kwatiswa ngemave emhlaba kwelikhono kanye nesakhiwonchanti setfu.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki ku tirhisa vutleketli bya mani na mani na ku tirhisa hi nkhinkhi mapfhumba ya vuhlayiseki bya le magondzweni lembe hinkwaro.

src: Ithelesikobhu yemagagasi yaseNingizimu Afrika i-MeerKAT lenetindishi letinge-64, yetfulwe ngalokusemtsetfweni ngaKholwane kulomnyaka, iluhlobo lwethelesikobhu lenemandla kakhulu emhlabeni yekuva tintfo letikhashane.
tgt: A hi tirhiseni n’hweti leyi ku tlangela na ku vuyisa ntolovelo wo famba swin’we emimovheni loko hi ya entirhweni ku hunguta ntlimbano wa mimovha emagondzweni ya hina.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela licembu lebacwaningi baseNyuvesi yaseWits labente kususwa kwesibindzi lokuyincophamlandvo futsi lokube yimphumelelo kumake Loneligciwane Lesandvulelangculaza (i-HIV) basifaka kumntfwanakhe lote ligciwane lesendvulelangculaza.
tgt: Vuhlayiseki bya gondzo emagondzweni ya hina byi tshama bya ha ri ntlhontlho, naswona vachayeri na van’wamilenge va fanele va tirhisa magondzo ya mani na mani hi vutihlamuleri.

src: Lelicembu labodokotela lifaka ekhatsi Solwati Jean Botha, Dkt.
tgt: SwihungwanaVuhoyozeriThelesikopu ya rhadiyo ya Afrika-Dzonga, MeerKat yi ta joyina Breakthrough Listen, pfhumba ra matiko ya misava leri lavaka mikombeto ya vutomi bya vutlhari emisaveni.

src: June Fabian naSolwati Caroline Tiemessen.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela ntlawa wa valavisisi vo huma eYunivhesiti ya Wits lava nga endla hundziso wa xivindzi wa matimu na ku humelela ku suka eka manana loyi a nga na HIV ku ya eka n’wana wa yena loyi a nga hava HINtlawa wa vadokodela lowu a wu katsa Phurofesa Jean Botha, Dok Francesca Conradie, Dok Harriet Etheredge, Dok June Fabian na Phurofesa Caroline Tiemessen.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bantfu base-Equatorial Guinea ngekugubha iminyaka lenge-50 yenkhululeko.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela vanhu va le Equatorial Guinea eka ku tlangela ka vona ka malembe ya 50 ya ntshuxeko.

src: Live laseNingizimu Afrika libe nebudlelwane bebuncusa lobuphelele nelive laseRiphabhliki yase-Equatorial Guinea kusukela mhla ti-05 Inkhwekhweti 1993.Kudvudvuta IKhabhinethi ivakalisa emavi ayo ekudzabuka emindenini, kubangani nakulabebasebenta naye ngekusishiya emhlabeni kweNdvuna Yetemvelo Boma Edna Molewa.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi ve na vuxaka bya xidipulomatiki byo hetiseka na Rhiphabliki ra Equatorial Guinea kusukela hi ti 5 Mudyaxihi 1993.Michavelelo Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka ndyangu, vanghana na vatirhikulobye va Holobye wa Timhaka ta Mbangu Boma Edna Molewa.

src: Indvuna Molewa ukhombise kuba nelikhono etintfweni letinengi, kusukela eligalelweni lakhe emzabalazweni wekulwela kulingana kwabomake emmangweni wetfu.
tgt: Holobye Molewa u tihumelerise erivaleni hi tindlela to tala ta vuswikoti na swivangelo swo karhi, kusuka eka ku hoxa xandla ka yena ku lwela ntshuxeko wa hina na ku lwela ndzingano wa vamanana eka rixaka ra hina.

src: Bekalichawe futsi lavelonkhe kanye nelemhlaba wonkhe macondzana nemvelo nemhlaba losimeme kutsi siwujabulele sonkhe futsi sabelane nangawo.
tgt: U tlhele a va nghwazi ya rixaka na ya matiko ya misava eka ku xiximeka eka swa mbangu ka pulanete leyi nga ta va kona nkarhi wo leha leyi ku nga ta avelaniwa hayona na ku rhandziwa vanhu hinkwavo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa emavi ayo endvudvuto kuhulumende kanye nakubantfu base-Indonesia.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka mfumo na vanhu va le Indonesia.

src: Hulumende sewuvele wetsembise kusekela, labo kudzingeke khona, kantsi futsi Huluende udvumisa kakhulu tisebenti telusito taseNingizimu Afrika lesevele titimbandzakanye emitameni yekusita le eSihlengeni sase-Indonesia eSulawesi, lesihlaselwe kutamatama kwemhlaba kanye ne-tsunami.
tgt: Mfumo se wu tibohe nseketelo wa wona, laha swi faneleke, naswona Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela vatirhi vo pfuneta va Afrika-Dzonga lava nga va na xiave eka matshalatshala yo pfuneta eka Xihlala xa Sulawesi xa le Indonesia, lexi xi hlaseriweke hi ku ninginika ka misava na tsunami.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa emavi ayo endvudvuto emndeni nakulabo bekasebenta nabo ngekulahlekelwa kwabo nguMk Rowena Baird londlule emhlabeni kuleliviki.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka mindyangu na vatirhikulobye va Manana Rowena Baird loyi a hundzeke emisaveni vhiki leri.

src: Mk Baird bekayintsatseli yemsakato leyatiwako naletakhele ligama.
tgt: Man Baird a ri muteki wa mahungu ya rhadiyo wa ndhuma na ku va munhu wa ndhuma swinene.

src: Kubekwa EtikhundleniKutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.
tgt: Ku thoriwaLava thoriweke hinkwavo va fanele ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mitshwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: IKhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-24 Imphala 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Tindzaba Talelive.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.

src: Sitatimende Senchubomgomo Yesabelotimali Sethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS).
tgt: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa le Xikarhi ka Theme (MTBPS)1.1 Khabinete yi amukela MTBPS yo sungulasungula hi Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni, leyi simekiweke ehenhla ka nkholwo wo tiya leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi nga pfuxiwa hi vuntshwa.2 MTBPS ya 2018 yi kombisa swihlawuriwa swo tika swa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo leswi langutaneke na mfumo eka malembe manharhu lama landzelaka.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela i-MTBPS yekucala yeNdvuna yeteTimali Tito Mboweni, legcile embonweni locinile lotsi iNingizimu Afrika ingavuselelwa kabusha.
tgt: Ku kula ka ikhonomi ka 2018 ku pfuxetiwile kuya ehansi kusuka eka 1.5% kufika eka 0.7%, naswona mbangu wa misava hinkwayo wu ta tama wa ha ri na mitlhontlho eka tiikhonomi ta timakete leta ha tumbulukaka.

src: Le-MTBPS yanga-2018 ikhomba bumatima kutemnotfo kanye netincumo letiphatselene netimali tahulumende, hulumende latawubukana nato kuleminyaka lemitsatfu letako.
tgt: MTBPS 2018 yi humelerisa xihlohloteri xa ku kula ka ikhonomi xa Phuresidente na pulani ya ku hlukela, leswi swi nga ta seketeriwa hi ntshamiseko wa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo na wa timali.3 Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile eka ku yiseka emahlweni ka swa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, kambe ku vile na ku rheta kusukela loko ku andlariwile Mpimanyeto wa 2018 nan’waka.

src: Hulumende utimisele macondzana nekusimama kwetimali letiphatselene nahulumende, kodvwa kube nekuyekelela kusukela kwetfulwa Sabelotimali sa-2018 ngeNdlovana kulomnyaka.
tgt: Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile ku tshamisekisa na ku hunguta xikweleti.

src: Hulumende utimisele ekwenteni kutsi kube nekusimama nekutsi futsi kwehle tikweleti.
tgt: Ehenhla ka xiyimo xa mbangu wo tika wa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, ku aviwa loku ringanyetiwaka ka xibalo ku ya emahlweni ku rhangise minongonoko yo tirhisa mali leyi seketelaka dyondzo ya masungulo, rihanyu, ku hanya kahle ka vaaki, mati, nkululo na vukorhokeri bya gezi.

src: Ngekubuka simo lesimatima setemnotfo kanye simondzawo setimali letiphatselene nahulumende, lokwabiwa kwetimali lokuphakanyisiwe kubeka embili tindleko leticondzene netinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalo letisekela imfundvo lesisekelo, temphilo, tenhlalakahle, emanti kuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti kanye nagezi.
tgt: Samiti ya swa Rihanyu ya Phuresidente.1 Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya Samiti ya swa Rihanyu ya Phuresidente leyi yi nga na xikongomelo xa ku tirhana na mitlhontlho yo hambanahambana leyi langutaneke na sisiteme ya swa rihanyu ra vaaki.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeNgcungcutsela yaMengameli Yetemphilo lenhlose kulungisa tinsayeysa letahlukahlukene luhlelo lwahulumende lwetemphilo lolubukene nato.
tgt: Mivuyelo yi ta tiyisa ku lulamiseriwa ka ntirhiso wa Ndzindzakhombo wa swa Rihanyu wa Rixaka.

src: Letincumo letitawutsatfwa kuleNgcungcutsela titawucinisa emalungiselelo ekucala kusebenta kweMshwalensi weteMphilo waVelonkhe (i-NHI).
tgt: Mpfuxeto wa misava.1 Khabinete yi amukela ntirho lowu fananaka wa minongonoko ya mpfuxeto wa misava na ntlheriso wa timfanelo lowu lulamisaka nkavululami wa karhi lowu nga hundza na ku pfuna ku kurisa ikhonomi.2 Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u rhangele ntirho wa ntlheriso wa timfanelo ta misava, laha kutlula 4 586 wa tihekitara ta misava ti nyikiweke muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi eEmpangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.3 Muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi wu ta tlhela wu kuma mipako ya le ndzhaku ka ku tshamisekisiwa na nseketelo lowu nga ta va pfuna ku fikisa eka mpimo wa le henhla rifuwo leri nga kotekaka ra misava leyi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kucala kwekusebenta kwekubuyeketwa kwemhlaba kanye netinhlelo tekubuyisela kwawo kubanikati ngekulungisa umonakalo wesikhatsi lesengcile nekusita kutsi kukhule umnotfo.
tgt: Leswi swi cinca vaakandhawu kusuka eka vurimelakhwiri kuya eka vatekaxiave va swa mabindzu na vini va mabindzu eka nkhuluko wa nkoka hinkwawo wa rifuwo leri nga eka emisaveni ya vona.4 Mfumo wa tiboha ku seketela ku yiseka emahlweni ka mabindzu ya swa vurimi lama ha tumbulukaka, lama katsaka 262 wa tiphurojeke leti fambelanaka na mpfuxeto wa misava ku vuyerisa vantshwa na vavasati eswifundzenikulu hinkwaswo.

src: Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bekahola umcimbi wekubuyiselwa kwemhlaba kubanikati, lapho emahektha langetulu kwala-4 586 emhlaba lanikwe ummango waKaMkwanazi eMpangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Ku onheteriwa ka swimakiwakulu swa mfumo.1 Khabinete yi kombise ku vilela eka ku onheteriwa ka swimakiwakulu swa vutleketli.

src: Ummango waKaMkwanazi utawuphindza futsi utfole tibonelelo letitfolakala emuva kwekunikwa umhlaba kanye nekwesekelwa lokutawubasita kutsi basebentise ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu emandla alomhlaba.
tgt: Leswi swi yisa ehansi vutiboheleri bya mfumo bya ku yisa vukorhokeri emigangeni leyi a yi nga byi kumi kusukela khale na khale.

src: Loku kuyindlela yekutsi imimango isuke ekubeni balimi labalimela kutondla nje bona kodvwa balimele kutsengisa njengebanikati bemabhizinisi kuto tonkhe tinchubo tekukhicita ngalomhlaba wabo.
tgt: Ku hava mpimo wa nhlundzuko wu faneleke ku vanga ku onheteriwa ka nhundzu ya mfumo.

src: Hulumende utinikele kutsi asekele kusimama kwemabhizinisi etekulima lasafufusa, lokufaka ekhatsi imiklamo lenge-262 lehambisana nekubuyeketwa kwemhlaba kute kuzuze lusha nabomake kuto tonkhe tifundza.
tgt: Ku onheteriwa kwaloko ku tirha ku pfumata lava sweleke vukorhokeri lebyi dingiwaka swonghasi.2 Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku rhiya tihlo na ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku endla leswaku lavaya va nga na vutihlamuleri va tihlamulela.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka kwayo mayelana nekonelwa phasi kwesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa.
tgt: Vaaki va komberiwa ku endla va tiva hi vuahluri lebyi tanihileswi ntirhiso wa mbangi endhawini ya mani na mani wu tshimbisiweke.

src: Loku kubuyisela emuva kutinikela kwahulumende ekuletseni tinsita emimangweni lebeyinganakwa phambilini.
tgt: Ku ya emahlweni, vuahluri lebyi a byi susangi vugevenga bya ku xavisa mbangi.2 Khabinete yi amukela vuahluri lebyi nga kona eka mbangu wa milawu yin’wana leyi yi nga ha tirhisiwaka eka ntirho, ku va na mbangi na ku rima mbangi.

src: Kute kungajabuli lokukhulu kangako ngendlela yekutsi kungaholela ekutseni kunelwe phasi imphahla yahulumende.
tgt: Khabinete yi le ku kumeni ka switsundzuxo eka mhaka leyi.

src: Lokonela phasi lokunje kuncisha labaphuyile tinsita labatidzinga kakhulu.
tgt: Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya Swikolo.1 Khabinete yi amukela Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya Xikolo leya ha ku Khomiwaka ku nga ri khale leyi rhurheriweke ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Dyondzo ya Masungulo Angie Motshekga.

src: IKhabhinethi icela sive kutsi sicaphele futsi sisebentisane nema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo kute kutsi labo labenta loko baboshwe.
tgt: Samiti leyi yi tise endhawini yin’we dyondzo na vakhomaxiave va le handle ku kuma switshunxo swa swiphiqo swa vuhlayiseki leswi langutaneke na swikolo swa tiko xikan’we na ku khulela ndlela ku ya emahlweni ku va na mbangu lowu hlayisekeke eswikolweni.2 Leswi swi landzela timhangu ta madzolonga eswikolweni swin’wana, ku katsa na rifu ro vava ra mudyondzisi wa 24 wa malembe hi vukhale, Ttn Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, loyi a tlhaviweke hi mudyondzi eka Xikolo xa Sekondari xa Ramotshere eZeerust, N’walungu-Vupeladyambu.3 Vakhomaxiave hinkwavo va twananile leswaku madzolonga hi ku angarhela, naswona exikolweni ngopfungopfu, a ya amukeleki na leswaku ntirhisano wo yisa emahlweni wa laveka ku tiyisisa leswaku swikolo swi va swi hlayisekile swinene eka havumbirhi bya vadyondzi na vadyondzisi.

src: Lephaneli ibambe umhlangano wayo kwekucala kuleliviki kantsi ilindzeleke kutsi ingenise kuMengameli emagama alabo labahlungiwe mhla ti-07 Ingongoni Sijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo.1 IKhabhinethi icocile ngeSijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo lesimayelana nekusebentisa, kulima kanye nekuphatsa insangu kwemuntfu lomdzala ngasese kuti atisebentisele yena ngekwakhe kanye nelifutse lalesijubo.
tgt: I ro sungula, ndzawulo nan’waka yi ta tlhela yi fambisa swikambelo hi Ririmi ra Swikoweto ra Afrika-Dzonga eka levhele ya Ririmi ra le Kaya eka 58 wa vakamberiwa lava nga twiki eswikolweni swa 10 hinkwaswo.

src: Emalunga emmango acelwa kutsi asifundze kahle lesijubo ngobe kusetjentiswa kwensangu endzaweni yemmango akukavunyelwa.
tgt: Xikambelo xi famba ku ringana mavhiki ya ntlhanu na hafu naswona xi ta hela hi siku ra 28 Hukuri.2 Vadyondzi etikweni hinkwaro va ta tlhela va sayina xihlambanyo hi ku lava ka vona xa ku tiboha ku hlayisa vunene bya swikambelo hi ku nga teki xiave eka mitirho yo homboloka yihi kumbe yihi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela leNgcungcutsela yeKuphepha eTikolweni lesandza kubakhona lebeyiholwa yiNdvuna yeTemfundvo Lesisekelo Angie Motshekga.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku tivisiwa ka Tindhawu leyi Sirheleriweke (tiMPA) ta 20 tanihi Oparexini Phakisa: Netiweke ya Vayimeri va tiMPA ta Ikhonomi ya swa Lwandle.

src: Lengcungcutsela ihlangise ndzawonye betemfundvo kanye nalabatsintsekako bangephandle kute kutfolwe likhambi lelicondzene netindzaba tekuphepha tikolo talelive letibukene nato kanye nekuhlahla indlela leya embili yekwenta kutsi kube nekuphepha etikolweni.
tgt: Mbuyelo wa ku thoriwa ko engetela, exikarhi ka swin’wana, wu ta kotisa nhluvukiso lowu yaka emahlweni wa vupfhumba na ikhonomi na nkondletelo wa mfikelelo wa switirhisiwa leswi lawuriwaka hindlela leyi yisekaka emahlweni ya vunjoveri bya mpimo wa le hansi.

src: Loku kulandzela tehlakalo tebudlova letenteke kuletinye tikolo, lokufaka ekhatsi kushona kwathishela loneminyaka lenge-24 budzala, Umnu Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, lowagwazwa ngumfundzi wambulala lapha esikolweni saseRamotshere Secondary School eZeerust, eNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: TiMPA ti ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazate ya Mfumo.0 Khabinete yi pasise Nongonoko wa Matirhelo wa Rixaka (NAP) lowu Pfuxetiweke na ku va lowu Fambelanisiweke wa Afrika-Dzonga ku Herisa ku Endliwa ka Mananga, ku Hungutiwa ka Nono ka Misava na ku Hunguta Switandzhaku swa Dyandza (2018-2030).

src: Bonkhe labatsintsekako bavumelene ngekutsi budlova nje jikelele, kodvwa kakhulu etikolweni, abemukeleki nekutsi kudzinga kutsi kubanjisanwe kucinisekisa kutsi tikolo tibayindzawo lephephile yebafundzi nabothishela.
tgt: NAP yi lava ku hoxa xandla eka nhlayiso na ntirhiso lowu yisekaka emahlweni wa misava ya hina na swipfuno swin’wana swa ntumbuluko.

src: Bafundzi kulolonkhe lelive batawusayina ngekutsandza sibopho nome sifungo sekwetsemba ngesikhatsi seluhlolo ngekutsi bangatimbandzakanyi kunome ngabe ngusiphi sento sekungatiphatsi kahle.
tgt: Hi ku fambisana na Atikili ya 9 ya ntsombano, mavandla ya laveka ku hluvukisa, ku lulamisa na ku tirhisa NAP tanihi xiphemukulu xa qhinga ra ku herisa ku endliwa ka mananga na ku hunguta switandzhaku swa dyandza.

src: Batali nebondli bebantfwana bayagcugcutelwa kutsi basekele bafundzi ngalesikhatsi sabo lesimcoka eluhambeni lwabo lwetemfundvo.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Vana eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: Kubalulekile futsi bakhutsatwe bafundzi kutsi basicedze sikolo singabashipheli.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lava ku tiyisa ntirhisano wa sisiteme ya nhlayiso wa vana na nsirhelelo hi ku tirhisa ntirhisano wa le xikarhi ka tindzawulo na le xikarhi ka tisekitara.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kumenyetelwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kweTindzawo taseLwandle Letinge-20 Letivikelekile (ema-MPA) njengencenye ye-Operation Phakisa: Luhlakamsebenti Lolumelele ema-MPA eMnotfo waseLwandle.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta angula eka Vuahluri bya Khoto ya le Henhla ya Gauteng N’walungu bya Hukuri 2017, laha eka byona Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu yi leriseke ku lulamisiwa na ku tivisiwa ka mihundzuluxo leyi faneleke ya Nawu wa Vana, 2005, (Nawu wa 38 wa 2005) hi mayelana na xitshunxo xa xinawu eka malawulelo ya sisiteme ya nhlayiso na vuwundli.

src: Inzuzo yalokukhetfwa, kutsi, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, kutawuvumela kutsi kube nentfutfuko kutekuvakasha letivikela imvelo kanye nekukhutsata kutsi kufinyeleleke kumitfombolusito lelawulekako lesimeme yetinhlanti letisilinganiso lesincane.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Vukorhokeri bya Poso ePalamende.

src: Lokukhetfwa lokuphakanyisiwe kuta ngemuva kwekukhulumisana emkhatsini walabatsintsekako labafanele.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu humelerisa Papila ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo ra Pholisi ya ICT leyi Pfanganisiweke ya Rixaka leyi yi pasisiweke hi Khabinete hi Ndzati 2016.Mivuyelo leyi kunguhateriweke yi fanele ku va na Hofisi ya Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi phikizanaka, leyi tirhisekaka na ku va leyi yisekaka emahlweni leyi yi nyikaka/humelerisaka vukorhokeri bya vanhu hinkwavo na mfikelelo xikan’we na ncinco wa sekitara ya poso.

src: Lama-MPA atawushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende.
tgt: Nakambe Nawumbisi lowu wu nyika endlelo eka tiadirese ta ndhawu eka miganga ya le tindhawini ta le makaya na ya ndhavuko.

src: IKhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelo lweKwenta lwaVelonkhe (i-NAP) lweSibili Lolubuyeketiwe Lacondzaniswa lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweKulwa neBugwadvule, Kwehla kweMandla eMhlaba ekuKhicita kanye nekuNciphisa Imitselela Lemibi yeSomiso (2018-2030).
tgt: Khomferense ya Vuvekisi bya Matiko ya Misava ya Afrika-DzongaPhuresidente Ramaphosa hi Ravuntlhanu, 26 Nhlangula 2018, u ta va mutshamaxitulu wa Khomferense ya Vuvekisi leyi simekiwaka ya Afrika-Dzonga eSandton Convention Centre eJoni.

src: Le-NAP ihlose kufaka ligalelo ekongeni kanye nasekusetjenytisweni ngendlela lesimeme kwemhlaba wetfu kanye naleminye imitfombolusito yemvelo.
tgt: Lexi i xiphemu xa nkatsano wa matshalatshala ya ku koka vuvekisi na ku kurisa ikhonomi ya hina.

src: Ngekulandzela iSigaba se-9 salesivumelwane, emave alindzeleke kutsi asungule futsi acale kusebentisa i-NAP njengencenye lemcoka yendlelalisu lekulwa nebugwadvule nekunciphisa imitselela yesomiso.
tgt: Samiti ya Vuvekisi ya G20 yi ta tisa endhawini yin’we mabindzu ya Jarimani na Matiko ya CwA ku valanga swivandlanene swa vuvekisi ehansi ka rimba ra Xinakulobye xa Vavekisi va Jarimani va ta nyika tiphurojeke ta nkoka swinene leti nga ku endlekeni eka nkarhi wa sweswi eka Matiko ya CwA na ku valanga swivandlanene ku yisa emahlweni eka tikokulu.

src: INingizimu Afrika yasungula i-NAP yayo yekucala nga-2004.Imitsetfosivivinyo.
tgt: Phuresidente u ta ya eka samiti a ri eka xiyimo xa Mutshamaxitulukulobye wa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika wa G. Khomferense ya G20 eka CwA yi ta kongomisa eka tindlela leti G20, matiko ya Afrika na mihlangano ya nhluvukiso swi nga tirhisanaka hatona ku kondletela vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na vutekaxiave bya ikhonomi eka mifumo ya Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Letiphatselene neBantfwana kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Nhlengeletano leyi yi ta tlhela yi endla ntirho wo lulamisela eka xiyenge xa Samiti ya G20 eBuenos Aires, Argentina.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kucinisa kusebentisana emkhatsini kwekunakekela bantfwana kanye neluhlelo lwekubavikela ngekusebentisa kuhlanganisa kusebentisana emkhatsini wematiko nemikhakha.
tgt: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo xa RixakaSwirho swa Vurhangerinkulu swi ta teka xiave eka Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo xa Rixaka xa mafambiselo ya xidemokirasi ya vuntlhanu, leri ri nga ta va kona kusuka hi siku ra 12 kufika 25 Hukuri 2018.

src: Letichibelo tiphendvula Sijubo seNkantolo Lephakeme yaseNyakatfo Gauteng sangaLweti 2017, lapho Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle layalwa kutsi lilungise liphindze letfule tichibelo letidzingekile eMtsetfweni weBantfwana, wanga-2005 (Umtsetfo Longunombolo ye-38 wanga-2005) acondzana nekulawulwa kweluhlelo lwekukhuliswa kwemntfwana ngumuntfu longasuye umtali.
tgt: Leswi swi kotlana na Vhiki ro Vika ra Nongonoko wa Matirhelo wa Khabinete.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawunika emandla Inchubomgomo Lehlongotwako yaVelonkhe yeThekhinoloji Yelwati Lwetekuchumana (i-ICT) leHlanganisiwe leyavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngeNyoni 2016.
tgt: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo ri ta nyika pulatifomo eka swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan’we na varhangeri va mfumo wa swifundzakulu na wa miganga ku endla tinhlengeletano ta miganga na Swivijo etikweni hinkwaro, hi nkarhi lowu, ku kombisa ntirho wa mfumo wa Rimba ra Maqhinga ra le Xikarhi ka Theme na ku angula eka timhaka leti boxiwaka hi vaakatiko, leswiMavhiki mambirhi ya vugingiriki ya ta va kona ehenhla ka xiyimo xa mitlangelo ya malembexidzana mifungho ya Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeka Manana Albertina Sisulu na Tatana Nelson Mandela, lava havumbirhi bya vona va kombisaka nkoka wa vutihlanganisi na n‘wangulano na miganga leyi va yi korhokeleke.

src: Imiphumela lehlosiwe kutsi kube neLiposi laseNingizimu Afrika lelikhona kuchudzelana, lelisebentako nalelisimeme leliletsa tinsita letibanti lelinekufinyeleleka kanye nekuntjintja kwemkhakha wetemaposi.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozele Holobye wa swa Rihanyu, Dkd Aaron Motsoaledi, loyi a kumeke masagwati ya Kochon ya xiyimo xa le henhla mambirhi, eka nkhuvu wa masagwati lowu khomeriweke eThe Hague, Nethelands.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo futsi wenta kutsi kube nendlela yekunika imimango yasetindzaweni tasemaphandleni neyendzabuko emakheli.
tgt: Sagwati ro sungula ri le ka xiyimo xa munhu a ri yexe xa Holobye xa xiave xakwe na vurhangeri bya xipolitiki eka ku lwisana na rifuva (TB) emisaveni hinkwayo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo sekuvele kuboniswene ngawo nemmango.
tgt: Sagwati ra vumbirhi, leri Holobye a nga ta ri avelana na Muchavisekinkulu Nick Hebert, Xirho xa Palamende (MP) eUnited Kingdom, ri ta va eka xiyimo xa vona tanihi vatshamaxitulukulobye va Khokhasi ya TB ya Misava Hinkwayo ya tiMP to huma emisaveni hinkwayo.

src: Ikhomfa yaseNingizimu Afrika yeMave eMhlaba yeLutjalotimaliMengameli Ramaphosa ngaLesihlanu, mhla tinge-26 Imphala 2018, utawube angusihlalo wekuvulwa kweKhomfa yekucala yaseNingizimu Afrika yeLutjalotimali lapha eSandton Convention Centre eJozi.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Masagwati ya ku Tekiwa ka Tendzo Emisaveni ya 2018 laha ku vhotiweke Afrika-Dzonga tanihi Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni.

src: Loku kuyincenye yemitamo lehlangisiwe yekuheha batjalitimali kanye nekukhulisa umnotfo wetfu.
tgt: Durban eKwaZulu-Natal na yona yi tekeriwile enhlokweni tanihi Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka ya Madorobakulu leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni naswona hi tekile xidlodlo xa xiyimo xa le henhla xa Hlaluko wa Swikepe lowu Rhangeke Emahlweni wa Afrika.

src: Kwengeta, labane labamelele lutjalotimali labakhetfwe nguMengameli batakwetfula umbiko kulekhomfa mayelana nenchubekelembili leyentekile.
tgt: Kapa, eKapa-Vupeladyambu yi kume xidlodlo xa Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka ya Mikhuvu na Swiendleko leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni ya Afrika.

src: Ingcungcutsela yeMave Langemashumi Lamabili (i-G20) Mengameli Ramaphosa umenywe nguNdvunankulu waseGermany, Dkt.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku rhanga emahlweni ka filimi ya laha tikweni leyi thyiweke Nommer 37 hi muendli wa tifilimi Joshua Bradley eUnited States hi siku ra 2 Hukuri 2018.

src: Angela Merkel, kutsi abemdzibi munye eNgcungcutseleni ye-G20 Yelutjalotimali – emabhizinisi aseGermany nemave angemalunga eSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA), kanye neNkhulumiswano yeteMabhizinisi, kokubili kutawubanjelwa eBerlin, eGermany mhla tinge-30 Imphala 2018.LeNgcungcutsela Ye-G20 Yelutjalotimali itawuhlanganisa ndzawonye emabhizinisi aseGermany kanye neMave angemalunga e-CwA kute ahlwaye ematfuba elutjalotimali ngaphasi kweluhlakamsebenti lweBudlelwane be-G20 ne-Afrika.
tgt: Xitsakisi xa vugevenga leyi endleriweke eCape Flats yi nyikiwile timali hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi ku tirhisa xikimi xa yona xa Swihlohloteri swa Vaendli va Tifilimi va Vantima lava ha Tumbulukaka va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Batjalitimali baseGermany batakwetfula imiklamo lesezingeni lelisetulu kwanyalo leyentiwa eMaveni angemalunga e-CwA kanye nekuhlwaya ematfuba kulelivekati.
tgt: Leswi swi ta hoxa xandla eka ku koka vuvekisi byo kongoma bya matiko mambe eka indasitiri ya tifilimi ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Mengameli utahambela leNgcungcutsela ngemandla esikhundla sekuba nguSihlalo Ngekuhlanganyela weLicembu Lekweluleka lase-Afrika le-LeNgcungcutsela ye-G20 itawugcila etindleleni i-G20, emave ase-Afrika kanye netikhungo tentfutfuko letingasebentisana ngato ngekubambisana ekuheheni lutjalotimali lomkhakha lotimele kanye nekutimbandzakanya kutemnotfo wemave ase-Afrika.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatse na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku hundzisa ku tsana na michavelelo:19.1 eka ku lova ka kutlula 27 wa vanhu, eka nghozi ya swipandzamananganyingi eka N1 N’walungu eLimpopo.

src: Lomhlangano utawuphindza futsi wente emalungiselelo eNgcungcutsela ye-G20 letawubaseBuenos Aires, e-Argentina.
tgt: Vatirhisi va magondzo va khutaziwa ku va na vukheta emagondzweni ya hina na ku tiyisisa leswaku va landzelela milawu ya gondzo hi mikarhi hinkwayo.2 eka ku lova ka mfungho wa Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeko, Manana Agnes Msimang.

src: Liviki laVelonkhe Lekugcila Kutimbizo Emalunga eSigungu (iKhabhinethi) atawukutimbandzakanya kuLiviki laVelonkhe Le-9 Lekugcila Kutimbizo leLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Netekwatisa (i-GCIS) lwalohulumende watsatsa lulawulo nga-2014, lelitawuba mhla ti-12 kuya mhla tinge-25 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Manana Msimang a ri mugingirikeli wa rimbewu loyi a tinyiketeleke tlhelo Xandla xa Phuresidente ya Ligi ya Vamanana ya African National Congress.

src: LeLiviki Lwekugcila Kutimbizo litawunika emalunga eSigungu Savelonkhe, baholi betifundza kanye nebaholi babohulumende bendzawo inkhundla kutsi babambe imihlangano nemimango kanye neTimbizo eveni nje lonkhe, kulesikhatsi, kukhombisa kutsi hulumende ucala njani kusebentisa Luhlakamsebenti lweNdlelalisu yeThemu leseMkatsini (i-MTSF) ya-2014-2019 kanye nekuphendvula leto tindzaba letiphakanyiswa takhamuti, letinelifutse kutekuphepha, kukhula nekutfutfukisa imimango yetfu.
tgt: Ntirho wa nkosi wu ta sungula hi 08:00 eOur Lady of Cedars Catholic Church eWoodmead, Joni.3 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeko tlhelo muamukeri wa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Mendi eka Xitiyanhlana xa Silivhere, Ttn Eric “Stalin” Mtshali.4 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya ANC Moss Chikane.

src: Lamaviki lamabili etimbizo enteka ngemuva kwemigubho yelikhulu leminyaka yemachawe eMzabalazo, Make Albertina Sisulu naBabe Nelson Mandela, bobabili bayinkhomba yekukhombisa kubaluleka kwekubonisana ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi kanye nekucocisana nemimango lebebayisebentela.
tgt: Ttn Chikane u ve MP hi 1994 endzhaku ka mihlawulo ya xidemokirasi yo sungula ya tiko.

src: Aaron Motsoaledi, lozuze imiklomelo lemibili ye-Kochon, emcimbini wekunikwa lowo mklomelo lobewubanjelwe eThe Hague, eThe Netherlands.
tgt: Mnn Palme i noni ya khale ka Holobyenkulu Olof Palme loyi a dlaweke hi 1986 naswona loyi Phuresidente Ramaphosa a n’wi hlamuseleke tanihi munghana wa “Afrika-Dzonga”.

src: Lomklomelo wakhe wekucala uwutfole ngendzima yakhe layidlale yena matfupha kanye nebuholi kutepolitiki ekulweni kwakhe nesifo sesifuba (i-TB) mhlaba wonkhe.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ta fanela ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: Umklomelo wesibili, Indvuna itakwabelana nawo neMhlonishwa Nick Hebert, Lilunga lePhalamende (i-MP) lase-United Kingdom, ngetikhundla tabo tekuba bosihlalo ngekuhlanganyela be-Global TB Caucus yeMalunga ePhalamende emhlaba wonkhe.
tgt: Huvo ya SENTECH SOC LIMITED:a. Mnn Maureen Makole Manyama (mulawuri loyi nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu) nab.

src: Lomklomelo we-Kochon uklonyeliswa njalo ngemnyaka kulabo bantfu nome netinhlangano letibe negalelo lelimcoka ekulweni ne-TB emaveni ato nome emhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: Mnn Precious Nompumelelo Sibiya (mulawuri loyi nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu).

src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umcimbi wanga-2018 wemiklomelo yemhlaba yetekuvakasha, i-World Travel Awards 2018, lovotele live laseNingizimu Afrika njengeNdzawo Lephuma Embili e-Afrika longaya kuyo.
tgt: Ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa ka Mnn Gugulethu Brightness Nokukhanya (Poppy) Khoza tanihi Mulawuri: Vuhahisi bya Vaaki bya Huvo ya Vulawuri bya Vuhahisi bya Vaaki bya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-7 Lweti 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlengeletane hi Ravunharhu, 7 Hukuri 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Tindzaba Letimcoka.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.

src: Ingcungcutsela Lephatselene Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili Nekubulawa Kwalabasikati IKhabhinethi yamukela letingcogco letibe yimphumelelo teNgcungcutsela Lephatselene Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili Nekubulawa Kwalabasikati lebeyibanjwe mhla lu-01 kuya kumhla ti-02 kuLweti.
tgt: Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke eka Rimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente.

src: Lengcungcutsela icinisekise lokuphutfuma bekwakhiwa kwesivumelwano sekubuketana naletikhinga tekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili, kucwaswa kwabomake nekungalingani ngekwebulili.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku jekanekisana loku nga va na ku humelela ka Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke ekaRimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente leyi a yi khomiwe hi siku ra 01 na 02 Hukuri.

src: Hulumende uvumile kubuyeketa tinhlelo tavelonkhe kute kucedvwe kuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili kanye nekubhalwa Kweluhlelo Lwekusebenta Lavelonkhe lekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili.
tgt: Samiti leyi yi tiyisisile xihatla xa ku fikeleriwa ka ntwanano wa ku tirhana na xiphiqo xa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu, xihlawuhlawu ehenhla ka vaxisati na ku nga ringani ka rimbewu.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebente ndzawonye kute bacale bagucule indlela yekwenta, kusebenta netikhungo letitawucedza kuhlukunyetwa kwalabasikati.
tgt: Mfumo wu twananile ku endla nkambisiso wa makungu ya rixaka ku herisa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu na nhluvukiso wa Kungu ra Matirhelo ra Rixaka hi mayelana na madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu.

src: Lutjalomali.
tgt: Vuvekisi.

src: IKhabhinethi yamukela leKhomfa Yelutjalomali lebeyimphumelelo lebeyibanjwe ngenyanga yeMphala eSandton, eJozi.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi veke kona hi Nhlangula eSandton, eJoni.

src: LeKhomfa Yelutjalomali yente kwekutsi iNingizimu Afrika yetsenjiswe ngemali yekusisa letigidzigidziletinge-R290 yimikhakha leyehlukene yemnotfo.
tgt: Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi yi olovisele Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta kutlula R290 wa tibiliyoni ta ku tiboha ku vekisa loku humaka eka tisekitara to hambana ta ikhonomi.

src: Loku kungeta kulemali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi letinge-R400 iNingizimu Afrika lebeyetsenjiswe ngayo ngemave lahlukene ngalesikhatsi avakashelwe mancusa elutjalomali.
tgt: Leswi swi tatisa eka ku tshembisa loku tlulaka R400 wa tibiliyoni loku amukeriweke hi nkarhi wa pfhumba ro vekisa leri a ri huma eka vurhumiwa byo hlawuleka na lebyi humaka eka matiko yo hambana hi nkarhi wa tendzo ta mfumo.

src: Lekhomfa bewuhanjelwe tihambeli letingetulu kwa-1 000, letivela emaveni lange-35.
tgt: Khomferense a yi endzeriwile hi kutlula 1000 wa varhumiwa, lava a va huma eka matiko yo tlula Moya wa yona a wu nyanyula swinene, naswona tiko ra ka hina ri kombise swivandlanene swa vuvekisi na mapfhumba ya tipholisi lawa ma pfunaka ku tumbuluxa mbangu wa vuvekisi lowu nga na xinghana.

src: Umoya nenjabulo bekunyukile kantsi lakuleli likhangise ngematfuba lamasha ekusisa netinchubomgomo letisita kwakha simo lesilungele kusisa.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela xipanu lexi tirheke eka Khomferense, naswona yi langutela ku amukela swiviko swa vuxokoxoko lebyintshwa swa nkarhi na nkarhi hi mayelana na matirhisele ya vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongela lelicembu lelisebente kuleKhomfa kantsi litakutfokotela kutfola imibiko lebuyeketako njalo ekwenteni letintfo lekutsenjiswene ngato.
tgt: Loko Afrika-Dzonga na Afrika hinkwayo yi ya emahlweni no kurisa ikhonomi ya tikokulu, Khabinete yi tlhela yi amukela Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika yo sungula leyi sweswi yi nga eku humeleleni kufikela hi siku ra vu9 Hukuri, eJoni.

src: Njengobe iNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Afrika yonkhana bayachubeka kuhamba ngendlela lephakeme leholela ekukhuliseni umnotfo walelivekati, IKhabhinethi ibuye yamukele lokuvulwa kweNgcungcutsela Yelutjalomali yase-Afrika yekucala, lekwanyalo isachubeka kudzimate kube ngamhla ti--9 Lweti, eJozi.
tgt: Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika a yi rhambiwile hi Bangi ya Nhluvukiso ya Afrika.

src: LeNgcungcutsela Yelutjalomali yase-Afrika ihlelwe Libhange Lentfutfuko e-Afrika (i-African Development Bank).
tgt: Yi kongomise ku aka ehenhla ka ku humelela loku nga kona sweswi hi ku hlanganisa vavekisi lava humaka eka mfumo na lava humaka eka mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku pfula gondzo rintshwa eka Tikonklu ra Afrika hinkwaro.

src: Ihlose kwakhela emphumelelweni leseyivele ikhona ngekutsi ihlanganise ndzawonye basisi bemikhakha yangasese nahulumende kute basungule indlela lensha lekukhulisa umnotfo e-Afrika yonkhana.
tgt: Khomferense ya G20 ya Afrika leyi ya ha ku khomiwaka yi tlhela yi hlohlotela ku kula ka swivandlanene swa hina hi ku tirhisa ku vutiboheleri byo hambanahambana lebyi tlakusaka vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na ku nghenelela eka swa ikhonomi ka mifumo ya Afrika tanihi xiphemu xa Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika.

src: LoMhlangano we-G20 wase-Afrika losandza kubanjwa uchubeke nekusimamisa kukhula kwemnotfo wetfu ngekusebentisa kungenelela lokuhlukene lokube khona lokutfutfukisa kusisa kwabosomabhizinisi bangasese nekungenelela kumnotfo emaveni ase-Afrika njengencenye yeSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA).
tgt: Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika wu fambisiwa xikan’we hi Afrika-Dzonga na Jarimani hi ku tirhisa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika.

src: INingizimu Afrika ingusihlalo we-CwA ngekuhlanganyela neGermany ngenca Yelicembu Lekweluleka lase-Afrika.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela Phaka ya Tifeme ya Phuthaditjhaba ya R50 wa timiliyoni leya ha ku simekiwaka eFree State leyi nga ta tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme no tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku kula emigangeni eka xifundzakulu lexiya.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yamukela Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park lebite imali letigizi letinge-R50 lesandza kwetfulwa esifundzeni saseFreyistata letawutfutfukisa inchubekela phambili nekwakhiwa kwematfuba emisebenti yakuleli nekukhula kwemnotfo kulesa sifundza.
tgt: Khabinete ya ha tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku ekuheteleleni ku ta sungula ku hunguta mitlhontlho ya ku pfumaleka ka mitirho leyi nga langutana na tiko, hi ku tisa moya wo tshemba na ntshembo.

src: Kwakhiwa kwematfuba emsebenti.
tgt: Ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.

src: Hulumende uyangenelela ngekunyusa imitamo yekwakha ematfuba emsebenti kulusha nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika yonkhana, kugcilwe emadolobheni nasemakhaya, kanye nemabhizinisi abomake nelusha lebavame kutfwala lomtfwalo wekubuketana netinselele letiphatselene nemnotfo.
tgt: Mfumo wu tlakusa matshalatshala yo tumbuluxela vantshwa na MaAfrika-Dzonga hi ku angarhela mitirho yo tala, lama kongomiseke eka tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, na mabindzu ya vavasati na vantshwa lava va talaka ku rhwala mpingu wa mitiyiso ya ikhonomi leyi tlhontlhaka.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba kwekutsi loluhlelo lwemvusamnotfo, lolutawungenisa imali lemabhiliyoni lange-R50 kumikhakha lebalulekile njengetekulima, tinsitanchanti tahulumende, iminotfo yemadolobha neyasemakhaya, lutawuletsa kukhutsata lokufanele kwekwakha ematfuba emsebenti nekutfola umnotfo losimeme.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku mpako wa magoza yo pfuxeta ikhonomi, lawa ma nga ta nghenisa R50 wa timiliyoni eka tisekitara ta nkoka to fana na ta swa vurimi, swimakiwakulu swa vaaki, tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, wu ta nyika nhlohlotelo lowu faneleke wa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na mpfuxeto wa ikhonomi leyi nga hetaka nkarhi wo leha.

src: Loku kungeta kulemiphumela lebonakalako yaleNgcungcutsela Yemisebenti lapho hulumende, emabhizinisi nebetemisebenti batinikele: ekutsengeni imikhicito yakuleli kusetjentiswe indlela lenemandla yekukhulisa tintfo letitfunyelwa ngaphandle kungenelela kuluchungechunge lwetekulima nekusekela emabhizinisi lasemancane nalafufusako kute kusimamiswe imisebenti.
tgt: Leswi swi tatisela eka mivuyelo leyi tirhisekaka ya Samiti ya swa Mitirho laha mfumo, mabindzu na vatirhi va tiboheke ku: xava swimakiwa swa laha ndzeni ka tiko ku tirhisa maendlelo yo tikarhata swinene yo tlakusa nxaviselo-vambe ku nghenelela eka ku hangalasiwa ka swimakiwa swa vurimi no seketela mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi ku tlakusa mitirho.

src: IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ekutseni lokungenelela kubalulekile ekulungiseni lokutfolakele kuLuklayo Lwekota Lwetemisebenti lekota yesitsatfu yanga-2018, lolukhombisa kukhula kwemisebenti kanye nekukhula kwesibalo sebantfu labangasebenti.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku i ka nkoka eka ku ololoxa leswi kumiweke eka Ndzavisiso wa swa Nhlayokulu ya Vatirhi wa Kotara hi Kotara eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2018, lowu kombiseke leswaku ku kula eka ku thoriwa xikan’we na ku tlakuka ka nhlayo ya vanhu lava nga tirhiki.

src: Kuletinyanga leti-3, imisebenti leyengetiwe lenge-92 000 isunguliwe.
tgt: Eka nkarhi wa tin’hweti tinharhu, mitirho ya 92 000 yo tatisela yi tumbuluxiwile.

src: Noma kunjalo, bantfu labange-131 000 le ngaphambilini ‘bacedzelwa litsemba lekufuna umsebenti’ baphindze babuyela kuyofuna umsebenti kulekota, lizinga lebantfu labangasebenti libuye lakhula, nga-0.3% lafika ku-27.5%.
tgt: Hambiswiritano, hikwalaho ka vanhu lava lavaka mintirho va kwalomu ka 131 000 lava a va hele ntamu eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza va tlhele va nghena eka makete wa vatirhi eka kotare leyi, mpimo wa mpfumaleko wa ntirho na wona wu tlakuke hi wa poyinti ya tiphesente wu ya eka wa tiphesente.

src: Ngekusho kweLihhovisi Letelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika (i-StatsSA) ematfuba emsebenti akhule emkhakheni wetinsita temabhizinisi netekwakha, ngalesikhatsi kulaleka kwematfuba emsebenti kutfolakele etimayini, kutemikhicito, tekutfutsa nasemakhaya.
tgt: Hi ku ya hi Tinhlayonhlayo ta Afrika-Dzonga, ku kula ka ku thoriwa ku ve kona eka vukorhokeri bya swa mabindzu, mabindzu na vuaki, loko ku lahlekeriwa hi mitirho ku ve kona eka swa migodi, vumaki, vutleketli na le mitini.

src: Imisebenti kumikhakha lebhaliswe ngalokusemtsetfweni iphelile, ngalesikhatsi kumikhakha lengenasiciniseko ikhulile.
tgt: Ku thoriwa eka sekitara ya ximfumo ku tsongaharile, kasi mitirho eka sekithara leyi nga riki ya mfumo yi kurile.

src: Kubungatwa iminyaka lenge-20 yeMtsetfo Wekuncintisana IKhabhinethi inaka kwekutsi loMtsetfo Wekuncintisana uhlanganise iminyaka lenge-20 kusukela wacala kusebenta ngenyanga yeMphala nga-1998.
tgt: Anivhesari ya vu20 ya Nawu wa Mphikizano Khabinete yi lemuka leswaku Nawu wa Mphikizano wu fikelele lembe ra vu20 kusukela loko wu sungule ku tirha hi 1998.

src: Kuleminyaka lenge-20, lalabaphetse tekuncintisana bente inchubekelembili lenhle kakhulu ngekulwa netinhlangano letikhulisa tintsengo, kungasetjentiswa kahle kwemandla mabhizinsi lamakhulu nekuvikelwa kwemmango ngalesikhatsi kuhlanganwa.
tgt: Eka malembe ya 20 lama nga hundza, vulawuri bya mphikizano byi ve na ku humelela lokukulu swinene eka ku lwisana na ku twanana ku tlakusa minxavo ka vamaki na vaxavisi, matirhiselo yo biha ya ku va lava xaveriwaka ngopfu emakete na ku sirheleriwa ka ku tsakela ka vaaki loko ku va na ku hlangana.

src: Laba labaphetse babeke imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R8 yetinhlawulo etinkapani letiphula Umtsetfo.
tgt: Mfumo wu nyike kutlula R8 wa tibiliyoni ta mixupulo eka tikhamphani leti tluleke Nawu lowu.

src: Lihhovisi laNdvuna Wekutfutfukisa Umnotfo, ngekusebentisa uMtsetfo Wekuncintisana, lakhe imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R5 kusikhwama setimali letikhetsekile kute kutfutfukiswe emabhizinisi lasemancane, baphakeli bakuleli kanye nekungena kwebalimi labamnyama kulomkhakha wetemnotfo.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya swa Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi, hi ku tirhisa magoza lama nga eka Nawu wa Mphikizano, yi endle ku tlula R5 wa tibiliyoni ta nkwama wo hlawuleka ku tlakusa mabindzu lamatsongo, vahangalasi va swimakiwa na ku nghena ka van’wamapurasi va vantima eka ikhonomikulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongela labaphetse tekuncintisana ngalomsebenti lowentiwe kuvula umnotfo uvulelwe bantfu labasha nekutfutfukisa emabhizinisi nemincintiswano.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela valawuri va mphikizano eka ntirho lowu va wu tirheke ku pfulela vanhu lavantshwa lava khumbekaka ikhonomi no tlakusa ku endliwa ka mabindzu na mphikizano.

src: Umhlangano we-18 Wemkhandlu waboNdvuna we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) IKhabhinethi ibongela Litiko Letebudlelwane Nekubambisana Kwemave Emhlaba ngekubungata Umhlangano we-18 Wemkhandlu waboNdvuna (i-COM) we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) lowabanjelwa eDurban, KwaZulu- Natal ngamhla ti-02 Lweti 2018 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: Kuhlanganisa Bantfu base-Afrika, Asia, Australiasia naseMiddle East ngekusebentisa indlela yekusebentisana letfutfukisiwe nekuthula, Kusimama neKutfutfuka Lokusimeme”.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya vu18 ya Khansele ya Vaholobye ya Indian Ocean Rim Association.

src: Munye walemiphumela yalomhlangano we-18 we-IORA beyiSimemetelo Lesikhetsekile sekuhlonipha Mengameli Nelson Mandela lekangulomunye webasunguli be-IORLoku kuholele ekutseni kusungulwe “luhlelo lwekucecesha le-IORA Nelson Mandela ‘Bani Ngumshiyandvuku nesibonelo semisebenti yakhe” lekulindzeleke kutsi luvulwe ngalokusemtsetfweni ngenyanga yaKholwane 2019.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano ku va yi rhurhele Nhlengeletano ya vu18 ya Khansele ya Vaholobye (COM) ya Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi a yi khomeriwe eDurban, eKwaZulu-Natal hi siku ra 02 Hukuri 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku Vumba Vun’we bya Vanhu va Afrika, Asia, Australasia na Middle East hi ntirhisano lowu antswisiweke kuma ku Rhula, Ntshamiseko na Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni”.

src: Lomtamo uhlose kuniketa emandla nekuhlomisa bantfu labasha labayincenye ye-IORA ngelwati lwemsebenti kumikhakha yabo labayifundzelako.
tgt: Wun’wana wa mivuyelo ya nhlengeletano ya IORA ya vu18 a ku ri Xihlambanyo xo Hlawuleka hi ku xixima Phuresidente Nelson Mandela loyi a nga un’wana wa vasunguri va IORLeswi swi endle leswaku ku tumbuluxiwa “nongonoko wa ntirhodyondzo wa ‘Va na Ndzhaka’ wa IORA Nelson Mandela” lowu languteriweke ku simekiwa ximfumo hi Mawuwani 2019.

src: Kulwa Nebugebengu IKhabhinethi yamukela Lesikhungo Sekulwa Netigebengu Letingemacembu lesisandza kuvulwa endzaweni yaseHanover Park, eNshonalanga Kapa, sivulwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ri kongomise eka ku nyika vantshwa va IORA matimba na vuswikoti bya ntokoto wa ntirho eka swiyenge swa vona swo hambana swa dyondzo.

src: Lesikhungo sinemalunga laceceshiwe ekusebenteni ngetimo letinebungoti njengoba babuya kusikhungo selicembu leliphendvula ngekushesha (ma-Bharete), lelicembu lelinemsebenti lokhetsekile (i-special task force) kanye nalesikhungo lesingenelela velonkhe (i-national intervention unit).
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Yuniti yo Lwisana na Vugevenga bya Mitlawa leyi ya ha ku simekiwaka eHanover Park eKapa-Vupeladyambu hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Kulomtamo wekulwa nebugebengu, lomtamo walohulumnde wekungenelela utawundluliselwa kuvelonkhe.
tgt: Ku nghenelela loku engeteriweke hi mfumo loku ku ta pfuna swinene eka ku tirhana kahle ka ku lwisana na vugevenga bya mitlawa na vugevenga lebyi fambelanaka na swidzidziharisi lebyi hlaselaka vaakitiko.

src: IKhabhinethi imema imimmango kutsi isebentisane netikhungo temtsetfo ekugcineni kuphepha nekuvikeleka lekuyintfo lebalulekile kunoma ngumuphi ummango kutsi ukwati kukhula.
tgt: Yuniti leyi yi na swirho leswi leteriweke eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa nxungeto wa le henhla tanihileswi swi humaka eka Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta, maphorisa lama tirhaka ntirho wo hlawuleka xikan’we na yuniti yo nghenelela ya tiko hinkwaro.

src: Iyachubeka nekutinikela ekucinisekiseni kwekutsi imimmango iphephile kantsi itivela iphephile etindzaweni labahlala kuto.
tgt: Eka ku lava ku lwisana na vugevenga, ku nghenelela loku rhangeriweke hi mfumo ngopfungopfu ku yise ku nghenelela loku nga ta yisiwa etikweni hinkwaro.

src: Sikhatsi Sentsela IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe batseli bentsela ngekutfumela ngesikhatsi emafomu abo entsela yanjalo ngemnyaka nakulomnyaka wentsela wanga-2017/18, levalwe ngamhla tinge-31 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vaakitiko ku tirhisana na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ku hlayisa vuhlayiseki na nsirhelelo leswi nga swa nkoka eka ku hluvukisa muganga wun’wana na wun’wana.

src: Imali lengenako leyakhiwe ngekutsatsa intsela itawuhlala ingiyo lengumtfombo locinisekisa kwekutsi hulumende angatfulela bantfu tnsita.
tgt: Ya ha tiyimisele eka ku vona leswaku vaakatiko va hlayisekile no titwa va hlayisekile eka tindhawu leti va tshamaka eka tona.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bonkhe bafundzi lebafuna kubhalela kuSikhwama Savelonkhe Sekusita Bafundzi Ngetimali (i-NSFAS) kute batfole lusito nga-2019 kantsi kubhalela nge-inthanethi kuvalwa ngamhla tinge-30 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa vabari eka ku va va yise tifomo ta vona ta xibalo ta lembe na lembe hi xihatla eka nguva ya xibalo ya 2017/18 leyi nga pfala hi siku ra 31 Nhlangula 2018.

src: Ngamhla lu- 01 Inyoni 2018, Ticelo tavulelwa bafundzi lebafanele nalabafuna kuchubeka netifundvo tabo nga-2019 bente sifundvo lesivumelekile kunoma ngabe nguyiphi iyunivesithi yahulumende noma emakolishi Etifundvo Tebuciko Bemisebenti Yetandla kanye Nekuceceshwa (ma-TVET) eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Mali ya tiko leyi hlengeletiweke hi swibalo yi tshama ya ha ri xihlovokulu xa timali lexi xi endlaka leswaku mfumo wu nyika vaakitiko vukorhokeri.

src: Bafundzi bayakhutsatwa kakhulu kutsi batfumele nge-inthanethi ticelo noma bavakashele lihhovisi Lesikhungo Savelonkhe Sekutfutfukiswa Kwelusha (i-NYDA) ngembi kwalolusuku lwekuvala.
tgt: Xikimi xa Mpfuneto wa Swichudeni hi swa Timali xa Rixaka (NSFAS).

src: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi IKhabhinethi ilivumele Luhlaka Lwemasu lekuvikela umnontfo waseNingizimu Afrika mhlaba wonkhe ngalokuphatselene nekuhwebelana, kusisa nekutfutfukisa.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vadyondzi hinkwavo lava lavaka ku endla swikombelo eka Xikimu xa Mpfuneto wa Swichudeni hi swa Timali xa Rixaka (NSFAS) ku kuma mpfuneto wa swa timali hi 2019 leswaku ku endliwa ka swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete swi pfala hi siku ra 30 Hukuri 2018.

src: Lelisu lihlose kucinisekisa kwekutsi tivumelwano nemave angaphandle tihambisana netinchubomgomo talelive njengekucedza buphuya, kuswelakala kwemsebenti nekungalingani.
tgt: Hi siku ra 01 Ndzati 2018, swikombelo swi pfuleriwile eka swichudeni leswi fikelelaka leswi navelaka ku yisa tidyondzo ta swona emahlweni hi 2019 eka khoso leyi pfumeleriweke eka yunivhesiti ya mani na mani kumbe kholichi ya Dyondzo na Vuleteri ya swa Vuthekiniki na Mitirho ya Mavoko (TVET) yihi kumbe yihi eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Luhlanganisa budlelwano bekuhwebelana nelutjalomali nemave lasatfutfukile lufunela lutjalomali langekhatsi, kundluliselwa kwemakhono netheknoloji kanye nekutfunyelwa kwemphahla ngaphandle leyenta inzuzo lenyenti.
tgt: Swichudeni swi hlohloteriwa swinene ku yisa swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete kumbe swi endzela senthara ya Ejensi ya Nhluvukiso wa Vantshwa ya Rixaka (NYDA) ku nga se fika siku ro pfala.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumele kukhushulwa kwemiholo wemalunga eKhomishini Yemalungelo Eluntfu yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAHRC).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Rimba ra Maqhinga ro landzelerisiwa ka mitsakelo ya ikhonomi ya xiqhinga ematikweni ya misava ra Afrika-Dzonga tanihiloko ri fambelana na mabindzu, vuvekisi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme.

src: NgekweMtsetfo Wekhomishini Yemalungelo Eluntfu yaseNingizimu Afrika, wanga-2013, nguMengameli loneligunya, ngembi kwekukhulumisana neKhabhinethi neNdvuna Yetetimali, lekukhuphula imiholo, tinzuzo kanye naleminye imigomo nemibandzela yemsebenti.
tgt: Qhinga leri ri seketela leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi landzelerisa ku hlanganisiwa ka nhluvuko eAfrika hinkwayo loku seketeriwaka hi vuvekisi lebyi rhangeriweke hi qhinga no aka vuxaka bya xiqhinga ku yisa ajenda ya yona emahlweni.

src: Sihlalo waleKhomishini ubambisane naMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa kanye nalomlingani wakhe waseSweden Stefan Löfven.
tgt: Nawu wa Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga wa 2013 wu vula leswaku muholo, mali ya swipfuno na swipimelo swa le ntirhweni swin’wana swi fanele swi bohiwa hi Phuresidente hi ku tirhisana na Khabinete na Holobye wa swa Timali.

src: Lomsebenti waleKhomishini Yamhlabawonkhe uhambisana naloku hulumende lagcile kuko lekukwakha ematfuba emsebenti lokahle nalosimeme, nemitamo yekucinisekisa kwekutsi bantfu labasha baseNingizimu Afrika banemakhono ladzingekako kute kutsi bakhone kuphila kulemisebenti lenetingucuko.
tgt: Khomixini yi fambisiwa xikan’we hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa na ntangha ya yena hi ntirho Stefan Lofven wa le Sweden.

src: I-China International Import Export (i-CIIE)IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela lokungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika njengelive lelimenyiwe ngalokuhloniphekile kulomcimbi wekukhangisa, i-China International Import Export (i-CIIE) lebanjelwe eShanghai.
tgt: Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava ya Levhele ya le Henhla, leyi tumbuluxiweke hi ILO hi 2017, yi nyikiwe ntirho wo kambela ku cinca ka xihatla emitirhweni, ku kuma mitlhontlho ya nkoka na leswi swi faneleke ku endliwa ku endla vumundzuku bya ntirho byi va lebyinene no antswa.

src: Ndvuna Yetekuhwebelana Netimboni Rob Davis, uhola litsimba letinhlangano leti-27 taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ntirho wa Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava wu fambelanisa nkongomiso wa mfumo eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho ya kahle no va kona nkarhi wo leha na matshalatshala yo vona leswaku vantshwa va MaAfrika-Dzonga va na swikili leswi faneleke ku endlela ku humelela emitirhweni leyi cincacincaka.

src: Lelitsimba lisekelwe ngetimali Litiko Lekuhwebelana Netimboni ngekusebentisa i-Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (i-EMIA) Scheme.
tgt: Nkombiso wa swixaviwa leswi humaka ematikweni ya misava wa le China (CIIE)Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga tanihi tiko leri nga muyeni wo xiximeka eka Nkombiso wa Swixaviwa leswi Humaka Ematikweni Mambe wa Matiko ya Misava wa le China (CIIE) eShanghai.

src: Kungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika kwente kwekutsi lelive likhone kukhangisa ngemakhono alo ekuhwebelana nekusisa kantsi siphokophelele phambili kubona bakhangisi labavela kumikhakha, kufaka ekhatsi bekugaywa kwalokulinyiwe, ticatfula nesikhumba, tebunjiniyela, emakhemikhali aphethiloli, tetetitimela, tekuvikela, kanye netheknoloji yelwati lwetekuchumana, nekutsi babuye ekhaya neticelo tekutsenga.
tgt: Holobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Rob Davies, u rhangela vurhumiwa bya mihlangano ya 27 ya le Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Liviki Lavelonkhe Lekugcila Kutimbizo Lamaviki lamabili latako ekusebenta kwahulumende atawube akhombisa Liviki Lavelonkhe le-9 Lekugcila Kutimbizo, leholwa beLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Nelwatiso (i-GCIS).
tgt: Vurhumiwa byi pfuniwa hi swa timali hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi ku tirhisa Xikimi xa Vumaketi bya Swixavisela-vambe na Mpfuneto wa swa Vuvekisi (EMIA).Ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga ku pfuneta tiko hi ndlela yo antswa ku tlakusa vuswikoti bya rona eka swa bindzu na vuvekisi, naswona hi langutele vakombisi lava nga ta nghenelela vo huma eka tisekitara leti katsaka ku phurosesiwa ka swa vurimi, tintangu na dzovo, vuinjiniyere, tikhemikali to endla petirolo, swiphemu swa switimela, swa vusirheleri xikan’we na thekinoloji ya swa vuxokoxoko na vuhlanganisi laha va nga vuya ekaya tioda to xava.

src: Emalunga Esigungu Lesiphakeme kanye nebaholi betifundza nabomasipala batawubamba imihlangano kanye neTimbizo nemmango eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Eka mhaka ya Nkombiso, Afrika-Dzonga yi rhurhele nhlengeletano ya swa vuvekisi leyi a yi kongomise eka swivandlanene leswi nga kona eka sekitara ya swa vuendli.

src: Luhlelo lwamhla ti-12 kuya mhla ti-25 Lweti 2018 lutawufakwa ku-www.
tgt: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa ImbizoMavhiki mambirhi lama nga ta landzela ya ku gingirika ka mfumo ma ta fungha Vhiki ra Nkongomisa wa Imbizo ya Rixaka ya vu9, leyi kondleteriwaka hi Sisiteme ya swa Vuhlanganisi na Mahungu ya Mfumo (GCIS).

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi basebentise lesikhatsi kutsi bacocisane nalabaphetse ngetindzaba letiphatselene nekwetfulwa kwetinsita kucinisekisa kwekutsi kuyasetjentiswana ekutfutfukiseni imimmango yetfu.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga va hlohloteriwa ku tirhisa pulatifomo leyi ku kanerisana na varhangeri hi mayelana na timhaka leti khumbaka ku nyikiwa ka vukorhokeri ku vona leswaku ha tirhisana eka ku hluvukisa miganga ya ka hina.

src: Tililo.
tgt: Michavelelo.

src: IKhabhinethi yendlulisa kukhala kwayo kulemindeni netihlobo talabo bonkhe labo labashonile ngalesikhatsi kunemililo lecubuke ku-Garden Route netindzawo letisedvute nayo, kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela eka mindyangu na varhandziwa va vanhu hinkwavo lava nga hundza emisaveni hi nkarhi wa nandzelelano wa mindzilo eka Garden Route na tindhawu leti nga ekusuhi xikan’we na le Kapa-Vuxa.

src: Lomlilo ubulele Nico Heyns, lebekangumshayeli wendiza yaka-“Working on Fire”.
tgt: Ndzilo wu koxe vutomi bya Nico Heyns loyi a ri muhahisi wa xihahampfhukaphatsa wa “Working on Fire”.

src: Kantsi ugcine ubangela kushona kwebantfu labayimfica nekulahlekelwa tindzawo tekuhlala kwebantfu labalinganiselwwa ku-2000.
tgt: Leswi swi tlhele swi vanga rifu ra vanhu va kaye van’wana na ku rhurhisiwa ka kwalomu ka 2000 wa vona.

src: Tindlu letimbalwa netindzawo letinkhulu letingemadlelo nato talimala.
tgt: Tindlu to hlaya na tindhawu letikulukumba ta swimila na tona ti tshwile.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga lokuphendvula ngekushesha kwalabasebenti labacima umlilo netisebenti letisebenta ngetinhlekelele, kanye nebeMbutfo Wetekuvikela Wasemoyeni waseNingizimu Afrika ne-“Working on Fire” labasebente ngekungakhatsali ekuhlengeni timphilo nekulawula lomlilo.
tgt: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela ku tekiwa goza ra xihatla ka vatimeri va ndzilo na vatirhi van’wana vo lawula timhangu hi ku tirhisana na Masocha ya le Moyeni ya Afrika-Dzonga na “Working on Fire” lava tirheke hi nkhinkhi ku ponisa vutomi bya vanhu no lawula ndzilo.

src: IKhabhinethi indlulisa kukhala kwayo kuhulumende nebantfu base-Indonesia kulandzela lokuwa kwendiza lebulele bantfu laba-189 ngemuva kwekusuka edolobheni lelikhulu lase-Indonesia, iJakarta.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela eka mfumo na vanhu va le Indonesia endzhaku ka ku wa ka xihahampfhuka lexi xi koxeke vutomi bya vanhu va 189 endzhaku ko va xi suke entsindza wa Indonesia, Jakarta.

src: Kuhalalisa.
tgt: Vuhoyozeri.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iNingizimu Afrika ngekukhetfwa nangekusekelwa ngalokuvakalako kutsi isebente eNhlanganweni Yetakhiwonchanti Tekuchumana Mhlabawonkhe (i-ITU) ngeMsombuluko, ngamhla ti-05 Lweti 2018 ngalesikhatsi se-Plenipotentiary Conference ye-ITU eDubai.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela ku hlawuriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga hi nseketelo lowukulu ku tirha eka Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tiqingho ya Matiko ya Misava (ITU) hi Musumbunuku, 05 Hukuri 2018 eka Khomferense ya Vayimelatiko ya ITU eDubai.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela MnuMandla Mchunu weMtimba Lotimele Wetekuchumana WaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Icasa) lokhetfwe kutsi asebente kuBhodi leLawula Imisakato ye-ITU kanye naMake Doreen Bogdan-Martin ngekukhetfwa kwakhe kutsi abe nguMcondzisi weLuphiko Lekutfutfukisa Takhiwonchanti Tekuchumana, kantsi njengamake wekucala ekubeni yincenye yebaphatsi labakhulu be-ITU kusukela yasungulwa nga-1865.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Nkulukumba Mandla Mchunu wa Vulawuri bya Vuhlanganisi lebyi Tiyimelaka bya Afrika-Dzonga (Icasa) loyi a hlawuriweke ku tirha eka Bodo ya Swinawana swa Rhadiyo eka ITU xikan’we na Manana Doreen Bogdan-Martin eka ku hlawuriwa ka yena tanihi Mufambisi wa Byuro ya Nhluvukiso wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho no va waxisati wo sungula ku va xiphemu xa vufambisinkulu bya ITU k sukela loko yi tumbuluxiwile hi 1865.Afrika-Dzonga ya tinyungubyisa hi ku tshemba loku yi nyikiwaka kona hi matiko man’wana ku tirha eka mihlangano ya le henhla ya ITU eka malembe ya mune lama landzelaka.

src: INingizimu Afrika iyatitfoba ngalokutitsemba lokubekwe ngulalamanye emave kutsi basebente kuletikhundla letinkhulu kuleminyaka lemine lelandzelako.
tgt: Hi ta tirhisa swiyimo leswi ku yisa ajenda ya hina ya nhluvukiso na ku va na rixaka leri pfulekeke mahlo leri katsaka vanhu hinkwavo eka nkarhi wa xidjitali.

src: Sitawusebentisa letikhundla kuchubekisa loluhlelo lwekutfutfukisa nekuba nemmango lofaka ekhatsi kuniketwa kwelwatiso kulesikhatsi setheknoloji yesimanje.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Rhiphabuliki yXidemokirasi xa Federali ya Ethiopia eka ku va yi hlawule phuresidente wa wansati wo sungula, Muchaviseki Sahle-Work Zewde loyi sweswi a nga phuresidente wa wansati a ri yexe eka tikokulu ra Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ibuye yabongela iFederal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia ngekukhetsa mengameli wabo wekucala longumake, Umhlonishwa Sahle-Work Zewde, lekunguye kuphela mengameli longumake e-Afrika.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisisa vuxaka bya yona bya matiko lamambirhi na Ethiopia eka swiyenge swo hambana leswi katsaka vuxaka bya swa mabindzu, swa tipolitiki na swa ikhonomi.

src: INingizimu Afrika itawuchubeka kucinisa budlelwano lobusemkhatsini ne-Ethiopia etindzaweni letihlukene letifaka ekhatsi kuhwebelana, ipoltiki netemnotfo.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku hoyozela ka yona eka Phuresidente wa Cameroon, Paul Biya, loyi a nga vekiwa ximfumo eka nkarhi wo tirha ra vunkombo.

src: IKhabhinethi itfumela tilokotfo tekuhalalisa kuMengameli waseCameroon Paul Biya, lofungiswe sikhatsi sesikhombisa asehhovisi.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo va le Cameroon ku tirhisana leswaku va ta fikelela xitshunxo lexi nga na ku rhula hi ku tirhisa phurosese yo vulavurisana leyi katsaka vanhu hinkwavo.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseCameroon kutsi basebentisane kute babe nekuthula ngekutsi bacocisane.
tgt: Khabinete yi langutele ku tiyisisa vuxaka bya matiko lamambirhi bya swa tipolitiki, swa ikhonomi na swa mabindzu exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Cameroon.

src: IKhabhinethi ibuke phambili kulokujula kwetingcogco tepolitiki, temnotfo nekuhwebelana emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neCameroon.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela vanhu va Brazil eka ku va va ve na nhlawulo lowu nga na ku humelela lowu nga endla muyimelakulangwa wa Phuresidente ya Federative Republic of Brazil, H. Jair Bolsonaro a va Phuresidente wa Brazil loyi a landzelaka.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bantfu baseBrazil ngekubamba lukhetfo lolube yimphumelelo lolwente kukhetfwe mengameli longekabekwa waseFederative Republic of Brazil, Umhlonishwa Jair Bolsonaro njengaMengameli lolandzelako eBrazil.
tgt: Khabinete yi navelela miganga va Mahindu hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga leyi tlangelaka Diwali kumbe Deepavali.

src: IKhabhinethi indlulisa tilokotfo letihle kuyo yonkhe imiphakatsi yema-Hindu leseNingizimu Afrika lebungata i-Diwali noma i-Deepavali.
tgt: Lexi i xiendleko xa vukhongeri lexi xi tlangelaka ku hlula ka vunene eka vubihi, vutivi na vutlhari eka nkalavutivi xikan’we na ku hlula ka ku vonakala eka munyama.

src: Lona ngumcimbi wetenkholo lobungata kuncoba ngalokuhle etintfweni letimbi, lwati nekuhlakanipha kunekunganaki kanye nekuncoba kwekukhanya ngekumelana nebumnyama.
tgt: Ku vonakala ko kwetsima a ku katekise Afrika-Dzonga hi ku rhula, ntsako, ku humelela na ku hetiseka loko hi endla ntirho wa hina wo tiyisisa ku hanyisana na vun’we eka ku hambana ka tiko ra ka hina hi swa mfuwo na vukhongeri.

src: Ake lokukhanya lokungcwele kwaMvelanchanti kubusise iNingizimu Afrika ngekuthula, imphumelelo, injabulo, imphumelelo nekufezeka, ngalesikhatsi sonkhe sidlala indzima yetfu yekwakha kuthula nebunye eveni letfu lelinetinkholo nemasiko lahlukahlukene.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ta fanela ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: Kucaashwa kabusha kwaMake Nomfundo Maseti Njengelilunga leligcwele Lekulawula, lotawube asebenta ku-Piped-Gas regulation, kutsi asebente kuBhodi yaka-NERSLabantfu labalandzelako bacashiwe kumkhandlu we-Built Environment:a.
