src: IKhabhinethi yamukela lokuvulwa ngemphumelelo kweNgcungcutsela yeLutjalomali e-Afrika lebanjwe kusukela mhla ti-7 kuya ku-9 ngenyanga yeLweti 2018 eSandton Convention Centre eGauteng.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Foramu ya Vuvekisi ya Afrika leyi simekiweke yi famba kahle leyi khomiweke kusuka hi siku ra 7 kufika 9 Hukuri 2018 eSandton Convention Centre eGauteng.

src: Bohulumende base-Afrika nemabhizinisi, tikhungo tetetimali mhlabawonkhe nalabanye balingani betentfutfuko bagcile ekwenteni i-Afrika ibe ngumgcele lolandzelako emhlabeni wonkhe kutelutjalomali.
tgt: Mifumo ya Afrika na mabindzu, mihlangano ya swa timali ya matiko ya misava na vatirhisani va nhluvukiso van'wana va kongomise eka ku endla Afrika yi va rirhangu ra matiko ya misava leri landzelaka eka vuvekisi.

src: Nakuvalwa lenkhomfa kube netivumelwano letinge-45, letibita US$32 wetigidzigidzi, lekuvunyelwene ngato kute kuzuze lelivekati lonkhe.
tgt: Eku pfaleni ka khomferense 45 wa mitwanano, leyi nga na nkoka wa US$32 wa tibiliyoni, ku ngheniwile eka yona ku vuyerisa tikokulu.

src: Kuloko, iNingizimu Afrika itawuzuza kusukela kutigidzi leti US$6.8 kulutjalomali.
tgt: Eka sweswo, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta vuyeriwa kusuka eka US$6.8 wa tibiliyoni eka vuvekisi.

src: Ingcungcutsela yeMhlabuhlangene (i-AU) IKhabhinethi ikhutsatwe tingcogco letentiwe kulengcungcutsela ye-AU lebanjelwe e-Addis Ababa, kulase-Ethiopia ngamhla ti-17 ne-18 Lweti 2018, lapho Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bekangenelele.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaziwa hi mikanerisano eka Samiti ya AU leyi khomeriweke eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi siku ra 17 na 18 Hukuri 2018, laha Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa a tekeke xiave.

src: Lengcungcutsela Lesezingeni Leliphakeme idzingidze lenchubo lechubekako yekwakha kabusha i-AU lehlose kusungula indlela lesebentako, lehlelekile nalenemandla lamasha letawukhona kubeka phambilli tidzingo talelivekati netinjongo letibekiwe ku-Ajenda 2063, lekuluhlaka lwemasu lwekutfutfukisa umnotfo welivekati lase-Afrika kuleminyaka lenge-50 letako.
tgt: Nhlengeletano leyo ka yi nga Tolovelakangi eka tiphurosese ta mpfuxeto leti yaka emahlweni leti a ti kunguhateriwile ku tumbuluxa AU leyi tirhaka kahle, leyi nga tlangisiki swipfuno na ku va leyi nyikiweke matimba hi vuntshwa leyi kotaka ku fikelela swirhangana swa tikokulu na swikongomelokulu leswi hlamuseriweke eka Ajenda 2063, leswi swi nga rimba ra maqhinga eka ncinco wa vaaki na ikhonomi wa Afrika eka 50 wa malembe lama taka.

src: Lokutfutfukiswa kwe-AU kuyinchubo lechubekako, naletinye tinchubo tayo setivele tentiwe, ikakhulukati letiphatselene nalokutinikela ekubeni emave angemalunga e-AU kube ngiwo asita lenhlangano ngemali.
tgt: Mpfuxeto wa AU i phurosese leyi yaka emahlweni, laha swin'wana swa swibumabumelo swa yona se swi tirhisiweke, ngopfungopfu hi ku fambelana na vutiboheleri bya ku va na mifumo leyi nga swirho swa AU yi byarha vun'wini lebyikulu bya ku nyika timali eka nhlangano lowu.

src: Emave lamanye ayachubeka nekusayina leSivumelwano Sekuhwebelana Kwemave ase-Afrika Mahhala kucinisekisa kutsi lelivekati liyasisebentisa lesivumelwano sekuhwebelana kwemave ase-Afrika mahhala.
tgt: Matiko yo tala ya ya emahlweni ya sayina Ntwanano wa Mabindzu ya Nkaswipimelo ya Tikokulu ra Afrika ku tiyisisa leswaku Tikokulu ri humelerisa ntwanano wa mabindzu ya nkaswipimelo ya tikokulu hinkwaro.

src: Budlelwano Lobunemasu nemave eLubumbano lwase-Europe (i-EU).
tgt: Vutirhisani bya Xiqhinga na Yniyoni ya Yuropa (EU).

src: IKhabhinethi iyatfokota ngalemiphumela lemihle yaleNgcungcutsela yesi-7 ye-EU neNingizimu Afrika lebeyibanjwe ngamhla ti-15 Lweti eBelgium.
tgt: Khabinete ya tsaka hi mbuyelo lowunene wa Samiti ya Afrika-Dzonga – EU ya vu7 leyi khomiweke hi siku ra 15 Hukuri eBelgiu.

src: Lemiphumela netetsembiso letentiwe kulengcungcutsela kwakhiwe lokukhutsala kwetfu lokungenhla kwekubeka kukhula kwemnotfo nekwakhiwa kwematfuba emsebenti enkhabeni yeluhlelo lwavelonkhe lwaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: m Mivuyelo na vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke eka samiti ku aka ehenhla ka pfhumba leri nga si tshama ri vakona ku veka ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho exikarhi ka ajenda ya rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: INingizimu Afrika ngilo kuphela live lase-Afrika nalinye lalamave lali-10 mhlabawonkhe laneBudlelwne Lobunemasu kanye ne-EI-EU ingumlingani lomkhulu kunabo bonkhe le iNingizimu Afrika ihwebelana naye nemtjalimali wangaphandle lomkhulukati njengemlingani, imelele 73.7% yesitoko Selutjalomali Lemave Angaphandle kulelive.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga i tiko ra Afrika ri ri roxe naswona hi rin'wana ra matiko ya 10 emisaveni hinkwayo leri nga na Xinakulobye xa Xiqhinga na EEU i mutirhisani wo bindzurisa lonkulu wa Afrika-Dzonga naswona i muvekisi wa matiko mambe lonkulu tanihi biloko, leyi yimelaka 73.7% ta switoko hikwaswo swa Vuvekisi byo Kongoma bya Matiko Mambe etikweni.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa kuleliviki bekavakashelwe nguMengameli waseFederal Republic of Germany, MnuFrank-Walter Steinmeier, ngesikhatsi Avakashele eNingizimu Afrika ngekweMbuso, njengoba kunetinkapani taseGermany letingetulu kwe-600 letinemabhizinisi noma letinetikhungo tekukhicita kulelive, letidale imisebenti lelinganiselwa ku-100 000.
tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa vhiki reri u rhurhele Phuresidente xa Rhiphabuliki ya Xifederali ya Jarimani, Ttn Frank-Walter Steinmeier, eka Vuendzeri bya Mfumo eka Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Lokuvakasha ngekweMbuso kubangele kutsi kusayinwe tivumelwano tekuhwebelna nekutjala imali emkhatsini walamave lamabili, kwaniketa nalabaholi lababili kutsi bacocisane ngetindzaba letibatsintsa bobabili nekusebentisana ngalokusondzelene njengemalunga langakagcwali Esigungu Setekuvikela Kumhlabubuhlangene (i-UN) sikhatsi lesineminyaka lemibili kusukela nga-2019 kuya ku-2020.
tgt: Jarimani hi yin'wana ya vavekisi va matiko mambe lavakulu eAfrika-Dzonga, leyi nga na kutlula 6000 wa tikhamphani ta Jarimani leti nga na marhavu kumbe vuhumesi etikweni, yi hlayisa kwalomu ka 100 000 wa mitirho.

src: IKhabhinethi inake kwekutsi Ikomidinhlanganisela Yekubuyeketwa kweMtsetfosisekelo yasePhalamende ivume umbiko wayo lohambisana nekuchitjiyelwa kweSigaba 25 seMtsetfosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wanga-1996.
tgt: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Komiti ya Nkambisiso wa Vumbiwa ya Nhlanganelo ya Palamende yi amukele xiviko xa yona lexi xi seketelaka ku hundzuluxiwa ka Xiyenge xa 25 xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.

src: Lokuchibiyela kutawenta kutsi umbuso ukhone kwaba umhlaba ngaphandle kwesincepheteliso ngekwetinshisekelo temmango.
tgt: Hundzuluxo lowu wu ta endla swi koteka eka Mfumo ku teka vun'wini bya misava ku ri hava ndziriso ku vuyerisa vaaki.

src: Lombiko walekomidi ulindzeleke kutsi udzingidvwe Libandla Lavelonkhe kute kucociswane ngawo.
tgt: Xiviko xa komiti xi languteriwa ku andlariwa eka Huvo ya Rixaka eka njhekajekisano.

src: Inchubo yekuva timvo tebantfu yenta kutsi tinhlangano letihlukene tiletse tetfulo ngaloMtsetfosivivinyo kantsi kulalelwa kwetimvo tebantfu kwabanjelwa kuto tonkhe tifundza.
tgt: Phurosese yo tinhlanganisa na vaaki yi endle mihlangano yo tala yi rhumela swibumabumelo eka Nawumbisi lowu naswona tinhlengeletano to twa miehleketo ya vaaki ti khomiwile eka swifundzakulu swa hinkwaswo.

src: Umtsetfosisekelo sewuke wachitjiyelwa emahlandla la-17 ngekusebentisa inchubo yekutsintsana nekufaka ekhatsi bonkhe bantfu.
tgt: Vumbiwa kufika sweswi ri hundzuluxiwile ka 17 hi phurosese yo tihlanganisa na ku katsa vanhu hinkwavo.

src: Hulumende utawuhlala atinikele kuluhlelo lwekulungiswa kahle kwemhlaba lokunetinshisekelo tabo bonkhe bantfu.
tgt: Mfumo wu tshama wa ha tibohe eka endlelo ra mpfuxeto wa misava lowu nga na vutihlamuleri leri nga ta vuyerisa munhu un'wana na un'wana.

src: IKhabhinethi iyacinisekisa kwekutsi hulumende uyawuhlonipha umtsetfo kantsi, ngaso sonkhe sikatsi, batawenta ngekuhambisana neMtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiyisisa leswaku mfumo wu xixima mfumo wa nawu naswona, hi mikarhi hinkwayo, wu ta endla hi ku fambisana na Vumbiwa.

src: Sincumo Senkhantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.

src: IKhabhinethi yamukela lesincumo seNkhantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo lencume kwekutsi Umtsetfo Wekutfutfukiswa Kwetimbiwa nePetroliyamu, wanga-2002 (Umtsetfo 28 wanga-2002) lobusa lokuniketwa kwemalungelo ekumba, kufanele ufundvwe ngekuhambisana Nemtsetfo Wekuvikela Emalungelo Emhlaba Langabhalisiwe, wanga-1996 (Umtsetfo 31 wanga-1996), lovikela emalungelo emhlaba lasengcupheni.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa leyi boheke leswaku Nawu wa Swicelwa na Nhluvukiso wa Swipfuno swa Oyilimbisi, 2020 (Nawu wa 28 wa 2002) lowu wu fumaka ku nyikiwa ka timfanelo ta vucelamigodi, wu fanele ku hlayiwa swin'we na Nawu wa Nsirhelelo wa Timfanelo ta Misava leti nga riki ta Ximfumo, 1996 (Nawu wa 31 wa 1996), lowu wu sirhelelaka timfanelo ta misava leti nga sirhelelekangiki.

src: Lokuncoba kwemmango waseLesetlheng eNyakatfo Nshonalanga kukhombisa sicalo sekunakwa kwemalungelo emhlaba lapho khona bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika lebebacindzetelwe bancishwe lamalungelo sikhatsi lesidze.
tgt: Vuhluri bya muganga wa Lesetlheng eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu wu komba masungulo ya timfanelo ta misava leti vanhu lava a va tshikeleriwile emikarhini leyi nga hundza va Afrika-Dzonga a va pfumatiwile tona eka tinxaka to hlaya.

src: Lapho khona kumba timbiwa kutsikameta indzawo yekuhlala, imindeni nemimmango, bantfu labatsintseka ngco ngenca yekumba timbiwa kufanele banikete imvume kunoma ngutiphi tingucuko letitsintsa umhlaba wabo.
tgt: Laha vucelamigodi byi hlohlotela eka matshamelo, mindyangu na miganga, vanhu lava khumbekaka hi ku kongoma hi vucelamigodi va fanele ku pfumela ku cinca kwihi kumbe kwihi loku khumbaka timfanelo ta vona ta misava.

src: Imiphumela yekuhlolwa kwemabhuku IKhabhinethi yamukela futsi ihalalisela ematiko netikhungo tahulumende letichubeka ngalokungagucuki ngekutfola imiphumela lehlobile yekuhlolwa kwemabhuku.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela na ku hoyozela tindzawulo na mavandla ya mfumo lama yaka emahlweni hindlela yo fanana ya ku kuma mivuyelo ya oditi yo basa.

src: Loku kuvele ngemuva kwekukhishwa kweMbiko Wekuhlolwa Kwemabhuku Etimali Tahulumende wemnyakatimali wanga-2017/18 nguMhlolimabhuku Jikelele (i-AG) Kimi Makwetu.
tgt: Leswi swi ta endzhaku ka ku humesiwa hi Oditara-Jenerala (AG) Kimi Makwetu ka Xiviko xa Oditi ya Malawulelo ya Timali ta Mfumo xa lembeximali ra 2017/18.

src: IKhabhinethi noma kunjalo ikhatsatekile ngalombiko lokhombisa kwehla kwesibalo sematiko ahulumende wavelonkhe newetifundza netikhungo tawo atfole imiphumela lehlobile yekuhlolwa kwemabhuku.
tgt: Hambisiwiritano Khabinete yi vilerisiwa hi xiviko lexi xi kombaka ku ya ehansi ko angarhela eka mivuyelo ya oditi ya tindzawulo tin'wana ta mfumo wa rixaka na wa swifundzakulu na mavandla ya tona.

src: Lokusayinwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Wekuhlolwa Kwemabhuku Ahulumende, ube ngumtsetfo nguMengameli Ramaphosa, kutawucinisa lomsebenti waleliHhovisi la-AG, utawusita ekutseni ubambise umtsetfo labo labachubeka nekunganaki tindlela letifanelekile tekuphatsa.
tgt: Ku sayiniwa ku va nawu ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Oditi ya Mfumo hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa, leswi swi nga ta tiyisa ntirho wa Hofisi ya AG, swi ta pfuna ku endla va tihlamulela lava va yaka emahlweni na ku tsan'wa rimba ra mfumo.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata onkhe ematiko netikhungo tahulumende kutsi basebentele kutfola tindlela tekulungisa kuto tonkhe letinkhinga letivetwe ngu-AG nekutsi babuke inchubekela phambili njalo kute balungise tinkhinga ngembi kwekutsi kufike sikhatsi lesilandzelako sekuhlola mabhuku.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza tindzawulo na mavandla hinkwawo ku tirha hi miphalalo yo lulamisa eka swiphiqo hinkwaswo leswi funghiweke hi AG na ku veka ndzima tihlo nkarhi na nkarhi ku tirhana na swiphiqo ku nga si fika ndzhendzeleko wa oditi ya nkarhi lowu taka.

src: Kuphepha Nekuvikeleka.
tgt: Vuhlayiseki na Nsirhelelo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela kusekelwa kuloMkankaso waVelonkhe wekuPhepha ngaleSikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi lowetfulwe nguNdvuna Wetemaphoyisa Bheki Cele ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi “Operation Quiet Storm”.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiboha ku seketela Pfhumba ra Nguva ya Makhisimusi yo Hlayiseka ya Rixaka leyi simekiweke hi Holobye wa Maphorisa Bheki Cele ehansi ka nkongomelo wa “Operation Quiet Storm”.

src: Lomkhankaso uhlose kwenta iNingizimu Afrika ibe yindzawo lephephile njengoba sicondze esikhatsini semaholide ekuphela kwemnyaka.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ri kongomisa eka ku endla Afrika-Dzonga yi va ndhawu yo hlayiseka tanihiloko hi tshinelela nguva ya tiholideyi ta ku hela ka lembe.

src: Luphiko LeMbutho Wemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) litawenta umsebenti velonkhe kulelo nalelo dolobha, emakhaya nasemadolobheni kudzimate kube kusekupheleni kwaBhimbhidvwane 2019.
tgt: Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa bya Afrika-Dzonga byi ta endla mitirho etikweni hinkwaro edorobeni rin'wana na rin'wana, emugangeni na le lokixini kufikela ku hela ka Sunguti 2019.

src: Batawugcila ekuniketeni tinsita temaphoyisa letibonakalako, ngalesikhatsi batisa ngebugebengu lobukhetsekile nekuvikela lokwentiwako.
tgt: Va ta kongomisa eka maphorisa lama vonakalaka, loko ku ri karhi ku endliwa mitirho ya vulemukisi na nsivelo wa vugevenga byo hlawuleka.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke basebentisane nemaphoyisa ekugcineni imimmango yetfu iphephile.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo eAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va tirhisana na maphorisa eka ku endla miganga yi tshama yi hlayisekile.

src: Batali nebagcini bebantfwana bayacwayiswa kutsi banake ngalokundlulele nabanakekela bantfwana babo ngalesikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi.
tgt: Vatswari na vahlayisi va xinawu na vona va tsundzuxiwa ku va xa xalamuka swinene eka ku hlayisa vana va vona hi nkarhi wa nguva ya makhisimusi leyi nga eku teni.

src: IKhabhinethi ibuye yacela kusekelwa kulomkhankaso Wekuphepha Emgwacweni Ngalesikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi nga-2018, lesungulwe nguNdvuna weTekutfutsa, Dkt Blade Nzimande, eLimpopo ngemphelasontfo.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete ya tiboha ku seketela pfhumba ra Vuhlayiseki bya le Magondzweni bya Nguva ya Makhisimusi, leri simekiweke hi Holobye wa Vutleketli, Dkd Blade Nzimande, eLimpopo hi ku hela ka vhiki.

src: Lokusungulwa kushayisane naleNgcungcutsela Yekuphepha Emgwacweni leyenteka njalo ngemnyaka emalanga lamabili neLilanga le-UN Lamhlabawonkhe Lekukhumbula labo labashonele etingotini temgwaco.
tgt: Nsimeko lowu wu kotlana na Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya le Magondzweni ya masiku mambirhi ya lembe na lembe na Siku ra ku Tsundzuka ra Misava ra UN ra lava weriweke hi khombo ra mitlumbano ya le magondzweni.

src: Kubalulekile kutsi sonkhe lesiphilako sidlale indzima ekucinisekiseni sikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi lesiphephile ngekushayela ngekucophelela nekuhlonipha imitsetfo yemgwaco.
tgt: Swi ta vuyerisa ku hanya kahle ka hina leswaku hinkwerhu hi tirha xiphemu eka ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na nguva ya makhisimusi leyi hlayisekeke hi ku chayela hindlela ya vutihlamuleri na ku landzelela milawu ya gondzo.

src: IMaputo-Catembe Bridge yakhiwe be-China Road and Bridge Corporation kantsi ihlanganisa iMaputo eMozambique neKwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe.

src: Mengameli waseMozambique, MnuFilipe Nyusi, uvule lelibhuloho lelingemkhilomitha lamatsatfu budze iMaputo-Catembe Bridge, lelakhiwa iminyaka lendlula kulemine ngetigidzi letilinganiselwa ku-US$785.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela vainjhiniyara va Afrika-Dzonga lava khumbekeke eka nhluvukiso lowu nga wa nkoka eka matimu wa biloho ro cinkinya ro leha kutlula hinkwawo eAfrika.

src: Lelibhuloho litawenta kutsi kube nekuhwebelana nekuvakashelana emkhatsini weMozambique neNingzimu Afrika kantsi sikhatsi sekuhamba kusuka eMaputo uye eKosi Bay KwaZulu-Natal emgceleni wase-East Coast sehlile kakhulu kusuka kumahora lasitfupha kuya kumizuzu lenge-90.
tgt: Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe ri akiwile hi Khamphanikulu ya Magondzo na Mabiloho ya Chayina naswona ri khomanisa Maputo eMozambique na KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Liviki Lekwatisa ngeLuhlelo Lwekusebenta.
tgt: Nongonoko wa Vhiki ro Nyika Vuxokoxoko bya Matirhelo.

src: IKhabhinethi itjeliwe ngalenchubekela phambili ngalemibiko yalemiphumela lebalulekile ngalesikhatsi kusukela ngamhla lu-1 iNkhwekhweti 2018 kuya mhla ti-30 Inyoni 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyike vuxokoxoko eka swiviko swa tindzima eka mivuyelo ya swirhangana eka nkarhi lowu sungulaka hi 1 Dzivamisoko 2018 kufika hi 30 Ndzati 2018.

src: Ematiko lasebenta ngemaklasta kute asebentise lemiphumela leli-14 lebalulekile kute bachubeke nekutfola imiphumela yalabakwentako.
tgt: Tindzawulo leti tirhaka exikarhi ka swikatsa leswi ku simeka 14 wa mivuyelo leya swirhangana ti ya emahlweni ti fikelela swiphakeriwa swa tona vini.

src: Lemiphumela ivela kuloLuhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini yanga-2014 - 2019 kuMbono wanga-2030 Weluhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP).
tgt: Mivuyelo leyi yi huma eka Rimba ra Maqhinga ra le Xikarhi ka Theme na kusuka eka Xivono xa 2030 xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume letinyatselo letidzingekako tekubuketana naletinkhinga letitsikameta kucala kusebenta.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xa goza leri lavekaka ku tirhana na mitlhontlho leyi khumbaka nsimeko.

src: Imibiko ishicilelwe kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letekucaphela Nekulinganisa Kusebenta Kwahulumende (i-DPME) letsi: WEBTOKEN Luhlelo Lwekutfutukisa Nekukhicitwa Kwetitfutsi (i-APDP).
tgt: Swiviko leswi swi kandziyisiwle eka webusayiti ya DPME (WEBTOKEN).

src: IKhabhinethi ivumele kukhuliswa kwe-APDP kusukela nga-2021 kuya ku-2035 ngetichibiyelo kute kusekelwe Loluhlelo Lolukhulu Lwetitfutsi eNingizimu Afrika (i-SAAM).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku engeteriwa ka APDP kusuka hi 2021 kufika hi 2035 hi mihundzuluxo ku seketela Kungukulu ra Swipandzamananga ra Afrika-Dzonga (SAAM).

src: I-SAAM igcile etindzaweni letisitfupha: Kukhulisa Mkakha Wetimoto Wasekhaya Kutfutfukisa Imboni Yetimoto Yesigodzi Kutsenga tingcenye tetimoto lapha eNingizimu Afrika Kutfutfukisa tinsitanchanti Kwenta kancono timboni, kanye Nekutfutfukisa iTheknoloji nemakhono lahambisanako.
tgt: SAAM yi kongomisa eka swiyenge swa tsevu: Ku tirhisiwa hindlela leyi vuyerisaka makete wa le tikweni Nhluvukiso wa makete wa Xifundza Nhluvukiso wa swimakiwakulu ncinco wa vumaki, na nhluvukiso wa thekinoloji na swikili leswi fambelanaka.

src: Lokuchibiyela kuhlose kulokunye kukhutsata emazinga laphakeme nekungeta emazinga akuleli ekwakha ematfuba lamanyenti emisebenti.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi exikarhi ka swin'wana yi lava ku hlohlotela tilevhele ta le henhla ta ku engeteriwa ka nkoka wa laha tikweni ku tumbuluxa swivandlanene swa mitirho yo engetela.

src: Kuhlola nekulandzelela loluhlelo netimboni letihambisana naloko nato tiyatfutfukiswa kucinisekisa intfutfuko ngekwalombono netinjongo te-SAANdvuna weTimboni neTekuhwebelana, Dkt Rob Davies, utawatisa betindzaba ngalokuchibiyela ngaLesihlanu, mhla ti-23 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Vulanguteri na nkambelo wa nongonoko lowu na swiendleko swa vumaki leswi fambelanaka swa antswisiwa ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ndzima eka xivono na swikongomelo swa SAAHolobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Dkd Rob Davies, u ta nyika vuxokoxoko eka swihangalasamahungu hi mihundzuluxo leyi hi Ravuntlhanu, 23 Hukuri 2018.Milawumbisi.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Umtsetfosivivinyo Wemali Leyongetelelweko Yeluhlolo Mabhuku Lwahulumende wanga-2018, kutsi wetfulwe ePhalamende.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Nawumbisi wa Hakelo yo Engetela ya Oditi ya Mfumo wa 2018 (Public Audit Excess Fee Bill of 2018) leswaku wu andlariwa ePalamende.

src: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uvumela Umhlolimabhuku Jikelele kutsi atsatse tinyatselo tekulungisa kucinisekisa kutsi lokulahlekela uMbuso, lapho kufanele khona, kuyatfolakala nekundlulisela letinye tento tebugebengu kutsi tiphenywe.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lulamisela Oditara-Jenerala ku teka goza ro lulamisa ku tiyisisa leswaku milahleko leyi Mfumo wu hlanganaka na yona, laha swi kotekaka, yi vuyisiwa na ku kongomisa mihambuko yo tivikana leyi ehleketeleriwaka yo karhi eka vulavisisi.

src: Lomtsetfosivivinyo ubuye uhlose kuniketa AG emandla ekuhlola emabhuku angaphandle nekuhlola emabhuku indlela lasebenta ngayo, nekucondzanisa lamalungiselelo ekulawula kwa-AG kuhambisane neluhlelo lwekusebenta kahle lwanyalo.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu ya emahlweni ku lava ku nyika matimba eka AG ku tirha ntirho wa oditi ya matiko ya misava a ku endla tioditi ta matirhelo, na ku fambelanisa milulamiselo ya mafumelo ya AG eka maendlelo lamanene ya nkarhi wa sweswi.

src: Imikhosi Letako.
tgt: Swiendleko leswi Taka.

src: I-100 #WomenOfFortitudeKulandzela lesikhatsi sekukhetfwa, i-100 #WomenOfFortitude itawembulwa e-Union Buildings ePitoli ngamhla ti-22 Lweti 2018.
tgt: 100 #WomenOfFortitudeEndzhaku ka nkarhi wa ku boxiwa ka mavito, 100 #WomenOfFortitude yi ta pfuriwa eUnion Buildings ePitori hi siku ra 22 Hukuri 2018.

src: Lekomidi Lehlanganisa boNdvuna yekubungatwa Kweminyaka Lelikhulu yaNelson Mandela na-Albertina Sisulu imemetele mhla ti-11 Imphala 2018 kutsi umkhankaso we-#WomenOfFortitude ungomunye lotawuba ingcenye yemikhosi Yeminyaka Lelikhulu yaMake Sisulu.
tgt: Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Tindzawulo eka Malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela na Malembexidzana ya Albertina Sisulu yi tivise hi siku ra 11 Nhlangula 2018 pfhumba ra #WomenOfFortitude tanihi un'wana wa migingiriko ya Malembexidzana ya Manana Sisulu.

src: Lomkhankaso we- #WomenOfFortitude wabomake labali-100 labatawuhola letingcogco tekutsi bomake namuhla bangawugcina njani umlandvo waMake Sisulu.
tgt: Pfhumba ra #WomenOfFortitude i nhlangano wa 100 ra vavasati ra ku hlohlotela mbulavurisano wa hilaha vavasati namuntlha va nga yisaka emahlweni ndzhaka ya Manana Sisulu.

src: Emalanga la-16 eKulwisana Neludlame Lwekuhlukumeta Ngekwebulili (i-GBV)Litiko Labomake lihlanganisa futsi lichumanise imigubho yahulumende Yemkhankaso Wemalanga la-16 eKulwisana Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili (i-GBV) kusukela ngamhla ti-25 Lweti kuya ku-10 Ingongoni 2018.
tgt: 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na Madzolonga yo ya hi Rimbewu (GBV)Ndzawulo ya Vamanana yi le ku kondleteleni na ku katsakanya khalendara ya swiendleko ya mfumo eka Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na GBV kusuka hi siku ra 25 Hukuri kufika 10 N'wendzamhala 2018.

src: Emalunga Esigungu Lesiphakeme kanye nebaholi bahulumende wetifundza nasemakhaya batawenta imicimbi lephatselene naleto tikhundla /umkhakha eveni lonkhe ngekubamba imihlangano yekukhulumisana nebantfu.
tgt: Swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan'we na varhangeri va swifundzakulu na va miganga va ta endla swiendleko swo kongomana na photifoliyo/sekitara etikweni hinkwaro hi mapfhumba ya ku vulavurisana na miganga.

src: Imininingwane lenabile yetinhlelo tahulumende ingatfolakala ku: WEBTOKEN IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lesikhatsi bangenelele emicimbini yahulumende lesedvute nabo.
tgt: Minongonoko ya mfumo leyi koxometiweke yi nga hlahluviwa kusuka eka from WEBTOKEN Khabinete yi hlohlotela maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tirhisa pulatifomo leyi na ku teka xiave eka xiendleko xa mfumo lexi nga ekusuhi na vona.

src: Imiphakatsi naletinye tinhlangano tabomake bayakhutsatwa kutsi bangayikhohlwa lemicimbi.
tgt: Vaakatiko lava nga na ku tsakela kun'we na mihlangano ya vavasati yin'wana yi khutaziwa ku tata tikhalendera ta yona hi swiendleko swa nkarhi lowu.

src: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayacelwa kutsi basebentisane kutsi baphendvule kulesicelo lesitsi #HearMeToo, ngekulalela kukhala kwabomake, bese benta lokutsite kucedza lokubhebhetseka kwanoma luphi luhlobo lwekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo va khutaziwa ku tirhisana ku tekela enhlokweni xirhambo eka #HearMeToo, hi ku yingisela mpingu wa vavasati, kutani va teka goza ku herisa maxangu ya mixaka hinkayo ya madzolonga ehenhla ka vavasati.

src: Kuhalalisa.
tgt: Vuhoyozeri.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela onkhe emachawe etemidlalo labhebhetelisa umjeka waseNingizimu Afrika uphaphele etulu.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela tinghwazi ta mitlangu hinkwato leti endlaka Afrika-Dzonga yi tinyungubyisa.

src: Lokuphumelela kwalabo labente kahle kulemikhakha lehlukene yetemidlalo, ibongwe kulomcimbi wanga-2018 Wemiklomela Yetemidlalo losandza kuba khona.
tgt: Mifikelelo ya lavaya va tirheke kahle swinene etimbaleni ta vona ta mitlangu, yi amukeriwile eka nkhuvu wa Masagwati ya mitlangu wa 2018 lowu wa ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale.

src: Caster Semenya waseNingizimu Afrika utfumbe emagolide lamabili ngekutiwinela indondo yemdlali lodvumile wemnyaka, i-Sports Star of the Year, kanye nendondo yemdlali longumake wemnyaka, i-Sportswoman of the Year.
tgt: Caster Semenya wa Afrika-Dzonga u amukele misuku yimbirhi hi ku wina sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Lembe leri rhandziwaka ngopfu swin'we na Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xisati wa Lembe.

src: Lona loyindadi eNingizimu Afrika Chad le Clos uphumelele indondo ye-Sportman of the Year.
tgt: Muhlamberi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wa Afrika-Dzonga Chad le Clos u wine Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xinuna wa Lembe.

src: Ndodomzi Ntutu uphumelele indondo yemdlali wemnyaka lonekukhubateka, i-Sportsman of the Year with Disability.
tgt: Ndodomzi Ntutu u wine Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xinuna wa Lembe loyi a nga na Vutsoniwa.

src: Anrune Liebenberg uphumelele indondo yemdlali wemnyaka longumake lonekukhubateka, i-Sportswoman of the Year Award with Disasbility.
tgt: Anrune Liebenberg u wine Sgwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xisati wa Lembe loyi a nga na Vutsoniwa.

src: IBanyana Banyana iphumelele indondo Yelicembu Lemnyaka.
tgt: Banyana Banyana u wine Sagwati ra Xipanu xa Lembe ra xiyimo xa le henhla.

src: IBanyana Banyana iphumelele umdlalo wayo wekucala lebawudlale ne-Nigeria ku-2018 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (i-AFCON).
tgt: Banyana Banyana yi wine meche wa yona wo sungula na Nigeria eka Khapi ya Tinxaka ya Vavasati ya 2018 (AFCON).

src: IBafana Bafana idlale ngekulingana nga-1-1 neNigeria kumdlalo wekungena ku-AFCOLicembu leRugby laseNingizimu Afrika lishayelwa tandla ngendlela lelidlale ngayo kantsi sibafisela inhlanhla kulomdlalo wabo lotako nababukene neWales ngamhla ti-24 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Bafana Bafana yi tlange ku ringana hi 1-1 eka meche wo hundzela emahlweni wa AFCON na Nigeria.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke basekele labomake nabobabe labadlala imidlalo kulelive.
tgt: Xipanu xa Rhagabi xa Afrika-Dzonga xa hoyozeriwa eka matirhelo ya xona naswona hi va navelela leswinene eka meche wa xona lowu taka na Wales hi siku ra 24 Hukuri 2018.Khabinete yi kombela maAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va seketela vatlangi va xinuna na va xisati va tiko.

src: Ndvuna weSayensi Netheknoloji Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, lokhetfwe kutsi asebente kuMkandlu Wenhlangano Yetemnotfo Yemhlaba weTheknoloji Yesimanje, lefaka ekhatsi hulumende, tinhlangano temphakatsi netifundziswa.
tgt: Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, loyi vito ra yena ri boxiweke ku tirha eka Khansele ya Forau ya Ikhonomi ya Matiko ya Misava eka Ncinco wa Tifeme wa Vumune, lowu vumbiwaka hi mfumo vaaki lava nga na ku tsakela kun'we na swidyondzeki.

src: Loku kutawusita emave mhlabawonkhe kutsi aphendvule atsatse nelitfuba lematfuba lavetwa yiTheknoloji Yesimanje.
tgt: Leswi swi ta pfuna matiko emisaveni hinkwayo ku angula na ku tirhisa hindlela leyi vuyerisaka swivandlanene leswi tisiwaka hi Ncinco wa Tifeme wa Vumune.

src: Ndvuna Wetetimali Tito Mboweni ngekufakwa kwakhe kuBhodi yaLabaphetse Sikhwama Sekuthula se-AU, leyitawuniketa timali tekungenelela nekuvikela imisebenti yemakhono, tidzingo tekuniketa tikhungo emandla, kanye nemitamo yekuletsa kuthula e-Afrika.
tgt: Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Bodo ya Valawulathirasiti ya Nkwama wa ku Rhula wa Misava, lowu wu nga ta nyika timali eka migingiriko ya xidipulomati yo lamula no sivela, swilaveko swa vuswikoti bya mihlangano, na mitirho yo seketela ku rhula eAfrika.

src: Njengelilunga leBhodi yaLabaphetse Ndvuna Mboweni utawufaka sandla kulokuhlanganiswa kwemasu nekutfutfukiswa kwembuso, kubuyeketa timali nekuphatfwa kwaleSikhwama Sekuthula.
tgt: Tanihi xirho xa Bodo ya Vulawulathirasiti, Holobye Mboweni u ta hoxa xandla eka nkhomano wa xiqhinga na mafumelo lama antswisweke, na vuangameri bya swa timali na mafambiselo bya Nkwama wa ku Rhula.

src: Lokubekwa kwalabaphatsi beSikhwama Sekuthula se-AU sinyatselo lesibalulekile ekusungulweni kwekuniketwa imali kweluhlelo lwe-AU, lekuyincenye yalenchubo lechubekako yekwakhiwa kabusha kwalesikhungo.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka valawulathirasiti va Nkwama wa ku Rhula wa AU i gozakulu eka nsimeko wa ku nyikiwa ka timali ka ajenda ya AU, leswi swi nga xiphemu xa phurosese ya mpfuxeto wa mihlangano leyi yaka emahlweni.

src: Ndvuna weTemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha Naledi Pandor, lotawuniketwa i-French National Order of the Legion of Honour Award ngaLesihlanu, mhla ti-30 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri Naledi Pandor, loyi a nga ta tlhomiwa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Furwa ra Sagwati ra Vuthu ra Nxiximo hi Ravuntlhanu, 30 Hukuri 2018.

src: Lomklomelo wekubonga lokuphumelela kwakhe sikhatsi lesidze nemitamo yekunotsisa nekutfutfukisa lokusebentisana emkhatsini weFrance neNingizimu Afrika kumkhakha weSayensi neTheknoloji.
tgt: Sagwati leri ri tekela enhlokweni mifikelelo na mitirho ya yena leyi nga erivaleni ya vutomi hinkwabyo eka ku kondletela na ku yisa emahlweni ntirhisano exikarhi ka Furwa na Afrika-Dzonga eka xiyenge xa Sayense na Thekinoloji.

src: Lomcimbi utawubanjelwa endzaweni yeLincusa laseFrance lapha eNingizimu Afrika ePitoli.
tgt: Nkhuvu lowu wu ta khomeriwa endhawini ya vutshamo ya Muyimeri wa Furwa eka Afrika-Dzonga ePitori.
