src: Uphindze futsi watfola lwatiso lakamuva lolumayelana neMmango Wetemnotfo loholwa ngeMave aseNshonalanga ye-Afrika mayelana nekuketulwa kwembuso waseNiger kanye nemitamo nje jikelele yekubuyisa esimeni umtsetfo wentsandvo yelinyenti eSahel.
tgt: U tlhele a kuma hungu leri pfuxetiweke hi mayelana na migingiriko leyi rhangeriwaka hi Nhlangano wa Ikhonomi wa Matiko ya le Vupeladyambu bya Afrika eka ku vutliwa ka mfumo eNiger na matshalatshala yo angarhela yo vuyisela mafumele ya xidemokirasi eSahel.

src: Mengameli Emmerson Mnangagwa waseRiphabhliki yaseZimbabwe, mayelana nemitamo yahulumende waseZimbabwe yekuhlanganisa kwakhiwa kabusha kwalelive ngemuva kwelukhetfo lokwavumelanwa ngalo lolusandza kuba khona.
tgt: Presidente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa Rhiphabliki ra Zimbabwe, eka migingiriko ya mfumo wa Zimbabwe yo hlanganisa ku akiwa hi vuntshwa ka tiko leriya endzhaku ka nhlawulo lowa ha ku vaka kona lowu ku pfumelelaniweke hawona.4 President Ramaphosa u tlhele a nghenelela eka Nhlangeletano yo Tshama va Vulavula hi Bindzu ra Mabindzu na Vuvekisi ya United States (US)-Afrika-Dzonga, lowu a wu katsa varhangeri va Bindzu va Afrika-Dzonga na Amerika.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi watibandzakanya kumhlangano weTekuhweba emkhatsini weMelika (i-US) neNingizimu Afrika neMhlangano Wetebhizinisi Nelutjalomali, lofake ekhatsi baholi betemabhizinisi baseMelika nebaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Laha ku nga na ku tlula 600 wa tikhamphani ta le US leti tirhaka eAfrika-Dzonga, ku nghenelela loku a ku ri ka nkoka swinene eka ku tiyisisiwa loku yaka emahlweni ka vuxaka exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na US.5 Hi nkarhi wa kona, ku nyikiwile xitiviso xa ximfumo xa leswaku Foramu ya Ntirhisano wa Mabindzu na Ikhonomi ya US na Matiko ya Afrika ya le Dzongeni wa Sahara ya vu 20, (Foramu ya AGOA) yi ta va kona eJoni ku sukela hi ti 2 ku fikela hi ti 4 Hukuri 2023.

src: Njengaloku kunetinkampani taseMelika letingetulu kwe-600 letisebentela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, lokucocisana bekumcoka kulokuchubeka kwekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neMelika.
tgt: Foramu yi ta tlhela yi va na ‘Nkombiso wa swi Endliwile eAfrika’ lowu nga ta kombisa nkoka lowu endliwaka hi xifundza eka tikonkulu.6 President Ramaphosa u tlhele a vona ku tivisiwa ka ntirhisano exikarhi ka Novo Nordisk na Aspen.

src: Ngalesikhatsi, kwentiwe simemetelo lesisemtsetfweni lesitsi Inkhundla ye-20 Yekuhlanganyela Kutemnotfo Nekuhweba emkhatsini weMelika ne-Afrika Lengentasi kweSahara, (Inkhundla ye-AGOA) itawubanjelwa eJozi kusukela mhla ti-2 kuya mhla ti-4 kuLweti 2023.
tgt: Ntirhisano wu ta vona vuhumelerisi bya insulin eka switirhisiwa swa Aspen’s eGqeberha, Eastern Cape.

src: Lenkhundla itawufaka ekhatsi ‘Umbukiso Walokwentiwe e-Afrika’ lokutawubukiswa tinchubo tekukhicita kwesigodzi kulelivekati.
tgt: Ntirhisano lowu wu kongomisa eka ku phakela ku tlula 16 wa timiliyoni ta tidoseji ta insulin hi 2024, leyi nga ta tlakusiwa hi 2026.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi waba ngufakazi wesimemetelo sekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela emkhatsini we-Novo Nordisk ne-Aspen.
tgt: Leswi swi ta ndlandlamuxa swinene ku fikeleriwa ka vutshunguri bya insulin ku nga ri eAfrika-Dzonga ntsena, kambe na le ka tikonkulu hinkwaro.

src: Lokusebenta ngekuhlanganyela kutawuholela ekukhicitweni kwelikhambi lekwelapha ushukela i-insulin etikhungweni te-Aspen letiseGqeberha, eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku va Mulawuri wa Eneji wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Rixaka a pfumelerile swikombelo swa layisense ya mabindzu na ku xava ematikweni ya le handle/ku xavisela matiko ya le handle swa Khamphani yo Fambisa ya Afrika-Dzonga ya Rixaka, leswi nga pfula ndlela yo xava gezi ku suka eka xifundza hinkwaxo.

src: Lokusebenta ngekuhlanganyela kuhloswe ngako kuphakela tilinganisomutsi telikhambi lekwelapha ushukela letingetulu kwetigidzi leti-16 nga-2024.
tgt: Ku vuyela eku tirheni ka Yuniti ya 4 ya Xitichi xa Gezi xa Kusile ku suka eka ku lulamisa ka nhlayiso lowu kunguhatiweke swi vuyisile 800 wa ti megawati eka giridi ya hina ya gezi.

src: Loku kutawukwenyusa kakhulu kufinyelela ekwelashweni nge-insulin hhayi kuphela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kodvwa kulo lonkhe lelivekati.
tgt: Ndzima leyi yo hlawuleka i ya nkoka eka ku antswisa vuswikoti bya giridi ya rixaka byo endla gezii na ku lulamisa ku vuyelela ka ku timiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kunikwa kweticelo temvume tekuhweba nekutfumela emaveni langephandle/nekutsenga kulamanye emave langephandle nguMlawuli Wavelonkhe Wetemandla waseNingizimu Afrika Inkampani Yavelonkhe Yekwendlulisa yaseNingizimu Afrika, ngekuvula indlela yekutsenga emandla ngale kulesigodzi.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi tivisiwa hi leswi fikeleriweke mayelana na ku tlherisela Tiyuniti ta 1, 2 na 3 ta Xitichi xa Gezi xa Kusile ku nga se fika nkarhi lowu a wu vekiwile.

src: Kubuyela kwekusebenta kweYunithi ye-4 yaseSikhungweni Sekuphehla Ugezi saseKusile emva kwekugcinwa esimeni sekusebenta lobekuhleliwe kubuyise ema-megawatts lange-800 kugridi yetfu.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pimiwa ku va Eskom yi ri eka xiyimo lexi nga tshamiseka hi Vukorhokeri bya Vavekisi bya Moody’s, lexi nga ta antswisa ku fikelela ka vukorhokeri bya gezi eka mali ya xikeweleti leswaku byi kota ku endla makungu ya nkarhi lowutaka yo tirhisa vuhlayisi lebyi kunguhatiweke eka swo famba swa byona leswi tirhisiwaka eka ku endla gezi.

src: Lenkhomba yalosekwentiwe imcoka ekwenteni ncono emandla ekuphehla kugridi yavelonkhe kanye nekulungisa kwenteka njalo kwekucishwa kwagezi ngenhloso yekuwonga.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi matshalatshala yo lulamisa mitlhontlho ya mati leyi khumbaka tindhawu to hlaya etikweni hinkwaro.

src: Ikhabhinethi yaphindze futsi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana nenchubekelembili yekubuyiswa kwekusebenta kweMayunithi 1, 2 na-3 aseSikhungweni Sekuphehla Ugezi saseKusile ngembikwesikhatsi lebesihleliwe.
tgt: Holobye wa mati na Mbhasiso, Tatana Senzo Mchunu na vameyarankulu va madoroba man’wana eGauteng va ta nyika hungu leri pfuxetiweke ra ku nghenelela loku yaka emahlweni ku tiyisisa mphakelo wa mati eka xifundzankulu.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kuhlolwa kwelizinga lelisimeme lekusebenta kwe-Eskom lokwentiwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, lokuyintfo letakwenta ncono kwetsembeka kwalesikhungo sagezi kanye nekutsi sikhone kuhlela ngaphambilini ekufezekiseni kugcina esimeni sekusebenta lokuhleliwe kwemayunithi aso ekuphehla gezi.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa munhu un’wana na un’wana leswaku Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri kayivelaka mati.

src: Indvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola, Mnu Senzo Mchunu kanye nabosodolobha balamanye emadolobhakati eGauteng batawuniketa lwati lolwakamuva lolumayelana netingenelelo tekusimamisa kuphakelwa kwemanti kulesifundza.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya BNC ya Afrika-Dzonga na Lesotho na Ntlawa wa Vaholobye leyi khomiweke ku sukela hi ti 25 ku fikela hi ti 28 Ndzati 2023 yi kongomisa eka ntirhisano wa ikhonomi, timhaka to tsemakanya mindzilekano, na ku fambafamba ka vanhu hi ku ntshunxeka, nhundzu na vukorhokeri exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi.

src: Ikhomishini Yetive Letimbili iNingizimu Afrika neLesotho (i-BNC) kanye neMhlangano Weklasta Yetindvuna.
tgt: KapaVupeladyambu na KwaZulu-Natal swi vile na mitungu ya HPAI H5 kasi HPAI H7 yi vikiwile eka swifundzankulu swa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga na North West.

src: Umhlangano weKhomishini Yetive Letimbili iNingizimu Afrika neLesotho kanye neMhlangano weKlasta Yetindvuna lebewubanjwe kusukela mhla tinge-25 kuya mhla tinge-28 Inyoni 2023 ugcile ekubambisaneni kutemnotfo, tindzaba letiphatselene nekuwela umnyele, kanye nekuhamba ngekukhululeka kwebantfu, timphahla kanye netinsita emkhatsini walamave lamabili.
tgt: Magoza yo lawula ku hangalaka ka mavabyi ya kona naswona van’wamapurasi va khutaziwa ku landzelela magoza lama vekiweke yo sirhelela swilo leswi hanyaka.2 Mitungu leyi yi tisa mixungeto ya nsirhelelo wa swakudya naswona ku nga tirhisiwa magoza ya mabindzu hi ndlela yo xava swilo leswi humaka ematikweni ya le handle ku lawula ku kumeka ka matandza yo nona, matandza ya le tafuleni na nyama ya huku.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa naNdvunankhulu Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane batawube babosihlalo ngekubambisana kuSeshini Yekuvula kwe-BNC emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neLesotho ngaLesine, mhla tinge-28 Inyoni 2023.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Mpfuxeto wa Misava na Nhluvukiso wa le Matikoxikaya, Huvo ya Vulawuri bya Swikumiwa swa Rihanyo swa Afrika-Dzonga na indasitiri va le ku lavisiseni ka swikombelo swa ntsariso wa misawutiso leyi nga kotekaka, laha magoza yo landzelerisa lama fambelanaka na vuhlayiseki, ku tirha kahle na nkoka swi langutisisiwaka swinene eka ntsariso wa misawutiso yoleyo.7 Ku lwisana na vugevenga loku hlanganisiweke Khabinete yi amukerile hungu leri pfuxetiweke ra ku lwisana na vugevenga, leri nga tlhela ri nyikiwa rixaka hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Jenerala Bheki Cele, na nhlangano wa Nhlanganelo wa Matirhelo na Vuhlori bya Rixaka.2 Ntirho wa swiyenge swo hambanahambana hi mayelana na ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri enawini na vuhlapfa eKapaN’walungu wu endle leswaku ku khomiwa vanhu va 867, vo tala va huma eLesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique na MaAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Le-BNC itawufaka ekhatsi budlelwane betebuncusa, tekuvikela nekuvikeleka, temanti, tekutfutsa, tagezi netekuhwebelana.
tgt: Khabinete yi vuyelerile matitwelo ya tiejensi to hlayisa nawu ya leswaku MaAfrika-Dzonga lava hlayisaka swigevenga leswi khumbekaka eka migingiriko ya ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri enawini va ta langutana na matimba hinkwawo ya nawu.8 Maxelo yo biha swinene.1 Ku landzelelana ka maxelo yo biha laha tikweni swi yisa ehansi nkucetelo lowu ku cinca ka maxelo ku nga na wona eka vutomi bya hina na xilaveko xa magoza lama tiyiselaka nkarhi wo leha yo susa khaboni eka ikhonomi ya hina loko hi ri karhi hi landzelela nhluvukiso lowu tiyiselaka nkarhi wo leha.

src: Luphenyo Lwetenkhundla Yemakethe Lesemkhatsini Ye-inthanethi.. Ikhabhinethi iwutfolile umbiko lovela kuKhomishini Yetekuchudzelana mayelana nolokutfolile kanye netento tekulungisa letimayelana neLuphenyo Lwetenkhundla Yemakethe Lesemkhatsini Ye-inthanethi.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshama yi ri karhi yi tivisiwa hi ku onhaka loku vangiwaka hi swidzedze leswikulu na ndhambi eKapaVuxa, KapaVupeladyambu na Gauteng, ku ri na swikombiso swa leswaku leswi swi nga endleka swi hangalaka na swifundzha leswin’wana.3 Khabinete yi kombela miganga ku tshama yi vambe ngoma eka switsundzuxo swin’wana swa maxelo yo biha, leswi nga tisaka ku onhaka kun’wana etikweni hinkwaro.4 Mfumo wu ya emahlweni wu seketela vukorhokeri bya xihatla na tisenthara ta vulawuri bya timhangu eka matirho yo ponisa na ku nyika nseketelo wo phalala eka swiyimo swa xihatla.9 Winnie Mandela Avenue.1 Khabinete yi lemukile ku cinciwa ka vito ra William Nicol Drive eSandton ku va Winnie Mandela Avenue tanihi goza ra nkoka ro tsala matimu ya Afrika-Dzonga hi vuntshwa ku kombisa ku hoxa xandla ka lava nga lwela ntshunxeko wa hina.2 Ntirho lowu wu kotlanile na siku leri a ri ta va ri ri ra ku velekiwa ka Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ra vu 87 hi ti 26 ndzati 2023.

src: Ikhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenti wekhomishini ngekulungisa kukhatsateka kwekwenganyelwa sikhondlakhondla sinye kwetinkhundla letisemkhatsini tedijithali, lokufaka ekhatsi tebhizinisi nge-elekthronikhi, ema-ejensi ekuhamba laku-inthanethi, kuletfwa kwekudla, titolo tema-app, batfulitinsita labahleleke ngemikhakha kanye netinjini tekutfungatsa lwatiso ku-inthanethi.
tgt: Qhinga ra Nyama ya Swiharhi swa nhova leri Pfuxetiweke ra Afrika-Dzonga.1 Khabinete yi pasisile ku tirhisiwa ka Qhingha ra Nyama ya Swiharhi swa nhova leri Pfuxetiweke ra Afrika-Dzonga, leri lavaka ku cinca indhasitiri ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova na ku endla leswaku yi va ya ximfumo.2 Xikongomelo xa qhinga i ku tiyisisa sekitara ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova tanihi muphakeri wa nsirhelelo wa swakudya na sekitara ya ku kula ka ikhonomi leswi nga pfunaka ku tumbuluxa mitirho.3 Afrika-Dzonga yi vekiwa eka xiyimo xo sungula eka tikonkulu ra Afrika xa ku kumiwa ka nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova.

src: Ikhabhinethi inike sicondziso Tindvuna tematiko ahulumende lafanele kutsi tichubeke ticubungule letincomo tekutfutfukisa, tibuke imitselela yetinchubomgomo kanye nekwenta tingucuku letinsha letidzingekako tetinchubomgomo letitawukwenta kutsi kube nekutibandzakanya lokuvakalako kwebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemabhizinisi lamancane, lasemkhatsini kanye nemabhizinisi lacashe bantfu labambalwa kubhizinisi ye-inthanethi lekhulako.
tgt: Qhinga ri lava ku tiyisisa ku tumbuluxiwa ka 202 666 wa mitirho leyi nga ta va kona nkarhi wo leha eka indasitiri ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova hi 20.4 Qhinga leri ri ta hangalasiwa eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Swihlahla, Tinhlampfi na Mbango: WEBTOKEKungu Lerikulu ra Sekitara ya Vupfhumba.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikunakile lokubhedvuka lokukhona kwemkhuhlane weligciwane lelibanga kugula kakhulu (i-HPAI) i-H5 ne-H7 embonini yetinkhukhu lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku yelanisiwa ka Kungu ro Vuyelerisa Sekitara ya Vupfhumba na Kungu Lerikulu ra Vupfhumba lerintshwa.

src: Inshonalanga Kapa neKwaZulu-Natal babe nekubhedvuka kwe-HPAI H5 kwatsi i-HPAI H7 yona yabikwa kutsi ibhedvuke eGauteng, eLimpopo, eMpumalanga naseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Xiphemu xa nkoka xa Kungu Lerikulu i ku hunguta switandzhaku swa ntungu wa COVID-19 eka sekitara ya vupfhumba.

src: Tinyatselo tekulawula kubhebhetseka kwalokubhedvuka setime ngemumo nebalimi bayagcugcutelwa kutsi bahloniphe tinyatselo tekuvikeleka letincunyiwe.
tgt: Ri ya emahlweni ri nyika ndlela ya matirhelo ya ku vuyiseriwa loku heleleke ka vupfhumba laha tikweni.

src: Lokubhedvuka kubeka kubakhona kwekudla ebungotini kanye netinyatselo tekuhweba ngendlela yekutsenga kulamanye emave langesheya kulawula kubakhona kwemacandza latalako, emacandza latayelekile kubatsengi kanye nenyama yenkhukhu tingafezekiswa.
tgt: Loko Kungu ro Vuyelerisa Sekitara ya Vupfhumba ri tumbuluxiwile ku olovisa ku vuyiseriwa ka sekitara, ku hlayisa mitirho na ku sirhelela tindlela to tihanyisa, Kungu Lerikulu ri ta yisa ntirho lowu eka xiyimo xin’wana na ku fambisa swivandlanene leswintshwa eka sekitara.

src: Litiko Letekulima, Kulungiswa Kabusha Kwemhlaba Nekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni, Umtimba waseNingzimu Afrika Lolawula Imikhicito Yetemphilo kanye nemboni bahlola ticelo tekubhalisa imitsi yekugoma lengabakhona, kanye netinyatselo tekuhambisana letiphatselene nekuphepha, kusebenta ngemphumelelo kanye nelizingasimo kubekwe kumcoka kakhulu nawubhalisa imitsi yekugoma lenjalo.
tgt: Kungu ri ringanyeta maqhinga ya nkombo yo nghenelela ku tiyisisa leswaku sekitara ya vupfhumba yi tlhelela eka masiku ya yona ya matirhelo ya xiyimo xa le henhla, na leswaku yi va exivindzini xa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na vubindzurisi.

src: Kulwa nebugebengu ngendlela lehlanganisiwe Ikhabhinethi ilwemukele lwatiso lakamuva lolumayelana nekulwa nebugebengu, loluphindze futsi lwaniketwa sive yiNdvuna Yetemaphoyisa, Jenene Bheki Cele, kanye Nekusebenta Ngekuhlanyanyela Kwavelonkhe NeLuhlaka Lwetebunhloli.
tgt: Indhasitiri ya vupfhumba i muhoxa xandla wa nkoka eka ikhonomi naswona a yi seketerile 725 000 wa mitirho loko ku nga se va ntungu wa COVID-19.Milawumbisi.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivakalise luvo lwema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemsetfo kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labafihla tigebengu letitibandzakanya ekugubheni timayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni batawubukana nesandla semtsetfo ngalokuphelele.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku yisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa SABC wa 2023 ePalamende.

src: Simo selitulu lesibi salelive sigcizelela umtselela wetingucuko tesimomvama selitulu etimphilweni tetfu kanye nesidzingo sesinyatselo lesisimeme sekucedza ikhabhoni emnotfweni wetfu kodvwa sibe silandzela intfutfuko lesimeme.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu ya emahlweni wu ringanyeta ku cinca eka modele wa mpfuneto wa timali wa SABC na sisiteme ya tilayisense ta TMpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Vukorhokeri bya Mati.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyatiswa kabanti mayelana nemonakalo lobangwe tiphepho letimatima netikhukhula eMphumalanga Kapa, eNshonalanga Kapa naseGauteng, lokunetinkhomba letitsi kungenteka tisabalalele nakuletinye tifundza.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Nawumbisi wo Cinca Vukorhokeri bya Mati ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ihlale icaphelele kakhulu tecwayiso tesimo selitulu lesibi, lokungenteka kutsi siletse lomunye umonakalo eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Swikongomelonkulu swa Nawumbisi i ku tiyisisa vutihlamuleri eka vanyiki va vukorhokeri bya mati na ku tisa mhaka yo va erivaleni.

src: Hulumene uyachubeka nekwesekela tinsita letiphutfumako kanye netikhungo tekulawula tinhlekelele kwenta imisebenti yekuhlenga kanye nekunika kwesekela kwebuntfu.
tgt: Ku cinciwa ka Nawu wa Vukorhokeri bya Mati, 1997 (Nawu wa 108 wa 1997) ku ta tiyisisa leswaku vanyiki va vukorhokeri bya mati va phakela mati ya xiyimo xa le henhla tanihi xiphemu xa swiyimo swa vona swa tilayisense.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kufezekiswa kweLisubuciko laseNingizimu Afrika Lolubuyeketiwe Lwetenyama Yetinyamatane, lokuhloswe ngalo kwenta imboni yenyama yetinyamatane kutsi ibe semtsetfweni futsi iguculwe.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu veka mipimo ya le hansi ya matirhelo ya vanyiki va vukorhokeri bya mati, leyi valawuri va Vukorhokeri bya Mati va faneleke ku vona leswaku ya landzeleriwa.

src: Lelisubuciko lihlose kucinisa umkhakha wetenyama yenyamatane njengemetfuli wekubakhona kwekudla kanye nemkhakha wekukhula kutemnotfo longasita kudala imisebenti.
tgt: Mpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Mati wa Rixaka.

src: INingizimu Afrika ibekwe yaba yekucala lapha kulelivekati lase-Afrika ngekukhicita inyama yetinyamatane.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka mpfampfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Mati wa Rixaka ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: Lelisubuciko lihlose kucinisekisa kudaleka kwemisebenti lesimeme leti-202 666 kumkhakha wetenyama yenyamatane nga-2030.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu cinca Nawu wa Mati wa Rixaka, 1998 (Nawu wa 36 wa 1998).

src: Lelisubuciko litawushicilelwa kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letemahlatsi, Tekudoba Nemvelo ku: www.
tgt: Ku cinciwa loku ku ta antswisa milawu naswona ki ta tiyisisa leswaku switirhisiwa swa mati swa tiko swi lawuriwa kahle, swi sirheleriwa no hlayisiwa.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwentiwa kwekutsi Lisu Lekuvusetela Kabusha Lemkhakha Wetekuvakasha lihambisane neLisu Lelikhulu Letekuvakasha lelisha.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka valawuri lava nga riki va xiyimo xa le henhla eka Bodo ya Nhlangano wa Ndzindzakhombo wa Nxungeto wo Hlawuleka wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wesikhashana Wekuchibela Tetinsita Temanti.
tgt: Manana Disebo Moephuli.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ubeka tilinganisozinga telinanincane tekusebenta kwebatfulitinsita betinsita temanti, lekufanele kutsi ticinisekiswe tiphatsimandla Tetinsita Temanti kutsi tiyagcinwa.
tgt: N‘hweti ya Vutleketli ya 2023 yi ta kongomisa eka vuvekisi lebyikulu eka switirhisiwa swa vutleketli, na xirhambo xo teka goza ro sirhelela switirhisiwa swa vutleketli eka vukhamba na ku onhiwa.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo wesikhashana Wavelonkhe Wekuchibela Temanti kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Siku leri ri tivisiwile hi ku hlanganela hi Nhlangano wa Vatirhi wa Matiko ya Misava na Nhlangano wa Tinxaka wa Dyondzo, Sayense na Mfuwo ku tlangela ntirho wa nkoka lowu vadyondzisi va hina va wu endlaka.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze futsi wente tiphakamiso tekucedza kungalingani kwasesikhatsini lesengcile lokuphatselene nekuphakelwa kwemanti, kanye nekwenta kutsi kube netindlela tekusombulula tincabano tangekhatsi ngemphumelelo nangekushesha.
tgt: Ku hlawuriwa ka Holobye Motshekga eka phanele ya xiyimo xa le henhla swi kombisa levhele ya yena ya ntokoto eka xiyenge xa dyondzo naswona i xikombiso xa ku tshemba eka ndlela leyi dyondzo ya Afrika-Dzonga yi fambaka ha yona.

src: TekucashwaKonkhe kucashwa kuncike ekucinisekisweni kweticu kanye nemvume lefanele.
tgt: Phanele yi katsa vayimeri ku suka eka Nhlangano wa Vatirhi wa Matiko ya Misava, Ntlawa wa Ntirho wa Vadyondzisi wa Nhlangano wa Dyondzo, Sayense na Mfuwo wa UN, Mihlangano ya Vatirhi ya Vadyondzisi ya Misava Hinkwayo na Vaholobye vanharhu va dyondzo.

src: A. Tindzaba Letibalulekile Talelive Tihlabani Tendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco Yanga-2023 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Emabhokobhoko ngekuphumelela kutsatsa Indzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco yanga-2023 leyenta kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngilo lodvwa live lelitsetse Lendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco emahlandla lamane nekutsi litsatse lendzebe tikhatsi letimbili ngekulandzelana.
tgt: Timhaka leti nga eka Mbango Tinghwazi ta Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby ya 2023 Khabinete yi hoyozerile tiSpringboks eka ku hlula ka vona eka Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby 2023 loku endleke Afrika-Dzonga tiko ri ri roxe ri nga hlula Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby ku ringana ka mune (4) no va ra vumbiri ku wina xidlodlo hi ku landzelelana.

src: Emlandvweni welibhola lembhoco, lelicembu leMabhokobhoko ngilona libhice tinhlanga letehlukene kunawo onkhe emacembu ngekwebuhlanga bebantfu labakhona eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Eka matimu ya Rugby eAfrika-Dzonga, xipano xa tiSpringboks hi xona lexi nga na vanhu vo hambanahambana hikuya hi nhlayo ya vaaki va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Kuhlanganiswa kwalelicembu lelibhice kangaka akuzange kumane kwenteke nje, kepha kwaba yimitamo leyentiwa ngulabaphetse kanye netisebenti leticecesha lelicembu leMabhokobhoko yekutsi bakhetse licembu lelifaka bantfu labehlukene.
tgt: Ku vumbiwa ka xipano xa tano lowu nga na vanhu vo hambanahambana a ku nga ri mhaka ya xiwelo, kambe i matshalatshala lama endliweke hi vufambisi na valeteri va tiSpringboks ku hlawula xipano lexi katsaka hinkwavo.

src: Leso sincumo semceceshi Rassie Erasmus nelicembu lakhe lesabonisa kuba nesibindzi siyachubeka kubonisa takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemhlaba wonkhe kwekutsi wonkhe umuntfu lonelikhono, uma anikwa litfuba nekusekelwa, angaba mkhulu - lokusiciniseko sekutsi Sinemandla Lamakhulu Uma Sihlangene.
tgt: Xiboho xelexo xa vurhena lexi tekiweke hi nkarhi wolowo hi muleteri Rassie Erasmus na ntlawa wa yena va ya emahlweni va kombisa maAfrika-Dzonga na misava hinkwayo, leswaku un’wana na un’wana la nga na vuswikoti, loko a nyikiwa nkarhi na nseketelo, a nga va lonkulu - i ku tiyisisa leswaku hi na matimba loko hi ri swin’we.

src: Lokumcoka kakhulu, kucina nekutimisela kweMabhokobhoko enkhundleni yemdlalo kucuketse liciniso leliyingcikitsi yebuve baseNingizimu Afrika, loko lokwenta lelive lelihle kangaka liphakame limelane nebumatima kuze baphumelele bancobe.
tgt: Xa nkoka swinene, ku tiyisela na ku tiyimisela ka tiSpringbok eka xivandla xa ntlangu i xikombiso xa xiviri xa ntiyiso xo va muAfrika-Dzonga, leswi endlaka leswaku tiko leri lerikulu ri lwisana na mintshikilelo hinkwayo ni maxangu leswaku ri va ni vun’we ri hlula.

src: Labanye bebadlali balelicembu leMabhokobhoko kubite kutsi bamelane netitsa lebetisendleleni yabo yekuphumelela.
tgt: Van’wana va vatlangi lavanene va xipano xa tiSpringbok va boheke ku hlula swiphiqo swa vona vini loko va karhi va lwela ku va ni ndhuma.

src: IKhabhinethi iphumisele kuhalalisa kwayo kuSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, longukapteni weMabhokobhoko Lotsetse Indzebe Yemhlaba kabili ngekuhola licembu lelibe kulelizinga lelibitwa nge-Greatest Of All Time (GOAT), lekungako lemigubho kumele ichubeke.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozerile Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mukaputeni wa tiSpringboks loyi a hluleke Khapu ya Misava kambirhi ku va a rhangele xipano ku ya fika eka xiyimo xa (Greatest of All Time) Vukulu bya Minkarhi Hinkwayo (GOAT) naswona ku tlangela ku fanele ku ya emahlweni.

src: Umhlangano we-AGOA IKhabhinethi isemukele sincumo sebaphatsi beMerikha kanye nemhlangano ngekuba nenhloso yekwelula sikhatsi se-AGOA, lokuyintfo leletsa sicinisekiso kubahlanyeli betimali kulawo mave lavumelekile ku-AGOIKhabhinethi beyiphindze yakwemukela kutsi leli lisingatse uMhlangano we-AGOA wanga-2023 eJozi kusukela mhlaka-2 kuya ku-4 kuLweti wanga-2023, lobenetihambi letivela emaveni langu-32 ase-Afrika letifaka ekhatsi bohulumende, bosomabhizinisi, umphakatsi wonkana kanye nekwekucala nalabamele tisebenti kanye nalabamele hulumende waseMerikha.
tgt: Nhlangano wa AGOA Khabinete yi amukerile ku tiyisisiwa hi mfumo wa United States na nhlangano eka xikongomelo xo ndlandlamuxa AGOA, leswi nyikaka vutitshembi eka vuvekisi eka matiko ya AGOA lama pfumeleriweke.

src: IKhabhinethi beyikadze ikuphakamisa kwekutsi i-AGOA iniketa litfuba lekutsi iMerikha icinise budlelwane bayo ne-Afrika kutemnotfo nekutsi ngaloko kumele ikuchubekise sikhatsi leseluliwe, nekutsi iciniswe kuze ibe nemiphumela futsi igcame.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela ku rhurheriwa ka nhlangano wa AGOA 2023 eJoni ku suka hi ti 2 ku fika hi ti 4 ta Hukuri 2023 na vatlangi vo suka eka matiko ya 32 ya Afrika ku suka eka mfumo, Mabindzu, vandla ra vaaki na nhlangano wa vatirhi ro sungula ni vayimeri va mfumo wa United States.

src: Umhlangano WeTindvuna te-BRICS kuTekuvakasha IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kuphetfwa kweMhlangano We-2023 BRICS WeTindvuna KuTekuvakasha lobe yimphumelelo, lobewubanjelwe e-Cape Town, lapho emave layincenye yalenhlangano atibophelele ekubambisaneni lokujulile kanye nekutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kwe-BRICS, kusungula imizila letawutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kancono nekuchumana kwemave layincenye yalenhlangano.
tgt: Khabinete khale na khale yi vula leswaku AGOA yi nyika nkarhi ku va United States of America ku tiyisa vuxaka bya yona bya swa ikhonomi na Afrika naswona byi fanele byi ndlandlamuxiwa nkarhi wo leha, byi antswisiwa leswaku byi va na nkucetelo na ku koka rinoko.

src: Loku kutawucinisa umkhakha wetekuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika losewuvele ubonisa timphawu tekuvuseteleka.
tgt: Leswi swi ta ya emahlweni swi tiyisa sekithara ya vupfhumba bya Afrika-Dzonga lebyi nga le ku kombiseni swikombiso swa ku antswa.

src: Etinyangeni letingu-8 tekucala kulomnyaka wa-2023, lelive libe netivakashi letingu-5.5 wetigidzi letifikile, loku yinkhulo lengu-63.4% uma kucatsaniswa nesikhatsi lesifanako emnyakeni wa-2022.
tgt: Eka tin’hweti to sungula ta nhungu ta 2023, tiko ri vonile wa timiliyoni ta vanhu lava fikeke leswi yimelaka ku tlakuka ka 63.4% ku suka eka nkarhi lowu fanaka hi 2022.

src: Kubhalisela Kuvota I-IEC seyimemetele imphelasontfo yekucala mhlaka-18 na 19 kuLweti 2023 kutsi ibe yekubhalisela Kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024.
tgt: Ku tsarisiwa ka Vavhoti Va IEC va tivisile leswaku hi ti 18 na ti 19 ta Hukuri 2023 tanihi hi mahelo ya vhiki yo sungula ya ku titsarisela ku vhota eka Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024.. Khabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na mfanelo yo vhota ku titsarisela ku vhota eka Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024 eka xitichi xa wena xa le kusuhi xo vhota.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe labavunyelwe kuvota kutsi babhalisele kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024 etindzaweni tekuvota lesitedvute.
tgt: Ku tsarisa ka vavhoti hi ku tirhisa inthanete ku pfuriwile ku suka hi Nyenyenyana 2023 naswona vaakatiko va komberiwa ku tirhisa xitirhisiwa ku tsarisa kumbe ku pfuxeta vuxokoxoko bya vona.

src: Kubhalisa nge-intanethi kwebavoti kwavulwa kusukela ngeNdlovana 2023 futsi takhamuti tiyakhutsatwa kutsi tisebentise letinsita kuze babhalise noma balungise imininingwane yabo.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga lava nga apulayela ti ID ta vona va khutaziwa ku endzela hofisi ya vona ya kwala tikweni ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku ti landza.

src: Takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika letifake ticelo tema-ID tiyakhutsatwa nato kutsi tivakashele emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya kuyowalandza.
tgt: Ku na makhadi ya ID yo hundza 500 000 lama ya ha lavaka ku tekiwa etihofisi ta Timhaka ta Xikaya etikweni hinkwaro.

src: Kunema-ID langemakhadi langetulu kweti-500 000 lasolo angakalandvwa emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Gezi Holobye eka Hofisi ya Vuphuresidente loyi a nga na vutihlamuleri bya Gezi u nyikile rungula leri heleleke eka xiyimo xa gezi etikweni.

src: Gezi Indvuna leseHhovisi LaMengameli lephetse lindzaba taGezi ikhulume kabanti nesive ngesimo sagezi eveni.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlangerile matshalatshala ya Mfumo wa Xifundzankulu xa Gauteng lowu tirhaka na Eskom ku lunghisa gezi eka tindhawu ta Gauteng leti nga hlaseriwa hi ku tima ka gezi hikokwalaho ka ku yiviwa kumbe ku onhiwa ka switirhisiwa swo hunguta kumbe ku engetela vholiteji ya gezi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyidvumisile imitamo yaHulumende Wesifundza se-Gauteng losebenta ne-Eskom kulungisa gezi etindzaweni letise-Gauteng lebetihlushwa kuhamba kwagezi ngenca yekubiwa noma kubhidlita ema-transformer.
tgt: Vusiku bya tolo, switirhisiwa swo hunguta kumbe ku engetela vholiteji ya gezi swa ntsevu swintshwa swi layitiwile eKagiso, endhawini ya West Rand endzhaku ka loko miganga yi siyiwile yi nga ri na gezi ku hundza malembe manharhu.

src: Ebusuku bayitolo, kukhanyiswe ema-transformer agezi lasitfupha eKagiso, lese-West Rand emva kwekutsi takhamuti takhona tihleli ngaphandle kwagezi iminyaka lengetulu kwalemitsatfu.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga leyi ku sirhelela switirhisiwa swa nkoka ku suka eka vukhamba, ku onhiwa ka swilo na ku onhaka loku vangiwaka hi vuhlanganisi lebyi nga riki enawini.

src: IKhabhinethi imema lemiphakatsi kutsi ivikele letakhiwo ekubiweni, kumoshwa kanye nemonakalo lokubangwa kokhela gezi ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.
tgt: Ku Cheriwa ka Chefu Swakudyeni Khabinete ya vilela hi nhlayo ya le henhla ya ku cheriwa ka chefu swakudyeni eka vana ku suka ka ku va vadya swakudya leswi nga hundzeriwa hi nkarhi no thyaka ku suka eka mavhengele ya swiphaza na vaxavisi va le switarateni.

src: Kudla lokunebutsi IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngakuvama kwekutsi bantfwana badle kudla lokunebutsi ngoba badla kudla losekudlulelwe sikhatsi, nalokonakele lokutsengiswa etipaza nasetitaladini.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaziwile hi matshalatshala ya ku tirhisa nawu ku sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka vuhlayiseki bya swakudya.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakhutsateka ngemitamo yebemtsetfo kucinisa tekuphepha nekulandzelwa kwemigomo yekudla.
tgt: Nhlengeletano wa ku Rhurha ka Matiko ya Misava na Timeyara na Varhangeri va Ndhavuko Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi nhlengeletano wa ku rhurha ka matiko ya misava lowu khomiweke hi Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya hi ku nghenelela ka DSBD, COGTA, Vutshamo bya Vanhu na varhangeri va ndhavuko na timeyara ku suka eka timasipala ta metro na timasipala ta muganga lava a va langutane no hunguta mbuyelo wa ku rhurha ka vanhu va nga ri enawini, ku katsa na matirhelo ya mavhengele ya swiphaza.

src: Umhlangano Wekucecesha Kutfutsela Kulamanye Emave Nebaholi Bemadolobha kanye Nebendzabuko IKhabhinethi yatjelwa kafishane ngalomhlangano wekucecesha lowabanjwa Litiko Letasekhaya nalowahanjelwa yi-DSBD, i-COGTA, Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu kanye nebaholi bendzabuko, nebaholi bemadolobha labaphuma kubomasipala bemadolobha kanye netigodzi, lebewubuka tindlela tekuncandvwa kwemiphumela yekungena eveni ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, lokufaka ekhatsi kusebenta kwetipaza.
tgt: Mimbuyelo ya nkoka yi katsa ku sunguriwa ka swinawana—nawana swa mani na mani ku vulavula hi mintlhontlho leyi fambelanaka na ku sindzisiwa ka milawu ya bindzu hi timasipala na valawuri va ndhavuko.

src: Imiphumela lesembili ifaka ekhatsi kucalwa kweluchungechunge lwetichibelo temitsetfo yekubukana netingcinamba letiphatselene nekutsi bomasipala kanye netiphatsimandla tendzabuko bacinise tichibelo temitsetfo yemabhizinisi.
tgt: Ku ta va na vukamberi bya le kusuhi bya mabindzu, ngopfungopfu mavhengele ya swiphaza hi tindzawulo ta mintirho, rihanyo, nhluvukiso wa mabindzu lamatsongo na mintlawa ya vukamberi bya ku rhurha eka Timhaka ta Xikaya, ku sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka milawu leyi faneleke Nkambisiso wa mavhengele ya swiphaza ematiko xikaya na swidorobanini, na tindlela to va tsarisa hi varhangeri va ndhavuko havambirhi na timasipala ti ta endliwa.

src: Kutawuba khona kuhlolwa kwemabhizinisi, ikakhulu tipaza ngulabaphuma ematiko etekusebenta, temphilo, kusungulwa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kanye nemacembu ebahloli beLitiko Letasekhaya, khona kutawucinisa kulandzelwa kwemigomo ngekusebentisa imitsetfo lefanele.
tgt: Ku tlhela ku va na matshalatshala yo seketela valawuri va ndhavuko ku hlayisa rhekhodo ya vahlampfa emigangeni ya vona.

src: Kutawentiwa luphenyo lwetipaza etindzaweni tasemakhaya kanye nasemalokishini, lokuhambisana netindlela tekutsi tibhaliswe lokutawentiwa baholi bendzabuko kanye nabomasipala.
tgt: Milawu ya tilayisense ta bindzu yi karhi ya cinciwa ku seketela hinkwavo lava lavaka ku xavisa eka sekithara leyi nga riki ya ximfumo.

src: Kuphindze kube khona nemitamo yekusekela tiphatsimandla tendzabuko kwekutsi bagcine luhlu lalabaphuma kulamanye emave emiphakatsini yabo.
tgt: Ku Lwisana na Vugevenga loku Hlanganisiweke Khabinete yi bumabumela va SAPS ku va va hlaserile mintlawa ya misava hinkwayo ya swidzidziharisi endzhaku ko kumiwa ka khokheyini ya ntsengo wa R80 miliyoni swi kumiwile hi ti 20 ta Hlangula 2023 eka ndhawu yo hlayisela eDube Trade Port endzeni ka Rivala ra Swihahampfhuka ra Matiko ya Misava ra King Shaka.

src: Imitsetfo yekubhaliswa kwemabhizinisi nayo iyaguculwa kuze kusekelwe bonkhe labo labafuna kutsengisa kulomkhakha wekutisebentela.
tgt: Masiku mambirhi ku nga si kumiwa mali, khokheyini ya ntsengo wo ringana R70 miliyoni yi kumiwile eka khontheyina eka nhlaluko wa Durban.

src: Kulwa Nebugebengu Lokuhlangahlangene IKhabhinethi iyayincoma i-SAPS ngekuncandza ngemandla kwalabo lababambisana ngekutsengiswa kwetidzakamiva lokulandzela kutfolakala kwe-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letingu-80 leyatsatfwa mhlaka-20 kuMphala 2023 endzaweni yekugcina imphahla e-Dube Trade Port ngekhatsi kweSikhumulo Setindiza I-King Shaka.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlangela va SAPS eka ntirho wa vona eku kavanyeteni na ku herisa vugevenga lebyi hleriweke bya matiko hinkwawo lebyi xungetaka swinene vaaki va hina na tiko.

src: Emalangeni lamabili landvulela kutsatfwa kwaletidzakamiva, kwatsatfwa lenye i-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letinge-70 kukhonteyina eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi eThekwini.
tgt: Operation Safer Festive Season yi le ku humeseni mimbuyelo na maphorisa ma khomile vaehleketeleriwa vo hundza 140, ku katsa murhangeri wa vatirhi va le mugodini lava nga riki enawini, naswona va kumile swibamu leswi nga riki na mpfumelelo.

src: IKhabhinethi ishaya tandla ngemsebenti we-SAPS wekuphatamisa nekuhliphitwa kwetinhlelo tebugebengu emkhatsini wemave lokumisa kabi kakhulu imiphakatsi yetfu kanye nesive.
tgt: Riendzo ra Vulanguteri bya Murhangeri Khabinete yi amukerile Riendzo ra Vulanguteri bya Murhangeri eka Masipala wa Emfuleni, lowu landzeleke eka ku tihlanganisa na muganga hi nkarhi wa riendzo ra Xikombiso xa Nhluvukiso wa Xifundza ra 2022.

src: Umkhankaso lobitwa nge-Operation Safer Festive Season wetekuphepha ngesikhatsi semaholide sewuvele uveta titselo ngoba emaphoyisa sekabophe basolwa labangu-140, lebafaka ekhatsi longungcondvongcondvo wekumbiwa kwetimayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, nangekutsatsa tibhamu letingenawo emalayisensi.
tgt: Riendzo ra 2022 ro ya Emfuleni ri kumile timhaka ta ku hlayisiwa ka switirhisiwa hi xiyimo xa le hansi hi masipala Hi ku nghenelela ka Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo, ku vile na nhluvuko lowu xiyekaka eku tiviseni mintlhontlho ya switirhisiwa swa mati na nkululo leswi nga vanga ku wa ka sisiteme ya Vaal ya Mati ya Thyaka.

src: .IKhabhinethi ikwemukele Kuhambela kwaMongameli welive kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni lwekuyohlola kuchubeka kwemsebenti, lobekulandzelela emva kwetingcoco letabakhona nemphakatsi ngesikhatsi sekuchutjwa kweLuhlelo Lekutfutfukisa Tigodzi (i-DDM) nga-2022.
tgt: Ntirho wu endliwile ku antswisa mphakelo wa mati, ku tirha kahle ka xitirhisiwa xa mati ya thyaka naswona hi ndlela leyi swi herisa xiphiqo xa nkululo lowu khulukaka eswitarateni na le majarateni ya vanhu.

src: Kuvakashela e-Emfuleni nga-2022 kwaveta tingcinamba tekugcinwa kwesakhiwonchanti ngumasipala.
tgt: Nhluvuko lowu xiyekaka hi nkarhi wa riendzo wu katsa ku antswisiwa ka tiphayiphi to rhwala nhundzu yo tala na switichi swo pompa mati, ku pfuxetiwa na ku pfariwa ka magondzo, na ku tirhisiwa ka timboni ta le switarateni hi xitalo leswaku ku antswisiwa timboni na vuhlayiseki.

src: .Ngekungenelela kweLitiko Letemanti Netekuhlanta, kwaba nenchubekela embili leyabonakala ekubukeni tingcinamba letiphatselene netakhiwonchanti temanti kanye nekuhlanta letabangela kungasebenti kwe-Vaal Water Waste.
tgt: Kungu ra Sisiteme ya Vutleketli bya Nhundzu eAfrika-Dzonga Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli yi sungurile ku burisana hi Kungu ra Sisiteme ya Vutleketli bya Nhundzu eAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi xiphemu xa magoza yo tivisa mintlhontlho leyi langutaneke na sekithara ya vutleketli na nhundzu na ku tiyisa matshalatshala ya ku hlakarhela ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Kunemisebenti leseyentiwe kutfutfukisa kwabiwa kwemanti, kusebenta kahle kwetakhiwonchanti temanti langcolile kanye nekucedvwa kwenkinga yemangcoliso lagijima etitaladini nasemabaleni etakhamuti.
tgt: Nhluvukiso wa Switirhisiwa na Vuhlayisi Khabinete yi amukerile nhluvuko lowu endliweke eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa na vuhlayisi hi ku hetisiwa ka mabuloho ya 36 ya le makaya ehansi ka Weliziwe Rural Bridges, na ntirho wo aka lowu yaka emahlweni eka 20 wa tipurojeke eka vutshamo bya vanhu, magondzo, na mati.

src: Inchubekela embili leyabonakala ngesikhatsi salokuvakasha ifaka ekhatsi kuphuculwa kwemaphayiphi kanye netiteshi tekufutsa emanti lamaningi, kulungiswa nekuchitjelwa kwemigwaco, kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwekukhanyisa nekuphepha ngekutsi kufakwe emalambu etitaladini.
tgt: Ku sunguriwa nakambe ka (SAA) tindlela ta matiko ya misava ta Rivala ra Swihahampfhuka Afrika-Dzonga Khabinete yi amukerile ku sunguriwa nakambe ka tindlela ta matiko ya misava SAA hi ku sunguriwa nakambe ka xihahampfhuka xa yona xa le xikarhi ka matiko-nkulu ku ya São Paulo, Brazil, leti nga tlhela ti fungha ku vuya ka vukorhokeli bya mpfhuka wo leha ehandle ka Cape Town na Joni.

src: INkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika Litiko Letekutfutsa selicale tinkhulumo letimayelana neNkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika, lokuyincenye yetaba tekubhekana netingcinamba letibukene nemkhakha wetekutfutsa nekuhanjiswa kwemphahla kanye nekuciniswa kwemitamo yekuvusetela umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ku vuya ka SAA eka tindlela ta matiko ya misava ku ta hoxa xandla hi ku kongoma eka ku fambisa ku kula eka maendzo ya matiko ya misava etikweni, na ku kula ka sekithara ya vupfhumba endzhaku ka timhangu ta ntungu wa Covid-19.

src: Kutfutfukiswa Nekugcinwa Kwetakhiwonchanti IKhabhinethi iyemukele inchubekela embili leyentiwa kutfutfukiswa kanye nekugcinwa kwetakhiwonchanti ngekutsi kuphetfwe kwakhiwa kwemabhuloho langu-36 etindzaweni tasemaphandleni ngephasi kwemkhankaso i-Welisizwe Rural Bridges, kanye nekwakhiwa lokusachubeka kwemiklamo lengu-20 yetekuhlaliswa kwebantfu, imigwaco, kanye nemanti.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi simeka xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu lexikulu eAfrika Khabinete yi hoyozerile khamphani ya vusirheleri na swa swihahampfhuka Milkor eka ku simekiwa loku humeleleke ka xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu xa Milkor 380 (UAV), leswi vekaka Afrika-Dzonga exikarhi ka matiko lama yaka emahlweni ya hluvuka eka thekinoloji ya sisiteme ya xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu.

src: Kubuyiselwa Kwemizila Yekuya Kulamanye Emave Kwe-South African Airways (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kubuyiselwa kwemizila yekundizela kulamanye emave kwe-SAA ngekutsi kuphindze kucalwe tindiza emkhatsini welivekati kuya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, lokukhombise kubuya kwemizila lemidze lesuka e-Cape Town kanye naseJozi.
tgt: Milkor 380 i xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu lexi akiweke eAfrika naswona xi ta tirhisiwa hi vumaki bya vusirheleri ku sivela, vulawuri bya mindzilikano, matshalatshala yo hlayisa ku katsa ku sivela ku hlota swi nga ri enawini.

src: Lokubuyela kuletindlela tekundizela kulamanye emave kutawufaka sandla ekuphakamiseni kukhula kwekuhambela kwalamanye emave kuleli, kanye nekukhula kwemkhakha wetekuvakasha kulandzela umonakalo lowadalwa yi-COVID-19.
tgt: Metiriki na swikambelo swa le ku heleni ka Lembe Khabinete yi amukerile ku sungula ka kahle ka swikambelo swa (National Senior Certificate) Xitifikheti xa le Henhla xa Rixaka ( swa metiriki), leswi sunguleke hi ti 30 ta Hlangula 2023.

src: INingizimu Afrika isungula idroni lenkhulu kunawo wonkhe e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ihalalisele inkampani yaka-Milkor yeTekuvikela kanye netekundiza, ngekuphumelela kusungula I-Milkor 380, lekuyindizamshini lengashayelwa ngumuntfu, leyente kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibalwe kanye nalamanye emave lachubeka ngemandla kutebuchwepheshe bemadroni.
tgt: Vatswari na vahlayisi va vana va khutaziwa ku ya emahlweni va seketela vadyondzi hi nkarhi lowu wa nkoka.

src: Batali kanye nebagcini bayakhutsatwa kwekutsi bachubeke kusekela bafundzi ngalesikhatsi lesimcoka kangaka.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi navelela leswinene eka vadyondzi hinkwavo lava nga ta tshama eka swikambelo swa vona swa ku hela ka lembe.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Simo SasePalestine IKhabhinethi ijabhile ngekutsi hulumende we-Israyeli ale kuhlonipha umtsetfo wemave nekuchubeka kucekela phasi tincumo teNhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene tekumisa kulwa ngaphandle kwekujeziswa.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete Xiyimo xa le Palestine Khabinete yi khomiwile hi tingana hi ku va mfumo wa Israel wu arile ku hlonipha milawu ya matiko ya misava no ya emahlweni wu tekela ehansi swiboho swa United States leswaku ku simekiwa ku yimisiwa ka nyimpi handle ko xupuriwa.

src: Imizila yekuletsa lusito kubantfu basePalestine solo ivaliwe, intfo lenemiphumela lemibi kubantfwana, basikati kanye netakhamuti letingenacala.
tgt: Tiphaseji ta ku pfuna vanhu va Palestine ta ha pfariwile na mbuyelo wo chavisa eka vana, vavasati na vaakatiko lava nga riki na nandzu.

src: Lokugadla ngetindiza kwahulumende we-Israyeli lokucotfula bantfu basePalestine, kuyachubeka kantsi nesibalo salabafile lokufaka ekhatsi basikati nebantfwana siyenyuka.
tgt: Ku hlaseriwa hi swihahampfhuka loku dlayaka rixaka hi mfumo wa Israel eka vanhu va Palestine, ku ya emahlweni ku tlakusa nhlayo ya mafu leyi katsaka vavasati na vana.

src: Kulamalanga lamabili ledlulile, umhlaba bewumile ubuka ungakhoni kwenta lutfo ngekugadla emoyeni lokunemandla eGaza naseWest Bank lokubhubhise tikolwa, takhiwo temphilo, ema-ambulensi kanye netakhiwo teluntfu kanye nemigwaco lekutsiwa iphephile kuya eNingizimu neGaza.
tgt: Masiku mambirhi lama nga hundza, misava yi tshamile yi nga endli nchumu yi hlalela loko ku hlaseriwa Gaza hi swihahampfhuka na West Bank yi onhile swikolo, switirhisiwa swa rihanyo, ambulense na switirhisiwa swa vaakatiko na magondzo lama ku vuriwaka leswaku ma hlayisekile lama yaka eDzongeni ra Gaza.

src: Ngenca yaloku, iKhabhinethi itsetse sincumo sekubita bonkhe labaseTel Aviv labamele lelive kuze bacocisane.
tgt: Eka leswi, Khabinete yi tekile xiboho xo vitana vayimeri hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga ku suka Tel Aviv ku ta burisana.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yakubona kuchubeka kwetinkhulumo letinetinshanshu talolincusa le-Israyeli kuleli, Mnz.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi lemukile hi ku vilela hi ku ya emahlweni ka ku delela ka vayimeri va Israel eka Afrika-Dzonga, Tat.

src: Eliav Belotsercovsky, lebekatibhekise kutakhamuti teNingizimu Afrika, nakubaholi beNingizimu Afrika labakuhulumende kanye nangaphandle kwakhe, lokufaka ekhatsi imibutfo yeluntfu lekhuluma lokuphambene nalokubhujiswa kwebantfu basePalestine lokwentiwa nguhulumende we-Israyeli.
tgt: Eliav Belotsercovsky, loyi a lwisanaka na MaAfrika-Dzonga, vurhangeri bya Afrika-Dzonga hinkwabyo endzeni na le handle ka mfumo ku katsa vaaki vo va na xichavo lava vulavulaka hi ku lwisana na ku dlayeteriwa ka vanhu loku endliwaka hi mfumo wa Israel ku lwisana na vanhu va Palestine.

src: Letinkhulumo teLincusa Belotsercovisky letinekucekela phasi ticatsaniswa nalokwaphawulwa ngulabake baba ngemancusa e-Israyeli kuleli (Illan Baruch naDkt.
tgt: Marito yo delela ya Muyimeri Belotsercovsky ya hambanile hi switatimende swa khale ka vayimeri vambirhi va Israel eka Afrika-Dzonga (Illan Baruch na Dok.

src: Alon Liel) lebebangayekeli kuchaza tento tahulumende wabo kubantfu basePalestine batifananisa neMbuso Welibandlululo.
tgt: Alon Liel) lava nga cincangiki loko va hlamusela swiendlo swa vona hi mfumo wa vona ku lwisana na vanhu va Palestine tanihi xihlawuhlawu.

src: Letinkhulumo leticekela phasi letibhekiswe kulabo labaphumisela kuphambana kwabo nalokubulala lokunelunya kanye nebaholi balelive kwenta sikhundla saBelotsercovsky sichubeke kungameleki.
tgt: Marito yo delela ku kanetana na lava vulavulaka ku lwisana na tihanyi na varhangeri va tiko va endla xiyimo xa muyimeri Belotsercovsky ku va xi nga tiyiseleki.

src: Ngenca yaloko iKhabhinethi seyikhiphe umyalo wekutsi Litiko Lebudlelwane Kanye Nekuhlanganyela Nemave ledlulise kungaphatseki kahle kwahulumende weNingizimu Afrika ngalesento salelincusa lisebentisa tindlela tebuhlobo nalamanye emave.
tgt: Hi ndlela yeleyo Khabinete yi lerisile Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano ku hundzisela emahlweni mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga ku ka wu nga yimi na muyimeri hi ximfumo hi tindlela ta swa tipolitiki.

src: Inkhulumo Yenchubo Yemaphakelotimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini IKhabhinethi isemukele Sitatimende Senchubo Yemaphaketimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini (i-MTBPS), lesibeke elubala kuhlolwa kwesimo semnotfo saletinsuku yaphindze yabonisa kubambelela kwahulumende mayelana netimali talelive esikhatsini lapho kungena kwayo kunetihibe.
tgt: Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Bajete ya Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi Khabinete yi amukerile Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Bajete ya Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi xa 2023 (MTBPS) lexi nyikekeke nkambelo lowu nga erivaleni wa xiyimo xa ikhonomi ya sweswi naswona swi kombisile ku tiya ka mfumo eka timali ta tiko ra hina exikarhi ka swipimelo swo tika swa mali leyi nghenaka.

src: Tincumo leticuketfwe ngule-MTBPS tiyaluphakamisa luhlelo lwetimali temnyaka kukhutsatwa kwekukhula kwemnotfo kube kulinganisa nekutibophelela kwetfu eluntfwini lokusekela labo labasengcupheni esiveni sakitsi.
tgt: Swiboho swa MTBPS swi antswisa rimba ra timali ta swibalo swa hina xi hlohlotela ku kula ka ikhonomi ya hina loko yi karhi yi ringanisela ku tinyiketela ka vanhu va hina lava seketelaka lava nga hlayisekangiki etikweni ra hina.

src: Luhlelo Lwekuvusetelwa Nekwakhiwa Kabusha Kwemnotfo lusifakile sandla ekuhlumiseni umnotfo wakuleli.
tgt: Ku Pfuxetiwa ka Ikhonomi na Kungu ro Vuyisa swi hoxile xandla eka ku kula ka ikhonomi ya hina.

src: 3.Kwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu IKhabhinethi seyiphasise Luhlelo Loluluhlaka Lwekwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu kantsi imitselela yekucaliswa kwaloluhlelo kutawudzingidvwa Tindvuna Tetekutfutsa kanye Netetimali.
tgt: Nhluvukiso wa Swiporo swa Rivilo ra le Henhla Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Nhluvukiso wa Swiporo swa Rivilo ra le Henhla na swiringanyeto swa timali ku simeka ku ta kaneriwa exikarhi ka Vaholobye va Vutleketli na Timali Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhangisiwa ka phaseji ya Joni ku ya eDurban ku kuma dyondzo yo enta ya ku koteka, na Joni ku ya Polokwane ku ya eMusina, na Joni ku ya Mbombela yi ta vekiwa emakete.

src: IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kubekwa embili kwemzila losemkhatsini weJozi kanye naseThekwini kwekutsi kube neluphandvo loluyibukisisako lendzaba, kulapho imizila emkhatsini weJozi nePolokwane naseMusina, kanye nalesemkhatsini neJozi neMbombela yona itawufakwa emakethe.
tgt: Mpfampfarhuto wa Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Vuakatiko, Ku Rhurhela eTikweni Rimbe na Nsirhelelo wa Muhlampfa Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Vaakatiko, Ku Rhurhela eTikweni Rimbe na Nsirhelelo wa Muhlampfa ku va mani na mani a nyika mavonelo ya yena.

src: Umhlahlandlela WeLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kushicilelwa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela kuze sive sibeke imibono yaso.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa mpfampfarhuto wa Pholisi i ku nyika rimba ro letela ku nyikiwa vutshamo na vuakatiko eka vaakatiko va matikomambe, swin’we na nsirhelelo wa vahlampfa na vanhu lava lavaka vuchavelo eAfrika-Dzonga, hi ku tekela enhlokweni swilaveko swa vuhlayiseki bya rixaka ra Rhiphabliki na hi ku landzelela mintwanano ya matiko ya misava na mintwanano hi mayelana na ku rhurha loku Afrika-Dzonga ri nga xirho eka rona.

src: Lomhlahlandlela Wenchubo uhlose kubeka luhlaka lweticondziso tekuniketwa kwebuve nemvume yekuhlala kuleli kulabaphuma kulamanye emave, kanye nekuvikelwa kwalabakhosele kuleli laseNingizimu Afrika ngekubalekela timphi nekufuna kufihla inhloko ngenca yemphatfo yemave abo, ibe ingakhohlwa ngulokufunwa yiRiphabhliki mayelana netekuphepha kwelive ibuye ilandzele tivumelwano nenchubo yemave lecondzene netekuhamba emkhatsini wemave iNingizimu Afrika letibophelele kuko.
tgt: Xiviko xa Nhluvuko xa Lembe na Lembe xa vu 6 eka ku simekiwa ka Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu Lava Hanyaka na Vutsoniwa Khabinete yi pasisile ku kandziyisiwa ka phepha-hungu ra mfumo Xiviko xa Nhluvuko xa Lembe na Lembe xa vu 6 eka ku simekiwa ka Xiviko xa vulawuri eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu Lava Hanyaka na Vutsoniwa .

src: Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili Lomayelana Nekusetjentiswa KweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kutsi Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili ngekusetjentiswa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Ngemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile ushicilelwe kugazethi yahulumende.
tgt: Ku kandziyisiwa ka xiviko xa nhluvuko ku ta fambisana na nkhuvo wa xitsundzuxo wa matiko ya misava wa N’hweti ya Vulemukisi bya Timfanelo ta Vutsoniwa ku suka hi ti 3 ta Hukuri ku fika hi ti 3 ta N’wendzamhala.

src: Lokushicilelwa kwalombiko wenchubekela embili kutawucondzana nekugujwa kweNyanga Yekwatisa Ngemalungelo Alabakhubatekile lokucala mhlaka ti-3 kuLweti kuya kumhla ti-3 iNgongoni.
tgt: Xiviko xa nhluvukiso xi tlhela xi kombisa ntlakuko wa pakani ya ndzingano hi swa ntirho wa minimamu ku suka eka 2% ku fika eka 3% eka vanhu lava nga na vutsoniwa ku suka hi lembe ximali ra 2024/2025, ku ya eka pakani ya minimamu xa 7% ya ndzingano hi swa ntirho eka vanhu lava nga na vutsoniwa hi 2030.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo UMtsetfosivivinyo Loluhlaka weSikhwamamali Sekuvusetela i-Afrika Nekusebentisana Kwemave Ngemave (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kufakwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela we-ARLo Mtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kuchibela uMtsetfo we-ARF (Umtsetfo we-51 wange-2000) nekusungula i-Ejensi Yekutfutfukiswa Kwekubambisana eNingizimu Afrika, letawusetjentiswa njengendlela yekusekela kutfutfuka kanye nekubambisana kweNingizimu Afrika kanye nemave lahlobene nayo ngekuphakamisa inchubo yentsandvo yelinyenti, kubusa ngebucotfo, nekuncandza nekucatululwa tindzaba tembango eveni, kutfutfukisa tenhlalakahle nemnotfo kanye nekuhlanganyela.
tgt: Nawumbisi Ku Pfuxetiwa ka Mpfampfarhuto wa Afrika na Nawumbisi wa Nkwama wa Ntirhisano wa Matiko ya Misava (ARF) Khabinete yi pasisile ku nyikiwa ka Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca eka Palamende.

src: Kubekwa Etikhundleni Kutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu lavana na ku cinca Nawu wa ARF (Nawu wa 51 wa 2000) no sungula Nhlangano wa Ntirhisano wa Nhluvukiso wa MaAfrika-Dzonga, lowu nga ta tirha tanihi endlelo ku seketela nhluvuko wa Afrika-Dzonga na ntirhisano na matiko ma rikwerhu hi ku tlakusiwa ka xidemokirasi, mafumelo lamanene, ku sivela na ku lulamisiwa ka nkwetlembetano, nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki na ku hlanganisiwa.

src: Kubekwa kwa-MnuEbrahim Rasool esikhundleni sekuba nguSihlalo we-Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka Tat Ebrahim Rasool tanihi Mutshamaxitulu wa Bangi ya Nhluvukiso wa Dzongeni ra Afrika.

src: Kubekwa kwa-MkMargaret Mosibudi kuba lilunga le-National Nuclear Regulator Board.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka Man Margaret Mosibudi Phiri tanihi xirho eka Bodo ya Rixaka ya Vulawuri bya Nyutliya

src: Imicimbi Letako Ingcoco Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Ingcoco yekumelana nenkhohlakalo itawubanjwa mhlaka ti-8 namhla ti-9 kuLweti 2023 eHhotela i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni kutogcugcutela umphakatsi ekulweni nenkhohlakalo ngekuhambisana neNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni.
tgt: Swiendlakalo Leswi Taka Mbulavurisano wo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana Mbulavurisano wo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana wu ta khomiwa hi ti 8 na ti 9 Hukuri 2023 eHotela ya Birchwood eKurhuleni ku hlengeleta vaaki eka ku lwisana na vukungundzwana hi ku fambisana na Kungu ra Rixaka ro Lwisana na Vukungundzwana etikweni Khabinete, hi Hukuri 2020, yi pasisile Kungu ra Rixaka ro Lwisana na Vukungundzwana (NACS 2020-2030).

src: Ngenyanga yeLweti 2020, iKhabhinethi yaphasisa iNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni (i-NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: Kungu ra rixaka leri nga na xikongomelo xo endla muganga lowu pfumalaka vukungundzwana hi tlhelo ri ta va ri karhi ri khutaza vaakatiko ku ka va nga pfumeleri vukungundzwana na ku landzelela nawu.

src: Lena kuyindlela yelive lehlose kusungula umphakatsi longenankhohlakalo iphindze ikhutsate sive kutsi singayibeketeleli inkhohlakalo futsi sigcine umtsetfo lobekiwe.
tgt: Masiku ya 16 ya Pfhumba ro Lwisana na Madzolonga eka Vavasati na Vana 2023 Lembe leri ri fungha malembe ya 25 ya ku tlangela Afrika-Dzonga ku va ri nghenelerile eka Masiku ya 16 ya Pfhumba ro Lwisana na Madzolonga eka vavasati na vana leri nga ta xiximiwa ehansi ka nhlokomhaka: Ku hatlisisa mintirho ku herisa Madzolonga ya rimbewu na ku dlayiwa ka vavasati (GBVF): Ku nga siyiwi munhu endzhaku”.

src: Umnkankaso Wemalanga Langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kanye Nebantfwana wange-2023 Lomnyaka lesikuwo wekukhumbula minyaka lenge-25 yekuhlanganyela kweNingizimu Afrika kuloMkankaso Wemalanga langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati Nebantfwana lotawugujwa ngephasi kwesicubulo lesitsi: “Kukhutsatwa Kwetento Tekucedza Budlova Lobucondziswe Kubulili Lobutsite Nekubulawa Kwebasikati (i-GBVF): Asishiyi Muntfu Ngaphandle”.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ra misava hinkwayo ri ta sungula hi ti 25 Hukuri, Siku ra Misava Hinkwayo ro Herisa Madzolonga eka Vavasati ku fika ti 10 ta N’wendzamhala, Siku ra Timfanelo ta Ximunhu Misava Hinkwayo.

src: Lomkhankaso wemhlaba utawucala kusukela mhlaka ti-25 kuLweti, ngeLilanga Lemave Lekucedza Kuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kuze kube ngumhla ti-10 kuNgongoni, lekuLilanga Lemave Lemalungelo Eluntfu.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa rona i ku lwisana na madzolonga eka vavasati hi hala tlhelo ri seketela timfanelo ta ximunhu.

src: Lomkhankaso uhlose kucedza kuhlukubetwa kwebasikati kodvwa kube kuphakanyiswa emalungelo eluntfu.
tgt: Foramu ya vu 14 ya Pholisi ya Mbulavurisano Afrika-Dzonga yi ta rhurhela Foramu ya vu 14 ya Pholisi ya Mbulavurisano hi ku tirhisana na Ntlawa wa Ntirho wa Vadyondzisi Matiko ya Misava wa UNESCO wa Dyondzo (TTF) hi Sunguti ehansi ka nhlokomhaka “ ku vulavula hi nkayivelo wa vadyondzisi no endla leswaku ntirho lowu wu koka rinoko swinene”.

src: Umhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo INingizimu Afrika itawubambisana neLicembu Lemave laboThishela le-UNESCO (i-TTF) kusingatsa uMhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo ngenyanga yaBhimbidvwane 2024, lotawubanjwa ngephasi kwesihloko lesitsi “Kubukana nekungabikho kwabothishela ngalokwenele nekwenta lomsebenti wekufundzisa ube ngulokhangisako”.
tgt: Foramu yi ta hlanganisa vatirhela mfumo, tiNGO, vadyondzisi na vativi va dyondzo ku kanela timhaka ta nkoka leti khumbaka swiyimo swa ntirho eka vadyondzisi, timhaka ta ku tifuma ka mudyondzisi na vutihlamuleri xikan’we na ndlela yo endla leswaku ntirho wo dyondzisa wu koka rinoko swinene.

src: Lomhlangano utawubutsanisa tisebenti tahulumende, bothishela kanye netingcweti temfundvo kutodzingidza ndzaba letiphatselene nesimo sekusebenta kwabothishela, tindzaba tekukhutimela kwabothishela ekusebenteni kwabo kanye nekutiphendvulela nekwenta umsebenti wekufundzisa ukhangeke.
