src: Mengameli ucele baholi base-Afrika kusi bachubeke ngekwenta ncono emazinga ekucaphela kwemave awo macondzana nelubhubhane esikhatsini lesitako wakhutsata kutsi kwemukelwe Simo Lesicinile Lesifananako e-Afrika lesimayela Nekulungela Lubhubhane Nekuphendvula.
tgt: Puresidente u hlohlotela varhangeri va Afrika ku ya emahlweni va antswisa swiyimo swa switsunfdzuxo eka matiko ya vona eka mintungu leyi ya ha taka na ku hlohlotela ku tekela enhlokweni loku tiyeke ka Xiyimo Xin’we xa Afrika eka ku Tilulamisela na ku Angula eka Mintungu.

src: INingizimu Afrika itawusingatsa Licembu Lemashumi Lamabili (i-G20) neLihhovisi Lamengameli nga-2025 Ikhabhinethi yemukele futsi yacubungula umbiko lomayelana nemalungiselelo eNingizimu Afrika ekungenisa Ingcungcutsela Ye-G20 nga-2025 kanye nekutsatsa Lihhovisi Lamengameli.
tgt: Ku rhurhela ka Afrika-Dzonga Ntlawa wa Matiko ya Makumembirhi (G20) na Hofisi ya Puresidente hi 2025 Khabinete yi amukerile na ku xopaxopa xiviko eka ku tilulamisela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka ku rhurhela Nhlengeletano ya G20 hi 2025 xikan’we na ku teka ka Ndzawulo ya Puresidente.

src: Loku kutawuba ngumcimbi loyinchophamlandvo eNingizimu Afrika njengaloku itawuba ilive lekucala kutsi lapha e-Afrika isingatse umhlangano waloluhlobo hhayi kutsi awukavami nje kuphela ngenca yelinani lelilindzelekile kodvwa nangenca futsi yemtselela longapheli lokucatjangwa kutsi itawenta.
tgt: Lexi i xiendleko lexikulu xa Afrika-Dzonga tanihiloko ri ta va tikor o sungula ra Afrika ku rhurhela nhlengeletano yo tani ehandle ka leswaku yi hlawulekile hikwalaho ka tinhlayo leti languteriwaka kambe nakambe na hi nkoka lowukulu lowu yi languteriwaka ku wu endla.

src: Ikhabhinethi inelitsemba kutsi iNingizimu Afrika itayisingatsa ngemphumelelo leNgcungcutsela ye-G20, njengaloku ike yenta esikhatsini saphambilini emicimbini lemcoka lefanana neNgcungcutsela ye-Brazil, iRashiya, Indiya, iShayina neNingizimu Afrika (i-BRICS) kanye neKukhula kwe-Afrika Nenkhundla Yelitfuba Lekwenta.
tgt: Khabinete yina ku tshemba leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri ta humelerisa Nhlengeletano ya G20, tanihiloko ri swi endlile hi swiendleko leswikulu swo tanihi hi Nhlengeletano ya Brazil, Russia, India, China na Afrika-Dzonga (BRICS) na African Growth and Opportunity Act Forum.

src: Sikhundla sekuba nguMengameli we-G20 sinika iNingizimu Afrika litfuba lekuhola embili tifiso tetimakethe letisafufusa.
tgt: G20 hi Ndzawulo ya Puresidente yi nyka Afrika-Dzonga nkarhi wo tiyisisa ku navela ka rona ka timakete leti ta ha kulaka.

src: Njengaloku itawusingatsa i-G20, kutimbandzakanya kweNingizimu Afrika kulenkhundla kutawuchubeka kuholwe kutinikela kwalelive ekuchubeleni embili timfuno tavelonkhe talelive kanye netelivekati i-Afrika.
tgt: Tanihiloko ri rhurhela G20, ku teka xiave ka Afrika-Dzonga eka foramu swi ta ya emahlweni ku leteriwa hi ku tiyimisela ka tiko ku yisa emahlweni ku navela ka tiko xikan’we na lokuya ka tikonkulu ra Afrika.

src: Tincumo Tekhabhinethi Kusingatsa umhlangano Wemfica wemnyaka weLibhange Lentfutfuko Lensha (i-NDB) Ikhabhinethi yacubungula yaphindze yakuvuma kungeniswa kwemhlangano wemnyaka we-NDB lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngeNhlaba 2024.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete Ku rhurhela nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya Vukaye ya Bangi Yintshwa ya Nhluvukiso (NDB) Khabinete yi xopaxopile na ku pfumelela ku rhurheriwa ka nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya NDB eAfrika-Dzonga hi Khotavuxika 2024.

src: Sekuphele iminyaka le-10 kusukela emave e-BRICS asayina Imibhalo Yesivumelwane se-NDB eNgcungcutseleni Ye-6 ye-BRICS lebeyiseFortaleza, eBrazil mhla ti-15 namhla ti-16 Kholwane 2014.
tgt: Ku hundzile 10 ra malembe ku suka loko matiko ya BRICS ma sayinile Atikili ya Ntwanano wa NDB eka Nhlengeletano ya BRICS ya vu6 eFortaleza, Brazil hi 15 na 16 July 2014.

src: Loku kwaba sikhungo sekucala sentfutfuko yemave lahlukahlukene lasafufusa nalasatfutfuka.
tgt: Leswi swi sungurile nhlangano wa nhluvukiso wo sungula wa matiko lama ha hluvukaka.

src: Kute kube ngunyalo, iNingizimu Afrika seyifake tigidzigidzi letinge-R25 kulelibhange ngemali lekhokhelwe Yekucala Umsebenti.
tgt: Ku fika sweswi, Afrika-Dzonga ri hoxile R25 wa mabiliyoni eka bangi ku hakela Mali.

src: INingizimu Afrika yetsemba kutsi itawungenisa lomhlangano lomayelana ne-NDB bese itinikela ekusebentisaneni nalelibhange kanye nemave langemalunga alo kute kufezekiswe intfutfuko lesimeme neKwakha livekati i-Afrika lelincono.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri lamgutela ku rhurhela nhlengeletano ya NDB naswona ri tiyimiserile ku tirhisana na bangi xikan’we na swirho swa yona swa matiko ku fikelela nhluvukiso lowu tiyeke na ku tumbuluxa Afrika lero antswa.

src: Lisubuciko Lekucasha Tingcweti Tetinsita Tenhlalo (ema-SSP) Ikhabhinethi ilivumile Lisubuciko Lekucasha ema-SSP njengencenye yekwandzisa likhono lemtfombolusito webantfu lahulumende, letinhlangano letingekho ngaphasi kwahulumende kanye nemkhakha lotimele kute tiphendvule ngekucabanga kucala ngetinkinga tetenhlalo lelive lelibukene nato.
tgt: Qhinga ra ku Thoriwa ka Vatokoti va Vukorhokeri bya Vanhu (SSPs) Khabinete yi amukerile Qhinga ra ku Thoriwa ka SSPs tanihi xiphemu xo engetela vuswikoti bya vatirhi eka mfumo, mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo na swiyenge leswi tiyimeleke ku angula eka vubihi lebyi kongomaneke na tiko.

src: Lelisubuciko liyinhlanganyela yekutinikela lekwakha umkhakha wetinsita temmango lophendvula tidzingo temmango wetfu kanye nekuncoba tinkinga tetenhlalo njengebugebengu, budlova lobucondziswe kubulili lobutsite nekubulawa kwabesifazane, kukhulelwa kwelusha, buhonga, emakhaya laholwa bantfwana, kuphila kwengcondvo kanye nekusetjentiswa kabi kwetidzakamiva.
tgt: Qhinga leri i ku tiyimisela ka nhlanganelo ku aka xiyenge xa vukorhokeri bya vaaki lexi xi angulaka vukorhokeri bya le migangeni ya hina na ku hlula vubihi eka vaaki byo tanihi vugevenga, madzolonga ya le mindyangwini na xihlawuhlawu hi rimbewu, ku biha emirimi ka vantshwa, vunhenha, mindyangu leyi rhangeriwaka hi vana, mavabyi ya miehleketo na ku tirhisiwa ka swidzidziharisi.

src: Lelisubuciko lihlose futsi ekubekeni sisekelo lesifaka wonkhe wonkhe ngekwenhlalo kanye nelikusasa lelicinile nesive lesinakekelako.
tgt: Nakambe qhinga ri kongomisiwile eka ku aka masungulo ku katsa vaaki na vumundbzuku lebyi tiyeke na vutshamo lebyi hlayisaka.

src: Umtsetfo Lohlongotwako lomayelana neTimphesheni Ikhabhinethi yacubungula yaphindze yavuma kushicilelwa nekucela kutsi ummango ungenise kuphawula kwawo lokumayelana naloMtsetfo Lohlongotwako lomayelana neTimphesheni kulelive.
tgt: Phepha ra Rihlaza eka Nkatsakanyo wa Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu Khabinete yi xopaxopile na ku nyika mpfumelelo eka ku hangalasiwa na ku kombela mavonelo ya vanhu eka Phepha ra Rihlaza eka Nkatsakanyo wa Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu etikweni.

src: Leliphepha lalomtsetfo lihlose kwetfula luhlelo lolusemtsetfweni lwemphesheni yetenhlalo leniketa umhlalaphasi, tinzuzo tekukhubateka nekufa kubo bonkhe basebenti.
tgt: Phepha leri ri na xikongomelo xo sungula penxeni ya nsirhelelo wa vaaki lowu nyikaka mbuyelo eka ku tshika ntirho, vutsoniwa na mafu eka vatirhi hinkwavo.

src: Labahola umholo lophasi inkhokhelo yabo itawulekelelwa ngekuhambisana netimiso letikhona.
tgt: Lava va holaka mali ya le hansi tihakelo ta vona ti ta va na nseketelo ku ya hi swilaveko leswi nga kona.

src: Leliphepha leMtsetfo liphindze futsi lichubeke liphakamise kutsi kube nekuhambisana kwendlela yekutselisa kwebantfu lasebakhulile kanye neluhlelo lwesibonelelo sahulumende kute kulungiswe kuphatfwa ngalokungalingani kwebantfu lasebakhulile kulemikhakha lemibili.
tgt: Phepha ri ya emahlweni ri ringanyeta ku katsakanyiwa ka xibalo xa vadyuhari eka xibalo na maendlelo ya midende ku angula eka maendlelo ya nkandzingano eka vadyuhari eka swiyenge swimbirhi.

src: Kwengeta kuloko, leliphepha lweMtsetfo lihlose kuphakamisa tingucuko tesikhungo kute kugcugcutelwe bunye kunchubomgomo yekuvikeleka ngekwetenhlalo kute kube nekuphatsa ngelikhono, kwetfulwa kwetinsita lokuncono kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi kunekulawulwa ngemphumelelo, kuphatsa nekwengamela kuto tonkhe tinhlelembiso tekuvikeleka ngekwenhlalo.
tgt: Ku engetela, phepha ri lava ku pimanyeta ku cinca eka mihlangano ku kurisa mfambelano wa pholisi ya nsirhelelo wa vaaki leswaku ku va na mafambiselo ya kahle, mphakeo wa vukorhokeri lebyi antswaka na ku tiyisisa malawulelo lamanene, mafumelo na ku landzelerisa eka mintwanano hinkwayo ya nsirhelelo wa vaaki.

src: Tekucashwa
tgt: Ku thoriwa

src: Konkhe kucashwa kuncike ekucinisekisweni kweticu kanye nemvume yekufaneleka.
tgt: Ku thoriwa hinkwako ku ta lawula hi ntiyisiso wa tidyondzo na vubasisi lebyi faneleke.

src: Kucashwa kwaMnu Snike Thulani Sibuyi njengaMabhalane weLuphiko Lwemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka Tatana Snike Thulani Sibuyi tanihi Matsalani wa Ndzawulo ya Maphorisa eka Ndzawulo ya Vutsalani Ku thoriwa ka Tatana Xolile Sizani hi Mulawurinkulu (CEO) wa PetroSKu thoriwa ka Manana Nombulelo Guliwe tanihi Mulawurinkulu wa swa Vupfumba eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Kucashwa kwaMnu Xolile Sizani njengeSisebenti Lesikhulu (i-CEO) se-PetroSKucashwa kwaMk Nombulelo Guliwe njengeSisebenti Lesikhulu seTekuvakasha taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ku engeteriwa ka kontiraka ya Manana Totsie Memela-Khambula tanihi CEO ya Xiyenge xa Nsirhelelo wa Vaaki xa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Kwengetwa kwenkontileka yaMk Totsie Memela-Khambula njengeSisebenti Lesikhulu se-Ejensi Yesibonelelomali Sembuso.
tgt: Ku thoiwa ka Manana Mapatane Elizabeth Kgomo tanihi CEO ya Xiyenge xa Nseketelo wa Switirhisiwa swa Timasipala.

src: Kucashwa kwaMk Mapatane Elizabeth Kgomo njengeSisebenti Lesikhulu se-Ejensi Lesekela Takhiwonchanti Tamasipala.
tgt: Ku thoriwanakambe eka Bodo ya Nkwama wa le Xikarhi wa Eneji (CEF) na ku thoriwa ka Manana Ayanda Noah tanihi Mutshamaxitulu.

src: Kucashwa futsi kwiBhodi ye-Central Energy Fund (i-CEF) nekucashwa kwaMk Ayanda Noah njengaSihlalo.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka swirho swa Bodo ya Vupfumba ya Afrika-Dzonga: Ms Makhosazana Khanyile (Mutshamaxitulu) Adv Lizelle Dominique Jordaan (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu) Dr Gregory J Davids Tatana Ikaneng Ephraim Pilane Prof Motlhago Stella Bvuma Manana Nqabomzi Haya Tatana Rajesh Mahabeer Tatana Ayanda V Mazibuko Manana Maija de Rijk-Uys Dr Mzolisi Michael Toni na Manana Uveshnee Pillay tanihi muyimeri wa Ndzawulo ya Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba.

src: Kucashwa kwemalunga eBhodi Yetekuvakasha yaseNingizimu Afrika: Mk Makhosazana Khanyile (Sihlalo) Adv Lizelle Dominique Jordaan (Lisekela Lasihlalo) Dkt.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka Mutshamaxitulu na Museketeri wa Mutshamaxitulu wa Bodo ya Vahlayisi eka Independent Development Trust: Adv Kwazikwenkosi Mshengu (Mutshamaxitulu) na Manana Karabo Siyila (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu).

src: Gregory J Davids Mnu Ikaneng Ephraim Pilane Solwati Motlhago Stella Bvuma Mk Nqabomzi Haya Mnu Rajesh Mahabeer Mnu Ayanda V Mazibuko Mk Maija de Rijk-Uys Dkt.
tgt: Imbizo ya Puresidente ya Modelo wa Nhluvukiso wa Swifundzha (DDM) Puresidente u ta rhurhela Imbizo ya Puresidente ya DDM ya vu12 hi Ravumune, 7 Nyenyankulu 2024 eka Masipala wa Xifundzha xa Nkangala eMpumalanga.

src: Mzolisi Michael Toni kanye naMk Uveshnee Pillay njengemmeleli weLitiko Letekuvakasha.
tgt: Imbizo leyi yi hlanganisa varhangeri hinkwavo va swiyenge swinharhu swa mfumo ku ta tihlanganisa na vaaki eka swiphiqo swa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na ku ta endla makungu yak u antswisa ku antswisa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na nhluvukiso wa miganga endzhawini.

src: Kukhetfwa kwaSihlalo neLisekela Lasihlalo we-Board of Trustees of the Independent Development Trust: Adv Kwazikwenkosi Mshengu (Sihlalo) kanye naMk Karabo Siyila (Lisekela Lasihlalo).
tgt: Imbizo ya Puresidente ya DDM na maendzo ro landzellerisa swi vile kona eka swifundzhankulu hinkwaswo swa kaye tanihi matshalatshala yo tiyisisa ntirho lowu yaka emahlweni wa ku antswisa vutomi bya vaaki.

src: Imicimbi Letako Inyanga Yemalungelo Eluntfu Umgubho weNyanga Yemalungelo Eluntfu Nelusuku Lwemalungelo Eluntfu lonyaka mhla tinge-21 Indlovulenkhulu utakwendvulela umgubho wavelonkhe weMinyaka le-30 Yenkhululeko ngaMabasa.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vatshami hinkwavo va le ka Masipala ya Xifundzha xa Nkangala na tindhawu ta le kusuhi ku va kona eka Imbizo na ku burisana na varhangeri va vona va mfumo mayelana na swiphiqo leswi va khumbaka.

src: Ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Emashuminyaka Lamatsatfu eNhlonipho Nekugcugcutelwa Kwemalungelo Eluntfu”, Ikhabhinethi icela wonkhe wonkhe kutsi adlale indzima yakhe ekuciniseni emalungelo etfu eluntfu, kanye nekutsandza kakhulu inkhululeko yetfu nentsandvo yelinyenti, leyatfolwa ngelinani lelisetulu kakhulu.
tgt: Simphoziyamu ya Nhluvukiso wa Ntiyisiso wa Switirhisiwa eAfrika-Dzonga (SIDSSA) 2024 Sweswi swi le ka vufambisi hinkwabyo eka SIDSSA 2024,ley inga ta va kona eCape Town ku suka 17 ku fika 19 Nyenyankulu 2024.

src: LeMbizo ihlanganisa ndzawonye baholi labavela kuyo yonkhe imikhakha lemitsatfu yahulumende kutsi icocisane nebahlali macondzana netinsayeya tekuletfwa kwetinsita kanye nekubeka emasu ekutfutfukisa kuletfwa kwetinsita endzaweni.
tgt: SIDSSA yi hlanganisa vatekaxiave lavakulu eka xiyenge xa switirhisiwa lava va nga vona va nkoka eka ku hatlisisa magaoza ya vuvekisi bya switirhisiwa etikweni.

src: Imbizo Yamengameli kanye neLuvakasho lwekwengamela umsebenti kwenteke kuto totiyimfica tifundza njengencenye yemitamo yekucinisekisa umsebenti lochubekako wekutfutfukisa timphilo tetakhamuti.
tgt: Nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa wu vile wa nkoka eka mfummo na le ka Vufambisi bya VUtsevu, tanihi loko swi hoxa xandla eka ku kula ka ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela bahlali beSigodzi saMasipala waseNkangala kanye netindzawo letisedvute kutsi tihambele leMbizo kanye nekucocisana nalabamelele ummango mayelana netindzaba letibatsintsako.
tgt: SIDSSA yi ta kombisa yin’wana ya mihluvuko eku simekiweni ka Kungu ra Vuvekisi eka Switirhisiwa leri nga pfumelela hi Khabinete hi Mudyaxihi 2020.

src: Ingcungcutsela Yekutfutfukiswa Kwesakhiwonchanti Lesisimeme yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SIDSSA) yanga-2024 Bonkhe bantfu bamatasatasa ngemalungiselelo e-SIDSSA ye-2024, letawube ibanjelwe eKapa kusukela mhla ti-17 kuya mhla ti-19 Indlovulenkhulu 2024.
tgt: Khoniferense ya Vumbirhi ya Van’watifeme na Vaxaviselamatiko ya Vantima Khoniferense ya Vumbirhi ya Van’watifeme na Vaxaviselamatiko ya Vantima yi ta va kona Sandton Convention Centre eJoni hi Ravunharhu, 20 Nyenyankulu 2024.

src: I-SIDSSA itawuhlanganisa ndzawonye labatawudlala indzima lemcoka kumkhakha wetesakhiwonchanti labamcoka kutsi basheshise litubane lelutjalomali kusakhiwonchanti kulelive.
tgt: Khoniferense yi ta tiyisisa vuswikoti bya le henhla bya mabindzu na ku xixima mabindzu lama katsaka moya wo humelela na vutumbuluxi, na ku kombisa ku tumbuluxa mitirho, maendlelo lamanene ya swa mabindzu na nkoka.

src: Kutfutfukiswa kwesakhiwonchanti kube ngulokubekwe embili lokumcoka kutsi kucalwe ngako kwentiwa nguhulumende kanye neKuphatsa Kwesitfupha, ngobe kufaka ligalelo ekukhuleni kwetemnotfo nekudala imisebenti.
tgt: Ku tlula 600 wa tifeme ta vumaki ta vantima leti seketeriwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu, Vumaki na Mphikizano yi kombile mbuyelo wa ku tlula R80 wa mabiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2023/24, leswi kombaka mbuyelo wo khomeka eka ku tumbuluxa mabindzu ya vantima eka xiyenge xa ikhonomi.

src: Inkhomfa Yesibili Yabosotimboni Labamnyama Nebatfumeli Bemphahla Emaveni Langaphandle Inkhomfa Yesibili Yabosotimboni Labamnyama Nebatfulimeli Bemphahla Emaveni Langephandle itawubanjelwa lapha eSandton Convention Centre eJozi ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-20 Indlovulenkhulu 2024.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa na ku navelela swa kahle eka: Manana Michelle Phillips eka ku thoriwa ka yena tanihi Ntlawa wa CEO eka Transnet na Manana Nosipho Maphumulo tanihi Ntlawa wa Mutamerinkulu wa Nkwama eTransnet.

src: Lenkhomfa itawuhlonipha kuphuma embili kutemabhizinisi kanye nekuhlonipha emabhizinisi laluphawu lwemoya wemphumelelo netintfo letinsha, kanye nekukhombisa kudala imisebenti, inchubo lenhle lemukelekile nelizingagugu.
tgt: Ku thoriwa loku ku na nkoka eka ntirho wo yisa emahlweni ku aka nakambe vuswikoti eka Transnet tanihi xiphemu xa ntirho wo vuyisela vuswikoti bya tiko eka mindzhwalo, swifambo na vutleketli.

src: Emafemu langetulu kwe-600 abosotimboni labamnyama lasekelwe Litiko Letekuhweba, Timboni Nekuchudzelana akhombise inzuzo lelinganiselwa kutigidzigidzi letinge-R80 ngemnyakatimali wa-2023/24, akhombisa imiphumela lephatsekako ekuheheni bosomabhizinisi labamnyama abaningi kumnotfo wetetimboni.
tgt: Tatana Wamkele Mene, eka ku hlawuriwa nakambe ku va Matsalaninkulu wa African Continental Free Trade Area.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivakalisa kuhalalisa kwayo nekufisela lokuhle ku: Mk Michelle Phillips ekucashweni kwakhe njenge-Group CEO ye-Transnet kanye naMk Nosipho Maphumulo njenge-CFO ye-Transnet.
tgt: Tatana Sibusiso Ngalwa, Mutshamaxitulu wa sweswi wa Foramu ya Rixaka ya Vahleri va Afrika-Dzonga (SANEF), eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Komiti ya le Henhla ya African Editors’ Forum.

src: Lokucashwa kumcoka kulomsebenti lochubekako wekwakha kabusha likhono lekusebenta ku-Transnet njengencenye yemsebenti wekubuyisela esimeni likhono lalelive kutekutfutsa, tekuhamba ngesitimela nekuhambisa umtfwalo wemphahla.
tgt: Banyana Banyana, bolo ya milenge ya vavasati, eka ku hlula ka vona eka nenge wa vumbirhi wa CAF Women’s Olympic Qualifiers.

src: Mnu Wamkele Mene, ngekukhetfwa kwakhe njengaLobhala Jikelele weNdzawo Yekuhweba Lekhululekile Yelivekati Lase-Afrika.
tgt: Xipano xi winile milenge mimbirhi 4-0 hi ku angarha, naswona va ta hlangana na Nigeria eka rhengu ro hetelela hi Dzivamisoko 2024.

src: Kudzabuka
tgt: Ku chavelela

src: Ikhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo emndenini, kubangani nalasebenta nabo: Wakabuteni Simon Mkulu Bobe naLance Corporal Irven Thabang Semono weMbutfo Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika, labashone eDemocratic Republic of Congo (e-DRC) mhla ti-14 Indlovulencane 2024.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa ku chavelela ka yona eka maxaka, vanghana na vatirhikulobye va: Kaputeni Simon Mkhulu Bobe na Lance Corporal Irven Thabang Semon va Ndzawulo ya Vusirheleri ya Afrika-Dzonga, lava va nga dlayiwa eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) hi 14 Nyenyanyana 2024.

src: Bebayincenye yeMishini Yekutfutfukisa Ummango e-Afrika lengaseNingizimu e-DRC, leyatiwa ngalokwetayelekile kutsi yi-SAMIDRC, letfunyelwe kutsi ibuyisele esimeni kuvikeleka, kuthula nekutinta ngekulandzela i-Ajenda ye-AU “Yekubindzisa Tibhamu nga-2030.” Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yafisela kwelulama ngekushesha lamasotja lamatsatfu lalimele ngesikhatsi ahlaselwa.
tgt: A va ri xiphemu xa Southern African Development Community Mission eDRC, leswi tiviwaka tanihi SAMIDRC, lava yisiweke ku ya vuyisela vuhlayiseki, ku rhula na ntshamiseko ku ya hi AU Agenda ya “Silencing the Guns by 2030”.

src: Webantfu labayimfica baseMpumalanga labalahlekelwe timphilo tabo engotini yebhasi ePaulpietersburg, KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhatsi babuya embutsanweni waKhongolose lobewubanjelwe eThekwini.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi navelelea masocha laman’wana manharhu lava nga vaviseka leswaku va hatlisa va hola.

src: Tindzaba Letimcoka Telive Temnotfo.
tgt: Xiyimo Xa Khabinete Eka Timhakankulu Ikhonomi.

src: Kugcogcwa kwemtselo.
tgt: Ku hlengeletiwa ka mali.

src: IKhabhinethi incoma tigidzi tebakhokhi bemtselo labafake emafomu abo emtselo kute basite LuPhiko Lwetekugcogca Umtselo lwaseNingizimu Afrika kutsi lugcogce imali yemtselo lesigidzi setigidzi leti-R.155 ngemnyaka wetimali wa-2023/.
tgt: Khabinete yi bumabumela mamiliyoni ya vahakelaxibalo lava nga fayila tifomoxibalo ku pfuna Vukorhokeri bya Xibalo bya Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta mali ya xibalo ya R.155 wa tibiliyoni eka lembeximali ra 2023/.

src: Loku kungetulu kwesigidzigidzi lesinge-R52 salomnyaka lophelile futsi kukhombisa kusimama kwemnotfo wakuleli, nanome kunetimo takuleli netemave ngemave letitinsayeya.
tgt: Leswi swi tlula R52 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula lembe leri nga hundza naswona swi kombisa ku tiya ka ikhonomi ya laha kaya, hambileswi swiyimo swa laha kaya na swa matiko ya misava swi nga na ntlhontlho.

src: Imali lengenako lekhuphukile isita hulumende kutsi akhokhele imiklamo yelive yekuletfwa kwetinsita kanye naletinye tinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalomnotfo.
tgt: Mali leyi engetelekeke yi pfuna mfumo ku seketela hi timali tiphurojeke ta mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya tiko na minongonoko yin’wana ya nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele kuvulwa kwemklamo we-Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal lebita tigidzigidzi le-R3,4 esikhumulweni saseThekwini, lehlanganisa indzawo yekubeka imphahla lengemasikwemitha la-640 000, titeshana tetitimela kanye netindzawo tekubeka imphahla letivulekile.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka phurojeke ya R3,4 wa tibiliyoni ta Xiporo xa Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal eRibuweni ra Durban, leyi nga na 640 000 wa swikweremitara swa vuhlayiselo, matlhelo ya swiporo na vuhlayiselo lebyi pfulekeke.

src: Lesikhumulo lesisha sitawusita ekuhambiseni kahle kwemtfwalo elwandle, kujantji kanye nasemgwacweni esikhumulweni saseThekwini, futsi sisite kubukana netinsayeya takamuva lekuhlangabetwanwe nato kutekutfutsa, kusakhiwonchanti kanye nakunethiwekhi yetimboni.
tgt: Theminali leyintshwa yi ta fambisa ku fambafamba lokunene ka ndzhwalo wa le lwandle, swiporo na le magondzweni hi ku tirhisa Ribuwa ra Durban, na ku pfuneta ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya sweswinyana leyi nga hlangana na yona eka tiindasitiri ta vutleketli, switirhisiwa na netiweke.

src: Lolutjalomali luholele emisebentini yekwakha lecondzile le-4 013 kanye nekucashwa ngalokugcwele kwebantfu labangetulu kwe-1 000, kantsi lesibalo kulindzeleke kutsi sikhule njengobe lesikhungo sisingatsa imitfwalo leminyenti.
tgt: Vuvekisi byi endle leswaku ku va na 4 013 wa mitirho yo aka hi ku kongoma na ku thoriwa ka nkarhi hinkwawo ka vanhu vo tlula 1 000, laha nhlayo leyi yi languteriweke ku kula tanihileswi ndhawu leyi yi khomaka ndzhwalo wo tala.

src: Ekuvuseleleni inethiwekhi yajantji eveni letfu, iKhabhinethi iphindze yamukela kutsi i-Ejensi Yesitimela Lesilayisha Bantfu yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-PRASA) ibe nekubuyisela ngemphumelelo tinsitakalo letisihlanu letibalulekile te-Metrorail eGauteng, KwaZulu-Natal kanye naseNshonalanga Kapa.
tgt: Eku pfuxeteni ka netiweke ya swiporo swa tiko ra hina, Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela ku vuyiseriwa loku humelelaka ka Ejensi ya Switimela swo Rhwala Vanhu ya Afrika-Dzonga (PRASA) ya vukorhokeri bya ntlhanu bya nkoka bya Metrorail ku tsemakanya Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal na Kapa-Vupeladyambu.

src: I-PRASA ibuyisele ngemphumelelo imivila yayo lenge-31 kulenge-40 ekusebenteni kancane futsi isebentela kuzuza simo sekusebenta ngalokugcwele.
tgt: PRASA hi ndlela leyinene yi vuyisele 31 wa milayeni ya yona ya 40 eka ntirho wo karhi naswona yi le ku tirheni ku fikelela xiyimo xa ntirho hi ku hetiseka.

src: Lesigaba sikhombisa kutibophelela kwahulumende ekuvuseleleni tinsita tetitimela tebagibeli kanye nekuniketwa indlela yetekutfutsa umphakatsi lesebenta ngemphumelelo kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Nkoka lowu wu kombisa ku tinyiketela ka mfumo ku pfuxeta vukorhokeri bya switimela swo rhwala vanhu na ku nyika ndlela ya vutleketli bya mani na mani leyi tirhaka kahle eka MaAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Kulenye intfutfuko lehlobene naloku, iKhabhinethi yemukele simemetelo se-Ejensi Yavelonkhe Yetemigwaco yaseNingizimu Afrika sekutsi itawufaka imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi letinge-R50 ekutfutfukisweni kwesakhiwonchanti semigwaco eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Eka nhluvukiso lowu yelanaka, Khabinete yi amukerile xitiviso hi Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga leswaku yi ta nghenisa ku tlula R50 wa tibiliyoni eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa magondzo eKapa-Vuxa.

src: Lolutjalomali kusakhiwonchanti lucondziswe ekwakhiweni kwetikhungo letinsha, kutfutfukiswa nekuciniswa kwemigwaco, kanye nekulungiswa lokukhetsekile kwenethiwekhi yemigwaco yavelonkhe esifundzeni.
tgt: Vuvekisi lebyi bya switirhisiwa byi kongomisiwile eka ku akiwa ka switirhisiwa leswintshwa, ku antswisiwa ka magondzo na ku tiyisisiwa, na ku hlayisiwa ko hlawuleka ka netiweke ya magondzo ya rixaka eka xifundzankulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele kuvulwa kwesikhungo lesisha i-Tetra Pak KwaZulu-Natal nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, lesikhange lutjalomali lwetigidzi letinge-Kutjalwa kwetimali kuyincenye yeLugcugcutelo Lwemkhankaso weMengameli Welutjalomali lapho hulumende atibekela khona umgomo lophumelelako nga-2018 wekukhanga lutjalomali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R.2 eminyakeni lesihlanu.
tgt: Vuvekisi Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka ndhawu leyintshwa ya Tetra Pak eKwaZulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa, leyi kokeke vuvekisi bya R500 wa timiliyoni.

src: Lomnyaka lophelile ngeNkhomfa yesihlanu Yelutjalomali yaseNingizimu Afrika, leyaphawula kuphela kwetigaba tekucala temjikeleto wetfu wekugcugcutela lutjalomali, kwagcogcwa tibopho telutjalomali letingetulu kwetigidzigidzi letingu-Lokutjalwa kwetimali kugucukela ekubeni timboni letisha, imisebenti emiphakatsini kanye nemsebenti lomkhulu wetemnotfo eveni lakitsi.
tgt: Vuvekisi byi vumba xiphemu xa Pfhumba ro Hlengeleta Vuvekisi bya Phuresidente laha mfumo wu vekeke xikongomelo xa navelo hi 2018 ku koka rinoko ra vuvekisi bya R1,2 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula malembe ya ntlhanu.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi umkhankhaso wetfu welutjalomali utawuvuselela kukhula kwemnotfo futsi ukhuphule umnotfo wetfu.
tgt: Vuvekisi lebyi byi hundzuluxela eka tifekitri letintshwa, mitirho emigangeni na migingiriko leyikulu ya ikhonomi ku rhendzela tiko ra hina.

src: Loluhlelo lucinisekisa kutsi bantfu labasebasha kanye nalabafuna umsebenti bahlonyiswe ngemakhono ladzingekako kute bacasheke futsi batisungulele abo emabhizinisi.
tgt: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku pfhumba ra hina ra vuvekisi ri ta pfuxeta ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tlakusa ikhonomi ya hina.

src: I-UIF-LAP, letawusatjalaliswa eveni lonkhe, kulindzeleke kutsi idale ematfuba emsebenti kubantfu labangetulu kwe-704 000 labangasebenti.
tgt: Nongonoko Wo Tirhisa Vatirhi (LAP) Wa Nkwama Wa Ndzindzakhombo Wa Vaheleriwa Hi Ntirho (UIF)1.

src: Loku itawukwenta ngekuniketa kuceceswha kanye nekusekelwa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kumiklamo lenge-333 eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku simekiwa ka UIF-LAP, leyi nga phurogireme ya ndzetelo wa vuswikoti na vubindzurisi leyi kongomisiweke eka ku vuyerisa vantshwa na lava pfumalaka mitirho etikweni.

src: Imali lebalelwa etigidzini letinge-R.8 ibekelwe eceleni kute isetjentiselwe loluhlelo kantsi nematfuba emsebenti atawuba khona emkhatsini wetinyanga leti-12 naletinge-36.
tgt: Nongonoko lowu wu tiyisisa leswaku vantshwa na lava lavaka ntirho va hlomisiwile hi vuswikoti lebyi lavekaka leswaku va ta thoriwa na ku simeka mabindzu ya vona.

src: Kulokwetfulwa kwaloluhlelo kuphindze kwembulwa luphawu lolusemtsetfweni lweMinyaka lenge-30 yeNkhululeko, lokuluphawu lolutawusihlanganisa njengobe sigubha lesigaba lesibalulekile emlandvweni welive letfu.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku simekiwa ka xitsundzuxo xa 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko na Xidemokirasi, lexi khomeriweke ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “30 wa malembe ya Xidemokirasi, Ntirhisano na ku Kula”.

src: IKhabhinethi imema wonkhe umuntfu kutsi asebentise luphawu lolusemtsetfweni lolutfolakala ngetindlela letehlukahlukene kute lusetjentiswe kalula kuwebhusayithi ye-GCIS ku: WEBTOKEN2.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ku tlhele ku vona ku paluxiwa ka logo ya ximfumo ya Malembe ya 30 ya Ntshunxeko, leyi nga xikombiso lexi nga ta hi hlanganisa loko hi ri karhi hi tlangela xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka eka matimu ya tiko ra hina.

src: Lokwetfulwa kuphawula kucaliswa ngalokusemtsetfweni kwemisebenti letawutsatsa umnyaka wonkhe kugubha inchubekelembili lemangalisako lesesiyentile kusukela nga-1994 ekusunguleni umphakatsi wentsandvo yelinyenti losekelwe kuMtsetfosisekelo weRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996 kanye neMtsetfosivivinyo Wemalungelo.
tgt: Khabinete yi komberile un’wana na un’wana ku tirhisa logo ya ximfumo leyi kumekaka hi tifomati to hambana ku oloveriwa ku yi tirhisa eka webusayiti ya GCIS eka: WEBTOKEN.

src: Lomcimbi ubalulekile futsi ulitfuba lekucabanga ngetinsayeya letisasele futsi sitfole tindlela tekutincoba futsi sichubekisele live letfu embili.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ku funghe ku sunguriwa ka ximfumo ka migingiriko ya lembe hinkwaro ku tlangela nhluvuko wo hlamarisa lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 eku simekeni ka rixaka ra xidemokirasi leri simekiweke eka Vumbiwa bya Riphabliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 na Nawumbisi wa Timfanelo.

src: Sisebente kusukela nga-1994 kwakha umphakatsi losekelwe ebunyeni nakanyekanye, futsi nanome tisekhona tinsayeya letinyenti, timo tiba ncono kakhulu lilanga ngalinye lelindlulako.
tgt: Xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka xi tlhela xi va nkarhi wo anakanyisisa hi mitlhontlho leyi nga sala na ku kuma tindlela to yi hlula na ku yisa tiko ra hina emahlweni.

src: Inchubekelembili lenkhulu lesesiyentile kusukela nga-1994 ibonakala kuLubalo Lwebantfu lwanga-2022 kanye neluBuyeketo Lweminyaka lenge-30.
tgt: Hi tirhile ku sukela hi 1994 ku aka rixaka leri simekiweke eka vun’we na ku va swin’we, naswona hambileswi mitlhontlho yo tala ya ha riki kona, swiyimo swi antswisiwile hi ku angarhela hi siku rin’wana na rin’wana leri hundzaka.

src: Kokubili kudvweba sitfombe semphakatsi loseluhambeni futsi lesibonisa intfutfuko kuto tonkhe tinkhomba.
tgt: Nhluvuko lowukulu lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 wu kombisiwa eka Nhlayo ya Vanhu ya 2022 na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya Havumbirhi bya tona ti kombisa rixaka leri yaka emahlweni naswona leri kombisaka ku antswisiwa eka swikombiso swo tala.

src: Lokutfolwe Lubalo Lwebantfu kanye Nekubuyeketwa Kweminyaka Lenge-30 kukhombisa ngalokuphelele kutsi intfutfuko yetfu ayikatentakaleli, kodvwa idvwetjwe etinhlelweni tahulumende kusukela nga-19.
tgt: Swikumiwa swa Nhlayo ya Vanhu na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 swi kombisa hi ku hetiseka leswaku nhluvukiso wa hina a wu fikeleriwi hi xiwelo, kambe ematshan’weni ya sweswo wu fikeleriwa hi ku endliwa kusuka eka minongonoko ya mfumo ku sukela hi 1994.

src: IKhabhinethi yenta lubito kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemikhakha yemphakatsi kutsi itimbandzakanye ekugubheni Iminyaka lenge-30 yeNkhululeko kanye neNtsandvo Yelinyenti.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo na swiyenge swa vaaki ku nghenelela eku tlangeleni ka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko na Xidemokirasi.

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bangatimbandzakanya ngekucoca tindzaba tabo ngekutsi bekunjani kuphila eNingizimu Afrika yelubandlululo futsi basisite kutsi sakhele etikwetintfo lesitizuzile kute kube manje.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga va nga nghenelela hi ku vula switori swa vona eka leswi a swi ri xiswona ku va hi hanye eAfrika-Dzonga ra xihlawuhlawu na ku hi pfuna ku aka eka ku humelela loku hi ku fikeleleke sweswi.

src: Sincumo Semkhandlu Wemalungelo Ebantfu SaMhlabuhlangene (i-UN)3.
tgt: Xiboho xa Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN).

src: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela sincumo seMkandlu Wemalungelo Ebantfu we-UN lesenta lubito lwekutsi laka-Israyeli kumele litiphendvulele ngemacala etimphi langenteka kanye nebugebengu lobubhekiswe eluntfwini lokwentiwe eGaza.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela xiboho xa Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu xa Nhlangano wa Matiko lexi kombelaka leswaku Israel ri va na vutihlamuleri eka vugevenga bya nyimpi lebyi nga vaka kona na vugevenga byo lwisana na vumunhu lebyi endliweke eGaza.

src: Lesincumo siphindze “sicele tonkhe tifundza kutsi tiyekele kutsengisela, kundlulisa kanye nekuphambukisa tikhali, kwekudubula naletinye tintfo temphi kulaka-Israyeli”.
tgt: Xiboho lexi xi tlhele xi “kombela Matiko hinkwawo ku yimisa ku xavisiwa, ku hundzisela na ku hambukisiwa ka matlhari, swibamu na switirhisiwa swin’wana swa masocha eka Israel”.

src: Kwemukelwa kwalesincumo kungumlandvo njengobe kukwekucala ngca kutsi Umkhandlu Wemalungelo Ebantfu utsatse tinyatselo ngenhlekelele yebantfu lengakate ibonwe leyenteka eGaza, lapho sekubulawe khona lokungenani bantfu base-Palestine laba-32 975, lokuhlanganisa bantfwana labangetulu kwe-14 500, kusukela lapho live laka-Israyeli lahlasela emalangeni la-180 lendlulile.
tgt: Ku amukeriwa ka xiboho lexi i ka matimu tanihileswi ku nga rosungula swinene leswaku Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu yi teka magoza eka khombo ra ximunhu leri nga si tshamaka ri humelela eGaza, laha ku dlayiweke kwalomu ka 32 975 wa Mapalestina, ku katsa na vana vo tlula 14 500, ku sukela loko Israyele ri sungule nhlaselo wa rona eka masiku yo tlula 180 lama hundzeke.

src: Lukhetfo Lwavelonkhe Lwanga-20.
tgt: Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024.

src: Tonkhe tinhlelo setililungele lukhetfo lwavelonkhe nelwetifundza lwanga-2024, kulandzela kusayinwa kweNchubo Yekutiphatsa Yekhomishini Yelukhetfo ngemacembu etepolitiki kanye nalabangenele lukhetfo ngekutimela.
tgt: I tisisiteme hinkwato ti yaka eka Nhlawulo wa Rixaka na wa Swifundzankulu wa 2024, endzhaku ka ku sayiniwa ka Nawu wa Matikhomelo wa Khomixini ya Nhlawulo hi mavandla ya tipolitiki na vahlawuriwa lava tiyimeleke.

src: Lukhetfo Lwavelonkhe lutawubanjwa mhla tinge-29 iNkwekhweti 2024 kantsi linani lawo onkhe emacembu etepolitiki lange-325 atawuba yincenye elukhetfweni lwalomnyaka.
tgt: Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wu ta khomiwa hi ti29 Mudyaxihi 2024 naswona hi ku angarhela 325 wa mavandla ya tipolitiki ya ta nghenelela eka nhlawulo wa lembe leri.

src: Indlelanchubo Yekutiphatsa Elukhetfweni ibophelela bonkhe labangenele lukhetfo kutsi batfobele isethi yemitsetfo lehlose kucinisekisa lukhetfo lolukhululekile nalolungakhetsi.
tgt: Nawu wa Matikhomelo wa Nhlawulo wu boha hinkwavo lava phikizanaka eka nhlawulo ku landzelela xikatsa xa milawu leyi kongomisiweke ku tiyisisa nhlawulo lowu ntshunxekeke na ku lulama.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi sive sakitsi sitawuphindze sakhe etikwemlandvo wetfu wekubamba lukhetfo lwavelonkhe nelwetindzawo tasekhaya, lolutsembekile nalolukhululekile kusukela nga-1994.
tgt: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku rixaka ra hina ri ta tlhela ri aka eka rhekhodo ya hina ya ku khoma nhlawulo wa rixaka na wa miganga wa nkarhi na nkarhi, lowu tshembekaka na lowu ntshunxekeke no lulama ku sukela hi 1994.

src: Njengobe live ligubha Iminyaka lenge-30 yeNkhululeko, takhamuti tikhutsatwa kutsi tisebentise lilungelo lato lentsandvo yelinyenti futsi tivote.
tgt: Tanihi leswi tiko ri tlangelaka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko, vaaki va khutaziwa ku tirhisa mfanelo ya vona ya xidemokirasi na ku vhota.

src: INgcungcutsela Yahulumende Yekuhlakanipha Kwemshini Kwavelonkhe Bekwentiwa (i-AI)5.
tgt: Samiti ya Mfumo ya Rixaka ya Vutlhari byo Endliwa (AI).

src: Inftutfuko lesheshisako ku-AI ingiyo futsi i-AI ibumba umhlaba ngekusheshisa, lokwenta kube nesidzingo sekutsi emave alungiselele umtselela wayo etakhamitini nasetinhlelweni tekutiphatsa.
tgt: Nhluvuko wa xihatla eka AI i ntiyiso naswona AI yi vumba misava hi xihatla, leswi lavaka leswaku matiko ya tilulamisela nkucetelo wa yona eka vaaki na tisisiteme ta vulawuri.

src: Ingcungcutsela Yahulumende Yavelonkhe ye-AI yabitwa eJozi mhla tisiHlanu kuMabasa 2024 kute hulumende kanye nemkhakha bacale inchubomgomo neluhlaka lwekulawula kute kucondziswe futsi kukhutsatwe intfutfuko ye-AI kute kuzuze bantfu.
tgt: Samiti ya Mfumo ya Rixaka ya AI yi vitaniwile eJoni hi ti5 Dzivamisoko 2024 leswaku mfumo na sekithara ku sungula pholisi na rimba ra milawu ku kongomisa na ku tirhisa nhluvuko eka AI ku pfuna vanhu.

src: Tinchubomgomo te-AI tibalulekile ekwakheni luhlelonchubo lolucinile lwedijithali lapho bohulumende, emabhizinisi nebantfu ngabanye bangatfola khona tinzuzo.
tgt: Tipholisi ta AI i xilotlelo xo aka ikhosisiteme ya xidijithali yo tiya laha mifumo, mabindzu na vanhu va nga tshovelaka mivuyelo.

src: Lengcungcutsela isinyatselo sekucala sekuhlahla indlela lecacile leya embili ekusebentiseni emandla e-AI kubukana netinsayeya letitsite tetemnotfo netenhlalo taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Samiti i goza ro sungula ro hlela pulani ya maendlelo ya ndlela leyi nga erivaleni yo ya emahlweni eka ku tirhisa matimba ya AI ku lulamisa yin’wana ya mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi na ntshamiseko wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Bugebengu kanye nenkhohlakalo.
tgt: Vugevenga na vukungundzwana.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele kusayinwa kweMtsetfo wekuChibela tiNdzaba teMajaji, wa-2023 (uMtsetfo we-15 wa-2023).
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku sayiniwa ka Ndzulamiso wa Nawu wa Timhaka ta Vuavanyisi, wa 2023 (Nawu wa 15 wa 2023) leswaku wu va nawu.

src: LoMtsetfo wenta kusebente tincomo teKhomishini Yekubamba Umbuso Ngabhongwane futsi udala lelinye licala lelitawufakwa eMtsetfweni Wekuvimbela kanye Nekulwa Netento Tenkhohlakalo, wa-2004 (uMtsetfo we-12 wa-2004) ngekutfwesa bantfu licala lebugebengu ngekwehluleka kuvimbela inkhohlakalo.
tgt: Nawu wu nyika matimba eka xitsundzuxo xa Khomixini ya ku Vutliwa ka Matimba ya Mfumo na ku tumbuluxa nandzu wo engetela lowu nga ta katsiwa eka Nawu wa ku Sivela na ku Lwisana na Mitirho ya Vukungundzwana, wa 2004 (Nawu wa 12 wa 2004) hi ku khoma vanhu va ri na vutihlamuleri bya vugevenga byo tsandzeka ku sivela vukungundzwana.

src: LoMtsetfo futsi uhlose kuchibela iMitsetfo leminyentana lelawulwa Litiko Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa kweMtsetfosisekelo lokuhlanganisa emandla, imisebenti kanye nemisebenti yaLophetse Loyinhloko.
tgt: Nawu wu ya emahlweni wu kongomisa ku lulamisa Milawu yo hlaya leyi fambisiwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa ku katsa na matimba, vutihlamuleri na mitirho ya Mufambisikulu.

src: Letingucuko titawuvumela uMphatsi Loyinhloko kutsi adlale indzima lenkhudlwana yekugadza boNgcogcoshe Benkhantolo Lephakeme futsi kutawuholela ekuletfweni kwetinsitakalo lokutfutfukisiwe emphakatsini nakubasebenti betemtsetfo.
tgt: Ku cinca loku ku ta pfumelela Mufambisikulu ku teka xiave lexikulu xa vulawuri eka Vafambisi va Khoto ya le Henhla naswona va ta rhangela ku yisa eka mphakelo wa vukorhokeri lowu antswisiweke eka vaaki na le ka vatirhi va swa nawu.

src: Simo Sesikhwama Setingoti Temgwaco (i-RAF).
tgt: Xiyimo xa Nkwama wa Tinghozi ta le Magondzweni (RAF).

src: IKhabhinethi itfole umbiko lomfishane mayelana nekucaliswa kwekusebenta kwendlelalisu yekugucula i-RAF, lekuhloswe ngayo kwenta luhlelo lwetimali lube lula kube kwentiwa ncono kuphatfwa kwetinzuzo kanye nekukhokhelwa kwalabatfole tingoti.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku nyikiwa ka vuxokoxoko mayelana na ku tirhisiwa ka maqhinga yo hundzula eka RAF, leyi kongomisiweke eka ku olovisa sisiteme ya timali loko yi ri karhi yi antswisa mafambiselo ya mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka vatwisiwakuvava hi tinghozi.

src: Kungenelela lokubalulekile kube kwetfulwa kwesikhungo sekuchumana se-RAF, lesiniketa ngenkhundla yalabafaka ticelo te-RAF kute batfole lwatiso ngeticelo tabo ngaphandle kwekutsembela kubameli babo bemtsetfo kuphela.
tgt: Ku nghenelela ka nkoka ku vile ku simekiwa ka senthara ya vuhlanganisi ya RAF, leyi nyikaka pulatifomo eka vakomberi va RAF ku va na mfikelelo eka vuxokoxoko bya vona bya swikoxo handle ko titshega ntsena hi vayimeri va vona va nawu.

src: Inkhundla iphindze ivumele labafake ticelo litfuba lekucinisekisa tinkhokhelo letentiwa yi-RAF kubameli babo betemtsetfo.
tgt: Pulatifomo ley yi tlhela yi pfumelela vakomberi ku kuma nkarhi wo tiyisisa tihakelo leti endliweke hi RAF eka vayimeri va vona va nawu.

src: Indlelalisu yekugucula simo seyidale kutsi kube nentfutfuko lenkhulu ekukhokhelweni kweticelo kungakapheli emalanga la-120, kwehle tindleko temtsetfo ngemaphesenti lange-75 futsi sehlise tindleko tekwelaswha tisuka kutigidzigidzi le-R.6 ngemnyaka wetimali wa-2019/20 taya kutigidzigidzi le-R.1 ngemnyaka wetimali wa-2023/24.
tgt: Qhinga ro cinca ri endle leswaku ku va na ku antswisiwa lokukulu eka ku hakeriwa ka swikoxo ku nga si hela masiku ya 120, ku hungutiwa ka tihakelo ta swa nawu hi 75 wa tiphesente naswona ri vonile ku hunguteka ka tihakelo ta vutshunguri kusuka eka R.6 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2019/20 ku ya eka R.1 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2023/24.

src: Kungenelela kuphindze kwaholela ekuncipheni kwetindleko temtsetfo letingetulu kwetigidzigidzi letinge-R23 eminyakeni lemitsatfu yekucaliswa kwalendlelalisu.
tgt: Ku nghenelela ku tlhele ku yisa eka ku hlayisiwa ka mali leyi hlengeletiweke ya tihakelo ta swa nawu ku tlula R23 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe manharhu ya ku tirhisa maqhinga.

src: Ngetulu kwaloko, kungenelela kwaletindlelalisu kubangele ekwehlisweni kweticelo letikhokhelwa labafake tibito/ ticelo tesikhatsi lesifishane sibe tigidzigidzi le-R.3 esikhatsini lesiphela mhla tinge-31 iNdlovulenkhulu 2023.
tgt: Ku tlula kwalaho, ku nghenelela ka maqhinga ku endle leswaku ku hungutiwa swikoxo leswi hakeriwaka eka vakomberi/ vutihlamuleri bya nkarhi wo koma ku ya eka R.3 wa tibiliyoni eka nkarhi lowu helaka hi ti31 Nyenyankulu 2023.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yatiswa ngetichibiyelo temtsetfo kuloMtsetfo we-RAF wamanje, letisesigabeni lesisetulu.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi pfuxetiwa hi ku lulamisiwa ka milawu eka Nawu wa sweswi wa RAF, lowu nga eka xiyimo xa le henhla.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela we-RAF utawucutjungulwa baphatsi bahulumende wesikhombisa.
tgt: Ndzulamiso wa Nawumbisi wa RAF wu ta langutiwa hi vufambisi bya vu7 bya mfumo.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kuhlunga tinzuzo kanye netinkhokhelo letitsite nekwenta kube ngalokulinganako.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu kongomisiwile eka ku antswisa mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka swikumiwa swo karhi eka swipfuno swa mali na ku endla leswaku swi ringana.

src: Inchubomgomo ihlose kuniketa ngeluhlaka lwekucondzisa buve, kutfutsela kulelinye live kanye nekuvikelwa kwebabaleki, kucatjangelwa tinshisekelo tekuphepha kwelive kanye nekuhambisana netivumelwane temave ngemave kanye nemigomo yekuhamba iNingizimu Afrika leyincenye yako.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Vuakatiko, Vuhlapfa na Nsirhelelo wa Vahlapfa.

src: Itawuphindze ikhutsate tinshisekelo tetemnotfo taseNingizimu Afrika, lugucuko kanye nemitamo yekudala ematfuba emisebenti.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vuakatiko, Vuhlapfa na Nsirhelelo wa Vahlapfa ku tirhisiwa, endzhaku ka endlelo ro anama ra ku burisana leri endliweke hi Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya eka swifundzankulu hinkwaswo swa kaye.

src: Kubuyeketwa Kweminyaka Lenge-30 Yentsandvo Yelinyenti YaseNingizimu Afrika (1994-2024).
tgt: Ku Kongoma eka Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 wa Xidemokirasi xa Afrika-Dzonga (1994-2024).

src: IKhabhinethi igunyate kushicilelwa kwembiko “Kubuyeketwa Kweminyaka Lenge-30 Yentsandvo Yelinyenti YaseNingizimu Afrika (1994-2024)”.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku kandziyisiwa ka xiviko lexi nge “Ku Kongoma eka Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 wa Xidemokirasi xa Afrika-Dzonga (1994-2024)”.

src: Umbiko wekubuyeketa uveta indzaba yekugucukela kweNingizimu Afrika kuntsandvo yelinyenti kusukela elukhetfweni lolungumlandvo lwamhla tinge-27 kuMabasa 1994.
tgt: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi tivisa xitori xa ku cinca ka Afrika-Dzonga eka xidemokirasi ku sukela eka nhlawulo wa matimu wa ti27 Dzivamisoko 1994.

src: Indzaba yaseNingizimu Afrika yekundlulela kuntsandvo yelinyenti iyachubeka nekugcugcutela litsemba kubantfu labaningi emhlabeni jikelele, futsi umbiko wekubuketa ugcamisa tifundvo letibalulekile ekugucukeleni kuntsandvo yelinyenti yetfu.
tgt: Xitori xa Afrika-Dzonga xa ku cinca eka xidemokirasi xi ya emahlweni xi hlohlotela ntshembo eka vanhu vo tala emisaveni hinkwayo, naswona xiviko xa nkambisiso xi kombisa tidyondzo ta nkoka eka ku hundzuka ka xidemokirasi xa hina.

src: Kuleminyaka lenge-30 leyengcile, live litfole intsandvo yelinyenti letintile, lenetikhungo leticinile kanye nemtselela lomkhulu emhlabeni jikelele.
tgt: Eka malembe ya 30 lama hundzeke, tiko ri fikelerile xidemokirasi lexi tiyeke, lexi nga na mavandla yo tiya na nkucetelo lowukulu wa misava hinkwayo.

src: Umbiko Wekubuyeketa Weminyaka Lenge-30 uhlelwe etindzaweni letiyindzikimba leti-13 letisekelwe tinkhomba letine letibalulekile (1) teluHlelo Lekwakha Kabusha Nekutfutfukisa lwa-1994 kanye netinjongo talo letisihlanu (2) kwamukelwa kweMtsetfosisekelo wa-1996 (3) Luhlelo lweNtfutfuko lwaVelonkhe la-2012 kanye (4) Neluhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwesikhatsi Lesisemkhatsini wa-2019-2024 kute lubonise tintfo letibalulekile letisikhombisa tembuso wesitfupha.
tgt: Xiviko xa Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 xi hlengeletiwile eka tindhawu ta 13 ta nhlokomhaka leti tivisiweke hi swikombiso swa mune swa nkoka (1) Nongonoko wa ku aka hi Vuntshwa na Nhluvukiso wa 1994 na swikongomelo swa wona swa ntlhanu (2) ku amukeriwa ka Vumbiwa hi 1996 (3) Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka ra 2012 na (4) Rimba ra Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi ra 2019-2024 ku kombisa swilo swa nkoka swa nkombo swa vufambisi bya vutsevu.

src: Umbiko wekubuyeketa utawushicilelwa Litiko Letekuhlela, Kugadza kanye Nekuhlola futsi emalunga emphakatsi atawutfola litfuba lekucocisana ngalombiko.
tgt: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi ta kandziyisiwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vupulani, Vulawuri na Nkambisiso naswona swirho swa vaaki swi ta va na nkarhi wo nghenelela eka xiviko.

src: Imicimbi Letako Inkhomfa yeSitfupha ye-Commonwealth Red Cross kanye ne-Red Crescent lemayelana neMtsetfo Webuntfu Wemave Ngemave .1 INingizimu Afrika kanye neLikomidi Lemave Ngemave Le-Red Cross litawubamba ngekuhlanganyela Inkhomfa yeSitfupha ye-Red Cross ne-Red Crescent Commonwealth Yemtsetfo Wemave ngemave Webuntfu eNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla ti-15 kuya kumhla ti-19 kuMabasa 2024 e-Irene Country Lodge ePitoli.
tgt: Migingiriko leyi nga ta Landzela Khonferense ya vu6 ya Xihambano xo Tshwuka na N’weti wo Tshwuka ya Nhlangano wa Matiko eka Nawu wa Matiko ya Misava wa Vumunhu.1 Afrika-Dzonga na Komiti ya Matiko ya Misava ya Xihambano xo Tshwuka va ta rhurhela swin’we Khonferense ya vu6 ya Xihambano xo Tshwuka na N’weti wo Tshwuka wa Nhlangano wa Nawu wa Matiko ya Misava eAfrika-Dzonga ku sukela hi ti15 ku fikela hi ti19 Dzivamisoko 2024 eIrene Country Lodge ePitori.

src: Lengcungcutsela itawuhlanganisa bameleli bemave langemalunga e-Commonwealth, emalunga e-Red Cross kanye ne-Red Crescent, kanye nalabanye labatsintsekako lababalulekile batawukhulumisana ngeMtsetfo Webantfu Wemave Ngemave.2 Lenkhomfa ihlose kulungisa kabusha nekucinisa emathuluzi lakhona emalungelo ebantfu kanye nekujulisa lwati lwetfu ngekubaluleka kweMtsetfo Webuntfu Wemave ngemave esikhatsini setingcabano letinekuhloma letikhulako kanye nekuntjintja kwesimo selitulu, kungabi nekudla lokwenele kanye nekulahlekelana lokukhulako.
tgt: Khonferense yi ta hlanganisa vayimeri va Matiko ya Swirho swa Nhlangano wa Matiko, swirho swa nhlangano wa Xihambano xo Tshwuka na N’weti wo Tshwuka, na vatekaxiave van’wana va nkoka ku burisana hi Nawu wa Vanhu wa Matiko ya Misava.

src: KuhalaliselaIkhabhinethi indlulise kuhalalisela kanye netilokotfo letinhle ku: • ENdvuneni Yetemphilo Dkt.
tgt: Mahungu Ku hoyozelaKhabinete yi hundzisa mahungu ya yona yo hoyozela ni ku navelela mikateko eka:• Holobye wa Rihanyo Dkd Joe Phaahla eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Huvo ya Nkwama wa Misava hinkwayo ku sukela hi ti1 Mudyaxihi 2024.

src: Joe Phaahla ngekukhetfwa kwakhe ku-Bhodi Yesikhwama Semhlaba Wonkhe kusukela mhla lu-1 iNkwekhweti -2024.
tgt: Dkd Phaahla u ta tirha tanihi muyimeri wa xifundzankulu xa Afrika-Vuxa na Dzonga.• Mamozileme ya MaAfrika-Dzonga xikan’we na lava va nga emisaveni hinkwayo, ngopfungopfu ePalestina, hi xiendlakalo xa Eid al-Fitr.

src: Phaahla utawusebenta njengemmeleli wencenye yaseMphumalanga neyaseNingizimu yelivekati i-Afrika.• Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labangeMasulumane Kanye nakulabo labasemhlabeni wonkhe jikelele, ngalokukhetsekile labase-Palestine, emcimbini we-Eid al-Fitr.
tgt: Ramadan nakambe i nkarhi wa ku anakanyisisa endzeni, ku pfuna na ku tinyiketela ka ximoya loko Mamozileme ya lwela ku kula ka ximoya na ku tikhoma.

src: I-Ramadan nayo isikhatsi sekuzindla kwangekhatsi, kuphana nekutinikela ngekwemoya lapho emaSulumane alwela kukhula ngekwemoya nekutitsiba.
tgt: Nkhuvo wa Eid al-Fitr wu fungha makumu ya n’hweti yo kwetsima ya Ramadan, leyi hi nkarhi wa yona Mamozileme ma titsone swakudya siku na siku, naswona ehansi ka swiyimo swo tika swinene ePalestina.• Khomixini ya Mphikizano ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku wina masagwadi mambirhi eka Masagwadi ya ku Tsala ya Antitrust ya 2024 leyi khomeriweke eWashington DC na ku xiximiwa eka Vulavisisi bya yona bya Makete bya Tipulatifomo ta Vuhlanganisi bya le ka Inthanete lebyi rhangelaka.

src: Umkhosi we-Eid al-Fitr uphawula siphetfo senyanga lengcwele ye-Ramadan, lapho emaSulumane azile emalanga onkhe, nangaphasi kwetimo letimbi kakhulu ePalestine.• Ikhomishini Yetekuncintisana yaseNingizimu Afrika ngekuzuza imiklomelo lemibili ku-Antitrust Writing Awards ya-2024 lebeyise-Washington DC kanye nekuhlonishwa ngeluphenyo lwayo loluhamba embili lweTinkhundla teKuphenya ngeTinkhundla Tekulamula nge-Inthanethi.
tgt: Yi hlurile sagwadi eka xiviko xa yona xo hetelela na xiboho kasi sagwadi rin’wana a ri ri ra atikili ya dyondzo eka ku cinca-cinca ka mphikizano eka timakete ta xidijithali ta Afrika-Dzonga eka tendzo na vupfhumba.

src: Uzuze umklomelo wembiko wayo wekugcina kanye nesincumo kantsi lomunye umklomelo bewuwembhalo ngetemfundvo lomayelana nekugucugucuka kwekuncintisana etimakethe tedijithali taseNingizimu Afrika kutekuhamba netekuvakasha.
tgt: MichaveleloKhabinete yi yisa nchavelelo eka mindyangu ni vanghana va:• Tat Tony Heard (86), loyi a a ri nghwazi ya timfanelo ta ximunhu, ku nga ri na xihlawuhlawu, muteki wa mahungu wo xiximeka, muhleri la dzunisiwaka na khale ka mutsundzuxi wo hlawuleka eka Hofisi ya Phuresidente.• Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi joyina Phuresidente Ramaphosa ku hundzisela marito yo chavelela eka mfumo na vanhu va tiko ra Botswana endzhaku ka mhangu leyi hlomulaka mbilu ya bazi leri a ri rhwale vapfhumba va Paseka ku ya eMoria.

src: Emavi endvudvutoIkhabhinethi ivakalise kudzabuka kwayo kubangani nasemndenini: • U-Mnu Tony Heard (86), lobekayingcwele yemalungelo ebantfu, kungabandlululi ngekwelibala, intsatseli lehlonishwako, umhleli lohlonishwako nalobekangumeluleki lokhetsekile ehhovisi leMengameli.• IKhabhinethi iphindze yahlanganyela neMengameli Ramaphosa ekundluliseni emavi endvudvuto kuhulumende nakubantfu baseBotswana kulandzela ingoti lehlasimulisa umtimba yebhasi lebeyitfutsa emakholwa labekaya kuPhasika eMoria.
tgt: Hi Ravumune ra ti11 Dzivamisoko 2024, Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa na ntangha ya yena hi ntirho wa le Botswana, Phuresidente Mokgweetsi Masisi va endzele ndhawu leyi ku nga humelela mhangu ya bazi eLimpopo leyi nga dlaya vanhu va 45 laha ku nga pona ntsena n’wana wa malembe ya nhungu hi vukhale.• Tat Luke Fleurs (24), muntshwa, loyi a ri mutlangi wa le ndzhaku wa Kaizer Chiefs kasi tlhelo a ri khale ka mutlangi wa matiko ya misava wa le hansi, loyi a dlayiweke hi ndlela yo tihanyi hi nkarhi wa ku tekeriwa swilo.

src: Tindzaba Letimcoka Telive Temnotfo.
tgt: Xiyimo Xa Khabinete Eka Timhakankulu Ikhonomi.

src: Kugcogcwa kwemtselo.
tgt: Ku hlengeletiwa ka mali.

src: IKhabhinethi incoma tigidzi tebakhokhi bemtselo labafake emafomu abo emtselo kute basite LuPhiko Lwetekugcogca Umtselo lwaseNingizimu Afrika kutsi lugcogce imali yemtselo lesigidzi setigidzi leti-R.155 ngemnyaka wetimali wa-2023/.
tgt: Khabinete yi bumabumela mamiliyoni ya vahakelaxibalo lava nga fayila tifomoxibalo ku pfuna Vukorhokeri bya Xibalo bya Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta mali ya xibalo ya R.155 wa tibiliyoni eka lembeximali ra 2023/.

src: Loku kungetulu kwesigidzigidzi lesinge-R52 salomnyaka lophelile futsi kukhombisa kusimama kwemnotfo wakuleli, nanome kunetimo takuleli netemave ngemave letitinsayeya.
tgt: Leswi swi tlula R52 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula lembe leri nga hundza naswona swi kombisa ku tiya ka ikhonomi ya laha kaya, hambileswi swiyimo swa laha kaya na swa matiko ya misava swi nga na ntlhontlho.

src: Imali lengenako lekhuphukile isita hulumende kutsi akhokhele imiklamo yelive yekuletfwa kwetinsita kanye naletinye tinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalomnotfo.
tgt: Mali leyi engetelekeke yi pfuna mfumo ku seketela hi timali tiphurojeke ta mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya tiko na minongonoko yin’wana ya nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele kuvulwa kwemklamo we-Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal lebita tigidzigidzi le-R3,4 esikhumulweni saseThekwini, lehlanganisa indzawo yekubeka imphahla lengemasikwemitha la-640 000, titeshana tetitimela kanye netindzawo tekubeka imphahla letivulekile.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka phurojeke ya R3,4 wa tibiliyoni ta Xiporo xa Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal eRibuweni ra Durban, leyi nga na 640 000 wa swikweremitara swa vuhlayiselo, matlhelo ya swiporo na vuhlayiselo lebyi pfulekeke.

src: Lesikhumulo lesisha sitawusita ekuhambiseni kahle kwemtfwalo elwandle, kujantji kanye nasemgwacweni esikhumulweni saseThekwini, futsi sisite kubukana netinsayeya takamuva lekuhlangabetwanwe nato kutekutfutsa, kusakhiwonchanti kanye nakunethiwekhi yetimboni.
tgt: Theminali leyintshwa yi ta fambisa ku fambafamba lokunene ka ndzhwalo wa le lwandle, swiporo na le magondzweni hi ku tirhisa Ribuwa ra Durban, na ku pfuneta ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya sweswinyana leyi nga hlangana na yona eka tiindasitiri ta vutleketli, switirhisiwa na netiweke.

src: Lolutjalomali luholele emisebentini yekwakha lecondzile le-4 013 kanye nekucashwa ngalokugcwele kwebantfu labangetulu kwe-1 000, kantsi lesibalo kulindzeleke kutsi sikhule njengobe lesikhungo sisingatsa imitfwalo leminyenti.
tgt: Vuvekisi byi endle leswaku ku va na 4 013 wa mitirho yo aka hi ku kongoma na ku thoriwa ka nkarhi hinkwawo ka vanhu vo tlula 1 000, laha nhlayo leyi yi languteriweke ku kula tanihileswi ndhawu leyi yi khomaka ndzhwalo wo tala.

src: Ekuvuseleleni inethiwekhi yajantji eveni letfu, iKhabhinethi iphindze yamukela kutsi i-Ejensi Yesitimela Lesilayisha Bantfu yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-PRASA) ibe nekubuyisela ngemphumelelo tinsitakalo letisihlanu letibalulekile te-Metrorail eGauteng, KwaZulu-Natal kanye naseNshonalanga Kapa.
tgt: Eku pfuxeteni ka netiweke ya swiporo swa tiko ra hina, Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela ku vuyiseriwa loku humelelaka ka Ejensi ya Switimela swo Rhwala Vanhu ya Afrika-Dzonga (PRASA) ya vukorhokeri bya ntlhanu bya nkoka bya Metrorail ku tsemakanya Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal na Kapa-Vupeladyambu.

src: I-PRASA ibuyisele ngemphumelelo imivila yayo lenge-31 kulenge-40 ekusebenteni kancane futsi isebentela kuzuza simo sekusebenta ngalokugcwele.
tgt: PRASA hi ndlela leyinene yi vuyisele 31 wa milayeni ya yona ya 40 eka ntirho wo karhi naswona yi le ku tirheni ku fikelela xiyimo xa ntirho hi ku hetiseka.

src: Lesigaba sikhombisa kutibophelela kwahulumende ekuvuseleleni tinsita tetitimela tebagibeli kanye nekuniketwa indlela yetekutfutsa umphakatsi lesebenta ngemphumelelo kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Nkoka lowu wu kombisa ku tinyiketela ka mfumo ku pfuxeta vukorhokeri bya switimela swo rhwala vanhu na ku nyika ndlela ya vutleketli bya mani na mani leyi tirhaka kahle eka MaAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Kulenye intfutfuko lehlobene naloku, iKhabhinethi yemukele simemetelo se-Ejensi Yavelonkhe Yetemigwaco yaseNingizimu Afrika sekutsi itawufaka imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi letinge-R50 ekutfutfukisweni kwesakhiwonchanti semigwaco eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Eka nhluvukiso lowu yelanaka, Khabinete yi amukerile xitiviso hi Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga leswaku yi ta nghenisa ku tlula R50 wa tibiliyoni eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa magondzo eKapa-Vuxa.

src: Lolutjalomali kusakhiwonchanti lucondziswe ekwakhiweni kwetikhungo letinsha, kutfutfukiswa nekuciniswa kwemigwaco, kanye nekulungiswa lokukhetsekile kwenethiwekhi yemigwaco yavelonkhe esifundzeni.
tgt: Vuvekisi lebyi bya switirhisiwa byi kongomisiwile eka ku akiwa ka switirhisiwa leswintshwa, ku antswisiwa ka magondzo na ku tiyisisiwa, na ku hlayisiwa ko hlawuleka ka netiweke ya magondzo ya rixaka eka xifundzankulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele kuvulwa kwesikhungo lesisha i-Tetra Pak KwaZulu-Natal nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, lesikhange lutjalomali lwetigidzi letinge-Kutjalwa kwetimali kuyincenye yeLugcugcutelo Lwemkhankaso weMengameli Welutjalomali lapho hulumende atibekela khona umgomo lophumelelako nga-2018 wekukhanga lutjalomali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R.2 eminyakeni lesihlanu.
tgt: Vuvekisi Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka ndhawu leyintshwa ya Tetra Pak eKwaZulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa, leyi kokeke vuvekisi bya R500 wa timiliyoni.

src: Lomnyaka lophelile ngeNkhomfa yesihlanu Yelutjalomali yaseNingizimu Afrika, leyaphawula kuphela kwetigaba tekucala temjikeleto wetfu wekugcugcutela lutjalomali, kwagcogcwa tibopho telutjalomali letingetulu kwetigidzigidzi letingu-Lokutjalwa kwetimali kugucukela ekubeni timboni letisha, imisebenti emiphakatsini kanye nemsebenti lomkhulu wetemnotfo eveni lakitsi.
tgt: Vuvekisi byi vumba xiphemu xa Pfhumba ro Hlengeleta Vuvekisi bya Phuresidente laha mfumo wu vekeke xikongomelo xa navelo hi 2018 ku koka rinoko ra vuvekisi bya R1,2 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula malembe ya ntlhanu.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi umkhankhaso wetfu welutjalomali utawuvuselela kukhula kwemnotfo futsi ukhuphule umnotfo wetfu.
tgt: Vuvekisi lebyi byi hundzuluxela eka tifekitri letintshwa, mitirho emigangeni na migingiriko leyikulu ya ikhonomi ku rhendzela tiko ra hina.

src: Loluhlelo lucinisekisa kutsi bantfu labasebasha kanye nalabafuna umsebenti bahlonyiswe ngemakhono ladzingekako kute bacasheke futsi batisungulele abo emabhizinisi.
tgt: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku pfhumba ra hina ra vuvekisi ri ta pfuxeta ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tlakusa ikhonomi ya hina.

src: I-UIF-LAP, letawusatjalaliswa eveni lonkhe, kulindzeleke kutsi idale ematfuba emsebenti kubantfu labangetulu kwe-704 000 labangasebenti.
tgt: Nongonoko Wo Tirhisa Vatirhi (LAP) Wa Nkwama Wa Ndzindzakhombo Wa Vaheleriwa Hi Ntirho (UIF)1.

src: Loku itawukwenta ngekuniketa kuceceswha kanye nekusekelwa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kumiklamo lenge-333 eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku simekiwa ka UIF-LAP, leyi nga phurogireme ya ndzetelo wa vuswikoti na vubindzurisi leyi kongomisiweke eka ku vuyerisa vantshwa na lava pfumalaka mitirho etikweni.

src: Imali lebalelwa etigidzini letinge-R.8 ibekelwe eceleni kute isetjentiselwe loluhlelo kantsi nematfuba emsebenti atawuba khona emkhatsini wetinyanga leti-12 naletinge-36.
tgt: Nongonoko lowu wu tiyisisa leswaku vantshwa na lava lavaka ntirho va hlomisiwile hi vuswikoti lebyi lavekaka leswaku va ta thoriwa na ku simeka mabindzu ya vona.

src: Kulokwetfulwa kwaloluhlelo kuphindze kwembulwa luphawu lolusemtsetfweni lweMinyaka lenge-30 yeNkhululeko, lokuluphawu lolutawusihlanganisa njengobe sigubha lesigaba lesibalulekile emlandvweni welive letfu.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku simekiwa ka xitsundzuxo xa 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko na Xidemokirasi, lexi khomeriweke ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “30 wa malembe ya Xidemokirasi, Ntirhisano na ku Kula”.

src: IKhabhinethi imema wonkhe umuntfu kutsi asebentise luphawu lolusemtsetfweni lolutfolakala ngetindlela letehlukahlukene kute lusetjentiswe kalula kuwebhusayithi ye-GCIS ku: WEBTOKEN2.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ku tlhele ku vona ku paluxiwa ka logo ya ximfumo ya Malembe ya 30 ya Ntshunxeko, leyi nga xikombiso lexi nga ta hi hlanganisa loko hi ri karhi hi tlangela xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka eka matimu ya tiko ra hina.

src: Lokwetfulwa kuphawula kucaliswa ngalokusemtsetfweni kwemisebenti letawutsatsa umnyaka wonkhe kugubha inchubekelembili lemangalisako lesesiyentile kusukela nga-1994 ekusunguleni umphakatsi wentsandvo yelinyenti losekelwe kuMtsetfosisekelo weRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996 kanye neMtsetfosivivinyo Wemalungelo.
tgt: Khabinete yi komberile un’wana na un’wana ku tirhisa logo ya ximfumo leyi kumekaka hi tifomati to hambana ku oloveriwa ku yi tirhisa eka webusayiti ya GCIS eka: WEBTOKEN.

src: Lomcimbi ubalulekile futsi ulitfuba lekucabanga ngetinsayeya letisasele futsi sitfole tindlela tekutincoba futsi sichubekisele live letfu embili.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ku funghe ku sunguriwa ka ximfumo ka migingiriko ya lembe hinkwaro ku tlangela nhluvuko wo hlamarisa lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 eku simekeni ka rixaka ra xidemokirasi leri simekiweke eka Vumbiwa bya Riphabliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 na Nawumbisi wa Timfanelo.

src: Sisebente kusukela nga-1994 kwakha umphakatsi losekelwe ebunyeni nakanyekanye, futsi nanome tisekhona tinsayeya letinyenti, timo tiba ncono kakhulu lilanga ngalinye lelindlulako.
tgt: Xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka xi tlhela xi va nkarhi wo anakanyisisa hi mitlhontlho leyi nga sala na ku kuma tindlela to yi hlula na ku yisa tiko ra hina emahlweni.

src: Inchubekelembili lenkhulu lesesiyentile kusukela nga-1994 ibonakala kuLubalo Lwebantfu lwanga-2022 kanye neluBuyeketo Lweminyaka lenge-30.
tgt: Hi tirhile ku sukela hi 1994 ku aka rixaka leri simekiweke eka vun’we na ku va swin’we, naswona hambileswi mitlhontlho yo tala ya ha riki kona, swiyimo swi antswisiwile hi ku angarhela hi siku rin’wana na rin’wana leri hundzaka.

src: Kokubili kudvweba sitfombe semphakatsi loseluhambeni futsi lesibonisa intfutfuko kuto tonkhe tinkhomba.
tgt: Nhluvuko lowukulu lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 wu kombisiwa eka Nhlayo ya Vanhu ya 2022 na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya Havumbirhi bya tona ti kombisa rixaka leri yaka emahlweni naswona leri kombisaka ku antswisiwa eka swikombiso swo tala.

src: Lokutfolwe Lubalo Lwebantfu kanye Nekubuyeketwa Kweminyaka Lenge-30 kukhombisa ngalokuphelele kutsi intfutfuko yetfu ayikatentakaleli, kodvwa idvwetjwe etinhlelweni tahulumende kusukela nga-19.
tgt: Swikumiwa swa Nhlayo ya Vanhu na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 swi kombisa hi ku hetiseka leswaku nhluvukiso wa hina a wu fikeleriwi hi xiwelo, kambe ematshan’weni ya sweswo wu fikeleriwa hi ku endliwa kusuka eka minongonoko ya mfumo ku sukela hi 1994.

src: IKhabhinethi yenta lubito kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemikhakha yemphakatsi kutsi itimbandzakanye ekugubheni Iminyaka lenge-30 yeNkhululeko kanye neNtsandvo Yelinyenti.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo na swiyenge swa vaaki ku nghenelela eku tlangeleni ka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko na Xidemokirasi.

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bangatimbandzakanya ngekucoca tindzaba tabo ngekutsi bekunjani kuphila eNingizimu Afrika yelubandlululo futsi basisite kutsi sakhele etikwetintfo lesitizuzile kute kube manje.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga va nga nghenelela hi ku vula switori swa vona eka leswi a swi ri xiswona ku va hi hanye eAfrika-Dzonga ra xihlawuhlawu na ku hi pfuna ku aka eka ku humelela loku hi ku fikeleleke sweswi.

src: Sincumo Semkhandlu Wemalungelo Ebantfu SaMhlabuhlangene (i-UN)3.
tgt: Xiboho xa Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN).

src: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela sincumo seMkandlu Wemalungelo Ebantfu we-UN lesenta lubito lwekutsi laka-Israyeli kumele litiphendvulele ngemacala etimphi langenteka kanye nebugebengu lobubhekiswe eluntfwini lokwentiwe eGaza.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela xiboho xa Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu xa Nhlangano wa Matiko lexi kombelaka leswaku Israel ri va na vutihlamuleri eka vugevenga bya nyimpi lebyi nga vaka kona na vugevenga byo lwisana na vumunhu lebyi endliweke eGaza.

src: Lesincumo siphindze “sicele tonkhe tifundza kutsi tiyekele kutsengisela, kundlulisa kanye nekuphambukisa tikhali, kwekudubula naletinye tintfo temphi kulaka-Israyeli”.
tgt: Xiboho lexi xi tlhele xi “kombela Matiko hinkwawo ku yimisa ku xavisiwa, ku hundzisela na ku hambukisiwa ka matlhari, swibamu na switirhisiwa swin’wana swa masocha eka Israel”.

src: Kwemukelwa kwalesincumo kungumlandvo njengobe kukwekucala ngca kutsi Umkhandlu Wemalungelo Ebantfu utsatse tinyatselo ngenhlekelele yebantfu lengakate ibonwe leyenteka eGaza, lapho sekubulawe khona lokungenani bantfu base-Palestine laba-32 975, lokuhlanganisa bantfwana labangetulu kwe-14 500, kusukela lapho live laka-Israyeli lahlasela emalangeni la-180 lendlulile.
tgt: Ku amukeriwa ka xiboho lexi i ka matimu tanihileswi ku nga rosungula swinene leswaku Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu yi teka magoza eka khombo ra ximunhu leri nga si tshamaka ri humelela eGaza, laha ku dlayiweke kwalomu ka 32 975 wa Mapalestina, ku katsa na vana vo tlula 14 500, ku sukela loko Israyele ri sungule nhlaselo wa rona eka masiku yo tlula 180 lama hundzeke.

src: Lukhetfo Lwavelonkhe Lwanga-20.
tgt: Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024.

src: Tonkhe tinhlelo setililungele lukhetfo lwavelonkhe nelwetifundza lwanga-2024, kulandzela kusayinwa kweNchubo Yekutiphatsa Yekhomishini Yelukhetfo ngemacembu etepolitiki kanye nalabangenele lukhetfo ngekutimela.
tgt: I tisisiteme hinkwato ti yaka eka Nhlawulo wa Rixaka na wa Swifundzankulu wa 2024, endzhaku ka ku sayiniwa ka Nawu wa Matikhomelo wa Khomixini ya Nhlawulo hi mavandla ya tipolitiki na vahlawuriwa lava tiyimeleke.

src: Lukhetfo Lwavelonkhe lutawubanjwa mhla tinge-29 iNkwekhweti 2024 kantsi linani lawo onkhe emacembu etepolitiki lange-325 atawuba yincenye elukhetfweni lwalomnyaka.
tgt: Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wu ta khomiwa hi ti29 Mudyaxihi 2024 naswona hi ku angarhela 325 wa mavandla ya tipolitiki ya ta nghenelela eka nhlawulo wa lembe leri.

src: Indlelanchubo Yekutiphatsa Elukhetfweni ibophelela bonkhe labangenele lukhetfo kutsi batfobele isethi yemitsetfo lehlose kucinisekisa lukhetfo lolukhululekile nalolungakhetsi.
tgt: Nawu wa Matikhomelo wa Nhlawulo wu boha hinkwavo lava phikizanaka eka nhlawulo ku landzelela xikatsa xa milawu leyi kongomisiweke ku tiyisisa nhlawulo lowu ntshunxekeke na ku lulama.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi sive sakitsi sitawuphindze sakhe etikwemlandvo wetfu wekubamba lukhetfo lwavelonkhe nelwetindzawo tasekhaya, lolutsembekile nalolukhululekile kusukela nga-1994.
tgt: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku rixaka ra hina ri ta tlhela ri aka eka rhekhodo ya hina ya ku khoma nhlawulo wa rixaka na wa miganga wa nkarhi na nkarhi, lowu tshembekaka na lowu ntshunxekeke no lulama ku sukela hi 1994.

src: Njengobe live ligubha Iminyaka lenge-30 yeNkhululeko, takhamuti tikhutsatwa kutsi tisebentise lilungelo lato lentsandvo yelinyenti futsi tivote.
tgt: Tanihi leswi tiko ri tlangelaka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko, vaaki va khutaziwa ku tirhisa mfanelo ya vona ya xidemokirasi na ku vhota.

src: INgcungcutsela Yahulumende Yekuhlakanipha Kwemshini Kwavelonkhe Bekwentiwa (i-AI)5.
tgt: Samiti ya Mfumo ya Rixaka ya Vutlhari byo Endliwa (AI).

src: Inftutfuko lesheshisako ku-AI ingiyo futsi i-AI ibumba umhlaba ngekusheshisa, lokwenta kube nesidzingo sekutsi emave alungiselele umtselela wayo etakhamitini nasetinhlelweni tekutiphatsa.
tgt: Nhluvuko wa xihatla eka AI i ntiyiso naswona AI yi vumba misava hi xihatla, leswi lavaka leswaku matiko ya tilulamisela nkucetelo wa yona eka vaaki na tisisiteme ta vulawuri.

src: Ingcungcutsela Yahulumende Yavelonkhe ye-AI yabitwa eJozi mhla tisiHlanu kuMabasa 2024 kute hulumende kanye nemkhakha bacale inchubomgomo neluhlaka lwekulawula kute kucondziswe futsi kukhutsatwe intfutfuko ye-AI kute kuzuze bantfu.
tgt: Samiti ya Mfumo ya Rixaka ya AI yi vitaniwile eJoni hi ti5 Dzivamisoko 2024 leswaku mfumo na sekithara ku sungula pholisi na rimba ra milawu ku kongomisa na ku tirhisa nhluvuko eka AI ku pfuna vanhu.

src: Tinchubomgomo te-AI tibalulekile ekwakheni luhlelonchubo lolucinile lwedijithali lapho bohulumende, emabhizinisi nebantfu ngabanye bangatfola khona tinzuzo.
tgt: Tipholisi ta AI i xilotlelo xo aka ikhosisiteme ya xidijithali yo tiya laha mifumo, mabindzu na vanhu va nga tshovelaka mivuyelo.

src: Lengcungcutsela isinyatselo sekucala sekuhlahla indlela lecacile leya embili ekusebentiseni emandla e-AI kubukana netinsayeya letitsite tetemnotfo netenhlalo taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Samiti i goza ro sungula ro hlela pulani ya maendlelo ya ndlela leyi nga erivaleni yo ya emahlweni eka ku tirhisa matimba ya AI ku lulamisa yin’wana ya mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi na ntshamiseko wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Bugebengu kanye nenkhohlakalo.
tgt: Vugevenga na vukungundzwana.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele kusayinwa kweMtsetfo wekuChibela tiNdzaba teMajaji, wa-2023 (uMtsetfo we-15 wa-2023).
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku sayiniwa ka Ndzulamiso wa Nawu wa Timhaka ta Vuavanyisi, wa 2023 (Nawu wa 15 wa 2023) leswaku wu va nawu.

src: LoMtsetfo wenta kusebente tincomo teKhomishini Yekubamba Umbuso Ngabhongwane futsi udala lelinye licala lelitawufakwa eMtsetfweni Wekuvimbela kanye Nekulwa Netento Tenkhohlakalo, wa-2004 (uMtsetfo we-12 wa-2004) ngekutfwesa bantfu licala lebugebengu ngekwehluleka kuvimbela inkhohlakalo.
tgt: Nawu wu nyika matimba eka xitsundzuxo xa Khomixini ya ku Vutliwa ka Matimba ya Mfumo na ku tumbuluxa nandzu wo engetela lowu nga ta katsiwa eka Nawu wa ku Sivela na ku Lwisana na Mitirho ya Vukungundzwana, wa 2004 (Nawu wa 12 wa 2004) hi ku khoma vanhu va ri na vutihlamuleri bya vugevenga byo tsandzeka ku sivela vukungundzwana.

src: LoMtsetfo futsi uhlose kuchibela iMitsetfo leminyentana lelawulwa Litiko Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa kweMtsetfosisekelo lokuhlanganisa emandla, imisebenti kanye nemisebenti yaLophetse Loyinhloko.
tgt: Nawu wu ya emahlweni wu kongomisa ku lulamisa Milawu yo hlaya leyi fambisiwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa ku katsa na matimba, vutihlamuleri na mitirho ya Mufambisikulu.

src: Letingucuko titawuvumela uMphatsi Loyinhloko kutsi adlale indzima lenkhudlwana yekugadza boNgcogcoshe Benkhantolo Lephakeme futsi kutawuholela ekuletfweni kwetinsitakalo lokutfutfukisiwe emphakatsini nakubasebenti betemtsetfo.
tgt: Ku cinca loku ku ta pfumelela Mufambisikulu ku teka xiave lexikulu xa vulawuri eka Vafambisi va Khoto ya le Henhla naswona va ta rhangela ku yisa eka mphakelo wa vukorhokeri lowu antswisiweke eka vaaki na le ka vatirhi va swa nawu.

src: Simo Sesikhwama Setingoti Temgwaco (i-RAF).
tgt: Xiyimo xa Nkwama wa Tinghozi ta le Magondzweni (RAF).

src: IKhabhinethi itfole umbiko lomfishane mayelana nekucaliswa kwekusebenta kwendlelalisu yekugucula i-RAF, lekuhloswe ngayo kwenta luhlelo lwetimali lube lula kube kwentiwa ncono kuphatfwa kwetinzuzo kanye nekukhokhelwa kwalabatfole tingoti.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku nyikiwa ka vuxokoxoko mayelana na ku tirhisiwa ka maqhinga yo hundzula eka RAF, leyi kongomisiweke eka ku olovisa sisiteme ya timali loko yi ri karhi yi antswisa mafambiselo ya mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka vatwisiwakuvava hi tinghozi.

src: Kungenelela lokubalulekile kube kwetfulwa kwesikhungo sekuchumana se-RAF, lesiniketa ngenkhundla yalabafaka ticelo te-RAF kute batfole lwatiso ngeticelo tabo ngaphandle kwekutsembela kubameli babo bemtsetfo kuphela.
tgt: Ku nghenelela ka nkoka ku vile ku simekiwa ka senthara ya vuhlanganisi ya RAF, leyi nyikaka pulatifomo eka vakomberi va RAF ku va na mfikelelo eka vuxokoxoko bya vona bya swikoxo handle ko titshega ntsena hi vayimeri va vona va nawu.

src: Inkhundla iphindze ivumele labafake ticelo litfuba lekucinisekisa tinkhokhelo letentiwa yi-RAF kubameli babo betemtsetfo.
tgt: Pulatifomo ley yi tlhela yi pfumelela vakomberi ku kuma nkarhi wo tiyisisa tihakelo leti endliweke hi RAF eka vayimeri va vona va nawu.

src: Indlelalisu yekugucula simo seyidale kutsi kube nentfutfuko lenkhulu ekukhokhelweni kweticelo kungakapheli emalanga la-120, kwehle tindleko temtsetfo ngemaphesenti lange-75 futsi sehlise tindleko tekwelaswha tisuka kutigidzigidzi le-R.6 ngemnyaka wetimali wa-2019/20 taya kutigidzigidzi le-R.1 ngemnyaka wetimali wa-2023/24.
tgt: Qhinga ro cinca ri endle leswaku ku va na ku antswisiwa lokukulu eka ku hakeriwa ka swikoxo ku nga si hela masiku ya 120, ku hungutiwa ka tihakelo ta swa nawu hi 75 wa tiphesente naswona ri vonile ku hunguteka ka tihakelo ta vutshunguri kusuka eka R.6 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2019/20 ku ya eka R.1 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2023/24.

src: Kungenelela kuphindze kwaholela ekuncipheni kwetindleko temtsetfo letingetulu kwetigidzigidzi letinge-R23 eminyakeni lemitsatfu yekucaliswa kwalendlelalisu.
tgt: Ku nghenelela ku tlhele ku yisa eka ku hlayisiwa ka mali leyi hlengeletiweke ya tihakelo ta swa nawu ku tlula R23 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe manharhu ya ku tirhisa maqhinga.

src: Ngetulu kwaloko, kungenelela kwaletindlelalisu kubangele ekwehlisweni kweticelo letikhokhelwa labafake tibito/ ticelo tesikhatsi lesifishane sibe tigidzigidzi le-R.3 esikhatsini lesiphela mhla tinge-31 iNdlovulenkhulu 2023.
tgt: Ku tlula kwalaho, ku nghenelela ka maqhinga ku endle leswaku ku hungutiwa swikoxo leswi hakeriwaka eka vakomberi/ vutihlamuleri bya nkarhi wo koma ku ya eka R.3 wa tibiliyoni eka nkarhi lowu helaka hi ti31 Nyenyankulu 2023.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yatiswa ngetichibiyelo temtsetfo kuloMtsetfo we-RAF wamanje, letisesigabeni lesisetulu.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi pfuxetiwa hi ku lulamisiwa ka milawu eka Nawu wa sweswi wa RAF, lowu nga eka xiyimo xa le henhla.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela we-RAF utawucutjungulwa baphatsi bahulumende wesikhombisa.
tgt: Ndzulamiso wa Nawumbisi wa RAF wu ta langutiwa hi vufambisi bya vu7 bya mfumo.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kuhlunga tinzuzo kanye netinkhokhelo letitsite nekwenta kube ngalokulinganako.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu kongomisiwile eka ku antswisa mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka swikumiwa swo karhi eka swipfuno swa mali na ku endla leswaku swi ringana.

src: Inchubomgomo ihlose kuniketa ngeluhlaka lwekucondzisa buve, kutfutsela kulelinye live kanye nekuvikelwa kwebabaleki, kucatjangelwa tinshisekelo tekuphepha kwelive kanye nekuhambisana netivumelwane temave ngemave kanye nemigomo yekuhamba iNingizimu Afrika leyincenye yako.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Vuakatiko, Vuhlapfa na Nsirhelelo wa Vahlapfa.

src: Itawuphindze ikhutsate tinshisekelo tetemnotfo taseNingizimu Afrika, lugucuko kanye nemitamo yekudala ematfuba emisebenti.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vuakatiko, Vuhlapfa na Nsirhelelo wa Vahlapfa ku tirhisiwa, endzhaku ka endlelo ro anama ra ku burisana leri endliweke hi Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya eka swifundzankulu hinkwaswo swa kaye.

src: Kubuyeketwa Kweminyaka Lenge-30 Yentsandvo Yelinyenti YaseNingizimu Afrika (1994-2024).
tgt: Ku Kongoma eka Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 wa Xidemokirasi xa Afrika-Dzonga (1994-2024).

src: IKhabhinethi igunyate kushicilelwa kwembiko “Kubuyeketwa Kweminyaka Lenge-30 Yentsandvo Yelinyenti YaseNingizimu Afrika (1994-2024)”.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku kandziyisiwa ka xiviko lexi nge “Ku Kongoma eka Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 wa Xidemokirasi xa Afrika-Dzonga (1994-2024)”.

src: Umbiko wekubuyeketa uveta indzaba yekugucukela kweNingizimu Afrika kuntsandvo yelinyenti kusukela elukhetfweni lolungumlandvo lwamhla tinge-27 kuMabasa 1994.
tgt: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi tivisa xitori xa ku cinca ka Afrika-Dzonga eka xidemokirasi ku sukela eka nhlawulo wa matimu wa ti27 Dzivamisoko 1994.

src: Indzaba yaseNingizimu Afrika yekundlulela kuntsandvo yelinyenti iyachubeka nekugcugcutela litsemba kubantfu labaningi emhlabeni jikelele, futsi umbiko wekubuketa ugcamisa tifundvo letibalulekile ekugucukeleni kuntsandvo yelinyenti yetfu.
tgt: Xitori xa Afrika-Dzonga xa ku cinca eka xidemokirasi xi ya emahlweni xi hlohlotela ntshembo eka vanhu vo tala emisaveni hinkwayo, naswona xiviko xa nkambisiso xi kombisa tidyondzo ta nkoka eka ku hundzuka ka xidemokirasi xa hina.

src: Kuleminyaka lenge-30 leyengcile, live litfole intsandvo yelinyenti letintile, lenetikhungo leticinile kanye nemtselela lomkhulu emhlabeni jikelele.
tgt: Eka malembe ya 30 lama hundzeke, tiko ri fikelerile xidemokirasi lexi tiyeke, lexi nga na mavandla yo tiya na nkucetelo lowukulu wa misava hinkwayo.

src: Umbiko Wekubuyeketa Weminyaka Lenge-30 uhlelwe etindzaweni letiyindzikimba leti-13 letisekelwe tinkhomba letine letibalulekile (1) teluHlelo Lekwakha Kabusha Nekutfutfukisa lwa-1994 kanye netinjongo talo letisihlanu (2) kwamukelwa kweMtsetfosisekelo wa-1996 (3) Luhlelo lweNtfutfuko lwaVelonkhe la-2012 kanye (4) Neluhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwesikhatsi Lesisemkhatsini wa-2019-2024 kute lubonise tintfo letibalulekile letisikhombisa tembuso wesitfupha.
tgt: Xiviko xa Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 xi hlengeletiwile eka tindhawu ta 13 ta nhlokomhaka leti tivisiweke hi swikombiso swa mune swa nkoka (1) Nongonoko wa ku aka hi Vuntshwa na Nhluvukiso wa 1994 na swikongomelo swa wona swa ntlhanu (2) ku amukeriwa ka Vumbiwa hi 1996 (3) Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka ra 2012 na (4) Rimba ra Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi ra 2019-2024 ku kombisa swilo swa nkoka swa nkombo swa vufambisi bya vutsevu.

src: Umbiko wekubuyeketa utawushicilelwa Litiko Letekuhlela, Kugadza kanye Nekuhlola futsi emalunga emphakatsi atawutfola litfuba lekucocisana ngalombiko.
tgt: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi ta kandziyisiwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vupulani, Vulawuri na Nkambisiso naswona swirho swa vaaki swi ta va na nkarhi wo nghenelela eka xiviko.

src: Imicimbi Letako Inkhomfa yeSitfupha ye-Commonwealth Red Cross kanye ne-Red Crescent lemayelana neMtsetfo Webuntfu Wemave Ngemave .1 INingizimu Afrika kanye neLikomidi Lemave Ngemave Le-Red Cross litawubamba ngekuhlanganyela Inkhomfa yeSitfupha ye-Red Cross ne-Red Crescent Commonwealth Yemtsetfo Wemave ngemave Webuntfu eNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla ti-15 kuya kumhla ti-19 kuMabasa 2024 e-Irene Country Lodge ePitoli.
tgt: Migingiriko leyi nga ta Landzela Khonferense ya vu6 ya Xihambano xo Tshwuka na N’weti wo Tshwuka ya Nhlangano wa Matiko eka Nawu wa Matiko ya Misava wa Vumunhu.1 Afrika-Dzonga na Komiti ya Matiko ya Misava ya Xihambano xo Tshwuka va ta rhurhela swin’we Khonferense ya vu6 ya Xihambano xo Tshwuka na N’weti wo Tshwuka wa Nhlangano wa Nawu wa Matiko ya Misava eAfrika-Dzonga ku sukela hi ti15 ku fikela hi ti19 Dzivamisoko 2024 eIrene Country Lodge ePitori.

src: Lengcungcutsela itawuhlanganisa bameleli bemave langemalunga e-Commonwealth, emalunga e-Red Cross kanye ne-Red Crescent, kanye nalabanye labatsintsekako lababalulekile batawukhulumisana ngeMtsetfo Webantfu Wemave Ngemave.2 Lenkhomfa ihlose kulungisa kabusha nekucinisa emathuluzi lakhona emalungelo ebantfu kanye nekujulisa lwati lwetfu ngekubaluleka kweMtsetfo Webuntfu Wemave ngemave esikhatsini setingcabano letinekuhloma letikhulako kanye nekuntjintja kwesimo selitulu, kungabi nekudla lokwenele kanye nekulahlekelana lokukhulako.
tgt: Khonferense yi ta hlanganisa vayimeri va Matiko ya Swirho swa Nhlangano wa Matiko, swirho swa nhlangano wa Xihambano xo Tshwuka na N’weti wo Tshwuka, na vatekaxiave van’wana va nkoka ku burisana hi Nawu wa Vanhu wa Matiko ya Misava.

src: KuhalaliselaIkhabhinethi indlulise kuhalalisela kanye netilokotfo letinhle ku: • ENdvuneni Yetemphilo Dkt.
tgt: Mahungu Ku hoyozelaKhabinete yi hundzisa mahungu ya yona yo hoyozela ni ku navelela mikateko eka:• Holobye wa Rihanyo Dkd Joe Phaahla eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Huvo ya Nkwama wa Misava hinkwayo ku sukela hi ti1 Mudyaxihi 2024.

src: Joe Phaahla ngekukhetfwa kwakhe ku-Bhodi Yesikhwama Semhlaba Wonkhe kusukela mhla lu-1 iNkwekhweti -2024.
tgt: Dkd Phaahla u ta tirha tanihi muyimeri wa xifundzankulu xa Afrika-Vuxa na Dzonga.• Mamozileme ya MaAfrika-Dzonga xikan’we na lava va nga emisaveni hinkwayo, ngopfungopfu ePalestina, hi xiendlakalo xa Eid al-Fitr.

src: Phaahla utawusebenta njengemmeleli wencenye yaseMphumalanga neyaseNingizimu yelivekati i-Afrika.• Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labangeMasulumane Kanye nakulabo labasemhlabeni wonkhe jikelele, ngalokukhetsekile labase-Palestine, emcimbini we-Eid al-Fitr.
tgt: Ramadan nakambe i nkarhi wa ku anakanyisisa endzeni, ku pfuna na ku tinyiketela ka ximoya loko Mamozileme ya lwela ku kula ka ximoya na ku tikhoma.

src: I-Ramadan nayo isikhatsi sekuzindla kwangekhatsi, kuphana nekutinikela ngekwemoya lapho emaSulumane alwela kukhula ngekwemoya nekutitsiba.
